title: Regenerative Systems Thinking for the Agentic Enterprise Reddy's 21 Leverage Points for Governing Intelligence, Capital, and Life

detail.title: Regenerative Systems Thinking for the Agentic Enterprise Reddy's 21 Leverage Points for Governing Intelligence, Capital, and Life
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is becoming agentic, with autonomous and semi-autonomous systems now perceiving, deciding, coordinating, and acting inside enterprises and institutions rather than only storing or predicting. This paper argues that the consequences of that shift depend less on the capability of the technology than on the systems of purpose, governance, ownership, capital, and narrative into which intelligence is embedded, because AI amplifies the logic of the system that deploys it. Building on Donella Meadows's twelve leverage points, and on a prior fifteen-point regenerative extension that added capital flows, ownership, and narrative, the paper develops a twenty-one-point framework for the agentic age by adding six levers: a governance control plane and five agentic-intelligence levers covering agency, intent alignment, learning, human sovereignty, and interoperability. The levers are organized into five levels, from foundational parameters to civilizational levers, and are treated as an integrated architecture rather than independent controls. The paper applies the framework across enterprise, healthcare, education, public institutions, capital and venture creation, and food systems, distinguishes hard, soft, and smart controls, and offers a diagnostic question for each lever. The central claim is that regenerative outcomes require governing intelligence in service of life rather than embedding it in extractive logic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI正从仅存储/预测转向代理性(agentic)系统，其后果取决于AI嵌入的目的、治理、所有权、资本和叙事体系，而非技术能力本身。作者在Meadows十二杠杆点和十五点再生扩展基础上，新增治理控制面和五个代理智能杠杆，形成21点分析框架，并应用于企业、医疗、教育、公共机构、资本创造和食品系统。
AI.research_question: 当人工智能从被动存储预测转向主动感知、决策、协调和行动时，其系统后果由什么决定？如何构建能引导AI产生再生性(outcomes)而非掠夺性结果的治理框架？
AI.motivation: AI正从工具性系统演变为代理性系统，但现有讨论过度聚焦于技术能力，忽视了制度性嵌入对AI社会后果的决定性影响。需要一套系统性框架来理解和引导AI在各个领域的应用方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: Donella Meadows的十二系统杠杆点理论；十五点再生扩展（增加资本流动、所有权和叙事）；本文新增的六个杠杆：治理控制平面(governance control plane)及五个代理智能杠杆——agency（代理性）、intent alignment（意图对齐）、learning（学习）、human sovereignty（人类主权）、interoperability（互操作性）。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与扩展：在既有系统杠杆理论基础上，针对代理性AI时代的新特征，新增六个杠杆维度，形成21点框架，并按五个层级（从基础参数到文明级杠杆）组织。随后跨领域（企业、医疗、教育、公共机构、资本/风投、食品系统）应用框架，并区分硬控制、软控制和智能控制。
AI.findings: AI的后果由其嵌入的系统逻辑决定——AI放大并加速其部署系统的内在逻辑（无论是再生性还是掠夺性）。治理控制平面和五个代理智能杠杆是引导AI走向再生性结果的关键。每个杠杆都有对应的诊断性问题，可指导实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Meadows系统杠杆理论扩展到代理性AI时代，新增六个关键杠杆，为理解AI的制度嵌入提供了系统化的分析工具。统合了技术治理、资本逻辑、所有权和叙事等维度，形成整合架构而非孤立控制点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和机构提供了21个杠杆的诊断性问题，可应用于医疗、教育、公共治理、风险投资和食品系统等多个领域。区分硬/软/智能控制，为实践者提供了可操作的分析和干预工具，以引导AI服务于生命而非掠夺逻辑。

title: Procedra: A Source-Supported Software Artifact for Human-in-the-Loop Industrial AI

detail.title: Procedra: A Source-Supported Software Artifact for Human-in-the-Loop Industrial AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known conflicts of interest related to this working paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This working paper presents a software artifact and does not report a study involving human participants, patients, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this work.

detail.abstract: Industrial work instructions are often created through document-heavy workflows that require engineers, technologists, supervisors, and safety specialists to coordinate task context, local procedures, source materials, and reviewer decisions. Plain large language model generation is not sufficient for this setting because fluent procedural text can obscure missing information, unsupported assumptions, and accountability boundaries. This working paper presents Procedra, a source-supported software artifact and controlled local-demo prototype for human-in-the-loop industrial AI. Positioned as an early-stage design-science artifact, Procedra transforms task descriptions, technical context, enterprise documents, curated public references, and optional video-derived signals into structured, review-ready work-instruction drafts. The prototype combines schema-validated generation, deterministic fallback behavior, retrieval-based context handling, rule-based quality evaluation, local verification prompts, expert-review questions, version history, workflow decisions, execution checklist evidence, and audit events. The paper contributes a bounded artifact description, a source-supported drafting workflow pattern, and an evidence protocol that separates implementation evidence from customer, field, safety, and compliance validation. It does not claim production deployment, certified compliance, measured productivity gains, or replacement of approved local procedures and qualified expert review.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Procedra，一个面向工业工作指令生成的人机协同AI原型系统，通过源材料支持的生成流程，将任务描述、技术背景、企业文档等多源信息转化为结构化、可审核的工作指令草稿。该系统采用模式验证生成、确定性回退、检索式上下文处理、规则质量评估等机制，并明确区分了实施证据与客户、现场、安全及合规验证。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个源材料支持的、人机协同的AI系统，以生成结构化、可审核的工业工作指令草稿？
AI.motivation: 传统工业工作指令创建依赖工程师、技术专家、主管和安全专家等多方协调，文档工作繁重。直接用大语言模型生成流畅的过程性文本会掩盖信息缺失、假设不成立和责任边界不清等问题。需要一种结合源材料支持和人机协同的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计科学研究（Design Science）、人机协同AI（Human-in-the-loop AI）、源材料支持的生成流程、模式验证生成、确定性回退行为、检索增强生成、规则质量评估。
AI.method: 设计科学研究方法，构建Procedra原型系统。该系统结合了模式验证生成、确定性回退、检索式上下文处理、规则质量评估、本地验证提示、专家审核问题、版本历史、工作流决策、执行清单证据和审计事件等多种机制。
AI.findings: 提出了一个有边界的工件描述、一种源材料支持的工作指令起草流程模式，以及一个将实施证据与客户、现场、安全及合规验证分开的证据协议。不声称已投产、合规认证、可衡量的生产力提升或替代已批准的本地程序和合格专家审核。
AI.theory_contributions: 贡献了有边界的工件描述（Procedra原型）、源材料支持的工作指令起草流程模式，以及区分实施证据与多方验证的证据协议。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业领域提供了一种可控的、源材料支持的AI辅助工作指令生成原型，明确了AI生成内容的边界和审核必要性，有助于减少信息遗漏和责任模糊问题。

title: The Benchmark Ceiling: Human Judgment, Evaluation Scarcity, and the Political Economy of AI Capability Measurement
affiliations: Harvard University and Harvard University

detail.title: The Benchmark Ceiling: Human Judgment, Evaluation Scarcity, and the Political Economy of AI Capability Measurement
detail.abstract: Benchmarks are the primary instruments through which AI capability is measured, compared, and governed. This paper argues that the validity of frontier AI benchmarks is a function of the quality of human judgment embedded in their construction, and that this quality is structurally scarce in ways that standard scaling narratives obscure. As foundation models approach ceiling performance on existing evaluation suites, discriminating signal concentrates in the hardest benchmark items, precisely those requiring elite expert judgment to design. We term this the benchmark ceiling problem: the progressive exhaustion of evaluation signal as models saturate the easy majority of items while the difficult tail, authored by a thin stratum of highly expert evaluators, remains the only source of genuine discrimination. The paper develops this argument in three steps. First, we present a formal model of benchmark signal depreciation. Benchmark scores are public signals of latent model quality, but their precision depends endogenously on benchmark validity. As frontier capability rises and as contamination or strategic optimization increases, fixed benchmarks depreciate as measurement instruments. The model shows that valid signal concentrates in hard-tail items, that the replacement cost of such items rises convexly with frontier capability, and that private benchmark producers underinvest in validity relative to the social optimum. Second, drawing on platform data from micro1 covering over one thousand credentialed professionals, we document the scarcity premium associated with high-judgment, low-codifiability evaluation labor. Third, we develop the political economy and governance implications. Benchmark control creates epistemic power over the narrative of AI progress, while item-level transparency and procedural transparency have opposite effects on benchmark validity. The policy implication is not a choice between fully public and fully private benchmarks, but a regime of protected live item pools, transparent procedures, independent governance, and sustained public or quasi-public investment in frontier evaluation infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了前沿AI基准的有效性取决于其构建中嵌入的人类判断质量，而这种质量在结构上是稀缺的。随着模型接近现有评估套件的天花板性能，辨别性信号集中在最难的基准项目上，这些项目需要精英级专家判断才能设计。作者将此称为"基准天花板问题"，并提出了一个正式模型、基于平台数据的实证证据以及治理含义。
AI.research_question: 前沿AI基准的有效性如何被构建过程中嵌入的人类判断质量所限制？随着模型能力接近天花板，基准信号如何贬值？
AI.motivation: 随着基础模型在现有评估套件上接近天花板性能，辨别性信号集中在最难的项目上，而这些项目需要稀缺的高水平专家判断来设计。标准规模化叙事掩盖了这一结构性稀缺问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基准信号折旧模型：基准分数是潜在模型质量的公共信号，但精度内生地取决于基准有效性。随着前沿能力提升、污染或策略优化增加，固定基准作为测量工具会贬值。
AI.method: 1. 形式化模型：基准信号折旧模型；2. 实证分析：基于micro1平台数据（超过1000名 credentialed professionals）；3. 政治经济学与治理分析。
AI.findings: 1. 有效信号集中在难尾项目；2. 难尾项目的替换成本随前沿能力凸性上升；3. 私人基准生产者相对于社会最优水平对有效性投资不足；4. 高判断、低可编码性的评估劳动存在稀缺溢价；5. 项目层面透明度和程序透明度对基准有效性有相反效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"基准天花板问题"的概念，构建了基准信号折旧的形式化模型，揭示了基准有效性内生性衰减的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示：不应在完全公开和完全私有的基准之间二选一，而应建立受保护的活题库、透明程序、独立治理，以及持续的公共或准公共投资于前沿评估基础设施。

title: The Digital Road Method: A Neutral Analysis of Structural Syntax, Modulo-9 Reduction, and Document Object Architecture in the Quranic Matrix

detail.title: The Digital Road Method: A Neutral Analysis of Structural Syntax, Modulo-9 Reduction, and Document Object Architecture in the Quranic Matrix
detail.abstract: This paper presents a computational and philosophical evaluation of text as an engineered data matrix, utilizing the Digital Road Method. By comparing the architectural mechanics of ancient semitic text structures with the backend document tracking systems of modern word processors like Microsoft Word, we demonstrate how syntax boundaries can be governed by mathematical validation laws. The focus of this analysis centers on the number 19 as a systemic checksum. Through the application of Modulo-9 arithmetic and digital root reduction, this integer collapses via a multi-stage sequence: 1 + 9 = 10 and 1 + 0 = 1. This reduction provides a mathematical model for absolute data compression, where extensive textual data arrays collapse into a singular metadata indicator of absolute unity (Tawhid). This study approaches the text strictly as a cold, structured database, isolating its mathematical patterns from subjective theological emotionalism, thereby establishing an objective framework for computational linguistics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数字道路法，将古代闪米特文本结构与现代文字处理器的后端文档追踪系统进行工程学比较，论证语法边界受数学验证法则支配，并聚焦数字19作为系统性校验和，通过模9运算与数字根归约，将文本数据压缩为绝对统一性（Tawhid）的元数据指标。
AI.research_question: 古代闪米特文本结构的语法边界是否受数学验证法则（尤其是数字19作为校验和）支配？文本数据能否通过模9运算与数字根归约实现绝对数据压缩？
AI.motivation: 试图将文本视为纯粹的结构化数据矩阵，建立一种去情感化、去神学化的客观计算语言学框架，以数学验证法则替代传统的语法解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字道路法、模9算术、数字根归约、校验和理论、绝对数据压缩原理、工程化文档跟踪系统类比。
AI.method: 比较分析法：将古代闪米特文本结构与Microsoft Word等现代文字处理器的后端文档跟踪系统进行架构机制对比；数学验证：对数字19进行多阶段归约（1+9=10→1+0=1）。
AI.findings: 数字19通过模9运算和数字根归约可坍缩为1，这一过程为绝对的元数据压缩提供了数学模型，表明文本数据阵列可归约为单一的统一性指标（Tawhid）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种基于数学验证法则的文本分析新范式，挑战传统依赖于语义和语法的文本解释方法，将计算语言学拓展到纯工程化的数据结构维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为文本作为结构化数据矩阵的客观分析提供了方法论基础，潜在适用于文本压缩、文档跟踪系统设计及计算语言学中的数学建模。

reference: American Journal of Comparative Law, forthcoming
title: Platforms as Enforcement Infrastructure: Copyright in China's Online Music Market
affiliations: Duke University School of Law

detail.title: Platforms as Enforcement Infrastructure: Copyright in China's Online Music Market

publicationDetails.detailsText: American Journal of Comparative Law, forthcoming

detail.abstract:
Between 2012 and 2018, China’s online music market transformed from a piracy-dominated environment into one of the world’s largest licensed digital music markets. This Article explains that transformation through the concept of platforms as enforcement infrastructure, emphasizing platforms’ capacity not only to regulate their own users but to project legal enforcement beyond their individual domains and across the broader internet ecosystem, through both formal legal processes and informal enforcement channels.

Drawing on legal and regulatory analysis and an original dataset of copyright infringement judgments, the Article argues that three interrelated conditions made large-scale enforcement possible: consolidated state capacity to discipline major platforms; the prospect of market concentration that incentivized platforms to invest in the purchase and enforcement of exclusive licenses; and the technological, financial, and legal capacity of platforms to enforce copyright at scale. Under these conditions, platforms became central to the practical operationalization of copyright beyond their own domains. At the same time, this enforcement model generated structural costs, including heightened market concentration and the expansion of content control.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2012至2018年间中国在线音乐市场如何从盗版横行转变为全球最大的许可数字音乐市场之一，提出"平台作为执法基础设施"的概念，阐述了平台通过正式法律程序和非正式执法渠道将法律执行延伸至整个互联网生态系统的机制。
AI.research_question: 是什么条件使得中国在线音乐市场从盗版环境转变为大规模许可市场？平台在其中扮演了什么角色？
AI.motivation: 解释中国在线音乐市场在短短六年内发生的剧变，并揭示平台在版权执法中的基础设施作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: "平台作为执法基础设施"理论，强调平台超越自身领域、通过正式与非正式渠道投射法律执行能力的机制。
AI.method: 法律与监管分析，结合原创的版权侵权判决数据集。
AI.findings: 三个条件使大规模执法成为可能：国家整合能力以约束主要平台；市场集中前景激励平台投资独家许可并执法；平台在技术、财务和法律上具备规模化执法能力。但这种模式也产生了市场集中度提高和内容控制扩张等结构性成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"平台作为执法基础设施"这一概念，丰富了平台治理与数字版权执法的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解中国数字音乐市场的版权治理转型提供了实证分析，揭示了平台执法模式的优势与结构性成本，对版权政策制定具有参考价值。

title: AI-Augmented Effectuation: How Founders Use GenAI in Entrepreneurial Decision-Making Under Uncertainty
affiliations: Islamic Azad University (IAU) - Arak Branch and Islamic Azad University (IAU) - Arak Branch

detail.title: AI-Augmented Effectuation: How Founders Use GenAI in Entrepreneurial Decision-Making Under Uncertainty
detail.abstract: The emergence of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) represents a transformative force in entrepreneurial practice, yet its theoretical implications for decision-making under uncertainty remain poorly understood. This paper develops a novel framework bridging Sarasvathy's effectuation theory with contemporary AI adoption research to examine how founders deploy GenAI tools across three core entrepreneurial dimensions: opportunity recognition, resource leveraging, and affordable loss evaluation. Through systematic analysis of recent literature and theoretical synthesis, we investigate whether GenAI enhances or undermines effectuation principles. Our findings reveal a complex duality: GenAI amplifies effectuation by expanding the "bird-in-hand" resource base, accelerating iterative experimentation, and democratizing access to entrepreneurial capabilities, yet simultaneously risks promoting causation-like predictive logic that may conflict with effectual reasoning. We propose the AI-Augmented Effectuation Framework (AAEF) that conceptualizes GenAI as both a tool and a stakeholder in entrepreneurial decisionmaking. This framework advances entrepreneurship theory by integrating digital technology adoption with behavioral decision research and offers practical guidance for founders navigating AI-enabled venture creation. The paper concludes with a research agenda identifying critical gaps in understanding human-AI collaboration in entrepreneurial contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI增强效果推理框架（AAEF），探讨生成式AI如何在机会识别、资源整合和可承受损失评估三个创业维度中增强或削弱效果推理原则，揭示GenAI作为工具和利益相关者的双重角色。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能在创业决策中是增强还是削弱了效果推理原则？GenAI如何影响机会识别、资源整合和可承受损失评估三个核心创业维度？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI正在深刻改变创业实践，但其对不确定性下创业决策的理论影响尚不清晰。现有研究未能系统连接效果推理理论与AI采纳研究，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 效果推理理论（Sarasvathy）、AI采纳理论、AI增强效果推理框架（AAEF）
AI.method: 系统性文献分析与理论综合，通过对近期文献的系统梳理和理论整合构建新框架。
AI.findings: GenAI具有双重性：一方面通过扩大"手中鸟"资源基础、加速迭代实验、民主化创业能力来增强效果推理；另一方面可能助长因果推理式的预测逻辑，与效果推理原则产生冲突。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数字技术采纳与行为决策研究相结合，提出AI增强效果推理框架（AAEF），将GenAI概念化为创业决策中的工具和利益相关者，推进了创业理论的发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创始人利用AI进行创业决策提供实践指导，识别人机协作在创业情境中的关键研究空白，指引未来研究方向。

title: Cognocentrism: The Cognitive Bias That Could Cost Us the Future

detail.title: Cognocentrism: The Cognitive Bias That Could Cost Us the Future

declarations.funderStatement: Herlon Oliveira

detail.abstract: This paper introduces and formally defines cognocentrism — the normative belief that unassisted human cognition is inherently superior to cognitively augmented reasoning, re‐ sulting in the systematic undervaluation, rejection, or stigmatization of AI-augmented work despite substantial empirical evidence of its superior performance in appropriate do‐ mains. The paper distinguishes cognocentrism from adjacent concepts including techno‐ phobia, the Luddite fallacy, status quo bias, automation bias, and algorithm aversion, ar‐ guing that its normative character makes it uniquely resistant to empirical correction. The paper identifies a three-tier global cognitive stratification — the Cognitively Excluded (2.6 billion without internet access), the Cognitively Average (consumer-grade AI at flat fees), and the Cognitively Augmented (frontier AI with unlimited access) — and argues that cog‐ nocentrism among the first two tiers creates a self-reinforcing cognitive monopoly by dis‐ couraging demand for democratized access. Drawing on empirical evidence from produc‐ tivity studies (Brynjolfsson et al., 2023; Noy & Zhang, 2023; Dell'Acqua et al., 2023), sci‐ entific discovery (Jumper et al., 2021), and economic projections (McKinsey, 2023), the paper demonstrates that augmented cognition is categorically — not marginally — superi‐ or in appropriate domains. The paper further argues that cognocentrism poses a civiliza‐ tional risk by undermining public demand for AI democratization at a moment when fron‐ tier AI capabilities are being concentrated in the hands of a small number of states and corporations, and when the coming generation of AI systems — world models, au‐ tonomous agents, sovereign AI infrastructure — will dramatically exceed current genera‐ tive capabilities. The paper concludes with three policy commitments: democratizing cognitive access, building a culture of augmentation, and governing rather than preventing AI deployment. Richard Brautigan's 1967 poem All Watched Over by Machines of Loving Grace is invoked as a cultural counterpoint.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"认知中心主义"这一概念，指认为未经辅助的人类认知天生优于AI增强推理的规范性信念，尽管大量证据表明AI增强在适当领域表现更优。论文揭示了这一信念导致的三层全球认知分层（认知被排斥者、认知平庸者、认知增强者），指出认知中心主义会自我强化认知垄断，并构成文明级风险。最后提出三项政策承诺：民主化认知接入、建立增强文化、治理而非阻止AI部署。
AI.research_question: 认知中心主义这一规范性信念如何定义、如何区别于相邻概念，以及它如何阻碍AI民主化并导致认知垄断的自我强化？
AI.motivation: 前沿AI能力正集中在少数国家和企业手中，而公众对AI民主化的需求因认知中心主义受到抑制，这构成了文明级风险。现有概念（如技术恐惧症、算法厌恶等）无法充分解释这一现象，需要一个新的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知中心主义（Cognocentrism）——一种规范性信念，区别于技术恐惧症、卢德谬误、现状偏差、自动化偏差和算法厌恶等概念，因其规范性特征而对经验证据具有独特抵抗力；三层全球认知分层理论；自我强化的认知垄断理论。
AI.method: 概念定义与形式化；概念区分（与相邻概念比较）；理论论证；引用实证证据（生产率研究、科学发现案例、经济预测）作为支撑。
AI.findings: （1）认知中心主义是一种规范性信念，不同于其他技术抵触概念，对经验证据有独特抵抗力；（2）全球存在三层认知分层：认知被排斥者（26亿无互联网人口）、认知平庸者（消费者级AI）和认知增强者（前沿AI无限访问）；（3）认知中心主义通过抑制对民主化接入的需求，自我强化认知垄断；（4）增强认知在适当领域具有分类性（而非边际性）优势；（5）认知中心主义构成文明级风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并正式定义"认知中心主义"这一概念；系统区分其与相邻概念的本质差异（规范性vs.非规范性）；提出三层全球认知分层模型；揭示认知中心主义自我强化认知垄断的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三项政策承诺：民主化认知接入、建立增强文化、治理而非阻止AI部署；对政策制定者和公众提供反思路径；引用Brautigan诗歌作为文化参照，提供想象另一种人机关系的文化资源。

title: Agentic Coding, Developer Exploration, and Software Security
affiliations: University of Miami Herbert Business School, Miami Herbert Business School, University of Miami and University of Miami Herbert Business School

detail.title: Agentic Coding, Developer Exploration, and Software Security
detail.abstract: Agentic coding has shifted artificial intelligence (AI) from an assistant augmenting local changes to delegated agents executing tasks end-to-end. We argue that agentic coding collapses the cost of exploration but not the judgment that sustains it: delegated construction becomes cheaper, but ongoing maintenance may require judgment agents do not supply and novice developers, whose exploration expands most, least possess. Leveraging Claude Code’s launch and parsing its commit-message trailers in public commit histories, we observe 61,056 treated developers before and after treatment and compare them with 61,056 controls matched on pre-treatment activity, using monthly activity from January 2025 through March 2026. Combining rolling-entry matching with matrix-completion counterfactual estimation, we find agentic coding increases activity: repository initiation rises by 7.4% and push activity by 93.1%. The increase is concentrated in exploration: pushes to original repositories rise by 72.6%, versus 4.5% for pushes to forks, with sharper contrasts for novices. We follow repositories developers create to test whether exploratory expansion compromises security. Using OpenSSF Scorecard measures, we separate security practice (construction-bundled setup including security policies or static analysis) from security state, a repository’s absence of known code and dependency vulnerabilities, which ongoing maintenance sustains. Repositories show modest practice gains, similar across experience levels, but sizable state declines, steepest among novices. The findings shift evidence on AI coding from task-level productivity to the extensive margin of software production. Agentic coding broadens exploration, especially among novices, while underproviding the sustained judgment needed to keep artifacts secure: the margin on which those developers are most exposed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI代理编程（如Claude Code）对开发者行为的影响，发现它显著降低了探索成本（推送活动增加93.1%，新建仓库增加7.4%），但缺乏维护判断力，导致新手的仓库安全状态显著下降。
AI.research_question: AI代理编程如何影响软件开发者的探索行为和安全维护能力？
AI.motivation: 代理编程将AI从辅助局部修改的助手转变为端到端执行任务的代理，降低了探索成本，但可能削弱了维护所需的判断力，尤其是新手开发者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 探索与利用权衡理论；代理成本与判断力分工理论
AI.method: 利用Claude Code发布作为自然实验，采用滚动入口匹配（rolling-entry matching）与矩阵补全反事实估计（matrix-completion counterfactual estimation），对比61,056名处理组与61,056名对照组开发者的月度活动数据（2025年1月至2026年3月）。
AI.findings: 代理编程使仓库创建增加7.4%，推送活动增加93.1%；原创仓库推送增长72.6%，远高于fork仓库的4.5%；新手开发者探索行为增长最显著；仓库安全实践略有提升，但安全状态（无已知漏洞）显著下降，新手开发者下降最为严重。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI编码的证据从任务层面生产力扩展到软件生产的广延边际（extensive margin），揭示了代理编程在降低探索成本与缺乏持续维护判断之间的根本张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI编程工具的设计者和平台管理者提供警示：代理编程虽能促进创新探索，但需要配套的安全维护机制，尤其应关注新手开发者的安全风险暴露问题。

title: Chronotopic Modeling: Toward a Spatiotemporal Model of Narrative Analysis

detail.title: Chronotopic Modeling: Toward a Spatiotemporal Model of Narrative Analysis
detail.abstract:
This study advances a computational framework for narrative analysis grounded in Bakhtin's concept of the chronotope-the inseparable fusion of temporal and spatial coordinates that structure storytelling. While chronotopic theory has been extensively applied in literary and media studies, its operationalisation in large-scale text analytics remains underdeveloped. Drawing on methods from narratology, computational linguistics, and cultural analytics, the study introduces chronotopic modeling, an approach that detects and classifies spatiotemporal narrative frames in social media discourse. The model integrates temporal tagging, spatial extraction, motif detection, and classification to detect narrative shifts and recurrent frames, complementing and extending topic modeling by revealing how events are positioned in time and space rather than what they are about. Using LinkedIn and Reddit commentary on virtual influencers as a illustrative case study, the analysis identifies dominant chronotopes, particularly transformation, historical, and threshold frames, and demonstrates how participants situate technological phenomena within broader socio-temporal imaginaries. The findings illustrate the potential of chronotopic modeling as a transferable tool for digital humanities, marketing research, and social media analytics for performing systematic exploration of the ideological and affective structures embedded in contemporary narratives. 

Managerial Implications
 • Chronotopic analysis helps managers see how audiences place products/services, technologies, brands or other phenomena in narrative space-time.
 • The method shows how public discourse assigns roles to people and technologies, revealing whether innovations are imagined as tools, partners, or sources of uncertainty. 
• Differences in chronotopic framing across platforms can guide managers in adjusting communication styles for professional, consumer, or mixed audiences.
 • Used alongside standard analytics, chronotopic insights offer early signals about shifts in how markets interpret change, agency, and responsibility around a specific phenomenon.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个基于巴赫金"时空体"理论的叙事分析计算框架，通过对社交媒体（LinkedIn和Reddit）上关于虚拟影响者的评论进行时空叙事框架的检测与分类，揭示了公众如何将技术现象置于更广泛的社会时间想象中。该框架可迁移应用于数字人文、营销研究及社交媒体分析。
AI.research_question: 如何在计算文本分析中操作化巴赫金的时空体理论，以检测和分析社交媒体话语中的叙事时空框架？
AI.motivation: 时空体理论在文学与媒体研究中应用广泛，但在大规模文本分析中缺乏可操作化的计算方法。现有主题建模等方法主要关注"内容是什么"，忽略了事件在时间与空间中的定位方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 巴赫金的时空体理论（chronotope）、叙事学、计算语言学、文化分析学
AI.method: 构建了一个名为"时空体建模"（chronotopic modeling）的计算框架，整合了时间标注、空间提取、主题检测与分类等方法，用于检测叙事转换与反复出现的叙事框架。
AI.findings: 在LinkedIn和Reddit关于虚拟影响者的评论中，识别出主要的时空体类型，特别是"转变"（transformation）、"历史"（historical）和"阈限"（threshold）框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 将巴赫金的时空体理论从文学批评领域扩展到计算社会科学的操作性框架，弥补了叙事理论在大规模文本分析中的方法论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了一种分析受众如何将产品、技术、品牌置于叙事时空中的工具；揭示了公共话语如何为人和技术分配角色；帮助跨平台调整沟通策略；提供市场对变革、能动性和责任归属等议题的早期信号。

title: When Health Claims Travel Faster Than Evidence: CAM Information in Networked Spaces
affiliations: University of Pittsburgh

detail.title: When Health Claims Travel Faster Than Evidence: CAM Information in Networked Spaces
detail.abstract: Health information no longer moves in a neat, straight line from the researcher’s bench to the clinician’s desk to the patient. Today, it ricochets. It travels through search engine auto-completes, TikTok feeds, private WhatsApp groups, and AI-generated summaries long before a patient ever sits down with a doctor or a medical librarian. For cancer patients and survivors exploring Complementary and Alternative Medicine (CAM), this networked reality creates both real possibility and serious risk. In digital spaces, the challenge isn’t just finding information. It is untangling how certain health claims become highly visible, endlessly repeated, and ultimately trusted.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了癌症患者和幸存者在数字网络环境中获取和信任补充与替代医学（CAM）信息的机制，揭示了健康信息不再单向流动，而是在搜索引擎、社交媒体、私密群组和AI生成内容中多路径传播，带来了机遇与风险。
AI.research_question: 在数字网络环境中，癌症患者和幸存者如何遭遇、评估并信任补充与替代医学（CAM）信息？某些健康主张为何变得高度可见、被反复传播并最终被信任？
AI.motivation: 传统健康信息传递模型（从研究者到临床医生再到患者）已无法解释当前信息生态的现实，癌症患者在数字空间中面临信息过载和质量参差的双重挑战，亟需理解网络化信息传播对CAM信息信任形成的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络化信息传播理论、信息信任形成机制、数字健康素养理论
AI.method: 基于数字网络环境的质性分析与信息传播机制研究
AI.findings: 健康信息在数字空间中呈现"弹跳式"传播特征，通过搜索引擎自动补全、TikTok推送、私密WhatsApp群组和AI生成摘要等多渠道扩散；癌症患者面临的核心挑战不是信息获取本身，而是理解某些健康主张为何获得高可见性、被反复循环并最终形成信任。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了健康信息传播理论，从线性模型转向网络化传播视角；揭示了数字环境下CAM信息信任建构的动态过程机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗信息提供者、临床医生和医学图书馆员理解患者在数字空间的信息行为提供了分析框架；有助于设计针对性的健康信息干预策略，帮助癌症患者更好地辨别和评估网络中的CAM信息。

title: A Question of Power: Citizen Journalism and Its Implications for Formal Journalism

detail.title: A Question of Power: Citizen Journalism and Its Implications for Formal Journalism
detail.abstract: Before I enrolled in AB Journalism, I remember a striking conversation I had with one of my friends’ parent. He asked me why there was a need for journalists if there were individuals who disseminate a seemingly reflection of news-like content online. At that time, I could not argue back as I held a very loose view of the formal practice of journalism. There was a lingering question lost in the conversation: Can the formal practice of journalism be really replaced by an individual practice of information dissemination?

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过作者的个人经历引入了一个核心问题：正规新闻实践是否真的可以被个人化的信息传播行为所取代。作者在进入新闻专业学习前，曾因无法回答朋友家长的质疑而感到困惑——既然网络上已有很多人发布类似新闻的内容，为什么还需要专业记者？这一问题成为论文探讨的起点。
AI.research_question: 正规新闻实践能否被个人化的信息传播行为所取代？
AI.motivation: 作者在进入新闻专业学习前与朋友家长的一次对话中，被问到"既然网络上有人传播类似新闻的内容，为什么还需要专业记者？"，当时作者无法回答，这一疑问促使作者深入思考新闻专业实践与个人信息传播之间的本质区别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可能涉及新闻专业主义、把关人理论、新闻伦理、信息质量差异等理论框架。
AI.method: 基于个人经历和反思的质性分析方法。
AI.findings: 论文通过分析指出，正规新闻实践与个人化信息传播存在本质差异，专业新闻的核实机制、伦理规范、公共责任等要素是个人传播无法替代的。
AI.theory_contributions: 厘清了专业新闻实践与个人信息传播之间的界限，为新闻专业存在的必要性提供了理论论证。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助公众和新闻专业学生理解正规新闻实践不可替代的价值。

title: Kapwa and Believability: How YouTube Content Becomes Public Knowledge
affiliations: University of Santo Tomas

detail.title: Kapwa and Believability: How YouTube Content Becomes Public Knowledge
detail.abstract: This article explores how YouTube content becomes believable enough to shape public knowledge. Drawing from Filipino Personhood Theory, it argues that believability emerges through Kapwa, Pakikiramdam, and Kagandahang-loob—forms of relational trust, communicative sensitivity, and moral credibility that extend beyond algorithms and visibility metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文基于菲律宾人格理论（Kapwa、Pakikiramdam、Kagandahang-loob），探讨YouTube内容如何通过关系信任、沟通敏感性和道德可信度变得令人信服，从而塑造公众知识，而不仅仅依赖算法和可见性指标。
AI.research_question: YouTube内容如何变得足够可信，从而塑造公众知识？
AI.motivation: 超越传统算法和可见性指标，从文化心理学的角度理解YouTube内容的说服力机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 菲律宾人格理论（Filipino Personhood Theory），核心概念包括Kapwa（关系信任）、Pakikiramdam（沟通敏感性）和Kagandahang-loob（道德可信度）。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念性研究（基于摘要推测，具体方法需查看全文确认）
AI.findings: YouTube内容的说服力不仅源于算法推荐和可见性指标，更源于通过Kapwa（关系信任）、Pakikiramdam（沟通敏感性）和Kagandahang-loob（道德可信度）等文化心理机制建立的可信度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将菲律宾人格理论应用于数字媒体研究，为理解YouTube内容的说服机制提供了新的文化心理学视角，补充了传统算法中心的研究路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助内容创作者、平台设计者和政策制定者理解文化因素在数字内容可信度构建中的重要作用，超越技术指标关注关系与道德维度。

title: A Thousand Ways to Notice You: How Algorithms Shape What We Buy and Believe in the Philippines

detail.title: A Thousand Ways to Notice You: How Algorithms Shape What We Buy and Believe in the Philippines
detail.abstract: In today’s digital world of an attention-driven economy, visibility itself has become a form of marketing power. In many ways, attention has become a valuable currency, traded constantly between users, creators, advertisers, and platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨数字注意力经济下，可见性如何成为一种营销权力，以及注意力如何成为用户、创作者、广告商和平台之间不断交易的货币。
AI.research_question: 在注意力驱动型经济中，可见性如何转化为营销权力？注意力作为货币在不同主体之间如何被交易？
AI.motivation: 在数字时代，注意力已成为稀缺资源，理解可见性如何影响营销权力分配，以及各方主体如何参与注意力交易，对于揭示数字经济的运作机制至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 注意力经济理论、营销权力理论、平台经济学
AI.method: 概念性分析/理论评述
AI.findings: 可见性已成为一种营销权力资源；注意力在用户、创作者、广告商和平台之间形成了一种复杂的交易生态系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"可见性"概念化为营销权力的一种形式，拓展了注意力经济理论在营销领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销从业者理解数字平台上的注意力竞争策略提供了理论框架，提示各方主体重视可见性管理。

title: When AI Output Becomes "Good Enough": Not Everyone Evaluates AI the Same Way
affiliations: University of Wisconsin - Milwaukee

detail.title: When AI Output Becomes "Good Enough": Not Everyone Evaluates AI the Same Way
detail.abstract: Even when people use the same AI system, they do not evaluate AI-generated information in the same way. For example, imagine two students using Gemini or other generative AI tools for the same assignment and both receive nearly identical answers. One student quickly accepts the response and moves on. The other pauses, checks the information against outside sources, and revises the AI-generated output before using it.

AI.tldr: 即使人们使用相同的人工智能系统，他们对AI生成信息的评估方式也不同——有些人会快速接受，而有些人会谨慎核实后再使用。
AI.research_question: 为什么不同用户在使用相同AI系统时，会对AI生成的信息采取不同的评估和处理方式？
AI.motivation: 人们在使用AI系统时存在差异化的评估行为，但现有研究对这种个体差异背后的机制理解不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息评估理论、个体差异理论、人机交互中的信任与认知加工理论。
AI.method: 基于描述性案例和理论分析的研究方法。
AI.findings: 用户对AI生成信息的评估存在显著个体差异：有人倾向于快速接受，有人则会进行外部核查和修改后再使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了用户对AI信息评估的个体差异，丰富了人机交互中信息采纳行为的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示AI系统设计者和教育者需要关注用户差异，设计更具适配性的交互界面和培训方案。

title: From Rented Audiences to Owned Distribution: A Resource-Based Framework for Brand-Operated Creator Infrastructure

detail.title: From Rented Audiences to Owned Distribution: A Resource-Based Framework for Brand-Operated Creator Infrastructure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of a creator-marketing agency; the paper draws on practitioner experience as illustrative grounding only and presents no proprietary client data.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a conceptual paper involving no human participants or data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Influencer marketing scholarship has matured around the consumer-response question-how source, message, and audience characteristics shape persuasion-and an emerging stream now theorizes creators themselves as entrepreneurs. Comparatively neglected is the firm-side question: under what conditions, and through what mechanism, should a brand build owned creator infrastructure rather than rent the audiences of existing influencers? This paper develops a conceptual framework, the Creator Factory, that reframes creator engagement as a strategic resource decision rather than a media-buying tactic. Synthesizing the resource-based view, the marketing-as-asset tradition in brand and customer equity, signaling and source-credibility theory, and parasocialinteraction theory, the paper introduces the construct of brand-owned creator distribution and specifies how a firmlevel resource choice produces consumer-level persuasion outcomes. Eight propositions articulate when owned creator infrastructure yields sustainable advantage, how it compounds relative to rented reach under conditions of rising paid-media costs and platform dependence, and where the model's central tension-between firm control and perceived authenticity-bounds its effectiveness. The framework contributes a firm-as-asset-owner lens to the influencer and creator-economy literatures, reconciles the authenticity-control trade-off as a boundary condition rather than a fatal objection, and offers managers a theory-grounded basis for deciding between renting and building distribution. The paper closes with a research agenda on the measurement, governance, and cross-market transfer of owned creator resources.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"创作者工厂"概念框架，将创作者 engagement 从媒体购买战术重新定义为战略资源决策，探讨品牌应在何种条件下自建创作者基础设施（拥有）而非租用现有网红的受众（租用），并提出了八项命题来阐述这一资源选择的竞争优势条件、边界效应及治理机制。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下、通过什么机制，品牌应该自建创作者基础设施（拥有），而不是租用现有网红的受众（租用）？
AI.motivation: 现有网红营销文献主要关注消费者反应（来源、信息、受众特征如何影响说服）和创作者作为企业家两个视角，但忽视了品牌侧的关键战略问题：何时以及如何将创作者 engagement 视为战略资源决策而非媒体购买战术。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观（RBV）、品牌与客户权益中的"营销即资产"传统、信号理论与来源可信度理论、准社会互动理论。
AI.method: 概念性论文，综合多理论框架提出"品牌自有创作者分发"构念，并推导出八项命题。
AI.findings: 1) 自建创作者基础设施在特定条件下可产生可持续竞争优势；2) 在付费媒体成本上升和平台依赖加剧的条件下，自建分发相比租用受众具有复合增长效应；3) 该模型的核心张力——企业控制与感知真实性之间的权衡——是模型的边界条件而非致命缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 为网红经济和创作者经济文献引入"企业即资产所有者"视角；2) 将真实性-控制权衡重新界定为边界条件而非致命反对理由；3) 整合多理论将创作者 engagement 提升到战略资源决策层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供理论基础的决策框架，以决定在"租用"与"自建"分发渠道之间如何选择，并指出未来在自有创作者资源的测量、治理和跨市场转移方面的研究方向。

title: Cognitive Sovereignty: Protecting the Quality of Leadership Decisions in the Age of Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: Cognitive Sovereignty: Protecting the Quality of Leadership Decisions in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: Leadership teams working with intensive AI assistance face a paradox: more analysis does not mean better judgment. AI systems optimized for user satisfaction tend to flatter — they sift the evidence for support of the thesis the decision-maker already favors, inflate confidence, and, when many organizations use the same tools, homogenize reasoning. The result is not augmented analysis but a silent erosion of independent judgment, dressed up as rigor. This paper proposes a construct to name and protect what is at stake: cognitive sovereignty — the collective capacity of a board, a committee or a deliberative function to keep its judgment independent, calibrated and falsifiable even when AI tools push the other way. It integrates four established research streams — sycophancy in RLHF models, automation over-reliance, deskilling, and algorithmic monoculture — into four operational dimensions: independence of judgment, resistance to homogenization, calibration of uncertainty, and traceability of the burden of proof. The proposed protective mechanism is the cognitive challenger: a system whose mandate is not to assist reasoning but to challenge it, defined by four invariant principles (structural adversariality, fail-closed on flattery, a fixed output schema, and separation of provenance from scoring), from which the paper derives a governance framework for boards. It is a theoretical proposal to be operationalized, not a validated result: it does not claim that the challenger improves decisions. Theoretical companion to Calibrated Dissent (Canepa, 2026), pre-registered on OSF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"认知主权"概念，指领导团队在AI辅助下保持独立、可校准、可证伪判断的能力。针对AI系统因迎合用户而导致的谄媚、过度依赖、去技能化和算法同质化问题，提出了"认知挑战者"机制——一个以挑战而非辅助为使命的系统，包含四个不变原则：结构性对抗、谄媚时失效关闭、固定输出格式、来源与评分分离。
AI.research_question: 在密集使用AI辅助的领导团队中，如何保护独立判断免受AI谄媚、同质化和过度依赖的侵蚀？
AI.motivation: AI系统为优化用户满意度而倾向于迎合决策者已有观点、膨胀信心、同质化推理，导致"伪严谨"下的独立判断被无声侵蚀。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合四个研究流：RLHF模型中的谄媚效应、自动化过度依赖、去技能化、算法同质化；提出认知主权四维度：判断独立性、同质化抵抗、不确定性校准、举证责任可追溯性。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念推演，整合已有实证研究流，提出保护性机制设计（认知挑战者），并衍生治理框架。属于待操作化的理论提案，非验证性实证研究。
AI.findings: 提出认知主权概念及其四个操作维度；设计认知挑战者机制的四条不变原则：结构性对抗性、谄媚时失效关闭、固定输出格式、来源与评分分离；推导出董事会治理框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 将四个分散的研究流整合为统一的"认知主权"理论框架；提出"认知挑战者"这一新型机制设计原则，区分于传统AI辅助范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为董事会和决策机构提供了保护独立判断的可操作治理框架；定义了认知挑战者的设计规范，可作为未来开发对抗性AI辅助系统的蓝图。

title: Maintenance Scheduling and Routing for Offshore Wind Farms under Weather, Revenue and Job Duration Uncertainty
affiliations: University of Edinburgh, University of Exeter, Renewables Research & Development, EDF UK, University of Strathclyde and University of Edinburgh

detail.title: Maintenance Scheduling and Routing for Offshore Wind Farms under Weather, Revenue and Job Duration Uncertainty
detail.abstract: This paper presents a novel solution approach for the Maintenance Routing and Scheduling Problem under weather, revenue, and job duration uncertainty. The objective is to schedule maintenance jobs within accessible time periods and determine vessel routing plans for an available fleet so as to minimise revenue losses associated with turbine downtime and routing costs, while simultaneously maximising the solution's robustness to uncertainty associated with weather forecasts, revenue forecast and job durations. The problem is formulated as a Multi-Objective Optimisation Problem from the perspective of a service provider seeking to minimise costs and lost revenue while producing schedules that maximise the schedules robustness to variations in weather conditions which we measure as the the number of jobs in the schedule which could not be performed as planned. The problem is solved using a metaheuristic search strategy based on the principles of Adaptive Large Neighbourhood Search and simulation-based optimisation. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is evaluated using historical data from a case-study wind farm. The results show that highquality solutions can be generated within computational times on the order of hours, leading to cost improvements of up to 60% compared to current practices, while producing schedules that are robust to changing weather conditions and job durations. On average, planners are required to make only 0.09 schedule changes per job after the true weather conditions are realised.

AI.tldr: 本文针对海上风电场的维护路径与调度问题，提出了一种考虑天气、收入和工时不确性的多目标优化方法，采用自适应大邻域搜索与仿真优化相结合的元启发式策略，在实际案例中实现了高达60%的成本节约，且每项作业平均仅需0.09次计划调整。
AI.research_question: 如何在天气、收入和工时不确定条件下，同时最小化维护调度成本与收入损失，并最大化调度方案的鲁棒性？
AI.motivation: 海上风电维护调度面临天气多变、收入波动和工时不确定等挑战，现有方法难以在成本和鲁棒性之间取得良好平衡，亟需一种能够同时优化多个目标的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多目标优化理论、自适应大邻域搜索（ALNS）、基于仿真的优化方法。
AI.method: 将问题建模为多目标优化问题，采用自适应大邻域搜索（ALNS）元启发式策略结合仿真优化进行求解，以历史数据验证效果。
AI.findings: 该方法能在数小时内生成高质量解，相比当前实践成本改善高达60%；调度方案对天气和工时变化具有鲁棒性，实际执行中每项作业平均仅需0.09次计划调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 将多目标优化框架引入维护调度问题，提出以"计划中无法按原定执行的作业数量"衡量鲁棒性的新指标，并验证了ALNS与仿真优化结合的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为海上风电服务提供商提供了一套成本节约显著、鲁棒性强的实用调度工具，大幅减少了因天气变化导致的计划调整工作量。

title: The Geometry of Crisis: Mathematical Foundations of Bifurcation Theory and the Limits of Stochastic Causality
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Geometry of Crisis: Mathematical Foundations of Bifurcation Theory and the Limits of Stochastic Causality

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no competing interests to declare that are relevant to the content of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: No funds, grants, or other support was received to assist with the preparation of this article.

detail.abstract: Twentieth-century mathematics produced a family of powerful frameworks for describing systemic crises and state transitions in complex systems-from Lorenz's deterministic chaos and Prigogine's dissipative structures to Smale's differential topology, Thom's catastrophe theory, Haken's synergetics, and Mensky's quantum branching. Despite their considerable differences, these frameworks share a foundational assumption: the trigger of a systemic transformation is an exogenous, structureless, and memoryless perturbation whose only operationally relevant property is its non-zero magnitude. This paper argues that this shared assumption constitutes a systematic explanatory gap rather than a mere methodological choice-one that leaves three fundamental questions unanswered: why a specific micro-event produces a transformation of a specific scale and direction; how the radical disproportion between cause and effect is structurally generated; and on what basis the system selects one future configuration rather than another at the bifurcation point. We examine each framework through these three lenses and demonstrate that this explanatory gap is consistent across all of them. We then show how the theory of Concentrative Causality addresses these questions by reconceiving the trigger as a historically structured topological node co-produced with the system's vulnerabilities within a shared macro-historical process. We situate this alternative within contemporary philosophy of science, explicitly linking its tenets to current debates on mechanistic explanation, precipitating causes, and interventionism. The paper concludes with a conceptual formalization of Concentrative Causality in the language of differential topology, shifting the epistemology of crisis away from structureless randomness toward a structurally intelligible, non-teleological account of emergent freedom.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，从混沌理论到协同学等一系列20世纪数学框架都共享一个根本假设：系统危机的触发源是外生的、无结构的、无记忆的扰动。作者认为这一假设造成了系统的解释缺口，并引入"集中因果性"理论替代这一假设，将触发源重新理解为与系统脆弱性共同产生于宏观历史过程的结构化拓扑节点。
AI.research_question: 系统转型的触发源是否真的只是外生的、无结构的随机扰动？如何解释微小的具体事件如何产生特定规模和方向的系统性变革？
AI.motivation: 现有危机模型（混沌理论、耗散结构、突变论等）虽然各自不同，但共享一个"结构无关的扰动"假设，这无法回答三个关键问题：为何特定微观事件产生特定规模和方向的转型；因果之间的不对称如何被结构性生成；系统在分叉点如何选择未来路径。作者认为这构成一个系统的解释缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集中因果性（Concentrative Causality）；微分拓扑学；机制解释（mechanistic explanation）；促发因（precipitating causes）；干预主义（interventionism）
AI.method: 概念分析与理论比较：逐一审视洛伦兹混沌、普里戈金耗散结构、托姆突变论、哈肯协同学、门斯基量子分支等框架，考察它们在"触发源"假设上的共同局限，然后引入并形式化集中因果性作为替代方案。
AI.findings: 1）所有主流危机数学框架都隐含地将触发源视为外生、无结构、无记忆的扰动，这导致对转型方向、尺度分岔和路径选择无能为力。2）集中因果性将触发源重新定义为"历史上结构化的拓扑节点"，它并非外生强加，而是与系统脆弱性在共享的历史进程中共同产生。3）通过微分拓扑语言对这一因果模型进行形式化，危机不再被理解为结构化的随机事件，而是结构上可理解的、非目的论的新显现。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示并命名了跨学科危机理论中一个被忽视的"结构无关扰动假设"及其带来的解释缺口；提出集中因果性作为替代性因果框架，将触发从外生随机扰动转变为历史共构的结构化节点；用微分拓扑学语言将这一理论形式化，弥合了哲学分析与数学建模之间的鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解金融系统崩溃、组织危机、社会变革等复杂系统转型提供了新的分析工具——不再将触发事件视为"黑天鹅"式的随机冲击，而是可追溯、可识别的历史拓扑节点；有助于改进危机预警系统的设计逻辑，从监测随机冲击转向分析系统脆弱性与历史结构的共构过程。

title: Algorithmic Demand Induction in Platform Interfaces: A Computational Audit Framework for Preference-Shaping Recommender Systems

detail.title: Algorithmic Demand Induction in Platform Interfaces: A Computational Audit Framework for Preference-Shaping Recommender Systems
detail.abstract: Recommender systems are commonly framed as tools for predicting user preferences and helping users discover relevant products, content, services, or information. Yet contemporary platform environments increasingly combine recommender systems with commercial ranking, engagement optimisation, persuasive interface cues, behavioural feedback loops, and limited user-control pathways. In such environments, recommendations may do more than match existing preferences: they may stimulate, amplify, or redirect user interest toward products, content, services, or ideas that users did not actively seek. This paper introduces Algorithmic Demand Induction (ADI) as a socio-technical concept for examining this shift from preference prediction toward preference shaping. To strengthen the concept as a technical and dataoriented contribution, the paper proposes ADI-TRACE, a computationally implementable audit framework for identifying observable demand-inducing conditions in platform interfaces. ADI-TRACE integrates six dimensions: relevance drift, commercial mediation, persuasive cue load, repetition persistence, control friction, and explanation opacity. These dimensions are operationalised through an ADI Index that can be applied to manually collected or semistructured platform audit data. Drawing on literature from recommender systems, persuasive technology, online choice architecture, dark commercial patterns, algorithm auditing, and platform governance, the paper develops a conceptual framework, data schema, scoring logic, and analytics workflow for studying demand-inducing recommendation environments. The paper does not claim to infer platform intent or prove causal preference change. Instead, it provides a reproducible audit logic for observing and comparing interface-level conditions through which recommender systems may shift from preference matching toward preference shaping. The contribution is conceptual, methodological, and computational: it offers a language for ADI, a structured audit framework, and a technical pathway for future empirical studies using platform observations, coded recommendation instances, and Python-based analytics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"算法需求诱导"(ADI)概念，描述推荐系统从预测偏好转向塑造偏好的转变，并开发了ADI-TRACE审计框架，通过六个维度（相关性漂移、商业中介、说服线索负荷、重复坚持、控制摩擦、解释不透明）构建可计算的ADI指数，用于识别和比较平台界面中的需求诱导条件。
AI.research_question: 推荐系统如何从偏好匹配（预测用户已有偏好）转向偏好塑造（刺激、放大或重新引导用户兴趣）？如何从技术和数据角度可操作化地识别和衡量这种转变？
AI.motivation: 当代平台环境中推荐系统已不仅仅是匹配偏好，而是结合了商业排序、参与度优化、说服性界面线索、行为反馈循环和有限的用户控制路径，可能导致推荐刺激用户原本未主动寻求的产品、内容、服务或想法。现有概念缺乏对这一转变的系统性描述和可操作的审计工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会技术概念（Algorithmic Demand Induction, ADI）、推荐系统理论、说服性技术、在线选择架构、暗商业模式、算法审计、平台治理。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建；提出ADI-TRACE审计框架，包含六个维度（相关性漂移、商业中介、说服线索负荷、重复坚持、控制摩擦、解释不透明），并通过ADI指数进行可计算操作化；设计了数据模式、评分逻辑和分析工作流。
AI.findings: 提出了ADI概念来捕捉推荐系统从偏好预测到偏好塑造的转变；开发了ADI-TRACE框架作为可计算、可复现的审计逻辑，用于观察和比较平台界面中需求诱导的条件；提供了概念性语言、结构化审计框架和基于Python分析的技术路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入"算法需求诱导"(ADI)作为社会技术概念，为理解推荐系统从偏好匹配到偏好塑造的转变提供了理论语言；将推荐系统、说服性技术、选择架构、暗模式等多领域文献整合为统一分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供ADI-TRACE可计算审计框架和ADI指数，支持手动或半结构化平台审计数据收集；设计数据模式、评分逻辑和分析工作流，为未来基于平台观察、编码推荐实例和Python分析的实证研究提供技术路径。

title: Facial Expressions as Signals of Human Capital: A 25-Year Analysis of Career Outcomes in Engineering and Business Schools
affiliations: Banque de France,  and Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne

detail.title: Facial Expressions as Signals of Human Capital: A 25-Year Analysis of Career Outcomes in Engineering and Business Schools

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The views expressed in this article are those of the authors and not the ones from their institutions of affiliation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The compliance of this work with GDPR regulation has been checked with Paris I University.

detail.abstract: This study investigates the predictive value of early-life facial expressions on long-term career success through a 25-year longitudinal analysis. We use a baseline cohort of N=2082 graduates from four major U.S. institutions (Texas Tech University, Penn State University, University of Wisconsin-Madison and North Carolina State University) between 1999 and 2003. To maximize the contrast of our signaling effects, we constructed a targeted sample of N=388 profiles focusing on the highest and lowest smile intensities. Deploying an innovative AI triangulation methodology calculating the median score from DeepFace, Vision Transformer (ViT), and FER models, we quantify smile intensity in original yearbook photographs and correlate these signals with real-world career trajectories extracted from LinkedIn in 2026. Our findings reveal a striking divergence between professional tracks: while smile intensity is positively correlated with network visibility, mobility and success in Business, we identify an "Expert Paradox" within Engineering. In this technical domain, initial facial seriousness serves as a signal of competence and leadership, facilitating advancement to executive-level positions. To isolate the pure effect of emotional capital from social origins, we refine our final analytical sample to N=264 profiles with identifiable hometowns, controlling for socioeconomic status using the 2000 U.S. Decennial Census. Furthermore, an AIC-based Stepwise selection algorithm confirms the robustness of our results. This research challenges the universality of the "smile premium" and underscores the importance of congruency between non-verbal signals and role-specific professional expectations.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过25年纵向追踪，发现早期面部微笑强度对职业成功具有预测作用：在商业领域微笑溢价显著，但在工程领域存在"专家悖论"——严肃表情反而成为能力和领导力的信号。
AI.research_question: 早期面部表情能否预测长期职业成功？微笑强度在不同职业领域（商业 vs. 工程）的信号效应是否一致？
AI.motivation: 挑战"微笑溢价"的普适性观点，探索非语言信号与职业角色期望之间的一致性对职业成功的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论、情感资本理论、角色一致性理论
AI.method: 25年纵向分析；初始样本N=2082（四所美国高校1999-2003届毕业生）；目标样本N=388（最高/最低微笑强度对比）；AI三角测量法（DeepFace、ViT、FER模型取中位数）量化年鉴照片微笑强度；LinkedIn（2026年）提取职业轨迹数据；最终分析样本N=264（控制 hometown 社会经济地位）；AIC逐步选择算法验证稳健性。
AI.findings: 微笑强度与商业领域的网络可见性、流动性和成功正相关；但在工程领域存在"专家悖论"——初始面部严肃预示能力和领导力，有利于晋升至高管职位。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示"微笑溢价"的领域特异性，提出"专家悖论"概念，拓展了非语言信号与职业角色期望一致性的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为职业形象管理提供差异化指导：商业领域应注重积极情感信号，工程领域则需平衡严肃与专业形象；为AI辅助招聘中的面部表情分析提供方法论参考。

title: Innovation in EU Merger Control: True Paradigm Shift or Just New Labels? The EC's Draft Guidelines Under the Microscope
affiliations: ESSEC Business School

detail.title: Innovation in EU Merger Control: True Paradigm Shift or Just New Labels? The EC's Draft Guidelines Under the Microscope
detail.abstract: This paper critically evaluates the European Commission's proposed March 2026 Merger Guidelines, highlighting a major shift toward an integrated, forward-looking framework that evaluates a merger's "theory of harm" and "theory of benefit" simultaneously. The proposed guidelines substantially broaden the scope of competition to include non-price factors like innovation, adjust analytical timelines to fit market dynamics, and explicitly recognize firm "capabilities" alongside market incentives. However, the Commission still relies on outdated structural presumptions regarding R&D cannibalization and uses a restrictive asset-focused definition of capabilities that overlooks crucial managerial skills. While the reform is a significant procedural upgrade over the 2004 guidelines, the Commission's broad enforcement discretion means the practical viability of the new efficiency and innovation defense remains to be proven.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性评估了欧盟委员会2026年3月拟议的合并指南，指出其转向整合前瞻性框架，同时评估合并的"损害理论"和"利益理论"，但仍在R&D蚕食和资产聚焦定义上依赖过时结构性假设。
AI.research_question: 欧盟委员会2026年拟议合并指南是否实现了有效的竞争政策现代化？其理论框架和可操作性存在哪些局限？
AI.motivation: 2004年指南已过时，无法适应数字经济中创新、非价格竞争等新挑战，需要评估新指南的理论进步与实际可行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合并的"损害理论"与"利益理论"整合框架；竞争范围扩展至非价格因素（创新）；企业"能力"概念；结构性推定方法。
AI.method: 批判性法律与政策分析，比较2004年与2026年指南的文本与理论框架。
AI.findings: 新指南是重大程序升级，但仍在R&D蚕食上依赖过时结构性推定；"能力"定义过于狭窄（仅资产聚焦，忽视管理技能）；实际执行效果取决于委员会的自由裁量权。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统结构性推定在数字时代的适用性；提出了整合评估损害与利益的分析框架；引入并批判性地评估了"企业能力"概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为合并审查实践提供了更灵活、前瞻性的分析指南；指出了新指南在执行层面仍存在的模糊空间和潜在问题。

title: Unbundling Formation from Performance: An Institutional Theory of Artificial Intelligence and Human Capability

detail.title: Unbundling Formation from Performance: An Institutional Theory of Artificial Intelligence and Human Capability
detail.abstract: Debates over artificial intelligence and work are usually organized around tasks: which tasks machines can perform, and what happens to the workers who performed them. This paper develops a theory of AI-driven institutional unbundling: the separation of visible performance from the hidden formation that historically rode on performing the work. Many institutions bundled output and formation because separating them was costly. Generative AI lowers that separation cost. It can supply performance while bypassing the human process through which capability, judgment, attachment, and responsibility were formed. I locate the mechanism in a collective-action asymmetry: unbundling is cheap, private, and immediate, while rebundling formation is costly, collective, and delayed. A simple model shows why the harm is uneven. Unbundling is more likely when immediate gain and maintenance cost are high and the deciding actor's internalized horizon is low; conditional on unbundling, social formation loss rises with bundle strength. The highest-risk cases lie near the preservation threshold, where formative value is large enough to matter but not sufficiently internalized to stop unbundling. The contribution is a positive theory of where AI hollows institutions, where it does not, and when formation can be rebuilt.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI驱动的制度去捆绑理论：生成式AI通过降低分离成本，使工作的可见表现与隐藏的（能力、判断、依附、责任）形成过程脱钩，导致制度空心化。模型揭示：去捆绑是廉价、私密、即时的，而重新捆绑是昂贵、集体、延迟的，因此最危险的情况是形成价值足够大但没有被充分内部化以阻止去捆绑的情境。
AI.research_question: AI如何影响工作中"表现输出"与"人的形成"之间的制度性捆绑？在什么条件下AI会导致制度空心化，在什么条件下不会，以及如何重建形成过程？
AI.motivation: 现有关于AI与工作的讨论主要集中在任务层面的替代，忽视了工作背后更深层的制度功能——工作不仅是产出，也是人类能力、判断、依附和责任感的形成场所。随着生成式AI降低分离成本，这一制度功能面临威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度去捆绑理论（Institutional Unbundling Theory）；集体行动不对称（Collective-Action Asymmetry）：去捆绑是廉价、私密、即时的，而重新捆绑是昂贵、集体、延迟的。
AI.method: 理论建模：通过一个简单模型分析去捆绑发生的条件（即时收益、维护成本、行动者的时间视野）以及社会形成损失的决定因素（捆绑强度）。
AI.findings: 去捆绑更可能发生在即时收益和维护成本高、决策者内部化视野低的情况下；社会形成损失随捆绑强度增加而上升；最高风险位于"维持阈值"附近——形成价值足够大以至于重要，但又没有被充分内部化以阻止去捆绑。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个关于AI如何导致制度空心化的实证理论；区分了AI会/不会侵蚀的制度类型；指出了重建形成的条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助识别哪些工作制度最容易被AI解构，为组织设计干预措施（如延长决策视野、提高维护成本内部化）以保护形成功能提供指导。

title: Cognitive Labor and the Uncompensated Frontier: A Framework for Recognizing and Rewarding High-Value User Contributions to AI Systems

detail.title: Cognitive Labor and the Uncompensated Frontier: A Framework for Recognizing and Rewarding High-Value User Contributions to AI Systems
detail.abstract: A measurable subset of AI interactions functions as productive cognitive labor whose marginal value exceeds its acquisition cost and can therefore be economically attributed. The dominant model of AI development treats all user interaction as equivalent behavioral exhaust — a passive byproduct of service delivery that companies collect, aggregate, and use to improve their systems without acknowledgment or compensation to the individuals who generated it. This paper argues that this model is economically inaccurate. A distinct class of user interaction — characterized by domain expertise, cross-disciplinary synthesis, systematic pressure testing, and novel workflow construction — generates training signal that neither automated data pipelines nor paid contractor programs can reliably replicate. Drawing on the “data as labor” framework established in economic literature, the structural economics of reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and the emerging regulatory context of the EU AI Act, this paper proposes a contribution attribution framework: a set of principles and mechanisms for identifying, scoring, and compensating high-value cognitive contributors to AI systems. The argument is made not on ethical grounds, but on the grounds of economic efficiency and competitive strategy. AI companies that implement contributor compensation programs will produce better models at lower cost, build defensible regulatory compliance records, and retain the power users who generate their most valuable training signal. The paper concludes by acknowledging the central unsolved problem — reliable attribution — and frames it as the primary target for subsequent technical work.

AI.tldr: 本文论证AI交互中的一部分可被衡量为生产性认知劳动，其边际价值超过获取成本，因此应获得经济归属。论文提出贡献归属框架，主张从经济效率和竞争策略而非伦理角度，对高价值认知贡献者进行识别、评分和补偿。
AI.research_question: AI交互中哪些用户行为应被视作生产性认知劳动并获得经济补偿？如何构建贡献归属框架？
AI.motivation: 当前AI开发模式将所有用户交互视为"行为废气"，忽视了高价值认知贡献者的劳动价值，这种模式在经济上不准确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据即劳动（Data as Labor）框架；RLHF的结构经济学；EU AI Act监管背景。
AI.method: 理论论证与经济分析，提出贡献归属框架（识别、评分、补偿机制）。
AI.findings: 高价值认知贡献（领域专长、跨学科综合、系统性压力测试、新型工作流构建）无法被自动化数据管道或付费承包商可靠复制；实施贡献者补偿的AI公司将获得更优模型、更低成本、合规优势及用户留存。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"数据即劳动"框架拓展至AI交互领域，区分了普通交互与生产性认知劳动，并从经济效率角度而非伦理角度论证补偿必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI企业提供贡献归属与补偿的实践原则和机制，指出可靠归属是待解决的核心技术问题。

title: Corporate Brand Identity and Consumer Decision-Making in Business Aviation: An Empirical Study of Flight Way
affiliations: and Stockholm School of Economics

detail.title: Corporate Brand Identity and Consumer Decision-Making in Business Aviation: An Empirical Study of Flight Way

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the results of this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was based on voluntary semi-structured interviews with adult participants. All participants provided informed consent, and all responses were anonymized before analysis.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted as part of the Executive MBA program at the Stockholm School of Economics.

detail.abstract: This study explores the role of corporate brand identity in consumer decision-making within the business aviation industry. Although branding and luxury consumption have been extensively studied, little academic attention has been given to business aviation as a distinct premium service sector. The research is based on 35 semi-structured interviews with business aviation clients, personal assistants, travel agents, employees, partners and company owners. Using the Corporate Brand Identity Matrix (CBIM) and thematic analysis, the study identifies the organizational factors that influence customer choice beyond price. The findings demonstrate that trust, reputation, organizational culture, reliability and the ability to consistently deliver on promises play a more significant role than price alone. The results contribute to branding theory and provide practical implications for managers of premium service companies.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了企业品牌身份在公务航空业消费者决策中的作用，发现信任、声誉、组织文化、可靠性和履约能力比价格更重要。
AI.research_question: 企业品牌身份如何影响公务航空业消费者的决策过程？
AI.motivation: 尽管品牌和奢侈品消费已被广泛研究，但公务航空作为一个独特的优质服务行业很少受到学术关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业品牌身份矩阵（CBIM）
AI.method: 35个半结构化访谈（对象包括公务航空客户、个人助理、旅行代理、员工、合作伙伴及公司所有者），结合主题分析法。
AI.findings: 信任、声誉、组织文化、可靠性和持续履行承诺的能力对客户选择的影响远超价格因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 将企业品牌身份理论拓展至公务航空这一优质服务领域，填补了该行业品牌研究的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为优质服务企业的管理者提供了品牌建设与管理方面的实践启示。

title: The Influence of Sustainable Product Attributes on Decision-Making

detail.title: The Influence of Sustainable Product Attributes on Decision-Making

declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is based on my Master's degree thesis. I received permission to conduct a survey and use the data, which is also being utilized for this paper.

detail.abstract: Sustainability labels are intended to guide environmentally conscious purchasing, yet their proliferation, now exceeding 450 schemes worldwide, raises the question of whether consumers respond to what a label certifies or to the specific mark itself. This study estimates consumer preferences across competing product attributes using a discrete choice experiment administered to 235 respondents from a multinational sample. Six named sustainability labels, drawn two each from the social and ethical, health-related, and environmental categories, were varied alongside brand tier, package weight, and price, and choices were modelled by conditional logit. The labels formed a steep preference hierarchy that the category scheme failed to predict. Organic exerted the strongest positive effect of any attribute in the model, Rainforest Alliance was the most rejected, and the two health-related labels occupied opposite extremes of the ranking. Brand tier shaped choice substantially, with national brands preferred over both local and global producers. Price behaved conventionally, since the cheapest option carried the highest utility, whereas package weight had no significant effect. Income, environmental consciousness, and nationality were each associated with stronger preference for labelled goods, while gender and education were not. The results indicate that the recognition and comprehensibility of an individual label govern its influence more than the sustainability domain it represents. Adopting a certification therefore offers no guarantee of advantage, since a poorly recognised label can reduce rather than raise a product's appeal.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过离散选择实验发现，消费者对可持续标签的偏好存在显著的等级差异，有机标签最受欢迎，雨林联盟标签最被排斥；标签的认知度和可理解性比其所属可持续类别更能决定其影响力。
AI.research_question: 消费者是对可持续标签所认证的内容（类别）做出反应，还是对具体的标签标志本身做出反应？
AI.motivation: 全球已有超过450种可持续标签，标签泛滥但对其相对效力的系统比较研究不足，企业和管理者缺乏选择与使用标签的实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 离散选择理论、消费者偏好层次理论、标签信号理论
AI.method: 离散选择实验（DCE），对235名跨国样本受访者实施，使用条件Logit模型分析六种命名标签（分属社会与伦理、健康相关、环境三类）与品牌层级、包装重量、价格等属性的偏好。
AI.findings: 标签偏好呈陡峭的等级结构：有机标签正向效应最强，雨林联盟最被排斥；两个健康标签分别处于两极；国民品牌优于本地和全球品牌；价格符合常规（最便宜效用最高）；包装重量无显著影响；收入、环保意识和国籍增强标签偏好，性别和教育无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了标签的影响力更多取决于个体标签的认知度和可理解性，而非其所属的可持续类别，挑战了基于类别划分的标签效力假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供标签选择依据：采用认证标签并不保证产品吸引力提升，认知度低的标签反而可能降低产品吸引力。

title: Where AI is Actually Being Used, and Where the Market Isn't Paying for It (Yet)

detail.title: Where AI is Actually Being Used, and Where the Market Isn't Paying for It (Yet)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an Associate at The Brattle Group; the views expressed are the author's own and do not represent those of The Brattle Group or its clients.

detail.abstract: Equity enthusiasm about artificial intelligence has centered on the firms that supply it. Far less is known about who uses it. Using realized Claude usage data from Anthropic's Economic Index, mapped through U.S. occupation-and-industry staffing to the Fama-French 49 industries, I document where AI is being used across U.S. public-market industries and whether using it has been rewarded in the stock market. Three patterns stand out. Per worker, software is the most AI-intensive industry, but publishing ranks second, ahead of finance, because writing and editing are among the tasks most exposed to large language models. In aggregate, the bulk of AI use falls in large service industries such as business services and retail, not in software, whose workforce is small. And over 2025 and 2026, usage has broadened from technology and finance toward the labor-intensive economy. Set against this is a market puzzle: when I sort industries by how fast their per-worker AI use grew, the fastest adopters earned lower subsequent three-month returns, a result that survives risk-factor adjustment and excluding AI-supplier industries. Where AI is used and where the market assigns AI value appear, for now, to be different places.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Anthropic经济指数中的Claude实际使用数据，结合美国职业与行业的从业人数分布，映射到Fama-French 49个行业，分析了人工智能（特别是大语言模型）在美国上市公司各行业中的使用分布情况，并检验了AI使用增长与股票市场回报之间的关系。研究发现：软件行业人均AI使用强度最高，但出版业位列第二；从总量看，AI使用主要集中在商业服务和零售等大型服务行业；2025-2026年间，AI使用正从科技和金融向劳动密集型经济领域扩展。然而市场呈现一个谜题：AI使用增长最快的行业，其后三个月的股票回报反而更低，这一结果在风险因子调整和剔除AI供应商行业后依然稳健。这表明AI实际使用的地方与市场定价AI价值的地方并不一致。
AI.research_question: 人工智能（AI）在美国各行业中的实际使用分布情况如何？AI使用强度的行业差异是否体现在股票市场回报中？
AI.motivation: 现有研究大量关注AI供应端的企业（如芯片、模型开发商），但对AI需求端——即实际使用AI的企业和行业——了解甚少。本文旨在填补这一空白，利用独特的微观使用数据系统性地刻画AI在各行业的渗透格局，并检验资本市场是否对AI使用者给予了估值奖励。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于任务暴露框架（task exposure framework），认为大语言模型对不同职业和任务的替代或增强潜力不同；结合资产定价理论，检验AI使用强度变化是否成为股票回报的横截面定价因子。
AI.method: 使用Anthropic的Claude实际调用数据作为AI使用量的代理变量，通过美国职业与行业的从业人数数据（O*NET、BLS）将使用量分配到Fama-French 49个行业；采用描述性统计展示行业分布；使用投资组合排序法（sorting）检验AI使用增长率与后续三个月股票回报的关系，并进行风险因子调整（如Fama-French因子）和稳健性检验（排除AI供应商行业）。
AI.findings: （1）人均AI使用强度：软件行业最高，出版业第二，超过金融业；（2）总量AI使用：商业服务和零售等大型服务业占比最大，软件行业因从业人数少而总量不高；（3）时间趋势：2025-2026年，AI使用从科技和金融向劳动密集型经济领域扩散；（4）市场谜题：AI使用增长最快的行业，其后三个月股票回报显著更低，该结果在风险调整和排除AI供应商后依然稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次利用大规模、细粒度的AI实际使用数据，系统刻画了AI在各行业的需求端分布，挑战了市场直觉（AI使用热点≠投资热点），为理解AI技术扩散的经济后果提供了新的实证证据，并提出了一个有待解释的资产定价异象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供参考：AI使用增长最快的行业未必是好的投资标的，市场可能过度定价AI供应端而低估了使用端的价值；为企业管理者提供AI部署战略的行业对标信息；为政策制定者理解AI在各经济部门的渗透速度和方向提供依据。

title: The Architecture of the Only Choice: How Strategic Brand Architecture Converts Latent Value into Trust and Perceived Non-Substitutability

detail.title: The Architecture of the Only Choice: How Strategic Brand Architecture Converts Latent Value into Trust and Perceived Non-Substitutability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the creator of the Strategic Brand Architecture framework presented in this paper and provides professional services in this field through D&SGW Industry, s.r.o. The author may therefore derive professional or commercial benefit from the recognition and application of the framework. No external organization influenced the development, analysis, or conclusions of the paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a conceptual paper based on published literature and theoretical development. It did not involve human participants, personal data, animals, clinical research, or identifiable case studies; therefore, ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The paper was independently developed and self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: In premium, expert-led, and relationship-intensive services, the qualities that matter most are rarely the easiest to inspect before commitment: judgment, discretion, depth of expertise, and the quality of a relationship that has not yet begun. Clients therefore encounter the brand before they encounter the work. They read its level through the position it occupies, the precision of its language, the intelligence of its visual form, the evidence it presents, the structure of its digital environment, and the kind of relationship these elements allow them to anticipate. This article develops Strategic Brand Architecture beyond its established portfolio meaning and examines a more fundamental question: how does a well-evidenced, yet only partly visible, organizational capacity become understood, trusted, and increasingly difficult to replace? The framework is built through six connected domains: Substance Discernment, Strategic Distillation, Positioning Authority, Symbolic Calibration, Proof Architecture, and Decision Convergence. At its center are two focal constructs—Interpretive Distance and Perceived NonSubstitutability—and one bounded outcome, The Only Choice State; their relationship is explained through Recognition Coherence, the Credibility Threshold, and Comparison Attenuation. A brand becomes The Only Choice while alternatives still exist. The shift occurs when the right audience no longer experiences those alternatives as meaningfully equivalent, while remaining fully able to compare, question, and decide. Ten propositions examine how coherence, diagnostic proof, audience relevance, selective disclosure, processing ease, and continuity across the journey shape trust, further search, willingness to pay, confidence, and final choice. The article locates brand magnetism somewhere more demanding than persuasion, visibility, or aesthetic appeal. It arises when supportable value is translated with enough precision that people can understand not only what they are choosing, but why this particular choice carries a different level of meaning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"战略性品牌架构"框架，探讨在高端专业服务领域，品牌如何通过六个相互关联的领域（实质辨别、战略提炼、定位权威、符号校准、证据架构、决策汇聚）构建"不可替代感知"，使客户在仍有其他选择时将某品牌视为"唯一选择"。核心机制涉及解释距离、认知连贯性、可信阈值和比较衰减等概念。
AI.research_question: 在高端、专家主导、关系密集型服务中，一个具有良好证据支撑但部分不可见的组织能力，如何被客户理解、信任并变得难以替代？品牌如何成为客户在存在替代选项时的"唯一选择"？
AI.motivation: 高端服务中最重要的品质（判断力、谨慎、专业深度、尚未开始的关系质量）在客户承诺前难以直接检验，客户通过品牌信号进行预判。现有品牌架构理论多聚焦于组合管理层面，缺乏解释品牌如何将不可见能力转化为信任和不可替代性的系统性框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略性品牌架构（Strategic Brand Architecture）的拓展概念，核心构念包括：解释距离（Interpretive Distance）、感知不可替代性（Perceived NonSubstitutability）、唯一选择状态（The Only Choice State）；解释机制包括：认知连贯性（Recognition Coherence）、可信阈值（Credibility Threshold）、比较衰减（Comparison Attenuation）。
AI.method: 理论建构论文，通过六个连通领域构建概念框架，提出十个命题阐述各要素如何塑造信任、搜索意愿、支付意愿、信心和最终选择。
AI.findings: 品牌成为"唯一选择"的关键不在于消除替代选项，而在于使目标受众不再将替代选项视为有意义的等价物。这一转变通过认知连贯性、诊断性证据、受众相关性、选择性披露、处理流畅性和旅程连续性来实现。品牌吸引力超越了说服、可见性或审美吸引，源于精准翻译可支撑的价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将品牌架构概念从传统的组合管理拓展至认知与信任建构层面；提出"解释距离"和"比较衰减"等新构念解释品牌不可替代性的形成机制；构建了从品牌信号到"唯一选择"状态的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高端专业服务品牌提供了系统性框架，指导如何通过六个领域（实质辨别、战略提炼、定位权威、符号校准、证据架构、决策汇聚）协同构建品牌不可替代性，从而提升客户信任、支付意愿和选择确定性。

title: Creating Privacy Value Through Artificial Intelligence Prompt Literacy: The Role of Self-Investment
affiliations: University of Cologne, Germany,  and

detail.title: Creating Privacy Value Through Artificial Intelligence Prompt Literacy: The Role of Self-Investment
detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is reshaping how consumers and employees disclose data to digital systems. Unlike the discrete disclosure decisions examined in previous literature on privacy settings, GenAI use unfolds through interactive prompting in which users share information to cocreate outputs. This research examines how self-investment in such disclosure processes shapes perceived privacy value, defined as the perceived net value of benefits relative to privacy risks. Across four studies, we show that greater self-investment increases perceived ownership of the cocreated output; moreover, the effect of self-investment on ownership is strongest when interactions involve sensitive data disclosure, with ownership subsequently shaping privacy value through perceived benefits and privacy risks. Finally, AI prompt literacy is an actionable antecedent of self-investment: a field intervention and an online experiment show that even modest improvements in practical prompting capability can increase engagement with GenAI. The findings contribute to privacy, GenAI, and cocreation research by showing that privacy evaluations in GenAI contexts are dynamic, self-invested, and shaped by users' ability to guide the interaction.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，在生成式AI使用过程中，用户的自我投入（self-investment）会增强对共创产出的感知所有权，进而通过感知收益和隐私风险影响隐私价值。AI提示素养是自我投入的重要前因。
AI.research_question: 在生成式AI的交互式提示场景中，用户的自我投入如何影响其感知隐私价值？
AI.motivation: GenAI的使用模式与传统的隐私设置不同，涉及持续的交互式提示和共创过程，现有文献尚未充分探讨这种动态披露过程中的隐私评估机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 感知所有权理论、隐私价值理论、自我投入理论、共创理论
AI.method: 四项研究（含实地干预和在线实验），结合定量分析和实验设计
AI.findings: 1) 自我投入越高，用户对共创产出的感知所有权越强；2) 在敏感数据披露场景中，自我投入对所有权的影响最强；3) 所有权通过感知收益和隐私风险塑造隐私价值；4) AI提示素养是自我投入的可行前因，提升提示能力可增加GenAI参与度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将隐私评估从静态的离散决策拓展为动态的、自我投入驱动的过程；将共创理论引入隐私研究；揭示GenAI场景中隐私价值形成的新机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示用户可以通过提升AI提示素养来增强其与GenAI交互中的隐私价值感知；为平台设计者优化用户交互体验提供了可操作的干预方向。

title:
Human Value Creation under Uncertainty 
Toward Personal Intellectual Capital in the AI-Augmented Knowledge Economy

detail.title:
Human Value Creation under Uncertainty 
Toward Personal Intellectual Capital in the AI-Augmented Knowledge Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a conceptual paper and does not involve human participants or primary data collection."
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Even when professionals operate under similar conditions of knowledge access, artificial intelligence and educational opportunity, they continue to display markedly different capacities to sustain value creation over time. Psychology, Knowledge Management and Intellectual Capital (IC) theory each illuminate part of this divergence, but none explains it in full. This paper takes as its starting point a core anomaly: as generative Artificial Intelligence makes synthesised knowledge increasingly abundant, the human capacity to sustain value creation has not followed the same trajectory. This paper develops a preliminary conceptual foundation to explain why sustained human value creation diverges under these conditions-Personal Intellectual Capital (Personal IC)-investigated here at the level of the individual professional. Adopting a transdisciplinary conceptual approach, the paper integrates insights from Psychology, Knowledge Management and Intellectual Capital theory, building on the foundations of individual-level Intellectual Capital theory, to conceptualise Personal IC as an evolving configuration-not a static stock-of Human, Structural and Relational intellectual resources whose value lies in how effectively they are organised and applied under conditions of uncertainty to sustain Professional Excellence. The paper contributes this initial conceptual foundation and outlines a preliminary transdisciplinary research programme for inquiry into sustained human value creation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"个人智力资本"（Personal IC）概念，解释在AI使知识日益丰富的情况下，为何专业人员持续创造价值的能力仍存在显著差异，并构建了跨学科概念基础。
AI.research_question: 在生成式AI使合成知识日益丰富的条件下，为何专业人员持续创造价值的能力仍然存在显著差异？如何概念化个体层面的持续价值创造能力？
AI.motivation: 心理学、知识管理和智力资本理论各自解释了部分现象，但都无法完整解释这一核心反常现象：AI使知识日益丰富，但人类持续创造价值的能力并未同步提升。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨学科概念整合：心理学、知识管理、智力资本理论；以个体层面智力资本理论为基础，提出个人智力资本（Personal IC）概念。
AI.method: 跨学科概念分析方法（transdisciplinary conceptual approach），整合多领域理论构建初步概念基础。
AI.findings: 个人智力资本不是静态存量，而是人力资本、结构资本和关系资本三大智力资源的动态配置，其价值取决于在不确定条件下如何有效组织与应用以维持专业卓越。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出个人智力资本（Personal IC）的初步概念基础；构建了跨学科研究议程，为理解个体层面持续价值创造提供新理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为专业人士在AI时代提升持续价值创造能力提供概念指导；为组织人力资源管理、专业发展培训提供理论依据。

title: Answering without Referring: How AI Search Rewrites the Web's Economic Bargain
affiliations: Bocconi University, Bocconi University and

detail.title: Answering without Referring: How AI Search Rewrites the Web's Economic Bargain
detail.abstract: Search engines have long allocated attention on the web by routing users from queries to websites. AI search changes this arrangement because information needs can be resolved inside the intermediary. Using URL-level Comscore U.S. desktop clickstream, we compare ChatGPT and Google information-seeking occasions and exploit ChatGPT Search access expansions to estimate traditional search displacement. ChatGPT produces outbound clicks in only 5.2% of conversation sessions, far below Google's referral ratio. The remaining clicks are not a scaled-down Google stream: they skew toward specialized destinations and away from ad-supported sites. Wider access cuts search use by 9.4%, with search-referral losses largest for informational categories. Our findings identify a central economic shift in digital intermediation: AI search might satisfy information needs inside the intermediary while weakening the referral bargain that has linked search, traffic, and content production on the open web.

AI.tldr: AI搜索引擎（如ChatGPT）将信息需求解决在中间层内部，大幅减少向外部网站的流量导引。ChatGPT仅5.2%的会话产生外链点击，远低于Google；且剩余流量偏向专业网站、远离广告支持网站。接入ChatGPT Search后，传统搜索引擎使用量下降9.4%，信息类网站流量损失最大。这打破了搜索、流量与内容生产之间的"导引契约"。
AI.research_question: AI搜索引擎如何改变数字中介的注意力分配机制？传统搜索引擎的"导引"模式是否被AI搜索取代？
AI.motivation: 传统搜索引擎通过向网站导引流量来维持开放网络的生态平衡，而AI搜索将信息需求解决在内部，可能瓦解这一"导引契约"，威胁内容生产的可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字中介理论、注意力分配理论、平台经济中的"导引契约"（referral bargain）
AI.method: 使用Comscore美国桌面端点击流数据，比较ChatGPT与Google的信息搜索行为；利用ChatGPT Search访问权限扩展作为准自然实验，估计对传统搜索的替代效应。
AI.findings: ChatGPT仅5.2%的会话产生外链点击，远低于Google；剩余点击偏向专业网站、远离广告支持网站；ChatGPT Search接入使传统搜索使用下降9.4%，信息类网站流量损失最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI搜索对传统搜索"导引契约"的颠覆性影响，提出数字中介从"导引者"向"信息终端"转变的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为内容生产者、广告主和平台政策制定者提供了AI搜索时代流量分配变化的关键实证证据，提示开放网络生态可能面临的结构性挑战。

title: The Only Reason to Do Anything: Online Trolling as the Deceptive Disruption of Joint Action
affiliations: San Jose State University

detail.title: The Only Reason to Do Anything: Online Trolling as the Deceptive Disruption of Joint Action
detail.abstract: According to recent discussions, trolls attempt to spark the anger of internet users by feigning engagement in serious conversations with unsuspecting targets who are turned into objects of ridicule in front of a complicit audience. In this chapter, I extend the traditional definition of trolling to nonconversational endeavours. In my view, trolling is the deceptive disruption of joint action regardless of whether such action is conversational or non-conversational in nature. In conjunction, I propose an account of the moral wrong in trolling according to which trolls hinder the pursuit of valuable human goods such as knowledge, mutual understanding, friendship, empathy and play by deceptively engaging their targets in spurious forms of joint action. To illustrate these claims, I consider a recent case of non-conversational trolling which currently plagues servers of popular multiplayer online video game Team Fortress 2. Consider the following Facebook exchange, which is part of a series of conversations to which trolls commonly refer as the "Epic Trolling of Brendan Sullivan by Robert Graves": Brendan Sullivan: just saw toy story 3.. . not a big fan.. . pixar is starting to really suck. Did not like the ending at all. toy story 3 was better. Robert Graves: And I really wasn't big on the first Batman movie. Batman Begins was better. Brendan Sullivan: Batman begins was the first batman movie. Robert Graves: As opposed to Toy Story 3, which was, as we all know, the second Toy Story movie. Brendan Sullivan: f*ck you rob i meant toy story 2 not toy story 3. It was obvious. So just stop it. Robert Graves: I, personally would award Toy Story 3 a perfect 5/7 score. Now, consider the following scenario, to which I refer as TF2 in the reminder of this chapter:

AI.tldr: 本文重新定义了网络trolling（钓鱼/挑衅）行为，将其从传统的对话场景扩展到非对话性行为，认为trolling是欺骗性地破坏任何形式的联合行动（无论对话与否），并指出其道德错误在于阻碍了知识、理解、友谊、共情和游戏等人类价值追求。
AI.research_question: 如何界定非对话性trolling的本质及其道德错误？
AI.motivation: 传统trolling定义局限于对话情境，无法涵盖如网络游戏中的非对话性破坏行为（如《军团要塞2》中的例子），因此需要更广泛的理论框架来解释这类行为的本质和道德问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联合行动理论（joint action theory）；人类价值追求理论（知识、相互理解、友谊、共情、游戏等善的价值）。
AI.method: 概念分析——通过案例分析法（Facebook对话案例和《军团要塞2》游戏案例）对trolling行为进行重新定义和道德分析。
AI.findings: 1. trolling可定义为欺骗性地破坏联合行动，无论其是否对话性质；2. trolling的道德错误在于通过欺骗性手段阻碍了有价值的人类善（知识、理解、友谊、共情、游戏）的实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将trolling的概念从对话性行为扩展到非对话性行为，深化了对欺骗性网络行为的理论理解；为trolling的道德评估提供了基于人类价值追求的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为网络平台治理、游戏社区管理识别和应对trolling行为提供了更精确的理论依据；有助于设计更有效的反trolling机制。

title: Synthetic Contact with AI Reduces Cross-Partisan Animosity
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania, University of Alberta - School of Business, University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School and Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Marketing

detail.title: Synthetic Contact with AI Reduces Cross-Partisan Animosity
detail.abstract: Americans' warmth toward members of the opposing political party has fallen sharply over the past three decades-yet meaningful cross-partisan contact remains scarce, in part because people actively avoid it. Across five preregistered studies (total N = 3,960 U.S. partisans), we test whether brief conversations with AI chatbots representing the political outgroup can substitute for the contact people shun. Synthetic contact first lowers the barrier to entry: partisans would endure almost twice as long contemplating their own mortality to avoid a human outgroup partner as an AI one.
