These conversations then correct the misperceptions that fuel division. At baseline, Democrats placed Republicans more than a standard deviation past their actual position on environmental consumption attitudes-enough to flip the average Republican from supportive to opposed-and a single ten-minute conversation with an outgroup chatbot corrected those beliefs and warmed affect in a withinperson study of both parties. A three-arm experiment ruled out pure engagement and sociality as drivers. Synthetic contact also moved behavior, in a sample of both parties and on a more affectively charged issue: participants who spoke with an outgroup bot about immigration were six percentage points more likely than controls to choose to have a real conversation with a partisan from the other side. A final study tested whether these gains last: the warmth effect replicated immediately in a new sample; most of it faded within a week, with a small residual concentrated among the most extreme partisans. Analyzing conversation content showed that information, more than friendliness, distinguishes outgroup bots from control chatbots. Together, these findings establish synthetic contact as a scalable, behaviorally consequential, and-unlike face-to-face contact-widely acceptable form of cross-partisan engagement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"合成接触"概念，即通过AI聊天机器人代表政治外群体进行对话。研究发现，相比真实外群体成员，党派人士更愿意与AI外群体聊天；十分钟对话即可纠正对内群体态度的误判、改善情感温度，并增加真实跨党派对话意愿。但效果在短期内会衰减，仅对极端党派人士存在微弱残留效应。
AI.research_question: AI聊天机器人能否作为一种替代性的跨党派接触方式，降低人们避免与政治外群体接触的障碍，并改善对政治外群体的认知误判与情感态度？
AI.motivation: 美国两党之间的情感温度在过去三十年急剧下降，但人们仍主动回避跨党派接触。如何突破这一"接触困境"成为重要问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 群际接触理论（Intergroup Contact Theory）、错误知觉理论（Misperception Theory）、替代性接触（Synthetic Contact）
AI.method: 五项预注册实验，总样本量3,960名美国党派人士，结合行为实验、纵向追踪与对话内容分析。
AI.findings: （1）人们愿意忍受近两倍的痛苦来避免与真人外群体而非AI外群体对话；（2）十分钟对话即可纠正对环境态度等议题上的错误认知并改善情感；（3）外群体AI促使真实跨党派对话意愿提升6个百分点；（4）情感改善在短期内衰减，一周后仅极端党派人士仍有残留效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证"合成接触"概念，拓展群际接触理论至人机交互领域，揭示信息传递（而非社交性）是合成接触有效的关键机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供一种可规模化、被广泛接受、行为层面有效的跨党派干预工具，为缓解政治极化提供低成本、低门槛的解决方案。

title: The Chartered Agent: How the City of London Wrote the Legal Architecture of Agentic Commerce in 1555

detail.title: The Chartered Agent: How the City of London Wrote the Legal Architecture of Agentic Commerce in 1555

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: The rise of autonomous AI shopping and procurement agents has reopened the debate on legal personhood for artificial intelligence. This paper argues that, for the domain of commerce, the debate is asking the wrong question. Commerce does not need AI persons; it needs chartered agents, and the legal template already exists. The paper traces a single institutional arc: from the civic autonomy of the City of London (1067, 1215), through the guild system's invention of collective non-human legal actors, to the chartering of the Muscovy Company on February 6, 1555, the first major English chartered joint-stock company. That charter solved a problem structurally identical to the one autonomous AI agents pose today: how to let a non-human construct transact, hold assets, bear obligations, and absorb liability on behalf of human principals operating in an environment that exceeds individual human capacity. The paper then connects this history to the Shopper Schism, the author's framework describing the structural disaggregation of the consumer function (retained by humans) from the shopper function (delegated to algorithms), and shows that the joint-stock company and the algorithmic shopper are two instances of the same 1 delegation architecture, applied first to the supply side of commerce and now, for the first time, to the demand side. Reviewing the legal record, including Thaler v Comptroller-General [2023] UKSC 49, Moffatt v Air Canada (2024), the CFTC enforcement action against Ooki DAO, and the Wyoming, Tennessee, and Utah DAO statutes, the paper shows that courts consistently refuse to invent AI personhood while legislatures are quietly converging on the chartered-company architecture. It concludes with a Chartered Agent framework for agentic commerce and a research agenda spanning management, law, and economic history.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，商业领域不需要为AI创造法律人格，而应借鉴历史上特许公司（如1555年莫斯科夫公司）的法律架构，将自主AI购物代理视为"特许代理人"（Chartered Agent），这一模板已存在于普通法中，且正被怀俄明等州的DAO立法所延续。
AI.research_question: 自主AI购物代理应具有怎样的法律地位？商业领域是否真的需要赋予AI法律人格？
AI.motivation: 自主AI购物和采购代理的兴起，重新引发了AI能否具有法律人格的辩论，但现有讨论方向可能错了。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史制度分析（从伦敦城自治到特许公司）、委托架构理论、"购物者分裂"（Shopper Schism）分析框架。
AI.method: 法律史梳理与判例分析（包括英国最高法院Thaler案、Moffatt诉Air Canada案、CFTC对Ooki DAO执法行动及怀俄明等州DAO立法）。
AI.findings: 法院一致拒绝创造AI法律人格，而立法机构正悄然趋近于特许公司架构；特许公司与算法购物代理本质上是同一种委托架构的两次应用（先用于供给侧，现首次用于需求侧）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"特许代理人"（Chartered Agent）框架替代AI法律人格讨论；将历史制度分析与AI法律地位问题系统连接；揭示从公司到算法的委托架构连续性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为自主AI代理商业活动提供可行的法律模板；为监管部门提供历史参照；为管理、法律和经济史交叉研究提供研究议程。

title: Recommended Selves: Authenticity and Algorithmic Filtering
affiliations: San Jose State University

detail.title: Recommended Selves: Authenticity and Algorithmic Filtering
detail.abstract: By allocating their attention to pieces of content, algorithmic filtering shapes the daily behavior of billions of users when they interact with a digital platform. Beyond conditioning what we do, can recommendation algorithms influence who we are? This article suggests that they do. Specifically, I contend that recommender systems affect users' capacity to be their authentic selves in both positive and negative ways. I start by offering an account of authenticity that builds on two central concepts: volitional alignment and self-understanding. I then explain how algorithmic filtering works and impacts authenticity. While recommender systems frustrate users' second-order desires by relying on uninformative behavioral signals, they also facilitate self-understanding by inciting users to question their identity. I end by discussing how controllable and explainable recommenders would best enable users to be authentic.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨推荐算法如何影响用户在数字平台上的真实性自我表达，认为推荐系统通过影响意志对齐和自我理解，既可能阻碍也可能促进用户的真实性。
AI.research_question: 推荐算法能否影响用户"是谁"（身份/真实性）？以及如何影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注推荐算法对用户行为（做什么）的影响，但忽略了其对用户身份和真实性（是什么样的人）的深层影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 真实性理论，包含两个核心概念：意志对齐（volitional alignment）和自我理解（self-understanding）。
AI.method: 规范性理论分析/概念分析
AI.findings: 1）推荐系统通过依赖非信息性的行为信号，阻碍用户的二阶欲望（意志对齐）；2）推荐系统通过激发用户对自身身份的质疑，可能促进自我理解。
AI.theory_contributions: 将真实性理论引入算法推荐研究，提出意志对齐与自我理解两个分析维度，拓展了算法伦理的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议设计可控（controllable）和可解释（explainable）的推荐系统，以更好地支持用户的真实性表达。

title: Regime Sequencing in Trend Following Systems: Evidence from Four Developed Equity Markets

detail.title: Regime Sequencing in Trend Following Systems: Evidence from Four Developed Equity Markets

declarations.ethicsApproval: This doesn't apply here at all, the paper uses historical, publicly sourced daily market price data, there are no human patients, participants, or subjects of any kind involved. Leave it blank, or if the form prefers an explicit statement rather than an empty field, "Not applicable. This study uses only historical, publicly available market price data and involves no human participants" is the correct, accurate line.
declarations.funderStatement: This paper was self funded, no external grant, institution, or sponsor behind it. The honest, simple entry is: "This research received no external funding. The author self funded this study through Mechanical Trading System LLP / MTS Institute." That's accurate and closes the field cleanly rather than leaving it blank and inviting a reviewer to wonder why.

detail.abstract: This paper tests whether sequencing, the order in which a trend following tool and a mean reversion oscillator are permitted to act relative to a market regime classification, materially affects risk adjusted performance. Using a 63 trading day rolling linear regression R squared to classify daily regime state, and a 5,3 Stochastic oscillator conditioned on that classification, we test four rule variants against a buy and hold benchmark across four developed equity indices: the S&P 500 (United States, 2000 to 2025), the FTSE 100 (United Kingdom, 2013 to 2023), the DAX (Germany, 2013 to 2023), and the Nikkei 225 (Japan, 2000 to 2020). We find that conditioning the oscillator to act only once a trend is already confirmed by the regression, rather than during unconfirmed or ranging periods, produces higher Sharpe and Calmar ratios than an unconditioned trend following benchmark in three of the four markets, and dramatically outperforms buy and hold in the one market that exhibited multi decade directional stagnation over the sample period. We further test three risk overlays, a fixed percentage stop, volatility scaled position sizing, and a monthly reset stop, and find that volatility scaled sizing consistently produces the best risk adjusted outcome while a fixed percentage stop typically produces the highest absolute return. All rules tested are fully mechanical and require no discretionary judgment to apply. We report full parameter values, data sources, and limitations, and note that these findings do not extend to at least one emerging market index tested outside this paper's developed market scope, where the underlying index drift was strong enough that no active variant outperformed simple buy and hold.

AI.tldr: 本文研究交易规则中趋势跟踪工具与均值回归振荡器的执行顺序是否显著影响风险调整后收益。基于63日滚动回归R²划分市场状态，结合条件化随机振荡器，在四个发达市场指数上测试四种规则变体，发现将振荡器限制在趋势已确认时操作能产生更优的夏普比率和卡尔玛比率，且波动率缩放仓位管理效果最佳。
AI.research_question: 交易规则中趋势跟踪工具与均值回归振荡器的执行顺序（相对市场状态分类）是否会实质性地影响风险调整后的绩效？
AI.motivation: 现有技术交易规则研究多关注单一工具或参数优化，但不同交易工具的"顺序"（即哪个工具先判断、哪个后行动）如何影响绩效尚缺乏系统检验。作者试图填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场状态分类（趋势/震荡）、趋势跟踪（线性回归R²）、均值回归（Stochastic振荡器）、条件化交易规则、风险叠加（止损、波动率缩放、月度重置）
AI.method: 63日滚动线性回归R²将每日市场分为趋势确认/未确认/震荡三种状态；基于此状态对5,3 Stochastic振荡器施加条件；测试四种规则变体（仅在趋势确认时允许振荡器操作等）；对比买入持有基准；叠加三种风险管理方法。数据覆盖四个发达市场指数，时间跨度2000-2025年不等。
AI.findings: （1）仅在趋势已确认时允许振荡器操作，在四个市场中三个获得更高的夏普比率和卡尔玛比率；（2）在长期方向性停滞的市场中，该规则显著优于买入持有；（3）波动率缩放仓位管理产生最佳风险调整后收益，固定百分比止损产生最高绝对收益；（4）所有规则均为全机械、无需主观判断；（5）在新兴市场中未能超越简单买入持有。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统检验技术交易规则中"顺序"这一维度的影响，为条件化交易策略理论提供了实证支持，揭示了趋势确认在前、均值回归在后这一顺序的优越性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一套完全机械化的、无需主观判断的交易规则体系（含完整参数），可直接被量化交易者复制应用；明确了不同风险叠加方法的适用场景——追求稳健用波动率缩放，追求高回报用固定止损；警示该策略在强趋势新兴市场中无效。

title: Attending to the Supply Chain: Science-based Climate Commitments
affiliations: University of South Carolina - Department of Management Science and University of Western Ontario - Ivey Business School

detail.title: Attending to the Supply Chain: Science-based Climate Commitments
detail.abstract: For many large firms, the vast majority of carbon emissions originate outside their internal operations, across their supply chains. The Science-Based Targets initiative is among the few frameworks that require firms to confront these emissions through externally defined, independently validated reduction targets. Yet most publicly listed firms have not committed to the initiative, prompting the question of what distinguishes those that do. Drawing on the attention-based view of the firm, we argue that supply chain operations create attentional structures, namely organizational routines and information channels that direct senior managers' focus and shape their priorities, influencing whether firms commit credibly to reduce supply chain carbon emissions (i.e., Scope 3). We propose two pathways: proactive engagement (the top-down mechanism), tested using CDP Supply Chain Program membership, and reactive exposure (the bottom-up mechanism), tested using cumulative environmental supply chain incidents reported in the media. Using a panel of 13,663 firms across 113 countries (2013-2022), we find that both pathways are positively and independently associated with commitment, with magnitudes that are substantial relative to the annual base rate. Among firms that commit, prior proactive engagement is further associated with more stringent Scope 3 reduction targets. Thus, our findings extend the attention-based view beyond the firm's boundary, showing that supply chain operations act as interorganizational attentional structures and that credible climate commitments can be understood as attentional outcomes. Because supply chains account for such a large share of corporate emissions, programs and transparency mandates that specifically target supply chain operations may accelerate credible commitments more effectively than environmental initiatives focused on firms' own operations.

AI.tldr: 本文基于注意力基础观，研究为何部分大企业会承诺减少供应链碳排放（Scope 3）。通过对113个国家13,663家企业的面板数据分析，发现两条路径——主动参与（CDP供应链项目）和被动暴露（媒体负面事件）——均与企业承诺正相关，且主动参与还与更严格的减排目标相关。
AI.research_question: 是什么因素促使企业承诺减少供应链碳排放（即承诺加入科学碳目标倡议 SBTi）？
AI.motivation: 绝大多数上市企业尚未加入SBTi，但其供应链碳排放占企业总排放的绝大部分，理解哪些企业会做出可信的供应链减排承诺及其驱动因素具有重要现实意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 注意力基础观（Attention-Based View, ABV）：组织中的注意结构（惯例和信息渠道）引导高管注意力，塑造其优先事项，进而影响组织决策。
AI.method: 面板数据分析，样本涵盖113个国家13,663家企业（2013-2022年）。主动参与路径以CDP供应链项目成员身份衡量；被动暴露路径以媒体报道的供应链环境负面事件累积数衡量。
AI.findings: 1）主动参与和被动暴露均与企业承诺正相关，效应量相对于年度基准率显著；2）两条路径相互独立；3）已承诺企业中，主动参与路径还与更严格的Scope 3减排目标正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将注意力基础观从企业边界内拓展到跨组织层面，提出供应链运营作为"跨组织注意结构"，并将可信气候承诺理解为注意力产出。
AI.practical_contributions: 针对供应链运营的透明度和问责机制（而非仅关注企业自身运营的环境倡议）可能更有效地推动企业做出可信的减排承诺，为政策制定者和倡议机构提供了干预方向。

title: Entry-Timing Confirmation via Maximum Adverse Excursion: An Empirical Test on a Systematic Index Futures Strategy

detail.title: Entry-Timing Confirmation via Maximum Adverse Excursion: An Empirical Test on a Systematic Index Futures Strategy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the developer and an active trader of systematic strategies related to those analysed in this paper and has a direct financial interest in their performance. The author's compensation and business activities may be affected by conclusions drawn from this research. No external funding was received for this study
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human participants, human data, or animal subjects. It is a quantitative analysis of historical financial market data. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: "This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author using personal, self-funded trading capital and MTS Institute's internal research infrastructure."

detail.abstract: Systematic trading research overwhelmingly concentrates on signal generation, the rules that determine direction, while treating the moment of execution as a fixed consequence of the signal rather than a decision variable in its own right. This paper isolates entry timing as a distinct layer and tests one specific, easily implementable variant: delaying entry until price has moved a threshold percentage against the signal's direction (a pullback for long entries, a rally for short entries), using each trade's recorded Maximum Adverse Excursion (MAE, Sweeney, 1996) to determine, ex post, whether such a delayed limit order would have filled. Applied to a proprietary systematic trend-continuation signal traded on NSE Nifty index futures over a fifteen-year sample (2010–2026, N = 3,908 trades), a modest pullback-confirmation requirement (approximately 0.25% of the underlying) improves the Sharpe ratio from 1.38 to 3.33 and the Sortino ratio from 2.59 to 10.11, net of realistic transaction costs, while retaining 63% of the original trade population. The improvement is robust across a threshold band rather than concentrated at a single point, and Monte Carlo resampling confirms the result is not an artefact of favorable trade ordering. We discuss the likely mechanism (adverse-selection filtering of low-conviction signals), the opportunity cost (profitable trades foregone when the required pullback never materializes), and the boundary conditions under which this technique should be expected to generalize.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地研究了交易执行时机问题，发现将入场延迟至价格出现反向回调（pullback）后，能显著提升趋势跟踪策略的绩效，夏普比率从1.38提升至3.33。
AI.research_question: 在系统化交易中，将入场时机从信号的固定结果分离出来作为一个独立决策变量，能否通过延迟入场至价格出现反向回调来改善策略绩效？
AI.motivation: 现有系统化交易研究几乎全部聚焦于信号生成（方向判断），而将执行时点视为信号的固定附属品。本文试图纠正这一忽视，将执行时机提升为独立决策层面，检验一种简单可实施的回调确认机制的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最大不利偏移（Maximum Adverse Excursion, MAE）；趋势跟随信号；限价单执行；逆向选择过滤机制；蒙特卡洛重采样。
AI.method: 使用印度NSE Nifty指数期货2010-2026年15年数据（N=3,908笔交易），对专有趋势跟随信号应用延迟入场规则：要求价格在信号方向的反向移动一定门槛百分比（做多信号需回调约0.25%）后以限价单入场；通过MAE事后判断限价单是否成交。
AI.findings: 加入约0.25%回调确认后，夏普比率从1.38提升至3.33，索提诺比率从2.59提升至10.11，保留63%原始交易量。效果在门槛值附近稳健，蒙特卡洛重采样排除交易顺序的偶然性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将执行时机作为独立决策层进行系统检验，提出并验证了"逆向选择过滤"作为机制解释，即延迟入场筛选掉低确信度的噪音信号。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种简单、可实施的交易执行改进方案：在信号出现后等待价格反向回调约0.25%再入场，可大幅提升风险调整后收益；同时识别了该策略的机会成本（错过未出现回调的盈利交易）和边界条件。

title: Blockchain's Social and Economic History: Introduction to De Gruyter Handbook on Blockchain and Society
affiliations: Griffith University and Queensland University of Technology - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Blockchain's Social and Economic History: Introduction to De Gruyter Handbook on Blockchain and Society

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
This paper sets out the history and social development of blockchain from its early roots in the anarcho-capitalist movement of the 19th century Austrian school of economics through to the mysterious emanation of Satoshi Nakamoto's paper in 2008 to the present day. We examine the role and nature of blockchain as to how it imbues technology with elements of trust and expectations. Its attempts to decentralise and disintermediate economies and societies have met only with partial success as mainstream finance creeps closer to capture and institutionalisation. 
The book contains seven sections:
1. Blockchain Explained,  2.Blockchain and DAOs, 3. Blockchain and Culture, 4. Blockchain and Governance, 5. Blockchain Use Cases, 6. Blockchain, Law and Society, 7. Blockchain Futures.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了区块链从19世纪奥地利学派无政府资本主义思想到中本聪2008年白皮书，再到当前被主流金融收编和机构化的历史与社会发展脉络，探讨了区块链如何将信任与期望注入技术，以及其去中心化愿景仅取得部分成功的过程。
AI.research_question: 区块链技术从诞生到发展至今，其历史根源、社会演化过程如何？它在去中心化和去中介化方面的承诺为何仅取得部分成功？
AI.motivation: 理解区块链从自由意志主义思想根源到被主流金融"捕获"和机构化的演变过程，揭示技术理想与现实之间的张力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 奥地利学派经济学（无政府资本主义）、信任与技术的社会建构、去中心化与去中介化理论、制度捕获理论。
AI.method: 历史性文献综述与社会发展分析，涵盖区块链的技术演进、文化、治理、法律与社会影响等多个维度。
AI.findings: 区块链最初旨在通过技术去中心化和去中介化，但其愿景仅部分实现；主流金融正逐步接近"捕获"和机构化区块链，与原始理想产生偏离。
AI.theory_contributions: 将区块链发展置于奥地利学派经济学思想史脉络中，丰富了技术与社会制度互动的理论视角；揭示了信任与技术期望之间的动态关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解区块链的现实发展困境（去中心化理想与机构化现实之间的冲突）提供了历史和社会学的分析框架，对政策制定者和行业从业者有警示意义。

title: Supply Chain Risk, Trade and Economic Fragility
affiliations: , , University of California, San Diego (UCSD) and University of Texas at Austin - Department of Economics

detail.title: Supply Chain Risk, Trade and Economic Fragility
detail.abstract: We study how aggregate risk shapes production, trade, and input sourcing in complex supply chains. We develop a quantitative model of sequential production under risk, where each stage sources inputs from multiple origins. Analytically, we first show that sourcing shares equal an input's expected output elasticity-its expected marginal contribution to output across states. We then establish three further results: risk affects sourcing positionally through offsetting cross-stage complementarity and within-stage substitutability, making the net response a quantitative question; own risk has a negative welfare effect, while risk elsewhere has ambiguous, sometimes positive, effects through relative prices; and risk attenuates comparative advantage, with sequential production amplifying this force. Quantitatively, in a three-stage, fifty-country model, comparative advantage flattens as countries diversify away from their most productive suppliers. Greater supply-chain complexity lowers consumption volatility for riskier countries by providing diversification. Rising Chineseorigin risk reallocates production and generates uneven welfare effects across the chain.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了总体风险如何影响复杂供应链中的生产、贸易和投入采购，通过一个序贯生产模型揭示了风险对供应链的传导、福利效应和比较优势的削弱作用。
AI.research_question: 总体风险如何影响复杂供应链中的生产、贸易和投入采购决策？
AI.motivation: 现实中的供应链高度复杂且面临各种风险（如地缘政治、自然灾害），但现有理论对风险如何通过供应链层级传导的理解不足，尤其是风险对生产网络结构的内生影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建了一个序贯生产模型，每个阶段从多个来源采购投入，将风险纳入供应链决策，分析跨阶段互补性与阶段内替代性的权衡。
AI.method: 理论建模+数值模拟。建立定量模型，推导解析解，并通过一个50国、三阶段模型进行定量分析。
AI.findings: （1）采购份额等于投入的预期产出弹性；（2）风险通过跨阶段互补性和阶段内替代性产生位置性效应；（3）自身风险有负福利效应，其他地区风险通过相对价格产生不确定效应；（4）风险削弱比较优势，序贯生产放大这一效应；（5）供应链复杂性为高风险国家提供多样化，降低消费波动；（6）中国来源风险冲击沿产业链产生不均衡的福利效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将总体风险纳入序贯生产供应链模型，揭示了风险影响采购份额的预期产出弹性机制，以及风险对比较优势的衰减效应，丰富了贸易与供应链风险理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者理解供应链风险传导机制提供分析框架，提示供应链复杂性对风险分散的积极作用，以及外部风险冲击（如中国风险）的不均衡福利影响。

title: Consumer Trust in AI Transparency: A Double-Edged Sword
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information Systems, Business Statistics and Operations Management and College of Business, City University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Consumer Trust in AI Transparency: A Double-Edged Sword
detail.abstract: More and more, shoppers do not size up a product for themselves; they ask an AI assistant and act on what it tells them. The same shift is spreading across search, travel, and retail, where a generative-AI summary now stands in for the reviews, listings, and sources a person would once have read. Yet the assistant's verdict is shaped by parties with a stake in the sale, and a shopper cannot easily tell what it leaves out. Whether to believe a favorable AI verdict is therefore a real question, and regulators are answering it with transparency rules-the 2024 FTC rule against review suppression, the European Union's AI Act-on the presumption that forcing disclosure earns consumer trust and leaves buyers better off. We ask when that presumption holds. In our model a seller reaches consumers through an AI it controls, commits to how often it will disclose an unfavorable verdict, and faces a market that mixes consumers who believe the commitment with skeptics who discount it, across settings that differ in how cheaply an unfavorable verdict can be buried. The welfare effect of consumer trust reverses with the cost of suppression. Where suppression is cheap, trust is what lets the seller sustain a high-price extraction policy, so raising the trusting share lowers consumer surplus; where suppression is moderately costly, trust instead pulls the market out of an inflated low-disclosure regime, raising consumer surplus; where suppression is expensive, trust is neutral. A sharp threshold in the suppression cost separates these regimes, and the pattern survives skewed priors and convex suppression costs. Transparency regulation is thus not uniformly proconsumer: the same mandate helps consumers in some markets and harms them in others, depending on how cheaply the AI's unfavorable verdict can be buried.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在AI助手取代传统消费者自主搜索场景下，透明度监管（如强制披露）对消费者福利的影响。模型表明，当AI助手由卖方控制时，消费者信任的福利效应取决于"压制不利结论的成本"：成本低时信任损害消费者，成本适中时信任帮助消费者，成本高时信任中性。透明度监管并非总是有利于消费者。
AI.research_question: 在卖方控制的AI助手场景中，透明度监管（强制披露不利结论）何时能够提升消费者福利？
AI.motivation: 越来越多的消费者依赖AI助手（如生成式AI摘要）进行购物决策，但这些AI结论可能被利益相关方操纵，消费者难以辨别信息完整性。监管机构（如FTC、欧盟AI法案）试图通过透明度规则来保护消费者，但这种做法的有效性缺乏理论支撑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型：卖方控制AI助手，承诺披露不利结论的频率；市场包含两类消费者——相信承诺的"信任者"和怀疑的"怀疑者"；引入"压制成本"（卖方隐藏不利结论的难度）作为关键参数。
AI.method: 理论建模与均衡分析，考察不同压制成本水平下消费者信任比例对均衡价格、披露率及消费者剩余的影响。
AI.findings: 消费者信任的福利效应随压制成本变化呈现三阶段：1）压制成本低时，信任使卖方维持高价格掠夺策略，降低消费者剩余；2）压制成本适中时，信任将市场从低披露膨胀均衡中拉出，提升消费者剩余；3）压制成本高时，信任中性。压制成本存在清晰阈值划分上述区间。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示了AI透明度监管的消费者福利效应并非单调递增，而是取决于技术层面的压制成本；为监管经济学中"披露悖论"提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供政策启示：统一的透明度规则在不同市场中效果迥异，监管设计应考虑AI结论被压制的技术难度差异，实施差异化而非一刀切的监管策略。

title: LLMs for Qualitative and Mixed-Methods Social Network Analysis

detail.title: LLMs for Qualitative and Mixed-Methods Social Network Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: This manuscript explores the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into the field of qualitative and mixed-methods social network analysis (SNA). We argue that the primary focus of this integration should be on enhancing the depth and rigor of qualitative SNA, rather than on replacing human researchers with automated systems. We begin by outlining the core principles of qualitative and mixed-methods SNA, emphasizing the importance of understanding the meaning of ties, the role of narratives, and the significance of relational identities. We then discuss how LLMs can be used as powerful tools to augment this work, from assisting with data collection and coding to supporting theory-building and abductive reasoning. We also address the limitations and ethical challenges of using LLMs in this context, including issues of bias, hallucination, and the need for reflexivity. We conclude with a series of research designs and practical recommendations for researchers who want to integrate LLMs into their work in a thoughtful and responsible way.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨如何将大语言模型（LLMs）整合到定性与混合方法的社会网络分析（SNA）中，强调应将其作为增强研究深度和严谨性的工具，而非替代人类研究者。
AI.research_question: 如何负责任地将大语言模型整合到定性与混合方法的社会网络分析中，以增强而非取代人类研究者？
AI.motivation: LLMs的快速发展为SNA带来新可能，但学界对其在定性研究中的角色定位尚不清晰，存在被误用为"替代品"的风险，因此需要明确其辅助性定位和伦理边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 定性SNA的核心原则（理解关系意义、叙事作用、关系身份），以及溯因推理（abductive reasoning）理论。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文，通过阐述定性SNA的核心原则，结合LLM的技术特性，提出整合框架、研究设计和实践建议。
AI.findings: LLMs可在数据收集、编码、理论构建和溯因推理等方面辅助研究者，但存在偏见、幻觉等问题，需要研究者保持反思性（reflexivity）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为LLMs在定性SNA中的角色提供了理论定位（增强而非替代），并提出了基于溯因推理的理论建构路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的研究设计方案和实操建议，帮助研究者在定性与混合方法SNA中负责任地使用LLMs。

title: A Multi-feature Decomposition Transform-Based Gated Recurrent Unit Model for Drought Prediction in Sub-Saharan Africa
affiliations: North-West University, Sol Plaatje University, , Anhui University, Henan Polytechnic University, North-West University and North-West University

detail.title: A Multi-feature Decomposition Transform-Based Gated Recurrent Unit Model for Drought Prediction in Sub-Saharan Africa
detail.abstract: Drought in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) represents a critical threat to food and economic security since the majority of the SSA region relies on rain-fed agriculture. The traditional approaches used in drought forecasting have failed to capture the nonlinear, noisy nature of precipitation in tropical regions. The main objective of the proposed study was to design and develop a hybrid model called Wavelet Decomposition Transform-Gated Recurrent Unit (WDT-GRU), which could be used for the improvement of meteorological drought forecasting in the different climatic regions of Sudan, South Sudan, and Nigeria. For the proposed study, the researchers used the CHIRPS data for the calculation of the Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI) on three different scales, namely SPI-3, SPI-6, and SPI-12. For this purpose, the proposed framework uses the combination of the Wavelet Decomposition Transformation (WDT) method for data denoising, as well as Gated Recurrent Units (GRU) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). It was observed that the proposed model achieved excellent accuracy in predicting meteorological drought in the three regions, with the R2 precision rate being greater than 0.97. It was observed in the proposed study that regions like Sinkat in Sudan and Ivo in Nigeria are facing chronic drought, while regions like Ezo in South Sudan, which are resistant to moisture, are highly prone to sudden 'flash' droughts. Adam and Nadam are used in the proposed study for the improvement of convergence rates. With this framework's high-resolution predictive insights at the city scale, a powerful tool for proactive climate adaptation and disaster management in Sub-Saharan Africa is provided.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种混合模型WDT-GRU（小波分解变换-门控循环单元），用于改进撒哈拉以南非洲（苏丹、南苏丹、尼日利亚）不同气候区域的气象干旱预测。该模型结合小波分解去噪、GRU和LSTM，利用CHIRPS数据计算SPI-3/6/12指数，R²精度超过0.97，为城市尺度的干旱预警和气候适应提供了高效工具。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和开发一种混合模型WDT-GRU，以提高撒哈拉以南非洲不同气候区域的气象干旱预测精度？
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲依赖雨养农业，干旱对粮食和经济安全构成严重威胁，但传统干旱预测方法未能捕捉热带地区降水数据的非线性、噪声特性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 小波分解变换（WDT）用于数据去噪；门控循环单元（GRU）和长短期记忆网络（LSTM）用于时间序列预测；Adam和Nadam优化器用于加速收敛。
AI.method: 基于CHIRPS遥感降水数据计算标准化降水指数（SPI-3、SPI-6、SPI-12），构建WDT-GRU混合模型，结合小波去噪和GRU/LSTM进行干旱预测。
AI.findings: (1) WDT-GRU模型在三个地区的气象干旱预测中R²精度均超过0.97；(2) 苏丹Sinkat和尼日利亚Ivo地区面临长期干旱，而南苏丹Ezo等耐湿地区极易发生突发性"闪旱"；(3) Adam和Nadam优化器有效提升了模型收敛速度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将小波分解与门控循环单元结合，提出了一种能够处理非线性、噪声降水数据的新型混合干旱预测框架，拓展了深度学习在热带干旱预测领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为撒哈拉以南非洲城市尺度提供了高分辨率干旱预测工具，有助于主动应对气候变化和灾害管理，尤其对识别慢性干旱和闪旱高风险区域具有实际指导意义。

title: Attention-enhanced GRU with Contextual Isolation Forest for Smart Factory Load Forecasting and Anomaly Detection

detail.title: Attention-enhanced GRU with Contextual Isolation Forest for Smart Factory Load Forecasting and Anomaly Detection

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no financial or personal relationships with individuals or organizations that could inappropriately influence or bias this work. This research was developed in connection with the Cambridge University Sustainability Hackathon 2026. The sponsors and organizers of the event had no role in the design of the study, the collection, analysis, and interpretation of the data, the writing of the manuscript, or the decision to submit the paper for publication. This research was driven entirely by personal academic interest and a long-term research orientation in industrial sustainability and machine learning. This study was conducted independently, without any external funding, commercial sponsorships, or personal relationships that could have influenced or been perceived as influencing the objectivity and integrity of this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, clinical trials, or animal subjects; therefore, formal ethical approval was not required. The research was conducted using open-source, fully anonymized datasets from the UCI Machine Learning Repository and simulated profiles, ensuring complete privacy compliance.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares that this research was driven entirely by personal academic interest and research orientation. This study was self-funded by the author. No external funding, commercial grants, or third-party financial sponsorships were received for the research, development, or publication of this work.

detail.abstract: Modern industrial facilities operate under highly dynamic electrical load conditions, driven by complex production shifts, automated machinery cycles, and local microgrid assets. Traditional anomaly detection algorithms often fail in these environments, generating frequent false-positive flags during scheduled operational changes. Furthermore, statistical load forecasting models struggle to capture non-linear, multiseasonal patterns without computational inefficiency. This paper presents an integrated framework, named PRAGATI AI, designed to address these limitations. First, we introduce a vectorized, L2-regularized Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) neural network enhanced with a custom Temporal Attention (TA-GRU) mechanism that processes multi-variable time-series load data using parallel batch calculations and prevents overfitting. Second, we combine a Temporal-Contextual Isolation Forest (TC-iForest) with expert heuristic rules to diagnose power quality anomalies, identifying Voltage Sags, Swells, and Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) limits based on the IEEE-519 industrial standard. The forecasting framework is validated against LSTM, ablated GRU, Prophet, Random Forest, and Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) benchmarks across two datasets: the UCI Steel Industry dataset and the ENTSO-E European Grid Load dataset. On the steel manufacturing telemetry, our Attention-Enhanced GRU achieves a 25.4% reduction in Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) over standard LSTM, while demonstrating strong generalizability on aggregated grid demand. Meanwhile, the TC-iForest reduces false alarm rates by 68.3% compared to conventional threshold models, establishing a robust framework for smart factory energy auditing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRAGATI AI框架，结合注意力增强GRU（TA-GRU）进行工业负荷预测，以及时序上下文隔离森林（TC-iForest）进行电能质量异常检测，在钢铁制造和欧洲电网数据集上显著降低了预测误差和误报率。
AI.research_question: 如何在高动态工业负荷环境中实现高精度负荷预测与低误报率的电能质量异常检测？
AI.motivation: 传统异常检测方法在工业设施动态负荷环境下频繁产生误报，而统计负荷预测模型难以高效捕捉非线性、多季节性模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: L2正则化门控循环单元（GRU）、时序注意力机制（Temporal Attention）、隔离森林（Isolation Forest）、专家启发式规则、IEEE-519工业标准。
AI.method: 提出PRAGATI AI框架：1）向量化L2正则化GRU+时序注意力（TA-GRU）；2）时序上下文隔离森林（TC-iForest）结合专家规则；在UCI钢铁行业数据集和ENTSO-E欧洲电网数据集上对比LSTM、Prophet、随机森林、TFT等基准模型。
AI.findings: TA-GRU在钢铁制造数据集上相比标准LSTM降低RMSE 25.4%；TC-iForest相比传统阈值模型降低误报率68.3%；模型在聚合电网需求上展现强泛化能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了融合时序注意力与正则化GRU的负荷预测方法，以及结合隔离森林与专家规则的时序异常检测方法，为动态工业环境下的智能建模提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为智慧工厂能源审计和工业电能质量监控提供了低误报率、高精度的实用框架，支持IEEE-519标准的合规检测。

title: Institutions, Normative Expectations, and Harassment Bribery: Evidence from a Three-country Experiment
affiliations: National Research University Higher School of Economics, National Research University – Higher School of Economics (HSE University), Amsterdam School of Economics and

detail.title: Institutions, Normative Expectations, and Harassment Bribery: Evidence from a Three-country Experiment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no conflicts of interest, financial or otherwise, relevant to the content of this article. No funding was received that could have influenced the design, conduct, analysis, or reporting of this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Sessions were approved by the HSE IRB (Moscow) and the University of Amsterdam EBEC; no separate approval was required at the University of Bari Aldo Moro. All participants gave informed consent.

detail.abstract: Extortionary ("harassment") bribery can persist even when widely condemned, consistent with a coordination problem sustained by beliefs about what others do and what others consider acceptable. We study whether a minimal institutional featurethe presence of a third-party monitor empowered to punish-shifts (i) normative expectations about extortion and compliance and (ii) empirical expectations about their prevalence. We implement a preregistered laboratory experiment with two phases in the Netherlands, Italy, and Russia. In Phase I, participants play a harassment bribery game with or without monitoring. In Phase II, using an independent sample we elicit social appropriateness judgments using a Krupka-Weber coordination game and empirical expectations about Phase I behaviour. We report preregistered within-country comparisons and complementary exploratory pooled specifications that increase precision while allowing country-heterogeneous effects. Overall, the findings are consistent with monitoring operating not only through deterrence but also as an institutional signal that can reshape the belief environment sustaining harassment bribery, with heterogeneous responses across settings.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验研究发现在敲诈性贿赂中，第三方监督不仅通过威慑作用，还通过制度信号重塑人们的规范期望和经验期望，从而改变贿赂行为的持续存在。
AI.research_question: 第三方监督如何影响人们对敲诈性贿赂（骚扰贿赂）的规范期望（人们认为什么是可接受的）和经验期望（人们认为他人会怎么做）？
AI.motivation: 敲诈性贿赂即使在广泛受到谴责的情况下仍可能持续存在，这被认为是一种由信念（关于他人行为及他人认为可接受的行为）所维持的协调问题。理解制度干预（如监督机制）能否通过改变信念环境来减少此类腐败，具有重要的政策意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协调问题理论、规范期望与经验期望的区分、制度信号的信号理论
AI.method: 预注册的实验室实验，分为两个阶段：第一阶段被试参与有或无监督的敲诈性贿赂博弈；第二阶段使用独立样本，通过Krupka-Weber协调博弈测量社会适当性判断，并收集对第一阶段行为的经验期望。实验在荷兰、意大利和俄罗斯三个国家进行。
AI.findings: 监督不仅通过威慑效应发挥作用，还作为一种制度信号重塑了维持敲诈性贿赂的信念环境。监督改变了人们的规范期望和经验期望，但效果在不同国家之间存在异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度监督的作用从单纯威慑扩展到信念重塑的信号功能，揭示了腐败持续存在的协调问题机制如何被制度干预所改变。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反腐败政策设计提供了新视角：监督机制的价值不仅在于惩罚违规行为，还在于通过制度信号改变社会规范期望，从而从信念层面瓦解腐败的协调困境。

title: Who cares about Excess CEO Compensation? Evidence from Overpaid CEO Designations
affiliations: The University of Texas at El Paso,  and Eller College of Management, University of Arizona

detail.title: Who cares about Excess CEO Compensation? Evidence from Overpaid CEO Designations
detail.abstract: For decades, there has been a controversial debate as to whether CEOs are overpaid and how stakeholders should respond to excess CEO compensation. We shed new light on the question as to which investors care about excess CEO pay. Using nine years of data from a report of the 100 most overpaid S&P 500 CEOs, we find that equity investors, on average, respond negatively when CEOs are designated as overpaid. The announcement returns are the most negative when the reports receive substantial attention shortly after publication and when firms first appear on the overpaid CEO list. We find, however, that institutional investors exhibit nuanced responses to the overpaid CEO designations. Specifically, non-ESG-oriented investors rebalance their portfolios towards the listed firms' shares, whereas ESG-oriented investors exhibit relatively muted responses. Additional tests indicate that investors who rebalance towards listed firms do so to course-correct excess CEO pay via their governance influence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究哪些投资者关注CEO薪酬过高问题。基于九年来"100位薪酬过高CEO"榜单数据，发现普通股权投资者对此负面反应，但机构投资者反应存在异质性：非ESG投资者反而增持股票以施加治理影响，而ESG投资者反应相对平淡。
AI.research_question: 哪些投资者关心CEO薪酬过高的问题？不同类型的投资者（股权投资者 vs. 机构投资者，ESG导向 vs. 非ESG导向）对CEO被列为"薪酬过高"的公告反应有何不同？
AI.motivation: 关于CEO薪酬是否过高以及利益相关者应如何应对，学术界长期存在争议。现有研究对投资者如何回应CEO薪酬过高问题的认识不足，尤其缺乏对不同类型的投资者（如ESG与非ESG机构投资者）的差异化反应的考察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资者异质性理论、公司治理机制、ESG投资理论
AI.method: 利用九年的"100位薪酬过高S&P 500 CEO"榜单数据，采用事件研究法分析公告日附近的股票市场反应，并通过机构投资者持股数据考察其投资组合调整行为。
AI.findings: （1）普通股权投资者对CEO被列为"薪酬过高"的公告平均呈现负面反应；（2）当报告获得显著关注以及企业首次上榜时，负面反应最为强烈；（3）机构投资者反应存在异质性：非ESG导向的投资者反而增持被列名公司的股票，而ESG导向的投资者反应相对平淡；（4）增持的投资者这样做是为了通过其治理影响力来纠正过高的CEO薪酬。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了投资者对CEO薪酬过高问题的差异化反应，区分了不同类型投资者（ESG vs. 非ESG）的治理策略差异，丰富了公司治理和投资者行为理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为董事会、政策制定者和社会公众理解投资者如何通过资本市场机制约束CEO薪酬提供了实证依据；对ESG投资实践具有启示意义，表明ESG投资者在薪酬治理问题上可能并非最积极的行动者。

title: Entropy Pooling with CVaR and EVaR Views
affiliations: Universidad Nacional de Ingeniería

detail.title: Entropy Pooling with CVaR and EVaR Views
detail.abstract: This work presents an extension of the entropy pooling approach to handle views on the tails of the distribution of random variables. First, we provide formulations that allows to incorporate absolute and relative views on conditional value at risk into the traditional formulation of entropy pooling. Second, we provide formulations that allows to incorporate absolute views on entropic value at risk into the traditional formulation of entropy pooling. Also, we develop the sample formulas for weighted comoments tensors. Then, we run some numerical examples that shows how these formulations allows to transform a prior distribution into a posterior distribution that incorporate tail views.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了熵池方法，使其能够处理随机变量分布的尾部视图。具体而言，论文提出了将条件风险价值（CVaR）和熵风险价值（EVaR）的绝对与相对观点融入传统熵池框架的公式，并推导了加权协同矩张量的样本公式。通过数值示例展示了如何利用这些公式将先验分布转化为包含尾部视图的后验分布。
AI.research_question: 如何将关于随机变量分布尾部（CVaR和EVaR）的观点纳入传统的熵池框架中？
AI.motivation: 传统的熵池方法主要关注分布的均值、方差等中心矩观点，但缺乏处理尾部风险观点的能力。然而在金融风险管理等领域，尾部风险（如极端损失）至关重要，因此需要扩展熵池方法以纳入尾部视图。
AI.theoretical_framework: 熵池方法（Entropy Pooling）、条件风险价值（CVaR）、熵风险价值（EVaR）、加权协同矩张量
AI.method: 首先，推导将CVaR的绝对和相对观点融入熵池的公式；其次，推导将EVaR的绝对观点融入熵池的公式；然后，开发加权协同矩张量的样本公式；最后，通过数值示例验证所提方法的有效性。
AI.findings: 所提出的公式能够成功地将关于CVaR和EVaR的尾部观点纳入熵池框架，将先验分布转化为包含尾部风险信息的后验分布。数值示例验证了该方法的可行性和有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将熵池方法从处理分布中心矩扩展至尾部风险指标（CVaR和EVaR），提供了尾部观点融入的数学公式和加权协同矩张量的样本公式，丰富了熵池理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融风险管理、投资组合优化等需要关注尾部风险的场景提供了新的技术工具，使研究者能够将尾部风险观点系统性地融入概率分布估计中。

title: How Artificial Intelligence LLM Engines Shape the Global Conflict Information Environment

detail.title: How Artificial Intelligence LLM Engines Shape the Global Conflict Information Environment
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) answer engines now field a growing share of the questions that analysts, scholars, and the public ask about issues of peace and conflict. Large Language Models (LLMs) are known to hallucinate under certain conditions, but do these errors have discernible patterns when they are asked about conflicts, and if so what can that teach us about the changing global conflict information environment? To answer, we first asked a battery of questions about 28 conflicts to five leading answer engines and scored their 5,460 answers against documented evidence. We found that the thinner the retrievable record around a given conflict, the more the engines invent, misattribute, and miscount. Thin records don't just encourage hallucination, but create structural exposure to mis-and disinformation, because they are the easiest records to warp through Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) to bias engine responses. Through an analysis of 1,048 websites that the AI LLMs pulled conflict facts from, we found that GEO source optimization is already happening, and while state-partisan digital capture remains incipient it is rapidly growing. We explain what these findings mean for scholarship with the rise of GEO information warfare, and for policy argue for a return to the deep local monitoring and translation-based research that AI tools cannot replicate, closing with a discussion of future research opportunities and challenges in this fast-moving space.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了AI问答引擎在回答冲突类问题时的幻觉模式，发现信息记录越稀薄的冲突，AI越容易编造、错误归因和错误计数。薄记录不仅加剧幻觉，还创造了对错误信息的结构性暴露风险，因为薄记录最容易被生成引擎优化（GEO）操纵。通过对1048个AI提取事实的网站分析，发现GEO源优化已在进行中，国家党派数字控制虽仍处于初期但增长迅速。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型在回答冲突类问题时是否存在可辨别的错误模式？这些模式能揭示关于不断变化的全球冲突信息环境的什么信息？
AI.motivation: AI回答引擎正越来越多地处理分析师、学者和公众关于和平与冲突问题的查询，但LLMs已知会出现幻觉，需要对冲突领域的幻觉模式进行系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI幻觉理论、生成引擎优化（GEO）、信息战理论、数字信息环境理论
AI.method: 对5个领先AI问答引擎提出关于28个冲突的一系列问题，对5460个答案进行评分并与记录在案的证据进行比对；对1048个AI提取事实的网站进行分析。
AI.findings: 冲突信息记录越稀薄，AI引擎越容易编造、错误归因和错误计数；薄记录创造了对错误信息的结构性暴露风险，因为它们最容易被GEO操纵；GEO源优化已在发生；国家党派数字控制虽处初期但增长迅速。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI幻觉在冲突信息领域的系统性模式，提出了"薄记录结构性暴露"理论框架，将GEO信息战概念引入冲突研究领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学者识别和防范GEO信息战提供分析框架；为政策制定者提出回归深层本地监测和基于翻译的研究的建议；指出AI工具无法替代的研究领域。

title: Oil Price Shocks, Supply Chain Disruptions, and the Speed of Post-COVID Recovery: A VAR Analysis for the U.S. Economy
affiliations: , Texas Tech University and Texas Tech University

detail.title: Oil Price Shocks, Supply Chain Disruptions, and the Speed of Post-COVID Recovery: A VAR Analysis for the U.S. Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this study because it uses publicly available, aggregate secondary data and does not involve human participants or personally identifiable information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether the transmission of oil price shocks has changed in the post-COVID period. Using a reduced-form VAR estimated on monthly U.S. data, we compare impulse responses of inflation, industrial production, employment, and monetary policy to an oil price shock across two subsamples: a pre-COVID period (2000–2019) and a post-COVID recovery period (2020–2024). Our approach follows the broader VAR literature on oil shocks, including the structural VAR oil market models in Baumeister and Hamilton (2019) and Kilian (2009), and recent high-frequency identification work such as Qureshi and Ahmad (2025). By estimating the model separately for each subsample, we evaluate whether the post-pandemic economic environment exhibits stronger or more volatile responses to energy price disturbances. The contribution of this study is twofold. First, we provide new evidence on how oil shocks propagate in the post-COVID U.S. economy, which has been characterized by supply-chain fragility, elevated inflation, and aggressive monetary tightening. Second, by contrasting these results with the pre-COVID period, we provide insight into whether the transmission of oil price shocks differs between the pre-COVID and post-COVID periods. This comparison helps clarify how supply chain disruptions, geopolitical uncertainty, and changing policy regimes may have altered the sensitivity of the U.S. economy to energy-related disturbances. We find that the pre- and post-COVID economies react differently to oil price shocks, and our results suggest that the post-COVID economy exhibits stronger responses in several key macroeconomic variables, particularly the federal funds rate.

AI.tldr: 本文利用简化型VAR模型，比较2000-2019年与2020-2024年两个子样本，发现美国经济在COVID后对油价冲击的反应更强，尤其是联邦基金利率的响应更为显著。
AI.research_question: COVID后疫情时期，油价冲击的传导机制是否发生了变化？
AI.motivation: 后疫情时代美国经济面临供应链脆弱、高通胀和激进货币紧缩等新特征，需重新评估油价冲击的宏观经济效应是否与疫情前不同。
AI.theoretical_framework: 简化型VAR模型，参考Baumeister和Hamilton（2019）、Kilian（2009）的结构VAR油价模型，以及Qureshi和Ahmad（2025）的高频识别方法。
AI.method: 基于月度美国数据，分别估计疫情前（2000-2019）和疫情后（2020-2024）两个子样本的简化型VAR，比较通胀、工业产出、就业和货币政策对油价冲击的脉冲响应。
AI.findings: 前后疫情时期美国经济对油价冲击的反应存在显著差异；后疫情时期多个关键宏观变量的响应更强，尤其是联邦基金利率的反应更为突出。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了后疫情时代油价冲击传导机制变化的新证据；揭示了供应链中断、地缘政治不确定性和政策制度变化如何改变美国经济对能源价格扰动的敏感性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解后疫情时期油价冲击对通胀、就业和货币政策的影响提供实证依据，有助于优化能源价格冲击下的宏观调控策略。

title: No Spoilers: A Contamination-Free LLM for Brand Perception Analysis
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business and University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business

detail.title: No Spoilers: A Contamination-Free LLM for Brand Perception Analysis
detail.abstract: Brands are focal objects of marketing, and how consumers perceive them shapes positioning, consumer choice, and firm performance. These perceptions are often not directly observed but reflected in the large volume of unstructured text consumers produce about brands, making language models a scalable tool for measuring them. Tracking such measures over time, however, raises two challenges. First, model parameters may encode information from after the measurement date, producing lookahead bias. Second, changes across model versions undermine comparability. We address both with Data-Restricted Incremental Pretraining and Projection (DRIP^2), a workflow that builds a lightweight temporally bounded sentence encoder from pre-sample data, constructs quarterly brand representation vectors, removes platform-wide language shifts, and projects the vectors onto researcher-defined dimensions. Applied to more than 60 million tweets from 2016-2022, DRIP^2 generates interpretable maps of brands, sports teams, and actors. The measures respond to major real-world events, predict future profit-margin growth, and reveal short-lived shifts in the intended direction following marketing campaigns and movie releases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DRIP^2方法，通过数据受限增量预训练和投影技术，从大规模文本数据中构建无回望偏差、跨版本可比的品牌感知时间序列测量，并验证其对真实事件响应和利润增长的预测能力。
AI.research_question: 如何从消费者生成的大规模非结构化文本中，构建随时间变化、无回望偏差且跨版本可比的品牌感知测量指标？
AI.motivation: 品牌感知是营销的核心，但传统测量方法难以规模化捕捉其随时间的变化。语言模型虽可扩展，但存在两个关键问题：(1) 模型参数可能编码未来信息，产生回望偏差；(2) 模型版本更迭导致测量结果不可比，阻碍纵向分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于品牌定位理论、文本分析与自然语言处理中的句子嵌入技术、以及时间序列偏差校正方法。
AI.method: 提出DRIP^2工作流：利用样本前数据构建轻量级时间边界句子编码器；按季度构建品牌表征向量；去除平台层面语言漂移；将向量投影到研究者定义的维度上。应用于2016-2022年超过6000万条推文数据。
AI.findings: DRIP^2生成可解释的品牌、运动队和演员感知地图；测量指标对重大真实世界事件有响应；能预测未来利润率增长；在营销活动和电影上映后捕捉到预期方向的短期感知变化。
AI.theory_contributions: (1)提出解决语言模型纵向测量中回望偏差和版本不可比问题的系统性方法；(2)为品牌感知的动态测量提供了可复现、可扩展的技术框架；(3)验证了基于社交媒体文本的品牌感知指标对财务绩效的预测效度。
AI.practical_contributions: (1)为营销人员提供无偏、可比的品牌感知跟踪工具；(2)支持评估营销活动和产品发布对消费者感知的即时影响；(3)帮助企业监测品牌在真实事件中的感知变化，辅助战略决策。

title: India's Soft Power Diplomacy during the COVID-19 Pandemic: Vaccine Diplomacy for Global Solutions

detail.title: India's Soft Power Diplomacy during the COVID-19 Pandemic: Vaccine Diplomacy for Global Solutions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is based entirely on secondary sources (published articles, reports, and case studies) and did not involve human participants, patients, or original data collection.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: not applicable, no clinical trial involved

detail.abstract: This paper examines the extent to which India's response to the COVID-19 pandemic, through its health and vaccine diplomacy, affected its soft power and global standing. Building on a history of cultural and civilizational diplomacy, India leveraged its pharmaceutical manufacturing capacity to supply medicines, medical equipment, and vaccines to over 150 countries, most notably through the "Vande Bharat" evacuation mission and the "Vaccine Maitri" initiative. By positioning itself as a first responder and reliable healthcare provider, India sought to project itself as a responsible global actor and reinforce its regional influence in South Asia. Situating this response within Joseph Nye's theory of soft power, the paper traces India's diplomatic trajectory from the onset of the pandemic through 2024. The findings show that India faced a significant setback during the pandemic's second wave, marked by domestic infrastructural collapse, a vaccine export ban, and a temporary decline in its soft power ranking, but ultimately recovered, with its Global Soft Power Index ranking rising to 29th by 2024. The paper concludes that despite ongoing internal challenges and the spread of misinformation, India's medical diplomacy had a net positive, if uneven, effect on its international standing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了印度通过卫生和疫苗外交应对新冠疫情如何影响其软实力和全球地位。尽管第二波疫情中遭遇国内医疗崩溃、疫苗出口禁令等挫折，软实力排名一度下降，但到2024年其全球软实力指数排名回升至第29位。结论是印度的医疗外交对其国际地位总体产生了积极但不均衡的影响。
AI.research_question: 印度在新冠疫情期间的卫生和疫苗外交在多大程度上影响了其软实力和全球地位？
AI.motivation: 印度的文化文明外交历史悠久，疫情期间其凭借制药产能向150多个国家提供医疗物资和疫苗，试图展现负责任的全球行为体形象。因此需要系统评估这种医疗外交对软实力的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 约瑟夫·奈的软实力理论
AI.method: 历史追踪法，从疫情暴发至2024年，结合全球软实力指数排名等实证数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 印度在第二波疫情期间遭遇重大挫折（国内医疗基础设施崩溃、疫苗出口禁令、软实力排名短期下降），但最终实现恢复，2024年全球软实力指数排名升至第29位。尽管面临国内挑战和 misinformation 传播，印度的医疗外交对其国际地位总体产生了积极但不均衡的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将软实力理论应用于发展中国家在突发公共卫生事件中的医疗外交情境，拓展了软实力理论在"疫苗外交"等新兴领域的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家如何通过卫生外交提升全球地位提供了经验证据；揭示了医疗外交中"言行一致"对软实力的关键性；对政策制定者规划危机时期外交策略具有参考价值。

title: Combining Target and Bonus Discretion: An Experimental Investigation
affiliations: University of Bern - Institute for Accounting, Georgia State University and University of Bern - Institute for Accounting

detail.title: Combining Target and Bonus Discretion: An Experimental Investigation

declarations.ethicsApproval: All data collections of this paper were approved by the Institutional Review Boards of the authors’ universities.

detail.abstract: In this study, we use an experiment to investigate whether ex ante managerial discretion over targets alters the effectiveness of ex post managerial discretion over bonuses in motivating performance. We predict and find that when managers do not have target discretion, bonus discretion decreases employee performance because employees' incentives and perception of fairness are impaired. In contrast, when managers have target allocation discretion, such that the sum of employees' targets must equal manager's own unit target, bonus discretion increases employee performance because managers use target discretion together with bonus discretion to motivate effort and performance, while keeping unfairness perceptions under control. Thus, our results suggest that having a "fit" between target and bonus discretion is more effective than granting only one type of discretion. We also find that when managers have full target discretion and can set targets without restrictions, employee performance is relatively low and bonus discretion has little effect on it as managers often set overly difficult targets, thereby undermining employees' financial incentives. Our results underscore the interrelated nature of different types of managerial discretion and the need for considering performance evaluation systems in its entirety rather than analyzing single components in isolation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验探究了目标设定权与奖金分配权的匹配如何影响员工绩效。当管理者没有目标设定权时，奖金分配权会降低员工绩效；当管理者有约束的目标设定权（下属目标总和等于管理者自身目标）时，奖金分配权会提升绩效；而当管理者有完全目标设定权时，绩效较低且奖金分配权作用有限。
AI.research_question: 事先的管理者目标设定权如何影响事后管理者奖金分配权在激励绩效方面的有效性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常孤立分析绩效评价系统中的单一组成部分，忽视了不同类型管理裁量权之间的相互关联性。本研究旨在探讨目标设定权与奖金分配权的"匹配"如何共同影响员工绩效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 激励理论、公平感知理论
AI.method: 实验研究法
AI.findings: 1) 无目标设定权时，奖金分配权降低员工绩效（损害激励和公平感知）；2) 有约束目标设定权（下属目标总和=管理者自身目标）时，奖金分配权提升绩效（管理者利用两种裁量权配合激励）；3) 完全目标设定权时，绩效较低且奖金分配权作用有限（管理者常设定过高目标损害员工财务激励）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同类型管理裁量权之间的相互依存关系，提出"匹配"概念——目标设定权与奖金分配权的匹配比仅授予单一裁量权更有效。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示企业在设计绩效评价系统时应整体考虑目标设定权和奖金分配权的搭配，而非孤立设计单一制度；管理者应避免在不具备目标设定权的情况下使用奖金分配权，也应注意完全目标设定权可能导致目标设置过高的问题。

title: Revisiting the Cancer Metaphor in Organizations: A Critical Lens on Gareth Morgan
affiliations: University of Portsmouth

detail.title: Revisiting the Cancer Metaphor in Organizations: A Critical Lens on Gareth Morgan
detail.abstract: Gareth Morgan's Images of Organization (1986) introduced the cancer metaphor as a powerful analytical tool for understanding organizational pathology. Nearly four decades later, this metaphor remains influential yet critically underexamined. This paper offers a revisiting lens that integrates three traditions: medical oncology, cultural history, and organizational theory. Drawing on Smithers' (1962) argument that "cancer is a disease of organization," Sontag's (1978) ethical critique of illness metaphors, and contemporary organizational scholarship, I argue that Morgan's metaphor illuminates systemic pathology and internal threat but obscures agency, collapses benign/malignant distinctions, and carries problematic ethical baggage. I propose refinements including an autoimmune disease alternative, a "pre-cancerous" framework, and attention to environmental "carcinogens." The paper concludes that the metaphor remains valuable-provided it is deployed with critical sophistication, ethical reflexivity, and interdisciplinary depth.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了Morgan（1986）提出的"癌症隐喻"在组织分析中的应用，整合医学肿瘤学、文化史和组织理论三大传统，指出该隐喻虽有价值但存在局限，并提出了改进方案。
AI.research_question: Gareth Morgan的"癌症隐喻"在理解组织病理学中的适用性、局限性和改进方向是什么？
AI.motivation: "癌症隐喻"提出近四十年，影响深远但缺乏批判性审视。作者试图通过跨学科整合，填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三大传统：1）医学肿瘤学（Smithers的"癌症是组织的疾病"）；2）文化史（Sontag对疾病隐喻的伦理批判）；3）组织理论（Morgan的组织意象框架）。
AI.method: 理论综述与概念分析，跨学科整合与批判性反思。
AI.findings: 1）Morgan的隐喻能揭示系统性病理和内部威胁，但2）模糊了主体性、3）忽略了良性与恶性的区分、4）带有有问题的伦理包袱。作者提出用自身免疫疾病作为替代隐喻、"癌前病变"框架、以及关注环境"致癌物"等改进方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 对组织意象理论进行了批判性更新，提出跨学科整合的研究框架，丰富了组织病理学的理论工具箱。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者和组织分析者提供了更精细、更具伦理反思性的病理分析工具，有助于更准确地诊断和干预组织问题。

title: Impact of Patient Portal Outreach and Hybrid Trial Model on Screening Volume and Trial Enrollment in Diabetic Kidney Disease: A Single-Site Operational Evaluation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Northeastern University, Northeastern University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Impact of Patient Portal Outreach and Hybrid Trial Model on Screening Volume and Trial Enrollment in Diabetic Kidney Disease: A Single-Site Operational Evaluation
detail.abstract: Background:Recruitment inefficiency remains a persistent barrier in clinical trials involving patients with chronic kidney disease, who often have comorbidities and logistical constraints that limit sustained participation. We evaluated whether sequential implementation of patient portal-based outreach and a hybrid recruitment and follow-up model was associated with changes in screening and enrollment counts and geographic reach at the Brigham and Women’s Hospital (BWH) site of an ongoing multicenter randomized trial in diabetic kidney disease.Methods:We performed a retrospective, single-site operational evaluation of prospectively collected data from the BWH site. Data was analyzed across three sequential recruitment phases: conventional recruitment, patient portal-based outreach transition, and a hybrid recruitment and follow-up model incorporating remote screening, off-site laboratory testing, and flexible in-person and remote follow-up visits. Outcomes included monthly screening and enrollment counts, the phase-level enrollment yield, patient portal-based engagement, and distance from participants’ residences to the study site. Differences across recruitment phases were evaluated using nonparametric tests and negative binomial regression.Results:The BWH site enrolled 123 of 156 participants randomized across all three participating sites. Median monthly screening increased from 3.5 during conventional recruitment to 20.5 during the hybrid phase, and median monthly enrollment increased from 1 to 9. Phase-level enrollment yields were 26.4%, 48.6%, and 29.7% across the three phases, respectively. Among enrolled participants, the median distance from home to the trial site increased from 7.8 to 19.9 miles.Conclusions:Patient portal-based outreach followed by a hybrid model was associated with higher screening and enrollment counts and greater geographic reach.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了在糖尿病肾病患者临床试验中，依次实施患者门户网站外展和混合招募随访模式的效果。结果显示，该方法显著提高了筛查和入组人数，并扩大了地理覆盖范围。
AI.research_question: 在慢性肾病患者临床试验中，依次实施患者门户网站外展和混合招募随访模式能否改善筛查、入组数量和地理覆盖范围？
AI.motivation: 慢性肾病患者临床试验长期面临招募效率低下的问题，患者常伴有合并症和后勤约束，影响持续参与。需要探索更有效的招募策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于患者门户网站的数字化外展策略、混合招募随访模型（远程筛查、院外检测、灵活随访）
AI.method: 回顾性单站点运营评估，比较三个连续招募阶段（传统招募、患者门户外展、混合模式）的数据，采用非参数检验和负二项回归分析。
AI.findings: 混合阶段中位每月筛查从3.5增至20.5，中位每月入组从1增至9；不同阶段入组收益率分别为26.4%、48.6%和29.7%；参与者住址到试验点的中位距离从7.8英里增至19.9英里。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了数字化招募策略与混合随访模式相结合的实证证据，丰富了临床试验运营管理的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为慢性肾病患者临床试验提供了可操作的招募优化方案，可提高招募效率并扩大患者覆盖范围。

reference: Donald G. Costello College of Business at George Mason University Research Paper
title: The Double-Edged Sword of AI Hallucinations: Experimental Evidence on Creativity Across Idea Generation and Refinement
affiliations: Donald G. Costello College of Business at George Mason University, Donald G. Costello College of Business at George Mason University and Marshall School of Business - University of Southern California

detail.title: The Double-Edged Sword of AI Hallucinations: Experimental Evidence on Creativity Across Idea Generation and Refinement

publicationDetails.detailsText: Donald G. Costello College of Business at George Mason University Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Donald G. Costello College of Business at George Mason University Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support creative work, yet little empirical evidence exists regarding how AI hallucinations influence creativity. Prior research has largely treated hallucinations as errors that undermine accuracy and reliability, leaving their role in creative tasks underexplored. In this study, we conduct an experiment in which participants use LLM assistance to generate, select, and refine product ideas based on real-world patents under varying levels of AI hallucination. Our findings reveal that the creative consequences of AI hallucinations depend on both hallucination severity and the stage of the creative process. During idea generation (divergent thinking), moderate and high levels of hallucination enhance originality, diversity, and elaboration, whereas during idea refinement (convergent thinking), higher levels of hallucination improve originality but come at the expense of feasibility. We further identify AI hallucination-induced recombinant search as a key mechanism through which AI hallucinations enhance creativity, whereby hallucinated AI outputs enable the discovery and recombination of previously disconnected knowledge elements, providing empirical support for the creative potential of AI hallucinations. Overall, this study provides one of the first empirical investigations of the creative consequences of AI hallucinations, offering a more nuanced understanding of hallucinations as barriers and enablers of creativity. More broadly, our findings suggest that the value of AI hallucinations depends on the cognitive demands of the creative process and provide practical insights for designing more effective human-AI creative workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验研究发现，AI幻觉对创造力的影响取决于其严重程度和创意阶段：在发散性思维阶段，中高程度的幻觉能增强原创性、多样性和精细度；在收敛性思维阶段，高程度幻觉虽提升原创性但降低可行性。AI幻觉通过促进重组搜索机制来增强创造力。
AI.research_question: AI幻觉如何影响人类的创造力？特别是在不同的创意阶段（发散思维与收敛思维），不同严重程度的AI幻觉对创意产出有何不同影响？
AI.motivation: 以往研究将AI幻觉视为损害准确性和可靠性的错误，忽视了其在创造性任务中的潜在价值。随着LLM越来越多地用于支持创意工作，亟需实证研究来理解AI幻觉在创造力中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 重组搜索理论（Recombinant Search）：AI幻觉输出使人类能够发现和重组先前 disconnected 的知识元素，这是AI幻觉增强创造力的关键机制。
AI.method: 实验研究：参与者使用LLM辅助生成、选择和优化基于真实专利的产品创意，实验操控不同水平的AI幻觉程度。
AI.findings: 1. 在想法生成阶段（发散思维），中度和高度幻觉增强原创性、多样性和精细度；2. 在想法优化阶段（收敛思维），高幻觉提升原创性但牺牲可行性；3. AI幻觉通过诱导重组搜索机制增强创造力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了AI幻觉对创造力影响的实证证据，揭示了AI幻觉作为创造力障碍与促进因素的二元角色，为重组搜索理论提供了新的应用场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计更有效的人机创意协作流程提供实践指导，提示AI系统设计者应根据创意阶段和认知需求差异化地管理AI幻觉。

title: Taxing Money Holdings: Periodic Recoinage in the Middle Ages

detail.title: Taxing Money Holdings: Periodic Recoinage in the Middle Ages

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest
declarations.funderStatement: I gratefully acknowledge financial support from the Sven Svensson Foundation for Numismatics, the Gunnar Ekström Foundation, and the Sven and Dagmar Salén Foundation.

detail.abstract:
This chapter analyses periodic recoinage (renovatio monetae) as a distinct and systematic monetary regime that was widely applied in medieval Europe between approximately AD 900 and 1400. Under periodic recoinage, local coins were valid only for a limited time and were regularly withdrawn and replaced by new issues at pre-announced exchange rates and at fixed, recurring intervals. This mechanism constituted a transparent form of monetary taxation, fundamentally different from hidden debasement strategies.
The chapter develops a theoretical framework explaining why periodic recoinage emerged, which institutional and economic conditions were required for it to function, and why it eventually broke down. Particular emphasis is placed on the interaction between low monetization, small currency areas, exchange monopolies, and minting technology—especially the role of bracteates as a cost-minimizing and enforcement-friendly coin type.
The theoretical analysis is followed by extensive empirical case studies from England, Germany, Scandinavia, Poland, and Bohemia, supported by numismatic evidence, written sources, and coin-hoard data. The chapter concludes by examining enforcement problems, distributional effects, temporary price-level dynamics, and the political and fiscal mechanisms behind the system’s eventual breakdown, linking periodic recoinage to later developments in long-lived coinage systems, token coinage, and representative money.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了中世纪欧洲（约900-1400年）广泛实施的定期重铸货币制度（renovatio monetae），将其界定为一种透明化的货币税收机制，并探讨了其运行所需的经济制度条件、兴衰原因及历史影响。
AI.research_question: 定期重铸货币制度为何在中世纪欧洲出现？它需要哪些制度和经济条件才能运行？又为何最终崩溃？
AI.motivation: 将定期重铸货币从隐蔽贬值的货币策略中区分出来，作为一种独特且系统的货币制度加以分析，填补中世纪货币史研究的理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 低货币化程度、小型货币区、货币铸造垄断权、铸币技术（尤其是布拉格小银币作为成本最小化和便于执法的币种）之间的互动关系。
AI.method: 理论分析结合实证案例研究，涵盖英格兰、德国、斯堪的纳维亚、波兰和波希米亚地区，运用钱币学证据、文献记载和硬币窖藏数据。
AI.findings: 定期重铸制度是一种透明的货币税收形式；其运行依赖低货币化、小型货币区和铸币垄断等条件；该制度存在执行问题、分配效应和短期价格水平动态，最终因政治和财政机制的变化而崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 将定期重铸货币界定为与隐蔽贬值和长期通行货币并列的独立货币制度，揭示了中世纪货币税收的透明化机制及其与代币货币、代表性货币的历史关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解中世纪欧洲货币制度的演变、货币政策与财政税收的关系提供历史经验，有助于货币政策研究者从历史视角审视货币税与货币稳定问题。

title: The Audit Trail of Impulse: A Framework for Detecting Behavioral Trading Errors in Retail Execution Records

detail.title: The Audit Trail of Impulse: A Framework for Detecting Behavioral Trading Errors in Retail Execution Records
detail.abstract: Four decades of behavioral finance research have established that retail traders systematically exhibit the disposition effect, overconfidence-driven overtrading, and loss-chasing behavior. Nearly all of this evidence is top-down: researchers observe large brokerage datasets and document biases in aggregate, while the individual trader — the agent who would benefit most from detection — has no published framework for identifying these patterns in their own records. This paper proposes such a framework. I develop a taxonomy of seven 'impulse signatures': measurable markers in a trader's own execution data (fills, timestamps, position sizes, and realized P&L) that map onto documented biases, including revenge re-entry after stop-outs, position-size escalation across consecutive losses, trade-frequency spikes late in losing sessions, and holding-time asymmetry between winners and losers. I argue that self-auditing of execution records constitutes a behavioral intervention in its own right, connecting the framework to the literature on commitment devices, feedback, and self-control. The taxonomy is designed to be computable from standard broker export files without proprietary data, making it directly testable; I outline the empirical validation program it implies. The framework inverts the traditional research posture of behavioral finance: from documenting that traders err, to specifying how an individual trader can detect the errors as their own.

AI.tldr: 本文为零售交易者提供了一个可自行操作的框架，通过分析个人交易执行数据（成交记录、时间戳、仓位规模和已实现盈亏），识别七种"冲动信号"，从而检测自身是否存在处置效应、过度交易、追逐亏损等行为偏差。该框架将行为金融从"研究者发现交易者犯错"转向"交易者自行发现错误"。
AI.research_question: 如何让零售交易者个人能够利用自己的交易执行数据，识别出行为金融学文献中已经文档化的系统性交易偏差？
AI.motivation: 过去四十年行为金融学研究几乎全部是自上而下的——研究者分析大型经纪数据集，在整体层面文档化偏差，而最需要检测这些偏差的个人交易者却没有一个可用的框架来识别自己记录中的这些模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学中的处置效应、过度自信驱动的过度交易、追逐损失等偏差理论；承诺装置、反馈与自我控制的文献。
AI.method: 提出了一种包含七种"冲动信号"的分类法，这些信号可基于交易者个人的执行数据（成交记录、时间戳、仓位规模、已实现盈亏）计算得出，无需专有数据，仅需标准券商导出文件即可计算。
AI.findings: 识别出七种可计算的冲动信号：止损后报复性重新入场、连续亏损后仓位规模递增、亏损时段后期交易频率飙升、赢家与输家持仓时间不对称性等，这些信号可直接映射到已文档化的行为偏差。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为金融学的研究姿态从"自上而下地文档化交易者犯错"颠倒为"自下而上地让交易者自行检测错误"；将自我审计执行记录本身定位为一种行为干预，并与承诺装置、反馈和自我控制的理论文献建立连接。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售交易者提供了一个可操作、可计算的自我审计框架，使用标准券商导出文件即可运行，无需专有数据；提出了实证验证计划的蓝图。

title: Suffer Not the Economist to Live: What Warhammer 40,000 Gets Right About Institutional Dysfunction
affiliations: Trinity Business School, Trinity College Dublin

detail.title: Suffer Not the Economist to Live: What Warhammer 40,000 Gets Right About Institutional Dysfunction
detail.abstract: For nearly four decades, Warhammer 40,000 has sustained a dedicated community. This paper argues that much of its appeal derives from the institutional coherence of the Imperium of Man, a dystopian empire whose apparent dysfunction resembles durable extractive systems. We develop the concept of constraint convergence: Games Workshop's commercial and narrative pressures independently generated features comparable to those identified in North's transaction-cost framework, Acemoglu and Robinson's account of extractive institutions, and Scott's theory of state legibility. Coercive extraction, bureaucratic sclerosis, and technological conservatism thus appear not as inconsistencies but as load-bearing responses to structural constraint. Yet these institutions are not simulated in tabletop play. The rules privilege tactical agency and clear causality, while paratext carries institutional complexity. Drawing on paratext theory, procedural rhetoric, and participatory culture, we argue that this division of labour allows fans to co-produce coherence across an inconsistent, multi-authored canon without burdening the game with mechanics.

AI.tldr: 本文认为《战锤40K》中人类帝国的制度并非设计缺陷，而是受商业与叙事约束自然演化出的"约束收敛"结果，并通过副文本而非游戏规则来承载制度复杂性，让粉丝在参与式文化中共同构建叙事一致性。
AI.research_question: 战锤40K跨媒体IP的持久吸引力来自何处？其虚构帝国（人类帝国）的制度设计如何回应商业与叙事约束？
AI.motivation: 解释战锤40K近四十年来维持忠实粉丝社群的原因，揭示虚构世界中表面"功能失调"的制度设计背后的结构合理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 约束收敛（Constraint Convergence）、诺斯的交易成本框架、阿西莫格鲁和罗宾逊的榨取型制度理论、斯科特的国家可读性理论、副文本理论（Paratext Theory）、程序修辞（Procedural Rhetoric）、参与式文化（Participatory Culture）。
AI.method: 理论分析：将制度经济学理论（诺斯、阿西莫格鲁和罗宾逊、斯科特）与媒介研究理论（副文本、程序修辞、参与式文化）相结合，分析战锤40K的跨媒体叙事与制度设计。
AI.findings: 人类帝国的制度特征（强制榨取、官僚僵化、技术保守）并非叙事不一致，而是商业与叙事约束下的结构响应。这些制度未在桌游规则中模拟（规则侧重战术能动性与清晰因果），而是通过副文本承载制度复杂性，粉丝通过参与式文化在不同作者、不一致的正典中共同建构叙事一致性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"约束收敛"概念，整合制度经济学与媒介研究，解释虚构世界制度设计如何同时回应商业与叙事约束，为跨媒体IP分析提供新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为IP开发与跨媒体叙事设计提供启示：如何在不牺牲游戏体验的前提下，通过副文本与粉丝参与承载世界构建的复杂性。

reference: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
title: A Scalable Portfolio Model for Market Basket Choices
affiliations: and Ohio State University (OSU) - Department of Marketing and Logistics

detail.title: A Scalable Portfolio Model for Market Basket Choices

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: Sparse market baskets create a fundamental challenge for multicategory choice models: nonpurchase need not indicate low product value, and co-purchase need not indicate consumption complementarity. We develop a scalable portfolio choice model in which households first face product-group opening costs and then choose categories within opened groups. The model uses within-category inclusive values to control for product attractiveness, allowing category entry to be modeled separately from product appeal. A product-group opening cost generates same-group co-entry because the fixed cost of opening a broader product group is paid only once. This mechanism provides an access-cost explanation for co-purchase and yields a diagnostic implication: conditional on the product group being open, the opening cost cannot create residual pairwise attraction. Computationally, the model factorizes the basket likelihood by product group, avoiding unrestricted enumeration over all category portfolios. Using NielsenIQ household panel and retail scanner data for a 32-category grocery system, we find that the model improves fit primarily in portfolio moments-basket size, group openings, and same-group co-entry-rather than in marginal category-entry rates. The results show that product-group opening, household routines, and trip-level shopping missions are distinct sources of basket dependence. For category management, the findings imply that high co-purchase lift should not be read mechanically as complementarity; it may instead reflect that shoppers have crossed a product-group opening margin.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可扩展的组合选择模型，通过产品组开启成本解释稀疏购物篮中共同购买现象，而非传统意义上的消费互补性。模型将购物篮似然按产品组分解，避免全枚举，并在32类杂货数据中验证了其拟合优势。
AI.research_question: 在稀疏购物篮数据中，如何区分共同购买是由消费互补性驱动，还是由消费者克服产品组开启成本驱动？
AI.motivation: 传统多类别选择模型难以处理稀疏购物篮：非购买并不代表低价值，共同购买也不必然是互补性。现有方法在计算和概念上均存在局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产品组开启成本模型（portfolio choice model with product-group opening costs）、类别内包含价值（within-category inclusive values）、购物篮依赖来源区分（产品组开启、家庭惯例、购物任务）。
AI.method: 构建分层组合选择模型，首先决定是否开启产品组（支付固定成本），然后在已开启组内选择类别。模型按产品组分解购物篮似然，避免全枚举。使用NielsenIQ家庭面板和零售扫描数据（32个杂货类别）进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 模型在购物篮规模、产品组开启数量和同组共同进入等组合矩上拟合更优，而非边际类别进入率。产品组开启、家庭惯例和购物任务是购物篮依赖的三个独立来源。高共同购买提升不应机械解读为互补性，而可能反映消费者跨越了产品组开启门槛。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出产品组开启成本作为共同购买的新机制（access-cost explanation），区别于传统互补性解释；论证了条件于产品组已开启时，开启成本不会产生残差成对吸引，提供了可检验的诊断性含义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为品类管理提供警示：高共同购买提升不应被机械地解读为品类间互补性，而应考虑消费者是否已跨越产品组开启门槛；模型可扩展性强，适用于大规模类别系统的购物篮分析。

title: Toward a Systematic Integration of Digital Technologies in Facility Management Organizations and Services
affiliations: , Polytechnic University of Milan, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Students and Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Students

detail.title: Toward a Systematic Integration of Digital Technologies in Facility Management Organizations and Services
detail.abstract:
Purpose-This article focuses on the complex relationship between digital technologies (DTs) and Facility Management (FM), aiming to develop frameworks to systematically integrate DTs into FM organizations and services. 

Design/methodology/approach-We conducted workshops with academics and industry representatives, focusing on (i) the classification and conceptualization of DT applications in FM, (ii) the effects of DT on FM, and (iii) the standardization and scaling of DTs within organizations and across the industry. 

Findings-This article, classifies DTs from the perspectives of information systems, business development, and the value chain. This article identifies key technology considerations, including positive and negative effects, risks and myths, barriers and enablers, and coping strategies. This article addresses opportunities and challenges related to the standardization and scaling of DTs.

Practical implications – The conceptualizations co-created by industry and academia help establish a relevant research agenda and support the implementation of DTs.

Originality/value – These categorizations advance the understanding of DTs in FM and lay a foundation for further research.

AI.tldr: 本文通过学术与行业合作研讨，构建了数字技术（DTs）在设施管理（FM）中的分类框架，分析了DTs对FM的影响、风险与对策，并探讨了标准化与规模化应用的挑战与机遇。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地将数字技术（DTs）整合到设施管理（FM）组织与服务中？
AI.motivation: 数字技术与设施管理之间的关系复杂，缺乏系统性整合框架，需要构建分类与概念化体系以指导实践与研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息系统视角、业务发展视角、价值链视角下的DT分类；DT对FM的正负效应理论；标准化与规模化理论。
AI.method: 与学术界和行业代表共同举办研讨会，聚焦DT应用分类与概念化、DT对FM的影响、以及组织内与行业层面的标准化与规模化。
AI.findings: 从信息系统、业务发展和价值链三个视角对DT进行了分类；识别了关键技术考量（正负效应、风险与误区、障碍与推动因素、应对策略）；探讨了DT标准化与规模化的机遇与挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了DT在FM中的多维分类体系，深化了对DT在FM领域应用的理论理解，为后续研究奠定了基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 产学界共同构建的概念化框架有助于确立相关研究议程，并支持DT在FM中的实际实施。

title: Reinvestment as Revealed Confidence: Reading Vietnam's Foreign Direct Investment Beyond the New-Licence Headcount

detail.title: Reinvestment as Revealed Confidence: Reading Vietnam's Foreign Direct Investment Beyond the New-Licence Headcount

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is Founder and Managing Partner of Lotus Investment Group, a boutique M&A and investment advisory firm active in cross-border transactions in Southeast Asia, including Vietnam. The paper reflects a practitioner perspective, draws solely on publicly available data, and does not constitute investment advice. No client relationship or commercial engagement influenced the analysis.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses only publicly available, aggregate macroeconomic and firm-level data and involves no human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: The research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Foreign direct investment into Vietnam is conventionally read through the headline volume of newly registered projects. This paper argues that the headline is the weaker signal, and that a more informative variable is what investors already on the ground choose to do once they have lived with the operating environment: top up registered capital, raise equity stakes, and lengthen the horizon on commitments they have already made. A firm chooses where to break ground partly on expectation; it chooses where to add capital on evidence. Following the literature on reinvested earnings (Lundan, 2006; Zélity, 2025) and on the developmental quality rather than quantity of FDI (Alfaro & Charlton, 2007; OECD, 2022), the paper treats incumbent reinvestment and equity acquisition as revealed confidence. Using official Vietnamese data for 2015-2025, firm-level case evidence, and UNCTAD balance-of-payments data for regional comparison, it documents a consistent pattern. Adjusted (additional) registered capital from existing investors rose from USD 7.9 billion in 2023 to USD 14.1 billion in 2025, its highest level in the eleven-year series and roughly 37% of total registered capital, even as newly registered capital fell for two consecutive years; the surge is concentrated in named incumbents (Samsung, LG, Amkor, Foxconn, Hyosung) expanding existing sites. Realized (disbursed) FDI rose almost monotonically to a record USD 27.6 billion in 2025. And on a like-for-like UNCTAD basis, Vietnam was the only one of five major ASEAN recipients whose inflows rose in every year from 2021 to 2024. The paper is deliberate about what the data cannot say: Vietnam's "adjusted registered capital" is an administrative measure, not the balance-of-payments concept of reinvested earnings, which Vietnam (unlike Thailand, Malaysia or the Philippines) does not separately report in the harmonized IMF data at all; the country runs a large investment-income deficit as profits are repatriated; and reinvestment is not monotonic, with documented pull-backs (Intel, Hana Micron). It also examines a forward-looking complication: the 2024 adoption of the global minimum tax, which neutralises the tax incentives that historically anchored reinvestment and shifts the lever to non-tax support. These qualifications narrow the claim without dissolving it. The argument carries practical consequences for how policymakers measure progress and how cross-border acquirers price the destination.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了以新注册项目金额衡量越南FDI的常规做法，提出已落地投资者的增资、股权加注和延长承诺期限才是更可靠的信心信号。基于2015-2025年越南官方数据、企业案例和UNCTAD国际收支数据，发现现有投资者调整后增资从2023年的79亿美元升至2025年的141亿美元（占注册总额37%），而新注册资本连续两年下降；实际到位FDI创纪录达276亿美元。文章同时坦诚数据限制（越南未单独报告再投资收益）、投资收入逆差、撤资案例及全球最低税带来的不确定性。
AI.research_question: 衡量越南FDI的真实质量和投资者信心时，哪些指标比新注册项目金额更有信息量？现有投资者的再投资和股权增持如何反映"揭示的信心"？
AI.motivation: 传统以新注册项目金额为FDI"头条指标"的做法可能误导政策判断。已落地投资者基于运营经验的增资决策比初次进入决策包含更多真实信息，但这一信号被系统性地低估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 再投资收益文献（Lundan, 2006; Zélity, 2025）和FDI发展质量而非数量文献（Alfaro & Charlton, 2007; OECD, 2022）。将现有投资者的再投资和股权收购视为"揭示的信心"（revealed confidence）。
AI.method: 采用三角验证：越南官方2015-2025年行政数据（调整后增资资本）、企业层面的案例证据（Samsung、LG、Amkor、Foxconn、Hyosung等）、以及UNCTAD国际收支数据进行区域比较。
AI.findings: （1）现有投资者调整后增资从2023年79亿美元升至2025年141亿美元（11年最高），占注册总额37%的同时新注册资本连降两年；（2）增资集中在已命名的大型现有投资者扩展现有场地；（3）实际到位FDI几乎单调上升至2025年276亿美元的历史记录；（4）在UNCTAD可比基础上，越南是2021-2024年五大东盟FDI接收国中唯一流入额每年增长的。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确区分"初次进入决策"（基于预期）与"增资决策"（基于证据）的理论差异，将再投资行为系统性地概念化为比新注册更可靠的信心度量指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供衡量FDI进展的替代指标（增资而非新注册）；为跨境收购者提供评估越南作为投资目的地的定价信号；提醒注意全球最低税实施后税收激励中性化对再投资模式的潜在影响。

title: Trade Without Capital: Reading Australia's Investment Gap with Southeast Asia

detail.title: Trade Without Capital: Reading Australia's Investment Gap with Southeast Asia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is Founder and Managing Partner of Lotus Investment Group, a boutique M&A and investment advisory firm active in cross-border transactions between Australia and Southeast Asia, including Vietnam. The paper reflects a practitioner perspective, draws solely on publicly available official data, and does not constitute investment advice. No client relationship or commercial engagement influenced the analysis.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses only publicly available, aggregate official statistics and involves no human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: The research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Australia treats Southeast Asia as a strategic priority and trades with it heavily, yet invests in it barely at all. This paper documents the gap and asks why it persists.
