title: Sustainability Practices in Online Grocery Retail: A Case-Based Evaluation of Picnic and Implications for Vocational Training and Personnel Development

detail.title: Sustainability Practices in Online Grocery Retail: A Case-Based Evaluation of Picnic and Implications for Vocational Training and Personnel Development

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare that I have no personal or financial relationships that could have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethics approval was required for this work because the study is based on publicly available documents and academic literature. No interviews, surveys, experiments, or personal data collection were conducted.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Not applicable. This paper has not appeared in a paper series, journal, or book.

detail.abstract: The thesis examines the sustainability practices of online grocery retailers on a case-by-case basis with the example of Picnic and their implications for vocational training and personnel development. Online grocery retail has grown at a fast pace in Europe, presenting new sustainability challenges in the field of last-mile delivery, packaging waste, food waste, digital logistics and resource efficiency. The thesis examines documents of the company as well as relevant academic literature in the context of the case study of Picnic with a structured qualitative content analysis. The study has adopted the Triple Bottom Line approach of Elkington and the concept of competence by Weinert as well as the sustainability competence framework by Wiek et al. to gain insight into the environmental, economic and social aspects of sustainability and competence requirements of the employees. The results indicate that most of the sustainability efforts of Picnic are linked to electric delivery vehicles, logistics are route efficient and planning is demand-based on management of the packaging system, reduction of food waste and the use of digital operational systems. These practices are not only technological/organizational measures, but also rely on the knowledge, skills, attitudes, motivations, communication and problem-solving skills of employees. The thesis describes the areas of key competence such as sustainable awareness, resource-efficient working behaviour, sustainable logistics understanding, packaging and waste reduction competence, digital process competence, teamworking competence and continuous improvement competence. The results of these findings inform the proposed practice-oriented training model for HR managers, in-company trainers, captains, and supervisors. However, the study indicates that a more effective way of achieving sustainability in online grocery retail is to make corporate-level sustainability practices into competencies and training at the workplace.

AI.tldr: 本文以Picnic为案例，通过三重底线和胜任力理论框架，分析在线杂货零售商的可持续发展实践及其对员工能力要求和职业培训的启示，并提出实践导向的培训模型。
AI.research_question: 在线杂货零售商的可持续发展实践有哪些？这些实践对员工能力要求和职业培训有何影响？
AI.motivation: 欧洲在线杂货零售快速增长，带来了最后一公里配送、包装浪费、食品浪费、数字物流和资源效率等方面的可持续性挑战，需要探究企业如何通过员工能力建设来应对这些挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: Elkington的三重底线理论（环境、经济、社会可持续性）、Weinert的胜任力概念、Wiek等的可持续性胜任力框架。
AI.method: 单案例研究法，对Picnic公司文件及相关学术文献进行结构化定性内容分析。
AI.findings: Picnic的可持续实践主要集中在电动配送车辆、高效路线规划、基于需求预测的包装管理、减少食品浪费和数字运营系统；这些实践依赖员工的知识、技能、态度、动机、沟通和问题解决能力；识别出可持续意识、资源节约工作行为、可持续物流理解、包装与减废能力、数字流程能力、团队合作能力和持续改进能力等关键能力领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 将三重底线理论与胜任力框架结合，揭示了企业层面可持续实践与个体层面员工能力之间的内在联系，丰富了可持续人力资源管理领域的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出实践导向的培训模型，为HR经理、企业内部培训师、主管等提供具体的能力培养方案；指出将企业可持续实践转化为员工工作场所能力与培训是实现可持续性的更有效路径。

title: The Predictive Capacity of Financial Analysis in Understanding Rating Dynamics
affiliations: Groupe ISCAE, Université de Nice Sophia Antipolis,  and Université Côte d’Azur - GRM Research Center

detail.title: The Predictive Capacity of Financial Analysis in Understanding Rating Dynamics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: An earlier version of this paper was published in French as Olivero, B., Luu, P., & Seffar, M. (2024), "Surnotations financières et déclassements des entreprises de la catégorie « Investment Grade »," Revue du Financier, 46(263/264),. This English version is a translation/adaptation made available for wider dissemination.
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: The persistent inability of rating agencies to foresee financial crises and systemic failures raises questions about their reliability, especially as their role expands in a globalised economy. Notably, some firms with AAA ratings have faced bankruptcy, highlighting delays in rating adjustments and the factors influencing them. This study examines the relationship between financial ratings and market indicators, uncovering instances of rating inertia. It distinguishes between "Investment Grade" and "Speculative Grade" ratings, focusing on the significant impact of transitions between these categories. Using a two-stage empirical approach, we first develop a prediction model to identify overrated firms, employing regression techniques to address errors and correlations. Next, logistic regression with repeated data estimates downgrade probabilities based on prior over-ratings. Findings reveal a strong correlation between over-scoring and ratings, with "Investment Grade High" firms exhibiting lower downgrade risks, challenging traditional assumptions about rating dynamics. This analysis underscores the need for more responsive and accurate rating mechanisms to enhance market reliability. Our findings challenge conventional assumptions about rating dynamics and highlight potential regulatory and market implications.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过两阶段实证方法，发现评级机构存在显著的评级惯性（尤其是投资级高评级企业），过度评级与后续降级概率高度相关，挑战了传统评级动态假设，呼吁更精准的评级机制。
AI.research_question: 信用评级机构为何存在评级调整滞后（评级惯性）？过度评级如何影响后续降级概率？
AI.motivation: AAA级企业仍破产、评级机构未能预见金融危机，质疑评级可靠性；评级机构在全球化经济中角色日益扩大，但评级调整延迟的问题未得到充分解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 评级惯性理论；投资级与投机级分类的阈值效应；过度评级与降级风险的动态关系。
AI.method: 两阶段实证方法：第一阶段用回归技术构建预测模型识别过度评级企业，处理误差和相关性；第二阶段用逻辑回归（含重复数据估计）基于前期过度评级估算降级概率。
AI.findings: 过度评分与评级高度相关；"投资级高"企业降级风险更低，挑战传统假设；评级惯性现象显著存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了评级惯性的存在及其与过度评级的关联；挑战了"高评级企业风险更低"的传统动态假设；区分投资级与投机级过渡的显著影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议提升评级机制的响应速度和准确性以增强市场可靠性；对监管政策和市场实践有重要启示。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Cost Structure
affiliations: Shenzhen University, Fudan University - School of Management, University of Sussex and City University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Cost Structure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the relation between artificial intelligence (AI) investment and firms' cost structures. Using a firm-level AI investment measure that captures AI-related skills in employee resumes, we find that firms with greater AI investment exhibit more elastic cost structures, consistent with AI improving prediction, coordination, and resource redeployment and thereby increasing firms' ability to adjust resources flexibly in response to demand uncertainty. This relation is stronger for firms facing greater supply chain uncertainty, covering a broader set of product markets, and approaching capacity, suggesting that AI is especially valuable when firms encounter greater difficulty aligning resources with demand and therefore have a greater need for flexibility. It is also stronger in environments that better support the effective use of AI. We further find that AI investment is associated with greater elasticity in cost of goods sold, lower reliance on vertical integration, and higher inventory turnover. These results suggest that AI also enhances firms' flexibility in adjusting production costs, coordinating supply chains, and utilizing assets more efficiently. Our results are robust to an instrumental variable approach and a change analysis. Overall, our findings suggest that AI is an important technological force that shapes firms' resource commitments, capacity choices, and cost structures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI投资如何影响企业成本结构弹性，发现AI投资越高的企业成本弹性越大，尤其是在供应链不确定性高、产品市场范围广、接近产能上限的企业中更为显著。
AI.research_question: AI投资如何影响企业的成本结构弹性？
AI.motivation: AI技术快速发展，但其对企业成本结构（特别是成本弹性）的影响尚缺乏系统性的实证研究。理解AI如何改变企业资源配置和成本决策具有重要的理论和实践意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AI改善预测能力、协调能力和资源重新配置的理论逻辑，认为AI能够提升企业灵活调整资源以应对需求不确定性的能力，从而影响成本结构弹性。
AI.method: 使用基于员工简历中AI相关技能构建的企业层面AI投资度量指标，采用回归分析、工具变量法和变化分析等方法进行实证检验。
AI.findings: （1）AI投资越高的企业成本结构弹性越大；（2）这种关系在供应链不确定性高、产品市场范围广、接近产能上限的企业中更强；（3）在支持AI有效使用的环境中更强；（4）AI投资与销售成本弹性更高、纵向整合依赖降低、库存周转率提高相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI技术与成本结构理论联系起来，揭示了AI作为技术力量如何影响企业的资源承诺、产能选择和成本结构决策，拓展了成本弹性影响因素的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者理解AI投资对企业运营灵活性和成本管理的影响提供实证依据；提示企业在面临较高不确定性时应重视AI投资以增强资源配置灵活性。

title: Southeast Asia Foreign Direct Investment Monitor 2025: A Comparative Data Compendium

detail.title: Southeast Asia Foreign Direct Investment Monitor 2025: A Comparative Data Compendium

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is Founder and Managing Partner of Lotus Investment Group, a boutique M&A and investment advisory firm active in cross-border transactions across Southeast Asia. This paper is a data compendium compiled from publicly available official statistics and does not constitute investment advice. No client relationship influenced the analysis.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The paper uses only publicly available aggregate statistics and involves no human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: The research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Southeast Asia is the developing world's leading destination for foreign direct investment, drawing a record US$225 billion in 2024 and holding that position among developing regions for four years running, yet comparing its economies against each other is a trap for the unwary, because the region's headline numbers are reported on three incompatible bases that are routinely, and wrongly, placed on the same axis. This compendium assembles the comparable evidence for the six largest ASEAN economies, Singapore, Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia and the Philippines, and states, as its first contribution, the measurement rule that governs any honest comparison: balance-of-payments FDI is the only crosscountry comparable series, and national registered, approved or realised figures, several times larger and forward-looking, must never be benchmarked against it. On that comparable basis the picture is stark. Singapore alone accounts for about 64 percent of the region's inflows, a scale that reflects its role as a global holding and conduit hub rather than a host economy, and once it is set aside the real contest among the other five shows Vietnam as the only one rising every year since 2020. The compendium maps inflows, stock and intensity, the sources and sectors of the capital, the split between greenfield and acquisition, the region's weight in global flows, and the 2025 policy frontier of the global minimum tax and the China-plus-one relocation wave. It is built to be a standing annual reference, with every figure sourced, every measurement basis labelled, and the data gaps named rather than hidden.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了东南亚六国（新加坡、印尼、越南、泰国、马来西亚、菲律宾）FDI数据因统计口径不一致（国际收支平衡表口径 vs. 各国注册/批准/实现口径）而普遍被误读的问题，指出只有国际收支平衡表口径的FDI才是跨国可比的，并按此统一标准重新描绘了区域FDI的真实图景：新加坡占区域流入约64%（因其全球控股和通道枢纽角色），排除新加坡后，越南是唯一自2020年起每年上升的经济体。
AI.research_question: 东南亚最大六个经济体的FDI数据在三种互不兼容的统计口径下被普遍误读，那么按统一的可比口径（国际收支平衡表口径）重估后，各国FDI的真实规模、趋势、结构及来源如何？
AI.motivation: 东南亚FDI总量惊人（2024年创纪录的2250亿美元），但各国统计口径差异巨大（国际收支口径、注册口径、批准口径、实现口径混用），导致研究者、政策制定者和媒体经常错误地将不同口径的数据放在同一坐标轴上进行比较，产生严重误导。作者希望建立一套可比的标准和年度参考基准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际收支平衡表口径的FDI统计（BOP-based FDI）是唯一可用于跨国比较的系列；各国国内统计的注册、批准或实现数据（通常数倍于BOP口径且具有前瞻性）不能与国际收支口径作基准比较。新加坡的数据应作为全球控股和通道枢纽（holding and conduit hub）而非纯粹东道经济体的数据来理解。
AI.method: 汇编和可比性整理（Compendium/descriptive quantitative analysis）：收集六个东盟最大经济体（新加坡、印尼、越南、泰国、马来西亚、菲律宾）的FDI数据，统一按国际收支平衡表口径标准化，分国别、分年份、分来源、分行业、分绿地投资vs并购进行系统比较，并标注所有数据来源和计量基础。
AI.findings: （1）按国际收支口径，新加坡占区域FDI流入约64%，其规模主要体现全球通道功能而非实体东道功能；（2）排除新加坡后，越南是唯一自2020年起FDI逐年上升的经济体；（3）提供了区域内FDI流入、存量、强度、来源国、行业分布、绿地vs并购占比、全球占比及2025年政策前沿（全球最低税、中国+1转移浪潮）的全面比较。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确指出了FDI跨国比较中统计口径不一致这一常被忽视的方法论陷阱，并确立了“国际收支平衡表口径为唯一可比系列”的比较规则，为后续跨国FDI研究提供了统计方法论上的基础参照。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者、投资者和研究人员提供了统一可比口径的东南亚FDI年度参考基准；（2）纠正了因混用不同口径数据而产生的对各国FDI表现的系统性误判；（3）揭示了新加坡的特殊通道角色与其他五国的真实竞争格局；（4）为2025年政策前沿（全球最低税落地、中国+1产业转移）提供了数据基础。

title: When Can Bibliometric Evidence Be Trusted? Developing a Conditional Robustness Theory for Research Evaluation in Business Research

detail.title: When Can Bibliometric Evidence Be Trusted? Developing a Conditional Robustness Theory for Research Evaluation in Business Research

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a systematic literature review and bibliometric analysis that did not involve any human participants, patients, or tissue sampling.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Bibliometrics has become one of the most widely used tools in management and accounting research, yet the method that measures scholarly impact is rarely asked to justify its own statistical footing. This paper turns the bibliometric lens on bibliometrics itself. Drawing on a Scopus and Web of Science corpus assembled through a PRISMA-guided identification and screening process (6,144 unique records, 763 retained at the eligibility stage), we combine science mapping (co-word analysis, thematic mapping and thematic evolution, co-citation analysis and a historiographic map) with a systematic reading of the 57 most influential works in the field to ask a single question: is bibliometrics a statistically robust and econometrically reliable research method, and why do some journals and researchers accept it while others do not? We find that the field's own most-cited literature is dominated by critical and nuanced positions (33 of 57 works) rather than unconditional endorsement (8 of 57), converging instead on a small set of recurring validity threats spanning data coverage, indicator construction, citer behaviour and research governance. From this evidence we develop the Contingent Theory of Bibliometric Robustness, which reframes bibliometric robustness not as an inherent property of citation counts but as an achievement that depends on triangulation with peer judgement, field normalisation, transparent construction rules and adequate sample scale. We discuss the implications of this model for research evaluation in accounting, finance and management, where journal-ranking lists such as the ABS Academic Journal Guide, the ABDC list and the Financial Times 50 sit at the exact intersection of indicator construction and institutional governance, and we close with a nine-point research agenda derived directly from the threats identified.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献计量学方法自我审视，发现该领域最被引文献中多数持批判立场（33/57），而非无条件支持（8/57），并据此提出"文献计量稳健性的权变理论"——稳健性不是引用次数的固有属性，而是依赖三角验证、领域标准化、透明规则和充分样本规模才能达成的成就。
AI.research_question: 文献计量学作为一种研究方法，在统计学上是否稳健、在计量经济学上是否可靠？为什么有些期刊和研究者接受它而另一些不接受？
AI.motivation: 文献计量学已被广泛应用于管理学和会计学研究，但其自身的统计基础却很少受到审视，存在一个"自我反思"的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量稳健性的权变理论（Contingent Theory of Bibliometric Robustness）
AI.method: PRISMA流程筛选（6,144条记录→763条合格），结合科学图谱分析（共词分析、主题图谱与演化、共被引分析、历史图谱）和对57篇最具影响力文献的系统阅读。
AI.findings: (1) 57篇核心文献中，33篇持批判/审慎立场，仅8篇无条件支持；(2) 识别出一组反复出现的效度威胁：数据覆盖、指标构建、引文行为和研究治理。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"文献计量稳健性的权变理论"，将稳健性重新定义为需要在情境中达成的成就而非固有属性。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为ABS、ABDC、FT50等期刊排名榜单的使用提供方法论警示；(2) 提出九点研究议程，直接源于识别的效度威胁。

title: The Impact of Warehouse Expansion on B2B Procurement: Evidence from an e-commerce Pharmaceutical Supply Chain
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology - School of Management, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Indiana University Bloomington, Kelley School of Business, Indiana University and Huazhong Universtiy of Science and Technology

detail.title: The Impact of Warehouse Expansion on B2B Procurement: Evidence from an e-commerce Pharmaceutical Supply Chain
detail.abstract: Logistics responsiveness is a key driver of supply chain performance, yet its role in business-to-business (B2B) procurement remains underexplored. We empirically study how upstream warehouse expansion affects downstream purchasing behavior in an e-commerce pharmaceutical supply chain. Exploiting the upstream seller's opening of a new warehouse as a quasi-natural experiment, we use a difference-indifferences design to estimate the causal effect of shorter delivery lead times. We find that faster delivery leads to more purchases from downstream pharmacies, with monthly gross merchandise value increasing by 129.6%. Moreover, downstream pharmacies begin to place orders more frequently and in smaller quantities, with the number of orders placed per month increasing by 13.3% and the average quantity per order decreasing by 11.0%. These patterns are especially pronounced for smaller pharmacies and those facing higher demand uncertainty. Furthermore, the response varies by product price tier: for lower-and mid-priced products, pharmacies mainly reduce batch sizes, whereas for high-priced products they primarily increase replenishment frequency. These changes in downstream buyers' purchasing behavior, however, also carry costs for the upstream seller. The total product return rate increases by 24.1%, driven by a 90.0% rise in buyer-induced returns and a 289.2% rise in seller-induced returns. Overall, our findings highlight how logistics infrastructure reshapes downstream purchasing decisions, reallocates risk across supply chain partners, and generates both efficiency gains and operational frictions in B2B supply chains.

AI.tldr: 本文利用上游卖家开设新仓库作为准自然实验，通过双重差分法实证研究了仓储扩张（缩短配送时间）如何影响下游药店的采购行为，发现配送速度提升显著增加了采购量，同时改变了采购模式（更频繁、更小批量），但也带来了退货率上升等运营摩擦。
AI.research_question: 在B2B电商药品供应链中，上游仓储扩张（缩短配送时间）如何影响下游药店的采购行为？
AI.motivation: 物流响应能力是供应链绩效的关键驱动因素，但它在B2B采购情境中的作用尚未被充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于物流响应能力、库存管理理论、风险分配等理论框架，分析配送时间缩短对下游采购决策的影响机制。
AI.method: 以上游卖家开设新仓库作为准自然实验，采用双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences）估计配送时间缩短对下游采购行为的因果效应。
AI.findings: （1）配送速度提升使月均GMV增加129.6%；（2）下单频率增加13.3%，单次订单量减少11.0%；（3）小药店和高需求不确定性药店反应更显著；（4）低中价产品主要减少批量，高价产品主要增加补货频率；（5）退货率上升24.1%，其中买方引发退货增加90.0%，卖方引发退货增加289.2%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了物流基础设施如何重塑下游采购决策、重新分配供应链合作伙伴之间的风险，并展示了B2B供应链中效率提升与运营摩擦并存的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为B2B电商平台的仓储布局策略、库存管理优化和退货风险管理提供了实证依据。

title: Reimagining Scotland's Golf Value Chain: Architecture, Operations, Social Impact and Regional Development in a Contemporary Multi-Case Study
affiliations: University of Edinburgh, King’s College London - King's Business School, , affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Edinburgh

detail.title: Reimagining Scotland's Golf Value Chain: Architecture, Operations, Social Impact and Regional Development in a Contemporary Multi-Case Study
detail.abstract: Golf holds a unique position within Scotland's cultural identity and economic structure. Whilst extensive scholarship has examined the historical significance of Scottish golf, considerably less attention has been paid to its contemporary value chain and the evolving interactions between course design, operational models, social contribution and regional development. This study addresses this gap by conducting an integrated qualitative analysis based on twelve elite interviews with architects, general managers, investors, and industry stakeholders across Scotland's most influential golf developments. These include historic championship venues, newly constructed destination courses, remote community clubs and modern multi-course resorts. Using a multi-case thematic approach, the paper identifies four interlinked dimensions shaping the modern Scottish golf economy: architectural innovation rooted in landscape heritage; evolving operational and business models that influence global competitiveness; the social and cultural value of golf as a tool for community wellbeing and employment; and, the role of new golf investments in stimulating economic growth, particularly in fragile or remote regions. The findings demonstrate that Scotland's golf sector now operates as a complex, adaptive system in which tradition and modernity reinforce and support rather than contradict each other. The study concludes with policy implications for sustainable development, regional regeneration and the future positioning of Scottish golf within the global sports-tourism marketplace.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对12位精英从业者的深度访谈，采用多案例主题分析法，识别出塑造苏格兰现代高尔夫经济的四个相互关联的维度：植根于景观遗产的建筑创新、影响全球竞争力的运营与商业模式演变、高尔夫作为社区福祉和就业工具的社会文化价值，以及新投资对经济增长（尤其是偏远地区）的刺激作用。研究发现，苏格兰高尔夫产业已发展为一个复杂适应系统，传统与现代相互强化而非矛盾。
AI.research_question: 苏格兰高尔夫产业的当代价值链是什么？球场设计、运营模式、社会贡献与区域发展之间如何互动？
AI.motivation: 大量研究关注苏格兰高尔夫的历史意义，但对其当代价值链以及球场设计、运营模式、社会贡献与区域发展之间不断演变的互动关系关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂适应系统理论（传统与现代相互强化而非矛盾）；多案例主题分析法。
AI.method: 基于12位精英访谈（包括建筑师、总经理、投资者和行业利益相关者）的整合性定性分析；多案例主题分析；样本涵盖历史冠军场地、新建目的地球场、偏远社区俱乐部和现代多球场度假村。
AI.findings: 识别出四个关键维度：①植根于景观遗产的建筑创新；②影响全球竞争力的运营与商业模式演变；③高尔夫作为社区福祉和就业工具的社会文化价值；④新投资对经济增长（尤其是偏远脆弱地区）的刺激作用。苏格兰高尔夫产业是一个复杂适应系统，传统与现代相互强化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将高尔夫产业视为一个复杂适应系统，揭示传统与现代性在该系统中相互强化而非对立的机制，填补了苏格兰高尔夫当代价值链研究的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为苏格兰高尔夫的可持续发展、区域振兴以及在全球体育旅游市场中的未来定位提供政策建议。

title: The Provincial Geography of Foreign Investment in Vietnam: Concentration, the Northern Shift, and the 2025 Redraw

detail.title: The Provincial Geography of Foreign Investment in Vietnam: Concentration, the Northern Shift, and the 2025 Redraw

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is Founder and Managing Partner of Lotus Investment Group, a boutique M&A and investment advisory firm active in cross-border transactions across Southeast Asia, including Vietnam. This paper is a data reference compiled from publicly available official statistics and reputable secondary sources and does not constitute investment advice. No client relationship influenced the analysis.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The paper uses only publicly available aggregate statistics and involves no human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: The research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Foreign direct investment in Vietnam is a national headline but a local phenomenon. Where the capital lands, and why, is decided at the level of the province, and the provincial map has just changed in two ways that this atlas sets out to chart. The first change is a shift in the flow of new investment from the historic southern core around Ho Chi Minh City toward the northern industrial belt: in 2024, for the first time, two northern provinces, Bac Ninh and Hai Phong, drew more registered FDI than Ho Chi Minh City, with Bac Ninh alone up 184 percent on the year on the back of the electronics and semiconductor cluster. The second change is administrative and abrupt: on 1 July 2025 Vietnam cut its provinces from 63 to 34, merging Binh Duong and Ba Ria-Vung Tau into an enlarged Ho Chi Minh City that now accounts for roughly 31 percent of national GDP, and folding Bac Giang into Bac Ninh. This paper maps the geography of Vietnamese FDI across four dimensions, the concentration of the flow, the northern shift, the role of provincial governance as measured by the Provincial Competitiveness Index, and the industrial-park infrastructure that hosts it, and then confronts the discontinuity the 2025 merger introduces into the data. It shows that while the flow of new investment has tilted north, the cumulative stock still favours the south, that provincial governance quality and FDI leadership overlap closely, and that the country's 433 industrial parks are filling fastest in the north. It closes with what the redraw means for reading Vietnamese FDI data going forward, and for investors deciding where to look next. Every figure is sourced and labelled as flow or stock.

AI.tldr: 本文绘制了越南FDI的四维地理图谱：投资北移趋势、2025年省级合并对数据的断裂、省级治理质量与FDI的关联、工业园基础设施分布，并指出北部省份首次在新增FDI上超越胡志明市，但累计存量仍集中在南方。
AI.research_question: 越南FDI的地理分布格局如何变化？2025年省级行政合并如何影响FDI数据的连续性和投资者决策？
AI.motivation: FDI在越南是国家级热点但落地却是省级现象，而越南刚刚经历了投资流向的北移和省级行政区划的重大合并，需要系统性地重新绘制FDI地理版图并评估数据断裂带来的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集聚经济理论、新经济地理学、地方治理与制度质量理论（以省级竞争力指数衡量）、工业园基础设施区位理论。
AI.method: 基于FDI流量与存量的地理制图分析，四维框架：投资集中度、北移趋势、省级治理指数（PCI）、工业园基础设施；区分流量与存量数据；应对2025年省级合并带来的数据断层。
AI.findings: 1）2024年北部两省（北宁、海防）新增FDI首次超越胡志明市，北宁得益于电子半导体集群同比增184%；2）累计存量仍集中于南方；3）省级治理质量与FDI领导力高度重合；4）全国433个工业园中北部填满速度最快；5）2025年省级合并导致数据序列断裂，需重新校准历史对比。
AI.theory_contributions: 为集聚经济与制度质量在发展中国家FDI区位选择中的交互作用提供了省级层面的最新证据；揭示了行政区划调整如何改变FDI地理数据的面貌，补充了FDI区位研究中对制度"突变"的方法论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在越投资者提供了基于流量与存量的区位选择参考；提醒政策制定者和数据分析者注意2025年省级合并后数据断层的处理；为越南各省级政府优化治理与工业园配套提供对标框架。

title: Transparency Without Capacity

detail.title: Transparency Without Capacity
detail.abstract: The Common Reporting Standard (CRS) ended bank secrecy for more than one hundred jurisdictions, and the prevailing policy expectation-advanced by the OECD, the G20, and a large advocacy literature-is that the resulting automatic exchange of information (AEOI) raises domestic revenue by exposing previously hidden offshore income to taxation. Developing countries are held to have the most to gain. This paper tests that expectation directly against the outcome that matters to finance ministries: direct-tax revenue as a share of GDP. Using a panel of 47 countries over 2013-2023 drawn from the UNU-WIDER Government Revenue Dataset and matched to the exact first-exchange dates published by the OECD Global Forum, and exploiting the staggered timing of adoption with the heterogeneity-robust difference-indifferences estimator of Callaway and Sant'Anna (2021), I estimate a preciselymeasured null: the average effect of CRS adoption on direct-tax revenue is 0.04 percentage points of GDP (95 percent CI:-0.43 to 0.50). An event study shows no anticipatory pre-trends and no post-adoption break; the null is robust to alternative control groups, to the exclusion of the pandemic years, and to a placebo test. The effect is, moreover, heterogeneous in the direction opposite to the policy hope: it is negative though imprecise for low-and middleincome countries, null or negative in every developing region examined, and post-CRS revenue gains accrue disproportionately to countries that already possessed strong tax-administration capacity. A case study of Pakistanwhose 2018 CRS activation coincided with two foreign-asset declaration schemes-uses the author's experience administering AEOI enforcement to trace why the information does not become revenue: the binding constraint is the domestic capacity to match, risk-score, assess, and defend the data, not its receipt. The findings imply that the distributional promise of the global transparency agenda, now central to the negotiation of the UN Framework Convention on International Tax Cooperation, cannot be realised through legal instruments alone; the marginal international dollar would do more for developing-country revenue if invested in administrative capacity than in further mechanisms of exchange.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2013-2023年47个国家的面板数据和异质性稳健的双重差分法，发现CRS（共同报告标准）对直接税收入占GDP比重的平均效应精确为零（0.04个百分点），且对低收入国家效应为负，表明自动信息交换本身并不能自动转化为税收收入，行政能力才是关键瓶颈。
AI.research_question: CRS（共同报告标准）下的自动信息交换（AEOI）能否有效提高各国的直接税收入，特别是发展中国家的税收收入？
AI.motivation: OECD、G20及大量倡导文献预期AEOI能通过暴露离岸隐藏收入来增加国内税收，且发展中国家被认为获益最大。但这一政策预期缺乏严谨的因果识别实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收信息交换与税收遵从理论；行政能力作为信息转化为收入的约束条件理论；异质性处理效应下的双重差分识别策略（Callaway & Sant'Anna, 2021）
AI.method: 基于UNU-WIDER政府收入数据集和OECD全球论坛首次交换日期，构建47个国家2013-2023年面板数据；使用Callaway和Sant'Anna (2021)的异质性稳健双重差分估计器；辅以事件研究、安慰剂检验、排除疫情年份等稳健性检验；以及巴基斯坦案例研究。
AI.findings: CRS对直接税收入的平局效应为0.04个百分点（95%置信区间：-0.43至0.50），精确为零；对中低收入国家效应为负（虽不精确）；税收增长仅发生在已有强征管能力的国家；巴基斯坦案例表明瓶颈在于国内数据匹配、风险评分、评估和抗辩能力，而非数据接收本身。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对CRS的税收收入效应进行了严谨的因果识别检验，揭示了"信息≠收入"的理论缺口；提出行政能力是信息交换转化为税收收入的约束条件，挑战了"信息自动透明即可增加收入"的简化假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 对联合国国际税收合作框架公约的谈判具有直接政策启示：边际国际资源应用于提升发展中国家的税收行政能力，而非推进更多信息交换机制；为发展中国家参与全球税务透明议程提供了优先序建议。

title: There Is No User in the Living Room: Ambient Household Devices and the User-Relative Architecture of the People-First Chatbot Act

detail.title: There Is No User in the Living Room: Ambient Household Devices and the User-Relative Architecture of the People-First Chatbot Act
detail.abstract: The People-First Chatbot Act, introduced in the House on July 9, 2026, would impose privacy, transparency, and design duties on artificial intelligence chatbot providers. Every operative duty in the bill runs through a single term. A provider may process personal data only as necessary to fulfill an express request made by a user who has given affirmative consent. A provider must disable risky design features for a user it knows to be a minor. A provider incurs strict liability to a user injured through use. The Act then defines that term, at Section 5(22), as "an individual, regardless of age." That is a genus without a differentia. It defines nothing. The defect is invisible on a phone, where the person holding the device and the person the statute regulates are the same person. It becomes dispositive on an ambient household device, a category already shipping into American homes at scale and about to be entered by the largest chatbot provider in the country. A child who walks past a camera-equipped speaker has made no request, consented to nothing, and interacts with the system only in the sense that the system is processing her face. This Article shows that the Act cannot say whether she is a user, that both available answers defeat the statute's purpose, and that a third defect compounds them: the Act creates a private right of action denominated in violations while never defining a violation. The resulting damages exposure for a single afternoon in a single household ranges across four orders of magnitude on a question the text does not answer. The Article makes three contributions. It identifies user-relativity as a structural drafting pathology distinct from the overbreadth and vagueness critiques already directed at chatbot legislation, and distinguishes requester-keyed statutes from data-subject-keyed statutes using the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act as the comparator. It demonstrates that the Act's consent architecture permits one individual to authorize the processing of another individual's biometric data, a result the Act's own definition of affirmative consent was written to foreclose. It proposes three amendments, each drawn from existing federal law, that close the gap without disturbing the bill's structure.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了《以人为本的聊天机器人法案》中因"用户"定义缺陷导致的系统性法律漏洞，指出该定义在环境智能设备场景下完全失效，并提出了三项从现有联邦法律借鉴的修正方案。
AI.research_question: 《以人为本的聊天机器人法案》中"用户"这一关键法律术语的定义是否存在结构性缺陷？该缺陷如何影响法案的适用性与可执行性？
AI.motivation: 环境智能设备（如摄像头音箱）已大规模进入美国家庭，而最大的聊天机器人提供商即将进入该领域。在这些场景中，设备的操作者与被监管的"用户"可能不是同一个人（如儿童经过摄像头时被处理面部数据），现有法案的"用户"定义在此类情境下完全无法适用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 用户相对性（User-Relativity）理论——一种区别于传统"过度宽泛"和"模糊性"批评的结构性起草病理学；请求者关键词法律（requester-keyed statutes）与数据主体关键词法律（data-subject-keyed statutes）的区分框架。
AI.method: 法律文本分析：逐条解析法案定义条款（尤其是第5(22)条"用户"定义）；情境分析：将定义置于环境智能设备（如摄像头音箱）的实际使用场景中测试其适用性；比较法分析：以《儿童在线隐私保护法》（COPPA）为对照，区分两类不同的立法架构。
AI.findings: (1) "用户"定义是"属+无种差"的伪定义，在环境智能设备场景下无法判断儿童是否为"用户"；(2) 无论将儿童解释为用户或非用户，都会导致法案目的落空；(3) 法案创设了以"违规次数"计量的私人诉权，但从未定义何谓"违规"，导致单个家庭一个下午的赔偿范围横跨四个数量级；(4) 法案的同意架构允许一个人授权处理另一个人的生物识别数据，这与该法案自身对"肯定性同意"的定义相矛盾。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"用户相对性"（user-relativity）这一新型结构性起草病理学概念，区别于传统的过度宽泛（overbreadth）和模糊性（vagueness）批评；建立了"请求者关键词法律"与"数据主体关键词法律"的类型学区分框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了一项即将生效的联邦法案在环境智能设备场景下的致命缺陷，为立法者提供了三项从现有联邦法律中借鉴的具体修正案，在不改变法案整体结构的前提下修复漏洞。

title: The Need for Speed: Regulatory Strategies for Fast-Moving AI and Software Medical Devices, and the Rise of the Predetermined Change Control Plan, 2018-2026

detail.title: The Need for Speed: Regulatory Strategies for Fast-Moving AI and Software Medical Devices, and the Rise of the Predetermined Change Control Plan, 2018-2026

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Bryan Davis, is founder and Chief Executive Officer of BeneDoc, Inc., a company that develops regulatory-intelligence and compliance software for medical-device manufacturers. BeneDoc's commercial interests relate to the subject matter of this analysis, which could be perceived as a competing interest. To mitigate this, the study relies only on publicly available FDA data and a first-party, text-derived measurement built on those public records, and the analysis code and data sources are openly available. The author has no other financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a secondary analysis of publicly available, aggregate FDA administrative records (510(k), De Novo, and PMA decisions and their public summaries). It did not involve human participants, animal subjects, or any identifiable private patient information, and therefore did not require ethics committee approval or informed consent.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was conducted internally by BeneDoc, Inc.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study is a retrospective analysis of public FDA regulatory records and is not a clinical trial.

detail.abstract: Background. AI/ML-enabled and software-based medical devices iterate faster than FDA's permodification review is often said to accommodate. FDA offers a graduated menu of premarket pathways and, since 2022, the Predetermined Change Control Plan (PCCP), an overlay that preauthorizes a defined envelope of future changes at initial authorization. How fast-moving devices use these pathways, and how the PCCP is being adopted, has not been comprehensively characterized. Methods. We analyzed all 510(k) clearances and De Novo grants decided 2018-2025 (24,841 submissions from 8,596 applicants), nesting AI and software devices within the full device population, and examined premarket approval (PMA) decisions separately. We identified every disclosed PCCP across all 2023-onward 510(k) summaries and all De Novo and PMA summaries using a hyphenation-tolerant keyword gate plus large-language-model adjudication (Gemini 2.5 Pro), classifying each plan as AI/ML or non-AI. PCCP counts are floors, capturing only summaries that name the plan. Results. Within each pathway, AI devices cleared at the same speed as devices generally (Special 510(k) median ~29 days; Traditional ~148; De Novo ~266-312), with no AI-specific penalty. AI devices used the Special 510(k) less than the overall population (11.6% vs 15.0%), a structural effect of its prior-clearance precondition. PCCP disclosure rose steeply after the pathway's 2022 statutory creation, reaching 8.2% of AI device summaries across 2023-2026 versus 0.50% of all other devices (an approximately 16-fold difference), and establishing one added no review-time penalty (152 vs 149 median days within the Traditional 510(k)). However, 47 of 125 PCCPs (38%) governed non-AI devices, concentrated in antimicrobial-susceptibility breakpoint updates and orthopedic implant families. Conclusions. AI devices are not reviewed more slowly than others on the same pathway; what distinguishes them is pathway strategy. The PCCP is adopted fastest by AI but functions as a general instrument for any device whose authorized specification changes on a predictable cadence.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2018-2025年间FDA所有510(k)和De Novo审批数据（24,841份），发现AI设备在相同路径上的审批速度并不慢于其他设备，但路径策略存在差异。预先变更控制计划（PCCP）在AI设备中采用率最高（8.2% vs 0.50%），且38%的PCCP用于非AI设备，证明PCCP是一种通用机制而非AI专用工具。
AI.research_question: AI/ML和软件类医疗设备在FDA各审批路径上的表现如何？PCCP（预先变更控制计划）的采用情况及其对审批速度的影响如何？
AI.motivation: 业界普遍认为FDA审批流程难以适应AI/ML设备的快速迭代节奏，但缺乏对实际审批数据和PCCP采用情况的系统性、全面性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: FDA医疗设备审批路径理论（510(k)、De Novo、PMA）及PCCP监管框架；AI/ML设备迭代速度与监管适应性之间的张力理论。
AI.method: 对2018-2025年24,841份510(k)和De Novo审批数据进行全量分析，嵌套AI和软件设备于总体设备中；使用连字符容忍关键词门控加LLM（Gemini 2.5 Pro）识别PCCP披露；分类统计并比较中位审批天数。
AI.findings: 1) AI设备在相同审批路径上与总体设备速度相当（Special 510(k)中位约29天，Traditional约148天，De Novo约266-312天）；2) AI设备使用Special 510(k)的比例低于总体（11.6% vs 15.0%），因其需先有已获批产品；3) PCCP披露率从2022年法定创建后急剧上升，AI设备达8.2%，非AI设备仅0.50%；4) PCCP未增加审批时间（Traditional 510(k)中位152天 vs 149天）；5) 38%的PCCP用于非AI设备（如抗菌敏感性折点更新、骨科植入物家族）。
AI.theory_contributions: 修正了"AI设备审批更慢"的普遍认知，揭示了路径策略（而非审批速度）才是AI设备与一般设备的真正区别；证实PCCP不仅是AI专用工具，而是适用于任何可预测变更的设备的通用监管机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗设备厂商提供FDA审批路径选择的实证依据；帮助监管机构理解PCCP的实际采用情况，为未来监管优化提供数据支持；澄清AI设备监管的误解，降低行业焦虑。

title: Clinical-Knowledge-Driven Prompt-Tuning for Predicting Occult Lymph Node Metastasis in Early-Stage Head and Neck Cancer: A Multicenter MRI-Based Study
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hospital, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - State Key Laboratory of Oncology in South China, Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hospital, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Harvard University - Massachusetts General Hospital, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU), affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hospital, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Harvard University - Massachusetts General Hospital, Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU), Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - Department of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - School of Computer Science and Engineering and Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - Department of Radiology

detail.title: Clinical-Knowledge-Driven Prompt-Tuning for Predicting Occult Lymph Node Metastasis in Early-Stage Head and Neck Cancer: A Multicenter MRI-Based Study
detail.abstract: Background This retrospective diagnostic study developed and validated an accurate and efficient method to predict occult cervical lymph node metastasis (LNM) for early-stage head and neck cancer (HNC). Method 591 patients were retrospectively recruited from Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hospital (n=308), Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (n=104), Affiliated Cancer Hospital and Institute of Guangzhou Medical University (n=94), Shanghai Ninth People’s Hospital (n=42), and The Third Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University (n=43) between January, 2012, and June, 2023. A prompt-assisted deep learning model (HNC-Net) was developed using MR images of primary tumor sites, and LNM prediction performance was evaluated using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC), sensitivity (SENS), specificity (SPEC), positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV). Results HNC-Net had favorable performance for predicting LNM in early-stage HNC patients both in the training dataset (AUROC 0.89 [0.85, 0.93], SENS 0.92 [0.87, 0.98], SPEC 0.66 [0.60, 0.73], PPV 0.54 [0.46, 0.61], NPV 0.95 [0.92, 0.99]) and in the testing datasets (AUROC 0.90 [0.87~0.95], SENS 0.93 [0.87, 0.98], SPEC 0.60 [0.53, 0.67], PPV 0.48 [0.40, 0.56], NPV 0.95 [0.92, 0.99]). The model demonstrated exceptional performance across various subsites (AUROC for oral cavity 0.89 [0.84, 0.94], oropharynx 0.96 [0.86, 0.99], and larynx 0.91 [0.86, 0.99]), and clinical T stages (AUROC for cT1 0.90 [0.72, 0.99], for cT2 0.89 [0.84, 0.94]). Conclusion The MRI-based HNC-Net model is a promising diagnostic tool for predicting cervical LNM in early-stage HNC, which will help surgeons make appropriate surgical decisions regarding neck dissection.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种基于MRI的深度学习模型HNC-Net，用于预测早期头颈部癌症患者隐匿性颈部淋巴结转移，模型在多个数据集上表现良好（AUROC约0.90），有望辅助外科医生制定颈部清扫手术决策。
AI.research_question: 如何准确且高效地预测早期头颈部癌症（HNC）患者的隐匿性颈部淋巴结转移（LNM）？
AI.motivation: 早期HNC患者隐匿性淋巴结转移的术前预测对手术决策至关重要，但现有方法准确性有限，亟需开发更精准的预测工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习的医学影像分析（Prompt-assisted deep learning model）；MRI影像特征与淋巴结转移的关联性。
AI.method: 回顾性多中心诊断研究，纳入591名患者；开发基于MRI原发肿瘤图像的提示辅助深度学习模型（HNC-Net）；使用AUROC、敏感性、特异性、阳性预测值、阴性预测值评估模型性能。
AI.findings: HNC-Net在训练集（AUROC 0.89）和测试集（AUROC 0.90）上均表现良好，在不同癌种亚部位（口腔、口咽、喉）和不同临床T分期中均具有优越性能，阴性预测值高达0.95。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了深度学习模型在医学影像分析中预测隐匿性淋巴结转移的有效性，拓展了AI辅助诊断在头颈癌领域的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为外科医生提供了一种无创、高效的术前预测工具，有助于识别真正需要颈部清扫的患者，避免不必要的手术创伤和过度治疗。

title: Beyond GDP: Economic Structures and Human Well-Being

detail.title: Beyond GDP: Economic Structures and Human Well-Being
detail.abstract: The interplay between macroeconomic performance and individual well-being remains a critical, highly contested debate in both economic theory and social sciences. While traditional development metrics have historically prioritized Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth as the ultimate proxy for societal advancement, emerging empirical literature suggests that aggregate economic expansion frequently masks profound, localized disparities in income equality, psychological health, and fundamental standards of living. This paper conducts a comprehensive empirical meta-analysis and theoretical synthesis to examine how structural economic shifts, inationary pressures, and severe economic crises directly impact human development at the micro-level. Utilizing a longitudinal, crosscountry analytical framework bridging macroeconomic indicators with human-centric outcomes, this research challenges the orthodox assumption that economic growth uniformly translates to enhanced quality of life. The ndings reveal that structural inequalities systematically exclude lower-income cohorts from the benets of economic expansion, while ination acts as a highly regressive shock. Ultimately, this paper provides a multi-dimensional framework for policymakers, arguing that economic success must be evaluated through the lens of equitable human welfare, institutional safety nets, and mental health security rather than mere nancial output.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了GDP增长作为社会进步唯一指标的假设，通过元分析和理论综合发现，结构性不平等系统性排斥低收入群体分享经济增长红利，通胀则是一种高度累退性的冲击，主张经济成功应通过公平的人类福祉、制度安全网和心理健康安全来评估。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济表现（结构性经济转型、通胀压力、经济危机）如何直接影响微观层面的人类发展（收入平等、心理健康、生活水平）？
AI.motivation: 传统发展指标（如GDP）将经济增长视为社会进步的唯一代理变量，但新兴实证文献表明总体经济扩张常常掩盖了收入平等、心理健康和生活水平方面的深层局部差异，因此需要重新审视这一假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济增长-人类福祉关系的批判性理论；结构性不平等理论；通胀的累退性理论；制度安全网理论。
AI.method: 综合性实证元分析（meta-analysis）与理论综合；采用纵向跨国分析框架，衔接宏观经济指标与以人为中心的结果变量。
AI.findings: (1) 结构性不平等系统性排斥低收入群体从经济增长中获益；(2) 通胀是一种高度累退性的冲击，对弱势群体伤害更大；(3) 经济增长并不均匀地转化为生活质量的提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"经济增长自动转化为生活质量提升"的正统假设，提出了一种多维度的评估框架，将人类福祉、制度安全网和心理健康安全纳入经济成功的衡量标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一个多维度框架，主张经济成功应通过公平的人类福祉、制度安全网和心理健康安全来评估，而非仅仅关注金融产出。

title: Beyond GDP: Reconstructing Macroeconomic Policy for Economic Resilience in the Twenty-First Century

detail.title: Beyond GDP: Reconstructing Macroeconomic Policy for Economic Resilience in the Twenty-First Century
detail.abstract: Mainstream macroeconomic policy frameworks have repeatedly failed to anticipate, and have struggled to contain, the major economic dislocations of the past two decades. This paper argues that these failures are not accidental but structural: they follow from an analytical architecture organized around a narrow scalar objective, real GDP growth 1 , low and stable inflation, and a notional natural rate of unemployment, that systematically underweights financial fragility, debt dynamics, environmental depletion, institutional quality, distributional outcomes, and the systemic capacity of an economy to absorb and recover from shocks. I first evaluated why dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) models, the rational-expectations programme, and inflation-targeting regimes performed so poorly across the Global Financial Crisis (2008-2009), the Eurozone sovereign debt crisis (2010-2013), the post-pandemic inflation shock (2021-2023), the collapse of Silicon Valley Bank (2023), and the secular accumulation of public debt in advanced economies. After that, I developed the Macroeconomic Resilience Framework (MRF), in which social welfare is defined across eight dimensions and resilience is formalized as a state variable that governs the amplitude and persistence of an economy's response to shocks. The framework yields a multidimensional social welfare functional with low cross-dimensional substitutability, an endogenous amplification mechanism that generates regime-dependent multipliers, a "golden rule of resilient public finance," and a Tinbergen-Mundell instrument assignment problem that rationalizes the separation of monetary, macroprudential, fiscal, and distributional instruments. I compare the framework with standard DSGE and New Keynesian models, derive implications for inflation targeting, debt management, fiscal policy, and financial regulation, and set out its limitations and an agenda for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文批判主流宏观经济政策框架（以GDP增长、低通胀和自然失业率为核心）在应对近二十年经济动荡中的结构性失败，并提出一个包含八维度社会福利和韧性状态变量的宏观韧性框架（MRF），以更全面地处理金融脆弱性、债务动态、环境 depletion、制度质量、分配结果和系统冲击吸收能力。
AI.research_question: 为什么主流宏观经济政策框架（DSGE模型、理性预期范式、通胀目标制）在应对近二十年重大经济动荡中表现不佳？如何构建一个更全面的宏观韧性框架来弥补这些结构性缺陷？
AI.motivation: 主流框架在2008年全球金融危机、欧债危机、疫情后通胀冲击、硅谷银行倒闭及公共债务累积等系列事件中反复失败，且这些失败不是偶然而是分析架构的结构性问题——过度聚焦窄标量目标，系统性地低估了金融脆弱性、债务动态、环境消耗、制度质量、分配结果和系统韧性能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观韧性框架（MRF）：将社会福利定义为八个维度；将韧性形式化为控制经济对冲击响应幅度和持久性的状态变量；低跨维度替代性的多维社会福利泛函；内生放大机制产生体制依赖乘数；"韧性公共财政黄金法则"；廷伯根-蒙德尔工具分配问题以合理化货币政策、宏观审慎、财政和分配工具的分离。
AI.method: 理论构建与比较分析：首先评估DSGE模型、理性预期范式和通胀目标制在多次危机中的表现；然后构建宏观韧性框架（MRF）；最后与标准DSGE和新凯恩斯模型进行比较，推导政策含义。
AI.findings: 主流框架的结构性缺陷源于过度聚焦单一目标而忽视多维度系统性风险；MRF通过引入多维社会福利和韧性状态变量，能够更好地解释和应对经济冲击；MRF提供了一个更全面的工具分配方案，合理化货币政策、宏观审慎、财政和分配工具的分离使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了宏观韧性框架（MRF），将韧性概念形式化为状态变量，并引入低跨维度替代性的多维社会福利泛函、内生放大机制和体制依赖乘数；重新定义了廷伯根-蒙德尔工具分配问题，为货币政策、宏观审慎、财政和分配工具的分工提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为通胀目标制、债务管理、财政政策和金融监管提供了新的政策框架；提出了"韧性公共财政黄金法则"作为财政可持续性的新准则；指出主流框架的局限性并为未来研究设定了议程。

title: Contemporary conflictive monumental architectures in the Global South: Contested infrastructures and the mobilisation of ’cheap’ sands
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Contemporary conflictive monumental architectures in the Global South: Contested infrastructures and the mobilisation of ’cheap’ sands
detail.abstract: This paper addresses the lack of research around mobilisation of the existing limited sand resources towards ecologically, socially, politically, and economically harmful large infrastructure projects. It deals with a specific category of highly conflictive, highly ecologically impactful, new infrastructure projects on the rise across the global South. These contemporary conflictive infrastructure projects include megastructures, megastructures-for-megaevents, mega-infrastructures, and private (semi-private) cities. To examine the dynamics behind these projects, two important theoretical perspectives are presented. First, based upon extensive literature on cheap natures the paper theorises the notion of ’cheap sands’. Using the cases, it demonstrates how ’cheap sands’ are constructed, and then mobilised to produce monumentality in contemporary times. Second, it explores the literature on monumentality in antiquities and demonstrates the parallels to contemporary conflictive monumental architectures. Here, it exposes the continuity of systems of power, oppression, and force utilised in the construction of megastructures. Using the notion of cheap sands, the scholarship on monument architectures of antiquities, and the specific case studies of contemporary conflictive infrastructures, the paper shows how sand use is linked to broader projects of authoritarian power and geopolitical soft-power projection, and more concrete everyday exploitation, labour rights violations, conflicts, and subversion of rights of people

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了有限沙资源如何被动员到生态、社会、政治和经济上有害的大型基础设施项目中，提出"廉价沙子"概念，并将其与古代纪念性建筑中的权力压迫体系相联系，揭示当代冲突性基础设施背后的权力运作与剥削机制。
AI.research_question: 有限的沙资源如何被动员到具有高度冲突性和生态危害的大型基础设施项目中？这些项目背后蕴含着怎样的权力动态和剥削机制？
AI.motivation: 当前学术界对沙资源如何被动员到生态和社会有害的大型基础设施项目中的研究不足，尤其缺乏对全球南方新兴的冲突性基础设施项目的深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. "廉价自然"理论——提出"廉价沙子"概念，解释沙子如何被建构为廉价资源并被动员；2. 古代纪念性建筑文献——揭示权力、压迫和强制体系在巨型建筑中的连续性。
AI.method: 理论建构与案例研究相结合，通过"廉价沙子"概念和古代纪念性建筑文献，结合当代冲突性基础设施的具体案例进行分析。
AI.findings: 沙子使用与更广泛的威权权力项目、地缘政治软实力投射，以及具体的日常剥削、劳工权利侵犯、冲突和人民权利剥夺之间存在直接关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"廉价沙子"这一原创性理论概念，并将古代纪念性建筑中的权力分析框架延伸至当代冲突性基础设施研究中。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了大型基础设施项目中沙资源动员背后的权力压迫与剥削机制，为理解全球南方冲突性基础设施项目的政治生态后果提供了分析工具。

title: Waste capitalism: Environmental conflicts and the dispossession of waste pickers in the Global South
affiliations: Universitat de Barcelona, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Institut de Ciència i Tecnologia Ambientals (ICTA - UAB)

detail.title: Waste capitalism: Environmental conflicts and the dispossession of waste pickers in the Global South
detail.abstract: Informal waste pickers play a critical role in urban waste management in the Global South, often serving as primary actors of recycling. Despite this, they face increasing socio-economic exclusion and environmental injustice. This article examines the drivers of environmental conflicts involving waste pickers in Global South cities, drawing on 70 cases from the Global Environmental Justice Atlas. We show how changes in the material-biophysical dimension (e.g. increasing volumes) and in the political-economic dimension of waste management (e.g. privatisation and incineration) jointly drive the marginalisation of waste pickers. Our mixed-method approach, combining descriptive statistics, qualitative coding, network analysis, and system dynamics modelling, reveals how reconfigurations of waste metabolism generate ecological distribution conflicts. We conceptualise these dynamics as waste capitalism, whereby waste becomes a contested site of capital accumulation through dispossession, and contamination. These transformations intensify disputes over waste, restrict access to recyclable materials, and shift environmental and health burdens onto marginalised groups. In response, waste pickers mobilise to defend their livelihoods, often forming alliances with urban residents and civil society organisations. This article advances ecological economics by conceptualising waste metabolism as the co-evolution of material-biophysical and political-economic processes, and by showing how their reconfiguration generates ecological distribution conflicts and gives rise to an urban environmentalism of the poor. More broadly, the concept of waste capitalism connects localised waste conflicts to global environmental change, including climate change as a large-scale manifestation of capital accumulation by contamination.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析全球南方70个环境冲突案例，揭示了废物资本主义如何通过物质-生物物理和政治-经济维度的重构，导致非正式拾荒者的边缘化，并引发生态分配冲突。拾荒者通过动员和结盟来捍卫生计，形成了城市贫困群体的环保主义。
AI.research_question: 全球南方城市中，涉及非正式拾荒者的环境冲突的驱动因素是什么？废物代谢的重构如何导致生态分配冲突？
AI.motivation: 非正式拾荒者在全球南方城市废物管理中扮演关键角色，但面临日益严重的社会经济排斥和环境不公正。现有文献缺乏对驱动拾荒者环境冲突因素的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 废物资本主义（waste capitalism）——废物成为资本积累通过剥夺和污染的争议场所；废物代谢（waste metabolism）作为物质-生物物理与政治-经济过程的共同演化；生态分配冲突（ecological distribution conflicts）；城市贫困群体的环保主义（urban environmentalism of the poor）。
AI.method: 混合方法：描述性统计、定性编码、网络分析、系统动力学建模。数据来源：全球环境正义地图集（Global Environmental Justice Atlas）中的70个案例。
AI.findings: 1）物质-生物物理维度（如废物量增加）和政治-经济维度（如私有化、焚烧）的变化共同驱动拾荒者的边缘化；2）废物代谢的重构产生生态分配冲突；3）冲突加剧了关于废物的争议，限制了拾荒者获取可回收材料，并将环境和健康负担转移给边缘群体；4）拾荒者通过动员和与城市居民及民间社会组织结盟来应对。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）概念化了废物代谢作为物质-生物物理与政治-经济过程的共同演化；2）揭示了废物代谢重构如何产生生态分配冲突并催生城市贫困群体的环保主义；3）提出了"废物资本主义"概念，将地方性废物冲突与全球环境变化（包括气候变化）联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球南方城市废物管理政策提供启示，强调应关注非正式拾荒者的权利和生计，反对私有化和焚烧等排斥性废物处理方式，推动包容性的循环经济实践。

title: Stock Selection within Sectors: Sector-specific Screening Models, Out-of-sample Evaluation, and Economic Value
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Stock Selection within Sectors: Sector-specific Screening Models, Out-of-sample Evaluation, and Economic Value
detail.abstract: This paper completes a three-part study of the top-down investment process, descending from market-level drawdown prediction and sector rotation to the nal layer: security selection within sectors. It addresses a critical question that analysts face: within a given sector, which measurable characteristics signal future relative returns best and most reliably, and how should they be combined into a stock screen? Using a survivorship-free, point-in-time panel of S&P 500 constituents from 2000 to 2025, I evaluate 25 pre-registered rm characteristics and eleven competing selection models (nine sector-specic, two pooled) under a purged walk-forward protocol with monthly rets and false-discovery-rate control. Three principal ndings emerge. First, the factor evidence is strongly conditional. Short interest is the most pervasive and decay-resistant signal, while within-sector momentum is absent except in Utilities and under stress; sector-level forecastability concentrates in six of eleven sectors and fails precisely where accounting comparability breaks down; and the payo to selection rises monotonically with the drawdown probability estimated in the rst paper of the series, so that stock selection pays when the macro layer is worried. A signal's favourable range is, moreover, frequently an interior zone rather than an extreme, and the paper reports level-by-level return proles with favourable zones, in screening units, for every characterisable signal in every sector. Second, on how the factors should be combined into a single score, simple discipline beats clever estimation: approaches that x each signal's expected direction in advance, whether xed-weight composites or a machine-learning model held to those same directions, earn pooled out-of-sample rank information coecients of 0.016 to 0.027, while models that estimate the weights freely add nothing, and often detract. A diagnostic explains why rather than merely showing that it happens: even an estimator handed the correct prior cannot reliably learn how hard to lean on it, so imposing the discipline in advance beats trying to estimate it. Third, the skill is economically material: longshort tercile books earn factor-spanning alphas with t-statistics of roughly 2.7 to 2.9 at the one-month horizon, a longonly tracking-error-targeted implementation retains a net information ratio of 0.80 at realistic costs, and the integrated three-layer framework raises the Sharpe ratio of a passive holding from 0.89 to 1.12 while adding 12.2 percentage points of active return in the 2022 drawdown. Five of six pre-registered success criteria pass; the sixth returns a split verdict and is reported as such.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三层自上而下投资框架（市场下跌预测→行业轮动→行业内选股），系统评估了25个预注册的公司特征和11个选股模型。研究发现：卖空兴趣是最持久有效的信号；简单纪律优于复杂估计；该框架能将夏普比率从0.89提升至1.12，并在2022年下跌市中创造12.2个百分点的主动收益。
AI.research_question: 在特定行业内，哪些可测量的公司特征能最可靠地预测未来相对收益？如何将这些特征组合成有效的选股筛选器？
AI.motivation: 分析师面临的关键问题是在行业内部如何基于可量化特征进行有效选股，但现有研究缺乏对行业内信号的系统性、跨行业比较，也缺乏对信号组合方法的严谨评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于三层自上而下投资流程（市场下跌预测→行业轮动→行业内选股），结合条件因子模型、信号衰减理论、以及"简单纪律优于复杂估计"的模型选择理论。
AI.method: 使用2000-2025年S&P 500成分股的无幸存偏差、时间点面板数据，在净化滚动验证协议下，评估25个预注册公司特征和11个竞争性选股模型（9个行业特定、2个混合），控制错误发现率，月度再平衡。
AI.findings: (1) 因子证据高度条件化：卖空兴趣是最普遍且抗衰减的信号；行业内动量仅存在于公用事业和压力市场下；选股收益随市场下跌概率单调上升。(2) 简单纪律优于复杂估计：预先固定信号方向的模型（固定权重或约束机器学习）表现更好，自由估计权重的模型反而降低表现。(3) 经济显著性：多空策略月频alpha t统计量约2.7-2.9；三层框架将夏普比率从0.89提升至1.12，2022年下跌市中增加12.2个百分点主动收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了行业内选股信号的条件性本质，提出并验证了"简单纪律优于复杂估计"的选股模型构建原则，为条件因子模型提供了行业内层面的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为分析师提供了每个行业、每个信号的具体有利区间（以筛选单位表示）；验证了完整的三层量化投资框架（宏观下跌概率→行业轮动→选股）的有效性；提供了可操作的高信息比率选股策略。

title: Nonlinear and lagged associations between ambient temperature and pre-weaning piglet mortality in Cuba
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Autonomous University of Barcelona, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Nonlinear and lagged associations between ambient temperature and pre-weaning piglet mortality in Cuba
detail.abstract: Climate change is increasing exposure to hot conditions, yet epidemiological evidence on temperature-related mortality in pre-weaning piglets remains limited, particularly in humid tropical production systems. We assessed the immediate and delayed association between daily mean ambient temperature and pre-weaning piglet mortality using daily records from 14 commercial farms in 12 Cuban municipalities during 2022–2024 (17,599 deaths). Farms mainly use open or semi-open naturally ventilated maternity buildings with limited active microclimate control. Municipality-level daily mean temperature and relative humidity were obtained from ERA5-Land. We applied a space–time-stratified case-crossover design with conditional quasi-Poisson regression and a distributed lag non-linear model over lags 0–7 days, adjusting for relative humidity. The cumulative temperature–mortality association was U-shaped and strongly heat-dominated, with a minimum-mortality temperature of 23.7 °C. Effects were predominantly acute. At lag 0, mortality risk increased at both the maximum observed temperature of 31.2 °C (RR 1.49, 95% CI 1.06–2.09) and the minimum of 14.3 °C (RR 2.26, 95% CI 1.27–4.02); however, cold effects attenuated rapidly and contributed little to the overall burden. Non-optimal temperature accounted for 16.5% of deaths, almost entirely attributable to heat (15.4%). Most heat-attributable deaths occurred on non-extreme warm days above the minimum-mortality temperature, whereas the hottest 1% of days accounted for 0.7%. These findings support routine heat-risk management in farrowing environments as a strategy to help reduce pre-weaning mortality and strengthen climate resilience in tropical swine systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于古巴12个市14个商业猪场的日常数据，分析了日均环境温度与哺乳前仔猪死亡率之间的即时和滞后关联。研究发现温度-死亡关系呈U形，热效应占主导地位，非最佳温度导致16.5%的死亡，其中几乎全部（15.4%）归因于热暴露。这支持在热带养猪系统中加强热风险管理以降低哺乳前死亡率的策略。
AI.research_question: 日均环境温度与哺乳前仔猪死亡率之间的即时和滞后关联如何？特别是在湿热热带生产系统中。
AI.motivation: 气候变化增加了高温暴露风险，但关于温度与哺乳前仔猪死亡率的流行病学证据仍有限，尤其是在湿热热带生产系统中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间-时间分层病例交叉设计；条件拟泊松回归；分布式滞后非线性模型
AI.method: 使用2022-2024年古巴12个市14个商业猪场17,599例死亡记录，获取ERA5-Land气象数据，采用空间-时间分层病例交叉设计，结合条件拟泊松回归和分布式滞后非线性模型（滞后0-7天），并调整相对湿度。
AI.findings: 累积温度-死亡率关联呈U形且以热效应为主，最低死亡率温度为23.7°C。效应主要为急性，最高温度31.2°C（RR 1.49）和最低温度14.3°C（RR 2.26）均增加死亡风险，但冷效应迅速减弱。非最佳温度导致16.5%死亡，几乎全归因于热（15.4%），且多数热归因死亡发生在非极端温暖日。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在热带地区系统评估了环境温度与哺乳前仔猪死亡率的暴露-反应关系，揭示了热效应占主导且呈急性特点，补充了该领域的流行病学证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究表明在分娩环境中实施常规热风险管理可有效降低哺乳前仔猪死亡率，增强热带养猪系统的气候韧性，尤其关注非极端高温日的累积热负担。

title: SELF-MANAGEMENT AND THE ”TOTAL ENVIRONMENT”: On the Reinterpretation of ”The Limits to Growth” in Yugoslavia and the Non-Aligned Movement

detail.title: SELF-MANAGEMENT AND THE ”TOTAL ENVIRONMENT”: On the Reinterpretation of ”The Limits to Growth” in Yugoslavia and the Non-Aligned Movement
detail.abstract: This article analyses the reception of The Limits to Growth in socialist Yugoslavia through the lens of the Non-Aligned Movement and the Stockholm Conference (1972). It argues that ecological limits were not simply imported as a Northern systems model, but were reinterpreted within Yugoslav self-management socialism as part of a broader debate on development, decentralisation, and global inequality. By tracing the circulation of ecological ideas across media, intellectual, and Party institutions based on archival research and interviews, the paper shows how Yugoslavia translated NAM critique of The Limits to Growth into an institutional project of expanding self-management and collective decision-making to include environmental protection. The article concludes that the Yugoslav case represents a distinct trajectory in the global history of ecological thought in which ecological governance is understood through the expansion of self-organisation rather than the limitation of development.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了《增长的极限》在南斯拉夫社会主义时期的接受过程，以不结盟运动和斯德哥尔摩会议（1972年）为视角，揭示生态限制观念如何被南斯拉夫自治社会主义重新诠释，并转化为一个通过扩大自我管理和集体决策来纳入环境保护的制度项目。
AI.research_question: 《增长的极限》这一北方系统模型如何在南斯拉夫社会主义语境中被重新解读，以及南斯拉夫如何将不结盟运动对该报告的批评转化为制度性的生态治理实践？
AI.motivation: 挑战"生态限制观念是简单从北方移植到南方"的线性叙事，揭示全球生态思想史中多元、地方性的发展轨迹，尤其是南斯拉夫这一非典型案例所代表的独特路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球生态思想史、不结盟运动批判理论、南斯拉夫自治社会主义理论、生态治理与自我组织理论。
AI.method: 档案研究（archival research）与访谈（interviews），追溯生态观念在媒体、知识分子和党的机构中的流通过程。
AI.findings: 南斯拉夫将不结盟运动对《增长的极限》的批评转化为制度性项目：扩大自我管理和集体决策以纳入环境保护；生态治理在南斯拉夫被理解为通过自我组织的扩展而非限制发展来实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 为全球生态思想史提供了一个区别于西方环境主义和发展限制论的非正统轨迹，即生态治理与自我组织扩张相结合的第三条道路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当代生态治理实践提供了历史参照，展示了一种不依赖发展限制而通过扩大民主参与和自我管理来实现环境保护的制度可能性。

title: Blood Supply as a Signaling Game: Institutions, Incentives, and Donation Regime Formation
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Blood Supply as a Signaling Game: Institutions, Incentives, and Donation Regime Formation
detail.abstract: Blood is an essential and non-substitutable input to health production whose supply depends on the behavioral choices of eligible donors. Financial incentives for donation generate heterogeneous effects, yet no formal theory derives when they produce welfare gains or losses, and no welfare criterion prices the quality gap between paid and voluntary supply. We argue that this heterogeneity is equilibrium selection across an institutional threshold rather than a universal behavioral parameter. We develop a Bayesian game in which agents differ in altruistic disposition, income, and donation history, and in which payoffs combine a public good term, a signaling term, and an identity formation mechanism activated by the first donation. Above a monetary threshold, paid donation destroys the signaling sub-game's separating equilibrium, yielding crowding-out as a provable equilibrium transition rather than a reduced-form parameter. A Grossman-style health production function whose quality rises in the voluntary share supplies a welfare criterion in health units. The planner's optimal incentive is non-monotone in institutional quality, zero above the threshold and strictly positive below it, which resolves the incentive-effectiveness paradox. A panel of 43 European countries observed between 2011 and 2018 exhibits the three predicted regimes with their retention and inequality signatures.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个贝叶斯博弈模型，证明金钱激励对献血行为存在非单调效应：低于阈值时激励有效，高于阈值时会产生挤出效应，并用43个欧洲国家的面板数据验证了三种预测机制。
AI.research_question: 金钱激励对献血供给的福利效应何时为正、何时为负？如何为有偿与自愿献血之间的质量差异提供福利定价标准？
AI.motivation: 现有文献观察到金钱激励对献血行为存在异质性效应，但没有形式化理论推导其福利损益条件，也没有福利准则为有偿与自愿供血之间的质量差距定价。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯博弈模型，包含公共物品项、信号传递项和首次献血激活的身份形成机制；Grossman式健康生产函数。
AI.method: 理论建模（贝叶斯博弈）+ 面板数据实证检验（43个欧洲国家，2011-2018年）。
AI.findings: 1) 金钱激励超过某个阈值时，信号博弈的分离均衡被破坏，产生可证明的均衡转换式挤出效应；2) 最优激励在制度质量上是非单调的：高于阈值时为零，低于阈值时为正，解决了激励-有效性悖论；3) 实证数据呈现三种预测机制及其留存率与不平等特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将献血的异质性效应形式化为均衡选择而非通用行为参数；为有偿与自愿供血的质量差异提供了基于健康单位的福利定价标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了最优激励的非单调设计原则：在制度质量低于阈值时使用正激励，高于阈值时不宜使用金钱激励；解决了长期以来关于献血是否应给予金钱补偿的政策争论。

title: Bayesian World Models: Posterior Predictive Imagination
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, George Mason University and

detail.title: Bayesian World Models: Posterior Predictive Imagination
detail.abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning agents-from Sutton's Dyna to Schmidhuber's world models-practice inside a learned simulator, treating the imagined dynamics as if they were the true environment. We argue this is decision-theoretically incomplete. The right object to plan against is the posterior predictive distribution over dynamics, not a point estimate; the standard Bellman operator collapses the parameter posterior with a Dirac mass and produces a value function whose bias tracks model misspecification rather than sampling noise. We develop a Bayesian formulation of model-based reinforcement learning that closes this gap. The framework has four ingredients: (i) a horseshoe prior on the latent transition weights, producing sparse and interpretable dependence between latent factors and inheriting the predictive minimaxity of van der Pas et al. (2014); (ii) a generalized Bayesian posterior (Bissiri et al., 2016) defined by predictive log-loss, avoiding intractable normalization of the joint likelihood; (iii) an implicit quantile forecaster for the latent transition, giving a nonparametric conditional CDF instead of a mixture density; and (iv) a Thompson-style planning rule under which the controller is optimized against rollouts drawn from the posterior predictive over dynamics. We establish a Bayesregret bound of order √ HSAT , matching the best known rate for posterior sampling in finite-horizon tabular MDPs, and a predictive-minimaxity bound of order s n log(d/s n)/n for the horseshoe-prior latent dynamics map. On a synthetic linear-quadratic environment where the Bayes-optimal solution is computable in closed form, on Car Racing, and on the DeepMind Control suite, the resulting agent matches or exceeds DreamerV3 and MBPO while requiring 30-50% fewer environment interactions and producing well-calibrated value uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出贝叶斯公式下的模型强化学习方法，通过后验预测分布代替点估计进行规划，在多个环境下以更少交互达到或超越DreamerV3等模型表现。
AI.research_question: 如何从决策理论角度弥补现有基于模型的强化学习中，将点估计动力学视为真实环境进行规划的决策不完整性？
AI.motivation: 现有MBRL算法用点估计代替真实动力学，忽视了参数后验的不确定性，导致价值函数偏差反映模型误设而非采样噪声，决策理论上不完整。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯模型强化学习框架，包括：马靴先验（horseshoe prior）用于稀疏潜变量过渡；广义贝叶斯后验基于预测对数损失；隐分位数预测器用于非参数条件CDF；汤普森式规划规则。
AI.method: 提出贝叶斯MBRL框架，包含四个成分：马靴先验、广义贝叶斯后验、隐分位数预测器、汤普森式规划。推导了贝叶斯遗憾界和预测最优界，并在合成环境、Car Racing和DeepMind Control套件上验证。
AI.findings: 该方法在合成线性二次环境、Car Racing和DeepMind Control套件上达到或超越DreamerV3和MBPO，同时节省30-50%的环境交互次数，并产生良好校准的价值不确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了Bayes遗憾界O(√HSAT)（与有限时域表格MDP后验采样的最优界一致），以及马靴先验潜动力图的预测极小化界O(s/n log(d/s_n)/n)。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出可在实践中落地的贝叶斯MBRL方法，在多个连续控制基准上超越SOTA方法（DreamerV3、MBPO），且样本效率提升30-50%。

title: Entry Policy and Repeated Firm Contact: Evidence from Gasoline Markets
affiliations: University of Oklahoma, Vassar College - Department of Economics and University of Oklahoma

detail.title: Entry Policy and Repeated Firm Contact: Evidence from Gasoline Markets
detail.abstract: This paper studies when entry-based competition policy succeeds. Using South Korea's Thrifty Gas Station policy, we find that low-cost entry lowers prices on average, but its effect depends on the incumbent contact network. When incumbent brands repeatedly meet across local markets, the price reduction from entry is attenuated and can reverse in the middle of the price distribution at very high levels of incumbent contact. The reversal is absent for private low-cost self-service entry and becomes weaker when government-backed entry is spatially denser. Entry-based policy therefore depends on both incumbent contact and the scale of entry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究进入式竞争政策何时有效。利用韩国“节俭加油站”政策发现，低成本进入会降低平均价格，但其效果取决于在位企业的接触网络。当在位品牌在多个地方市场频繁相遇时，价格降幅会减弱，并且在接触水平极高时，价格分布中段甚至可能出现价格反转。
AI.research_question: 基于进入的竞争政策在什么条件下能够成功？
AI.motivation: 理解进入式竞争政策的有效性边界，特别是当在位企业之间存在多市场接触时，低成本进入是否仍能起到降低价格、促进竞争的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多市场接触理论（Multimarket Contact Theory），即当在位企业在多个市场中重复相遇时，可能形成默契合谋，从而削弱进入的竞争效应。
AI.method: 以韩国“节俭加油站”政策为自然实验，采用实证分析方法，研究低成本进入对市场价格的影响，并考察在位品牌接触网络的调节作用。
AI.findings: （1）低成本进入平均降低了价格；（2）但在位品牌接触网络越密集，价格降幅越小；（3）当在位接触水平极高时，价格分布中段甚至出现价格反转（即进入反而导致价格上涨）；（4）该反转效应在私人低成本自助式进入中不存在，而在政府支持的进入密度较高时减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了多市场接触理论，揭示了其在进入式竞争政策情境下的调节作用，表明竞争政策效果并非普适，而是受到在位企业之间互动结构的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了明确指导：进入式竞争政策的效果取决于在位企业的市场接触程度和进入规模，在高接触市场中需要更密集或不同形式的干预才能达到预期效果。

title: Evolution and Future of Mission-Oriented Innovation Policy
affiliations: University of Cambridge and University of Cambridge - Institute for Manufacturing

detail.title: Evolution and Future of Mission-Oriented Innovation Policy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: M.H. and E.O. are supported by the Gatsby Charitable Foundation research grant GAT4039.

detail.abstract: Mission-oriented innovation policy (MOIP), grand challenges, and big science are central to contemporary industrial strategy. As innovation systems face AI-driven, fiscal, and geopolitical shocks, we synthesize the evolution of these traditions and reinterpret them through a contemporary lens. Innovation policy scholars seeking to: (i) clarify between missions, challenges & big science; (ii) understand how mission thinking has evolved; and (iii) design innovation missions for future technologies would find our interpretation useful.

AI.tldr: 本文综合分析了使命导向型创新政策、重大挑战与大科学三大传统的演变，并基于当代AI驱动、财政与地缘政治冲击的背景对其进行重新诠释，为创新政策学者提供关于使命、挑战与大科学之间关系的最新理解框架。
AI.research_question: 本文旨在回答：使命导向型创新政策、重大挑战和大科学三大传统如何演变？它们在当代（面临AI驱动、财政和地缘政治冲击）应如何被重新理解和设计？
AI.motivation: 创新系统正面临AI技术变革、财政紧缩和地缘政治冲突等多重冲击，而现有文献对"使命"、"挑战"与"大科学"三者之间的概念区分不足，且缺乏对使命思维演进的系统性梳理，因此有必要进行综合性的理论综合与重构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于创新系统理论、使命导向型创新政策（MOIP）、大科学理论以及重大挑战框架，通过历史演进的视角对三者进行概念辨析与理论综合。
AI.method: 文献综合与理论诠释（synthesis & reinterpretation），属于概念性/理论性综述研究，非实证方法。
AI.findings: 使命思维经历了从传统大科学（如阿波罗计划）到当代使命导向型创新政策的演变；在AI、财政与地缘政治冲击下，需要重新设计面向未来技术的创新使命；三大传统之间存在概念重叠但各有侧重，需进一步厘清。
AI.theory_contributions: 为创新政策学者提供了三大传统（MOIP、重大挑战、大科学）的概念辨析框架；梳理了使命思维的演进脉络；提出了在当代冲击下重新设计创新使命的理论方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计面向未来技术（如AI）的创新使命提供指导；帮助理解当前财政压力和地缘政治背景下创新政策的方向调整。

title: A Deep Graph Neural Network Architecture for Real-Time Intangible Asset Impairment Modeling under IFRS 9 and IAS 36 within Multi-Jurisdictional Digital Ecosystems
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Deep Graph Neural Network Architecture for Real-Time Intangible Asset Impairment Modeling under IFRS 9 and IAS 36 within Multi-Jurisdictional Digital Ecosystems
detail.abstract: The escalating prevalence of intangible assets-goodwill, capitalized software, customer relationships, brand equity, and platform-embedded data assets-within multinational digital ecosystems has exposed fundamental limitations in the periodic, judgmentintensive impairment testing regimes mandated by International Accounting Standard 36 (IAS 36) and the expected-credit-loss provisions of International Financial Reporting Standard 9 (IFRS 9). This paper proposes and rigorously evaluates a Graph Attention Network-Long Short-Term Memory (GAT-LSTM) architecture for continuous, real-time impairment trigger detection and recoverable amount estimation across heterogeneous cash-generating unit (CGU) hierarchies spanning multiple accounting jurisdictions. We formalize the multinational corporate group as a heterogeneous, dynamically evolving graph in which nodes represent legal entities, cash-generating units, and individually recognized intangible assets, while edges encode capital allocation relationships, shared-service dependencies, and cross-CGU cash flow interdependencies mandated under IAS 36 paragraph 66's allocation requirements. A relational graph attention mechanism learns to weight the influence of interconnected CGUs on each asset's discounted recoverable amount, while a temporal LSTM encoder captures the evolution of macroeconomic discount-rate inputs, segment-level cash flow forecasts, and qualitative trigger indicators across reporting periods. The resulting recoverable amount estimates are passed through a jurisdiction-aware rule translation layer that reconciles divergent treatment under IFRS, US-GAAP, and selected national GAAP regimes-addressing the structurally different impairment reversal prohibitions, discount-rate conventions, and unit-of-account definitions across jurisdictions. Evaluated on a constructed multinational panel spanning 1,840 CGU-years across 34 jurisdictions, the proposed GAT-LSTM architecture achieves an AUC-ROC of 0.93 for impairment trigger detection-a substantial improvement over logistic regression (0.71), gradient-boosted trees (0.79), and vanilla graph convolutional networks (0.84)-and an R² of 0.91 for impairment loss magnitude estimation against subsequently disclosed actual losses. We critically examine the auditability and explainability requirements imposed by ISA 540 (revised) on complex estimation techniques, the governance implications of continuous versus periodic impairment monitoring, jurisdictional reversal-prohibition asymmetries between IFRS and US-GAAP, data availability constraints inherent to private intangible valuation, and the systemic risk of model-induced procyclicality in impairment recognition. This work establishes a mathematically rigorous, empirically validated, and audit-conscious framework situated at the convergence of graph representation learning, financial reporting standards, and multinational corporate governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GAT-LSTM架构，用于跨国数字生态系统中无形资产减值的实时触发检测与可收回金额估计，在34个司法管辖区1840个CGU-年数据上实现AUC-ROC 0.93和R² 0.91，并讨论了审计性、治理影响及司法管辖区差异等关键问题。
AI.research_question: 如何利用图注意力网络-长短期记忆（GAT-LSTM）架构，对跨国数字生态系统中的无形资产进行连续、实时的减值触发检测与可收回金额估计，并解决不同会计准则（IFRS、US-GAAP、各国GAAP）之间的差异问题？
AI.motivation: IAS 36和IFRS 9框架下基于周期性、高度判断性的减值测试机制，在面对跨国数字生态系统中日益增长的 goodwill、资本化软件、客户关系、品牌权益及数据资产等无形资产时，已暴露出根本性的局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图表示学习（Graph Attention Network）、时序建模（LSTM）、跨国会计准则比较（IFRS/US-GAAP/各国GAAP）、审计准则（ISA 540修订版）对复杂估计技术的可审计性与可解释性要求。
AI.method: 将跨国企业集团建模为异构动态图（节点为法律实体、现金产出单元CGU、无形资产；边为资本配置关系、共享服务依赖及跨CGU现金流相互依赖关系），采用关系图注意力机制对CGU间影响进行加权，结合LSTM编码器捕捉宏观经济贴现率、现金流预测及定性触发指标的时序演变，最后通过司法管辖区感知规则转换层协调不同会计准则下的处理差异。
AI.findings: GAT-LSTM架构在减值触发检测上AUC-ROC达0.93（远超逻辑回归0.71、梯度提升树0.79、普通图卷积网络0.84），减值损失金额估计R²达0.91。同时识别出审计性要求、治理模式转换、司法管辖区禁止转回差异、私有无形资产数据约束及模型顺周期性等关键挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 将图注意力网络与LSTM结合应用于跨国无形资产减值领域，建立了跨会计准则协调的理论框架，揭示了连续监控vs周期性监控的治理理论含义，以及模型驱动减值确认的顺周期性理论风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国企业、审计师及监管机构提供了一种可审计、可解释的实时减值检测工具，能够协调IFRS、US-GAAP及各国GAAP之间的处理差异，并提出了关于数据可得性、模型治理及监管协调的实践建议。

title: Sustainability Action in the Real Estate Sector: An Organizational and Institutional Perspective
affiliations: KTH Royal Institute of Technology, KTH Royal Institute of Technology and

detail.title: Sustainability Action in the Real Estate Sector: An Organizational and Institutional Perspective
detail.abstract:
Introduction: Decision-makers' perceptions, influenced by institutional and organizational pressures, shape sustainability action. However, the current body of research on the impact of these pressures within the real estate sector, particularly among real estate owner organizations, remains limited.
Research argument: This explorative study fills the research gap by providing empirical findings and theoretical interpretation that explains the influence and outcomes of institutional pressures on decision-making processes. 
Methodological approach: Explorative surveys and interviews were conducted with asset managers in Sweden to understand their sustainability perceptions and actions within the real estate sector. 
Main findings: The study found a notable shift in sustainability perceptions among asset managers in Sweden, with most recognizing sustainability as critical for commercial real estate, challenging the notion of their passivity and highlighting their proactive engagement. Economic incentives significantly influence sustainability actions, with top priorities being energy efficiency and renewable energy due to their positive business impact. Other sustainability actions are also important but not prioritized to the same extent, revealing specific priorities within real estate owner organizations, an area less explored in prior research. 
Conclusion: The article proposes a theoretical framework to guide future research on how institutional and organizational mechanisms shape decision-makers' sustainability perceptions, guiding sustainability action. Understanding these mechanisms is essential for implementing Sustainable Development Goals in practice across industries.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对瑞典商业房地产资产管理者的调查与访谈，探讨了制度压力和组织机制如何影响决策者的可持续性认知与行动，发现资产管理者并非被动，而是积极将可持续性纳入决策，其中经济激励和能源效率是优先事项，并提出了一个理论框架以指导未来研究。
AI.research_question: 制度压力和组织压力如何影响房地产所有者组织中决策者的可持续性认知与行动？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对房地产行业，尤其是房地产所有者组织中制度压力的影响研究有限，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度压力理论（institutional pressures）与组织机制（organizational mechanisms）相结合的框架，用以解释决策者可持续性认知的形成及其对可持续行动的影响。
AI.method: 探索性研究方法，采用问卷调查和访谈，对象为瑞典房地产行业的资产管理者。
AI.findings: （1）瑞典资产管理者对可持续性的认知发生了显著转变，大多数人认为可持续性对商业房地产至关重要，挑战了其被动性的传统认知；（2）经济激励是影响可持续行动的关键因素，能源效率和可再生能源因具有正向商业影响而被优先考虑；（3）其他可持续行动虽重要但未被同等优先考虑，揭示了组织内部的具体优先级排序。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个结合制度压力与组织机制的理论框架，用于解释决策者可持续性认知的形成过程，拓展了制度理论在房地产所有者组织中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为房地产所有者组织理解如何通过制度与组织机制推动可持续性行动提供了实证依据，有助于在实践中落实可持续发展目标（SDGs）。

title: Labor Market Power in the Presence of Informality and Self-Employment

detail.title: Labor Market Power in the Presence of Informality and Self-Employment
detail.abstract: I develop a labor market framework in which monopsony power, firm informality, and self-employment coexist, a salient feature in developing economies' labor markets. I build a quantitative model of heterogeneous firms with endogenous entry and formalization decisions. Firms choose whether to operate formally or informally, while workers choose among formal wage work, informal wage work, and self-employment. From the firm's perspective, labor supply elasticity is endogenous to competition with other firms, substitution across local markets, and the availability of self-employment as an outside option. I calibrate the model using Brazilian administrative and survey data and quantify the equilibrium effect on welfare stemming from firm informality (+1%), self-employment (-6%) and market power (-5%). The channels interact: in the absence of market power, firm informality becomes welfare reducing (-0.7%) and self-employment's negative impact is strongly dampened (-0.8%). A payroll-tax cut financed by higher corporate profit taxation improves welfare by simultaneously raising equilibrium wages, reallocating labor towards formal firms, and reducing selfemployment.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含垄断势力、企业非正规性和自雇佣共存的理论框架，量化了巴西劳动力市场中这三类摩擦对福利的影响及其交互作用，并分析了工资税改革的福利效果。
AI.research_question: 在发展中国家的劳动力市场中，企业垄断势力、企业非正规性与自雇佣如何共存并相互作用？这些因素对福利的均衡效应及政策干预效果如何？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家劳动力市场普遍存在企业非正规性和高比例自雇佣现象，但现有理论多将二者分开处理，忽略了它们与垄断势力之间的互动关系。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供一个统一框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性企业模型（内生进入和正规化决策）；劳动力供给弹性内生于企业间竞争、跨市场替代及自雇佣作为外部选项的可得性。
AI.method: 构建定量异质性企业模型；使用巴西行政数据和调查数据进行校准；反事实模拟分析。
AI.findings: （1）基准均衡下：企业非正规性贡献+1%福利，自雇佣贡献-6%福利，市场势力贡献-5%福利；（2）渠道存在交互作用：若消除市场势力，企业非正规性转为福利减少（-0.7%），自雇佣的负面影响大幅减弱（-0.8%）；（3）以更高企业利润税融资的工资税削减可通过提高均衡工资、将劳动力重新配置到正规企业以及减少自雇佣来改善福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在同一框架中整合垄断势力、企业非正规性和自雇佣三个劳动力市场特征，揭示了它们之间的交互机制及对福利的非线性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家劳动力市场政策（尤其是工资税改革与企业利润税组合）提供了定量依据，表明减少市场势力可能改变非正规性和自雇佣的福利效应。
