affiliations: , University of Chile and Financial Market Commission of Chile

detail.title: Multidimensional Labor Conflict
detail.abstract: This paper studies labor conflict in collective bargaining when agreement clauses are multidimensional, and workers have heterogeneous preferences over wages and amenities. We develop a model of bargaining over bundles under two-sided incomplete information, where conflict arises as a war of attrition. The model predicts that conflict selects worker types whose preferences align with the disputed package. In the presence of internal uncertainty, unions choose packages that are robust to the distribution of preferences. Given the cost of a package, a symmetric distribution generally pushes toward balanced wage-amenity bundles. We study these predictions using administrative data from Chile. First, we leverage workers' votes on firms' offers to estimate how unions value wage and amenity clauses and document that, in feminized sectors, preferences are more symmetric across wage and amenity dimensions. Second, using an instrumental-variables research design and a revealed-preference approach to value collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), we show that conflict in feminized sectors shifts compensation toward amenities and raises the overall value of the CBA. In non-feminized sectors, by contrast, conflict primarily results in one-time resolution bonuses, with limited changes to the structure of the CBA.

AI.tldr: 本文研究劳动力在集体谈判中，当协议条款是多维的（工资与福利）且工人异质性偏好时，冲突如何通过消耗战机制筛选出偏好与争议包一致的工人类型，并利用智利行政数据验证了女性化行业中冲突更倾向于提升福利条款和协议总价值。
AI.research_question: 在多维集体谈判中，工人对工资和福利的异质性偏好如何影响劳动冲突的发生、冲突的类型选择效应，以及工会如何设计最优谈判包？
AI.motivation: 传统集体谈判研究多聚焦于工资单一维度，忽视了福利条款（如工作条件、工时等）的重要性以及工人偏好的异质性。本文试图弥补这一空白，从多维条款和异质性偏好视角理解劳动冲突的成因与后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于双边不完全信息下的多维谈判消耗战模型（war of attrition），并结合工人异质性偏好与工会内部不确定性（internal uncertainty）的理论框架。
AI.method: 理论建模（不完全信息博弈）；实证采用智利行政数据，结合工人对雇主提案的投票数据估计偏好，运用工具变量法和显示偏好法评估集体谈判协议价值。
AI.findings: (1) 冲突会筛选出偏好与争议包一致的工人类型；(2) 存在内部不确定性时，工会选择对偏好分布稳健的谈判包，对称偏好分布倾向于平衡工资-福利组合；(3) 女性化行业中工人偏好更对称，冲突导致补偿向福利条款倾斜并提高协议总价值；非女性化行业中冲突主要产生一次性解决奖金，协议结构变化有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 为多维集体谈判中的冲突选择效应提供了理论解释，将异质性偏好纳入消耗战框架，补充了劳动经济学中关于谈判冲突与条款结构关系的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工会设计谈判策略（尤其是性别差异化行业中如何平衡工资与福利条款）提供实证依据；为政策制定者理解劳动冲突对不同行业补偿结构的影响提供参考。

reference: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis, forthcoming
title: Location, Location, Location: Senate Trading and Seat Proximity
affiliations: University of Oregon, Texas A&M University - Mays Business School, Northwestern University - Department of Accounting Information & Management and University of Oregon

detail.title: Location, Location, Location: Senate Trading and Seat Proximity

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis, forthcoming

detail.abstract: Using the distance between two Senators' desks to capture the proclivity to share information, we find that when two Senators sit closer together in the Senate Chamber, they are more likely to trade stocks in the same industry and earn larger returns, especially when they belong to the same political party. This association varies with Senators' information sources and power, and the scrutiny they face. We perform multiple identification tests to support our inference that Senators share private trading information gleaned from their positions in Congress. Moreover, we provide the first evidence on the career benefits associated with sharing information.

AI.tldr: 通过参议员办公桌距离测量信息共享倾向，发现坐得近的参议员更可能在相同行业交易股票并获得更高收益，尤其在同一个政党时更明显。研究提供了信息共享带来职业利益的首个证据。
AI.research_question: 参议员之间的物理距离是否影响他们共享私人交易信息，从而影响股票交易行为和市场表现？
AI.motivation: 检验政治家之间非正式信息网络（由物理距离代理）如何驱动内幕交易行为，以及这种信息共享对个人职业利益的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会网络理论、信息传递理论、政治经济学中的寻租行为理论
AI.method: 利用参议院中办公桌间距作为信息共享倾向的代理变量，进行回归分析，并执行多项识别检验以支持因果关系推断。
AI.findings: 1) 座位距离越近，参议员在相同行业交易股票的概率越高，收益越大；2) 同政党效应更强；3) 效应受参议员信息来源、权力大小和受审查程度调节；4) 信息共享带来职业利益。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次量化了物理接近性在政治内幕信息共享中的作用，拓展了社会网络与信息交易的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融监管机构监控内幕交易提供了新的视角（物理距离作为风险信号），揭示了政治职位可能带来的非正当交易优势。

title: Oligopolistic Power in Music Streaming Platforms
affiliations: , Connetquot High School and Connetquot High School

detail.title: Oligopolistic Power in Music Streaming Platforms
detail.abstract: Music streaming platforms operate as digital oligopolies whose competitive advantages arise from ecosystem control, behavioral data accumulation, and algorithmic curation rather than price differentiation. Using market share data from 2019-2024, subscription pricing records, and artist revenue distributions, we show that the top four platforms-Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, and YouTube Music-have maintained a stable combined market share of roughly 68% despite near-identical pricing. To quantify the economic impact of platform-controlled curation, we estimate a log-log regression using Spotify track-level data (N = 953). A 1% increase in playlist count is associated with a 0.664% increase in total streams, holding chart appearances constant (R² = 0.691). Because playlist placement is determined by the platforms, algorithmic curation functions as an income distribution mechanism with measurable consequences for artist earnings and market access. We discuss implications for antitrust enforcement, algorithm transparency, and royalty reform, arguing that traditional price-based competition frameworks fail to capture the structural sources of market power in digital platform industries.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了数字音乐流媒体平台作为数字寡头，其竞争优势源于生态系统控制、行为数据积累和算法策展，而非价格差异化。通过量化分析，发现播放列表数量对播放量有显著正向影响，且平台控制的算法策展实质上是收入分配机制，对艺术家收入和市场准入产生重要影响。
AI.research_question: 数字音乐流媒体平台的市场权力来源是什么？平台控制的算法策展如何影响艺术家收入和市场准入？
AI.motivation: 传统基于价格竞争的框架无法捕捉数字平台行业市场权力的结构性来源，需要新的分析视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字寡头理论、平台生态控制理论、算法策展作为收入分配机制的理论
AI.method: 使用2019-2024年市场份额数据、订阅定价记录和艺术家收入分配数据；对Spotify曲目级数据（N=953）进行对数-对数回归分析。
AI.findings: 前四大平台（Spotify、Apple Music、Amazon Music、YouTube Music）尽管定价几乎相同，但合计市场份额稳定在约68%；播放列表数量每增加1%，总播放量增加0.664%（R²=0.691）。
AI.theory_contributions: 指出算法策展是一种具有可量化经济后果的收入分配机制；挑战了传统价格竞争框架对市场权力的理解；为数字平台行业的反垄断和监管提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 对反垄断执法、算法透明度和版税改革提出了具体政策启示；揭示了平台控制算法策展对艺术家收入和市场准入的实际影响。

title: Identifying Benchmark Demand in Corporate Bond Markets
affiliations: Copenhagen Business School, BI Norwegian Business School and BI Norwegian Business School

detail.title: Identifying Benchmark Demand in Corporate Bond Markets
detail.abstract: We introduce Benchmark Trading Intensity (BTI), a transaction-based measure to identify the corporate bonds that absorb benchmark demand. The measure exploits trading activity around benchmark pricing windows. Using an unexpected increase in the minimum bond size required for inclusion in the Bloomberg U.S. Corporate Bond Index, we find that excluded bonds experience a permanent yield increase of about 8 basis points upon announcement and a further temporary 4-5 basis points increase around implementation. These effects are concentrated among high-BTI bonds, which also experience larger declines in passive ownership following implementation. The larger announcement effect suggests that studies based on predictable benchmark events may substantially understate the full price effects of benchmark demand.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基准交易强度（BTI）指标，用于识别吸收基准需求的公司债券。利用彭博美国公司债券指数最低债券规模的意外上调，发现被排除债券在公告后收益率永久性上升约8个基点，实施期间再临时上升4-5个基点。这些效应集中在高BTI债券上，且其实施后被动持仓下降更明显。更大的公告效应表明，基于可预测基准事件的研究可能显著低估基准需求的完整价格效应。
AI.research_question: 如何识别并衡量公司债券市场中基准需求对债券价格的影响？具体而言，基准需求在债券收益率中产生了多大的价格效应？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多依赖可预测的基准指数构成变化来估计基准需求效应，但这些方法可能低估了真实的价格影响。本文旨在开发一种基于交易行为的度量指标（BTI），以更准确地捕捉基准需求对债券价格的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产定价中的需求曲线向下倾斜理论以及被动投资与指数效应文献，认为基准需求（如指数基金和ETF的配置需求）会对债券价格产生显著影响。
AI.method: （1）构建基准交易强度（BTI）指标，利用基准定价窗口期间的交易活动来识别吸收基准需求的债券；（2）利用彭博美国公司债券指数最小债券规模意外上调这一准自然实验，采用事件研究法分析被排除债券的收益率变化；（3）对比高BTI与低BTI债券的异质性效应。
AI.findings: （1）被排除债券在公告后收益率永久性上升约8个基点；（2）在实施期间收益率进一步临时上升4-5个基点；（3）效应集中在高BTI债券上；（4）高BTI债券在实施后被动机构持仓下降更大；（5）公告效应大于实施效应，表明基于可预测事件的研究会低估基准需求的价格效应。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出了BTI这一新的度量指标，为识别和量化基准需求对债券价格的影响提供了更精确的工具；（2）揭示了基于可预测指数事件的研究会系统性低估基准需求的价格效应，修正了现有文献的理解；（3）为需求曲线向下倾斜理论在公司债券市场提供了新的证据。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为投资者和资产管理公司提供了评估基准需求对债券价格影响的新工具；（2）对指数编制机构和监管机构如何调整指数构成规则具有政策启示；（3）帮助市场参与者更好地理解被动投资对债券市场的价格影响机制。

title: Comparative Rational Pharmacokinetic Modeling for Therapeutic Window Adjustment: A Computational--Analytical Framework Integrating College Algebra, Applied Calculus, and Model Selection Theory
affiliations: Keiser University, Keiser University and

detail.title: Comparative Rational Pharmacokinetic Modeling for Therapeutic Window Adjustment: A Computational--Analytical Framework Integrating College Algebra, Applied Calculus, and Model Selection Theory

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study used synthetic data with no human or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study uses synthetic pharmacokinetic data for educational modeling and does not involve human subjects, interventions, or clinical outcomes.

detail.abstract:
Pharmacokinetic (PK) modeling plays a central role in individualized pharmacotherapy; however, its mathematical foundations are rarely taught through sustained engagement with authentic modeling practices. This study presents a reproducible educational--computational framework designed to promote model-based reasoning, quantitative literacy, and evidence-informed model selection through analytically tractable pharmacokinetic representations. Four candidate time--concentration models—linear, quadratic, exponential, and rational—are systematically compared using simulated datasets representing a healthy subject and a patient with renal insufficiency. The data are generated from the rational model $C(t)=\dfrac{at}{bt^2+1}$ with $a=4$ and $b=1$ (healthy) or $b=0.25$ (renal), allowing transparent evaluation of model recovery, parameter interpretation, and peak behavior.

Nonlinear least-squares estimation (Levenberg--Marquardt) demonstrates that the rational model recovers the generating parameters within numerical precision for noiseless data, whereas alternative models fail to capture either the peak or the asymptotic decay. Model comparison using MSE, AIC, BIC, Akaike weights, and residual diagnostics overwhelmingly favors the rational formulation. Closed-form derivative analysis yields exact expressions for peak time and peak concentration, $t_{\max}=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{b}}$ and $C_{\max}=\dfrac{a}{2\sqrt{b}}$, enabling direct connections between mathematical structure and pharmacokinetic interpretation. A reduction of $b$ from 1 to 0.25, representing impaired elimination, produces a 100\% increase in peak concentration and a 100\% prolongation of peak time.

A Padé-like approximation links the rational model to the classical Bateman function, situating the framework within established pharmacokinetic theory. An extension incorporating synthetic measurement noise illustrates robustness, uncertainty, and the limits of inference under data imperfection. All code, data, and diagnostics are provided in accordance with open-science and FAIR principles. The framework is explicitly intended for educational and exploratory purposes, not for clinical decision-making, and is positioned as a transferable model-based literacy environment for STEM and pharmacokinetics education.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可复现的教育-计算框架，通过解析可处理的药代动力学模型（线性、二次、指数、有理函数）培养学生的模型推理和定量素养。使用有理模型生成模拟数据，通过非线性最小二乘估计和模型比较，证明有理模型在参数恢复和峰值捕捉上优于其他模型，并通过闭环导数分析推导出峰值时间和浓度的精确表达式。
AI.research_question: 如何通过可复现的计算教育框架，促进学生基于模型的推理能力、定量素养和基于证据的模型选择能力？
AI.motivation: 药代动力学建模在个体化药物治疗中至关重要，但其数学基础很少通过真实的建模实践来教授。现有教学缺乏让学生持续参与建模过程的机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有理函数模型（Padé-like近似）、经典Bateman函数、非线性最小二乘估计（Levenberg-Marquardt算法）、信息准则模型比较（MSE、AIC、BIC、Akaike权重）
AI.method: 1. 使用有理模型 C(t)=at/(bt²+1) 生成模拟数据（健康受试者b=1，肾功能不全患者b=0.25）；2. 比较线性、二次、指数、有理四种候选模型；3. 使用Levenberg-Marquardt算法进行非线性最小二乘估计；4. 通过MSE、AIC、BIC、Akaike权重和残差诊断进行模型比较；5. 闭环导数分析推导峰值时间和峰值浓度；6. 添加合成测量噪声检验鲁棒性。
AI.findings: 1. 有理模型在无噪声数据下能以数值精度恢复生成参数，而其他模型无法捕捉峰值或渐近衰减；2. 模型比较指标 overwhelmingly 支持有理模型；3. 推导出 t_max=1/√b 和 C_max=a/(2√b) 的精确表达式；4. 肾功能不全（b从1降到0.25）导致峰值浓度增加100%，达峰时间延长100%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 通过Padé-like近似将有理模型与经典Bateman函数联系起来，架起了教学框架与经典药代动力学理论之间的桥梁；2. 提供了从模型结构到药代动力学解释的直接数学连接。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一个完全可复现、符合FAIR原则和开放科学原则的教育框架；2. 所有代码、数据和诊断均公开可用，可作为STEM和药代动力学教育中可迁移的模型素养环境；3. 通过噪声扩展展示了数据不完美情况下的鲁棒性和推断局限性。

title: How Does Monetary Policy Affect the Space Economy?
affiliations: University of Naples Parthenope, University of Naples Parthenope, University of Naples Parthenope, University of Naples Parthenope and

detail.title: How Does Monetary Policy Affect the Space Economy?
detail.abstract: The space economy is becoming increasingly relevant for macroeconomic growth and technological spillovers, yet its interaction with monetary policy remains largely unexplored. This paper studies how restrictive monetary policy affects aggregate and aerospace-sector dynamics in a two-sector DSGE model. We compare a standard Taylor rule with a space-augmented rule that incorporates space-sector innovation productivity as a supply-side signal for potential spillover effects. Monetary tightening reduces aggregate activity and aerospace output, while the augmented rule makes the policy response more front-loaded and amplifies short-run effects. Thus, accounting for space-sector innovation can reshape monetary transmission as space activities gain macroeconomic relevance.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了包含太空部门的两部门DSGE模型，研究紧缩性货币政策如何影响宏观经济与航天部门动态，并比较了标准泰勒规则与纳入太空创新生产力的扩展规则。扩展规则使政策响应更前置、短期效应更强，表明太空创新可重塑货币政策传导机制。
AI.research_question: 紧缩性货币政策如何影响宏观经济与航天部门？纳入太空部门创新生产力的扩展泰勒规则会如何改变货币政策传导机制？
AI.motivation: 太空经济对宏观增长和技术溢出日益重要，但其与货币政策的相互作用仍几乎未被探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两部门动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型，标准泰勒规则 vs. 太空扩展泰勒规则（纳入太空部门创新生产率作为供给端信号以捕捉潜在溢出效应）。
AI.method: 构建两部门DSGE模型进行数值模拟与比较分析。
AI.findings: 1) 货币紧缩降低总体经济活动与航天产出；2) 太空扩展规则使政策响应更前置（front-loaded），放大短期效应；3) 考虑太空部门创新可重塑货币政策传导。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将太空部门纳入货币政策分析框架，揭示太空创新对货币传导机制的调节作用，拓展了DSGE模型在新兴经济部门的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行在制定货币政策时考虑太空经济的技术溢出效应提供理论依据与政策模拟工具，建议在太空经济日益重要的背景下调整政策规则设计。

title: Portfolio Allocation using Echo State Networks

detail.title: Portfolio Allocation using Echo State Networks

declarations.funderStatement: Funding was provided by the North West Social Science Doctoral Training Partnership (NWSSDTP), part of the Economic Social and Research Council (ESRC).

detail.abstract: This paper applies the state-of-the-art Echo State Network (ESN) to forecast and improve global minimum variance portfolio (GMVP) allocations. A restricted penalized framework is proposed, which adapts the ESN for portfolio optimization, regularizing $\Delta w_{T+1}$ turnover and satisfying the budget constraint. Simulations and empirical analysis for K = 2 to K = 90 assets using intraday data of S&P 500 constituents benchmark the ESN against plug-in and direct weight approaches, including the dynamic conditional weight (DCW) estimators of Cipollini et al. (2021). DCW-type models dominate in minimizing portfolio risk and turnover, while the ESN consistently ranks second in lower dimensions with K ≤ 10, but is additionally outperformed by HAR with dynamic correlations (HAR-D) for K ≥ 40. However, the ESN delivers practically relevant advantages of direct relevance to institutional portfolio managers, including least concentrated and short-exposed allocations, robust performance under reduced sample sizes, and turnover that declines as the estimation window is shortened.

AI.tldr: 本文利用回声状态网络（ESN）预测并优化全局最小方差组合（GMVP），提出带约束的惩罚框架以控制换手率并满足预算约束。基于S&P 500成分股日内数据，在K=2到K=90资产维度下，与DCW等基准方法对比发现：DCW类模型在最小化风险与换手率上最优，ESN在低维（K≤10）中排名第二，但在高维（K≥40）中被HAR-D超越。ESN的实践优势包括：集中度最低、空头暴露最少、小样本下稳健、短窗口下换手率下降。
AI.research_question: 如何将回声状态网络（ESN）应用于全局最小方差组合（GMVP）的预测与优化，及其与传统方法（如DCW、HAR-D）相比表现如何？
AI.motivation: 现有GMVP优化方法在高维、小样本及动态环境下存在局限性，需要更高效的机器学习方法来提升组合预测与优化表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 回声状态网络（ESN）、全局最小方差组合（GMVP）、动态条件权重（DCW）估计量、HAR模型、带惩罚的约束优化框架。
AI.method: 提出带惩罚的回声状态网络框架，约束Δw_{T+1}换手率并满足预算约束；通过模拟和实证分析（S&P 500成分股日内数据，K=2至90）与plug-in、直接权重方法及DCW、HAR-D等基准对比。
AI.findings: DCW类模型在风险最小化与换手率控制上最优；ESN在低维（K≤10）中排名第二；在高维（K≥40）中被HAR-D超越；ESN具有最低集中度、最少空头暴露、小样本稳健性及短窗口下换手率下降的实践优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将ESN应用于GMVP优化，提出适应组合优化的约束惩罚框架，拓展了机器学习在资产组合优化中的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资管理者提供了低集中度、低空头暴露且在小样本与短窗口下表现稳健的组合优化工具，具有直接实践价值。

title: Execution-Boundary Governance: A Runtime Control Model for Autonomous Systems

detail.title: Execution-Boundary Governance: A Runtime Control Model for Autonomous Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships that influenced this research. This is an independent, unfunded working paper.

detail.abstract: Current AI governance frameworks focus on policy, oversight, documentation, transparency, and post-execution accountability. As autonomous systems gain the ability to execute transactions, invoke tools, modify records, move funds, and trigger physical actions, governance must operate within finite latency budgets. This paper proposes Execution-Boundary Governance (EBG), a framework that distinguishes interpretive governance from executable governance and introduces the Executable Governance Kernel (EGK)-a minimal, deterministic, tamper-resistant mechanism operating at the final control point preceding autonomous action.

AI.tldr: 本文提出执行边界治理（EBG）框架，将治理分为解释性治理与可执行治理，并引入可执行治理内核（EGK）——在自主行动最终控制点运行的极小、确定性、防篡改机制，以解决自治系统在有限延迟预算内的实时治理问题。
AI.research_question: 自治系统如何在有限延迟预算内实现有效的实时治理？
AI.motivation: 现行AI治理框架关注政策、监督、文档、透明度及事后问责，但无法满足自治系统在实时执行交易、调用工具、修改记录、转移资金及触发物理行动时的低延迟治理需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 执行边界治理（EBG）框架；解释性治理与可执行治理的区分；可执行治理内核（EGK）
AI.method: 概念框架设计与机制构建
AI.findings: 提出在自主行动最终控制点部署EGK，作为极小、确定性、防篡改的治理机制，有望在有限延迟预算内实现可执行治理。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了解释性治理与可执行治理，提出了执行边界治理的新理论框架；将治理从政策层面下沉到执行层面，拓展了AI治理的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为自治系统的实时治理提供了可操作的架构方案；EGK机制可应用于金融交易、物理行动触发等高实时性场景。

title: Real-Time Money Laundering Detection for Blockchains and Financial Networks

detail.title: Real-Time Money Laundering Detection for Blockchains and Financial Networks
detail.abstract: This research introduces a technique to rapidly classify wallets based on their structural role in blockchain fund-flow networks. Using unsupervised learning in the Markov chain setting, the proposed methodology computes near-real-time steady-state probabilities identifying likely terminal recipients of funds. We validate the methodology via a contrastive design: validator wallets, which occupy structurally prominent positions in the Ethereum network, are assigned statistically higher terminal-state probabilities than a matched sample of randomly selected active wallets (KS statistic D = [•], p < 0.001), consistent with their role as high-connectivity intermediaries in fund flows. Among the highest-probability terminal wallets identified, several are independently associated with documented network irregularities on Ethereum.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于无监督学习的马尔可夫链方法，用于快速分类区块链资金流网络中的钱包结构角色，通过计算近实时的稳态概率识别可能的最终资金接收者，并通过对以太坊验证者钱包的对比验证展示了方法的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何快速且有效地基于钱包在区块链资金流网络中的结构角色对其进行分类？
AI.motivation: 区块链交易网络日益复杂，传统方法难以实时识别资金流动中的关键节点（如最终收款方、异常行为者），亟需一种高效的计算方法来实现钱包的结构性分类。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马尔可夫链、无监督学习、稳态概率、图论与网络分析
AI.method: 采用无监督学习框架，在马尔可夫链设定下计算钱包的近实时稳态概率，用以衡量其成为最终资金接收者的可能性；通过对比验证者钱包与随机活跃钱包的稳态概率分布差异（KS检验）进行方法验证。
AI.findings: 验证者钱包（以太坊网络中结构位置突出的钱包）的终端状态概率显著高于匹配的随机活跃钱包样本；最高终端概率钱包中有多个与以太坊上已知的网络异常事件独立相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将马尔可夫链稳态概率与区块链资金流网络的结构角色分析相结合，提出了一种新的无监督分类框架，拓展了网络分析在区块链金融中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种近实时的钱包分类工具，可用于区块链反洗钱、资金追踪、异常交易识别以及监管合规等实际场景。

title: Forecasting: Returns or Prices?
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Forecasting: Returns or Prices?
detail.abstract: This paper validates the Expectations hypothesis for the stock market using Futures data. It explains that price forecasts are reasonably accurate but returns forecasts are not because prices are level variables whereas returns are ratios and an economic relationship that might exist between levels may not extend to their ratios. This drawback is somewhat resolved by considering average returns since these incorporate the economic relationship between the levels into its ratios by considering multiple past prices. Further, that forecasted average returns generate higher profits for daily and weekly frequencies than forecasted plain or traditional returns.

AI.tldr: 本文利用期货数据验证股票市场的预期假说，发现价格预测准确但收益率预测不准。原因是价格是水平变量而收益率是比率，水平变量间的经济关系不一定适用于比率。通过考虑平均收益率（纳入多个历史价格的水平关系）部分解决了这一问题，且预测的平均收益率在日度和周度频率上比传统收益率预测能产生更高利润。
AI.research_question: 如何利用期货数据验证股票市场的预期假说，以及为什么价格预测准确而收益率预测不准确？平均收益率能否改善预测效果？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对预期假说的验证存在矛盾，价格预测与收益率预测表现不一致，需要解释这一现象并寻找改进方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预期假说（Expectations hypothesis）；水平变量与比率变量的经济关系差异理论。
AI.method: 利用期货数据进行实证分析，比较价格预测、传统收益率预测与平均收益率预测的准确性，并在不同频率（日度、周度）下检验预测的盈利能力。
AI.findings: 价格预测较为准确但收益率预测不准；原因是价格是水平变量而收益率是比率，水平变量间的经济关系不一定适用于比率；平均收益率通过纳入多个历史价格的信息部分解决了这一问题；预测的平均收益率在日度和周度频率上比传统收益率预测带来更高利润。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了预期假说中价格预测与收益率预测表现不一致的深层原因（水平变量与比率变量的差异），并提出了使用平均收益率作为改进方案的理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了更有效的收益率预测方法——使用平均收益率进行预测，尤其是在日度和周度频率上能获得更高交易利润。

title: International Evidence on Interest Rate Volatility Investment Strategies
affiliations: and Hokkaido University

detail.title: International Evidence on Interest Rate Volatility Investment Strategies

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by Japan Society for the Promotion of Science KAKENHI Grant Number 26K0035616.

detail.abstract: This study examines interest rate volatility long-short strategies across major markets and investigates jump and volatility risks as sources of returns. We construct swaption straddle portfolios exploiting the implied volatility term structure and analyze their performance in the U.S., European, U.K., and Japanese bond markets. We find that equal-weight and delta-vega neutral strategies exhibit high investment efficiency across regions, indicating that compensation for jump risk is a key driver of returns. A combination of regional portfolios significantly improves performance, highlighting the benefits of international diversification. In addition, we propose a rho-hedging approach that allows us to capture uncontaminated volatility risk exposure. Rho-hedged volatility strategies display little correlation with yield curve factors but are significantly related to macroeconomic and financial uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文研究跨市场利率波动率多空策略，发现跳跃风险补偿是回报的关键驱动因素，并提出了rho对冲方法来捕捉未被污染的波动率风险暴露。
AI.research_question: 利率波动率多空策略的回报来源是什么？跳跃风险和波动率风险如何驱动这些策略的收益？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对利率波动率策略的回报来源（尤其是跳跃风险与波动率风险的区分）尚不清晰，且缺乏跨市场的国际比较研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 隐含波动率期限结构理论、跳跃风险溢价理论、波动率风险溢价理论、国际分散化理论
AI.method: 构建跨市场掉期期权跨式组合（swaption straddle portfolios），利用隐含波动率期限结构，采用等权重和delta-vega中性策略，并提出rho对冲方法分离波动率风险暴露。
AI.findings: 1) 等权重和delta-vega中性策略在美、欧、英、日四大市场均表现出高投资效率；2) 跳跃风险补偿是策略回报的关键驱动因素；3) 跨区域组合显著提升绩效，体现国际分散化好处；4) rho对冲后的波动率策略与收益率曲线因子相关性低，但与宏观经济和金融不确定性显著相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 区分了跳跃风险与波动率风险对利率波动率策略回报的贡献；2) 提出了rho对冲方法以分离纯净的波动率风险暴露；3) 将国际分散化理论拓展至利率波动率策略领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为投资者提供了跨市场利率波动率策略的设计框架；2) 验证了国际分散化在波动率策略中的实际收益；3) 提出了rho对冲方法帮助投资者管理利率波动率风险暴露。

title: When the Tax Outlives the Income: Life-Course Liquidity Stress and Deferral in China's Property-Tax Debate

detail.title: When the Tax Outlives the Income: Life-Course Liquidity Stress and Deferral in China's Property-Tax Debate
detail.abstract: China is preparing to tax a housing stock that is most household wealth yet illiquid and weakly tied to income. Using the China Household Finance Survey, we simulate the first-round incidence of a recurrent residential property tax, evaluating designs not by progressivity but by a liquidity criterion: whether households can pay without distress. The primary-residence exemption favored in debate removes three-quarters of the base, whereas an income circuitbreaker raises more revenue while eliminating severe income stress, robust to housing-price haircuts up to 23 percent. Panel evidence shows liquidity stress is persistent and more prevalent at older ages. Even a combined circuit-breaker-and-deferral design leaves a pre-elderly gap: liquid-thin owners aged 45-64 below the 65-and-older deferral threshold, miscalibrated for China's lower, gender-specific retirement ages. We frame relief eligibility as a ladder of progressively more precise but more demanding proxies for taxpaying capacity: age, pension status, and liquidity.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国家庭金融调查数据，模拟了住宅房产税的首次征收效应，发现按流动性标准（而非累进性）评估，免征首套房会减少75%的税基，而收入断路器设计既能增加收入又能消除严重流动性压力，但现有方案对45-64岁流动性不足的房主存在保障缺口。
AI.research_question: 中国若开征经常性住宅房产税，如何设计才能在不给家庭造成流动性困境的前提下有效实施？
AI.motivation: 中国的住房资产是多数家庭最大但流动性差的财富，与收入关联弱。政策讨论中常关注累进性，但忽视了家庭能否在不陷入财务困境的情况下缴税这一流动性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收首次负担理论、流动性约束理论、生命周期理论
AI.method: 使用中国家庭金融调查（CHFS）数据进行微观模拟分析，评估不同房产税设计方案的首次征收效应，并利用面板数据检验流动性压力的持续性。
AI.findings: 1) 免征首套房方案会剔除75%的税基；2) 收入断路器方案能增加收入且消除严重流动性压力，对房价下跌23%以内的冲击具有稳健性；3) 流动性压力在老年群体中更普遍且具有持续性；4) 现有的"断路器+递延"组合方案对45-64岁流动性不足的房主存在保障缺口，因中国退休年龄偏低且具有性别差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 将流动性约束视角引入房产税设计评估，超越传统的累进性讨论，提出基于纳税能力代理变量（年龄、养老金状态、流动性）的递进式救济资格框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国的房产税政策设计提供了具体建议，指出当前首套房豁免方案的不足，推荐收入断路器方案，并建议针对中国退休年龄特点调整递延纳税的适用门槛。

title: Private Ceilings and Public Floors: A Typology of High-Income Economies

detail.title: Private Ceilings and Public Floors: A Typology of High-Income Economies
detail.abstract: High-income democracies are routinely ranked by output, competitiveness, or composite wellbeing scores. I argue, however, that the central problem with such rankings is not measurement but hidden commensuration: each ranking translates distinct distributional features of an economy into a single aggregate score, which can be done only by making an implicit value choice in how its components are weighted. I show that two of those components, private advantage and public protection, are close to statistically independent, so that the weighting choice, not the data, determines the ranking result. Therefore, I propose a typology that separates three distinct features of the socioeconomic environment. First, the private ceiling is household income near the top of the distribution, which depends on market position. Second, the public floor is the protection institutions provide independently of market position. Third, the risk constraint is an exposure, such as lethal violence, that I keep separate, so that its weight against the other goods stays an open choice. I use OECD and World Bank indicators for twenty-nine democracies and measure the ceiling with the 90th percentile of disposable income, the floor with equality, low poverty, social spending and longevity, and risk with intentional homicide. I show that the macroeconomic-outcome measures, national output and the affluent private ceiling, do not co-move with the public floor. The United States holds the highest ceiling yet one of the weakest public floors and a distinctive lethal-risk profile, and its nearest neighbours are not the other Anglophone economies but the Baltic states, while Belgium, Norway, Austria and the Nordic economies sustain high public floors on more modest ceilings. The contribution is conceptual and descriptive. I argue that there is no neutral weighting, and hence no neutral ranking, of high-income democracies. The ceiling-floor-risk framework does not resolve the normative choice such a ranking conceals; it exposes it, and shows what each economy distributes: who can buy advantage, what everyone can rely on, and which risks remain.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，对高收入民主国家的排名问题不在于测量本身，而在于隐含的“通约化”——将不同的分配特征加总为一个分数时必须做出价值选择。作者发现私人优势与公共保护两个维度在统计上几乎独立，因此权重选择决定了排名结果。为此提出“上限-下限-风险”三分框架，并展示了各国在这些维度上的不同组合。
AI.research_question: 高收入民主国家在社会经济表现排名中，如何解决因隐含通约化（commensuration）导致的权重选择偏见？能否通过分离私人优势、公共保护和风险暴露三个维度来更真实地呈现各国差异？
AI.motivation: 现有排名（如产出、竞争力、综合福利）看似客观，实则将不同维度的分配特征强制加总为一个分数，必须依赖隐含的权重判断。作者发现私人优势（private advantage）与公共保护（public protection）在统计上几乎独立，意味着权重选择而非数据本身决定了排名结果，因此需要一个新的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 隐藏通约化（hidden commensuration）：将不同维度的特征加总为单一分数必须做出价值权重选择；私人优势 vs. 公共保护的统计独立性；上限-下限-风险三分框架（ceiling-floor-risk framework）。
AI.method: 使用OECD和世界银行数据，涵盖29个高收入民主国家。用可支配收入的第90百分位数衡量私人上限（ceiling），用平等、低贫困率、社会支出和预期寿命衡量公共下限（floor），用故意杀人率衡量风险暴露（risk constraint）。进行描述性统计和跨国家比较。
AI.findings: 宏观经济产出和私人上限与公共下限并不共动（co-move）。美国拥有最高的私人上限，但公共下限极弱，且独特的致命风险特征，其最近邻不是其他英语国家，而是波罗的海国家。比利时、挪威、奥地利和北欧国家在更适中的私人上限基础上维持了高公共下限。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了排名中“隐藏通约化”的问题，证明私人优势与公共保护在统计上独立，因此任何加权排名都不是中立的。提出“上限-下限-风险”三分框架，替代传统的单一排名逻辑，将价值选择暴露出来而非掩盖。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和公众提供了一种更透明的比较各国社会经济表现的方式，避免被看似客观的单一排名误导。展示了不同国家的真实分配特征：谁可以购买优势、每个人可以依赖什么、以及哪些风险仍然存在。

title: The Language of Polarization: Hate Trumps Cooperation and Generosity Across Political Lines
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania

detail.title: The Language of Polarization: Hate Trumps Cooperation and Generosity Across Political Lines
detail.abstract: Is polarized political language mostly “cheap talk,” or does it reveal who will discriminate against political opponents? Across 15 experiments (N ≈ 8,600), participants evaluated a polarizing political figure (Donald Trump or Joe Biden) or a non-political topic, explained their rating in their own words, and then made incentivized allocation and cooperation decisions with a partner whose political identity was revealed. I find that this pre-interaction language predicts who discriminates and through which channel they do so. Where one’s decision is strategic and the outcome depends on the partner, hostile writing predicts lower contributions, and the gap runs through pessimistic beliefs about that partner (statistical discrimination). Where one’s decision is non-strategic and one’s own choice alone determines the outcome, conviction in the writing predicts taking more from the other side, an exploratory pattern driven by preferences rather than beliefs (taste-based discrimination). Hostility and conviction are largely orthogonal. Both patterns are target-specific and disappear for non-political topics. Of two behavioral interventions tested to reduce polarization, a default reduces discrimination among the most hostile writers only, while a norm nudge shows no significant effect. From a policy perspective, decomposing political language helps identify whom to target and with what kind of intervention.

AI.tldr: 通过15个实验（N≈8600）发现，极化政治语言（敌意 vs 信念强度）能区分不同类型的政治歧视：敌意语言预测统计性歧视（基于悲观信念），信念强度预测偏好性歧视（基于个人偏好）。两种维度正交且具有目标特异性。默认设置仅减少最敌意者的歧视，规范助推无效。
AI.research_question: 极化政治语言是否不仅仅是“空谈”，而是能够揭示谁会歧视政治对手，以及通过何种渠道（统计性歧视 vs 偏好性歧视）进行歧视？
AI.motivation: 现实中政治极化日益严重，但人们谈论政治的语言究竟是“廉价谈话”还是真实歧视行为的信号，尚不明确。研究者希望从语言中区分不同类型的歧视机制，并为政策干预提供精准靶向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统计性歧视理论（基于信念的歧视）与偏好性歧视理论（基于偏好的歧视）的区分；语言分析中的敌意与信念强度两个正交维度。
AI.method: 15个实验（N≈8600），参与者先评价极化政治人物（特朗普或拜登）或非政治话题，用自由文本解释评分，然后进行激励性的资源分配与合作决策（搭档的政治身份已知）。同时测试了两种行为干预（默认设置 vs 规范助推）。
AI.findings: 1）敌意语言预测统计性歧视：在策略性决策中（结果依赖搭档），敌意写作预测更低贡献，通过悲观信念（关于搭档）中介。2）信念强度预测偏好性歧视：在非策略性决策中（结果仅由自己决定），写作中的信念强度预测从对方群体索取更多，由偏好驱动。3）敌意与信念强度基本正交。4）两种模式具有目标特异性，非政治话题上消失。5）默认设置仅减少最敌意者的歧视，规范助推无显著效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 将政治语言分解为敌意与信念强度两个正交维度，分别对应统计性歧视与偏好性歧视两种不同机制，为极化研究提供了更精细的语言-行为链接理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）表明通过分析政治语言可以识别谁可能歧视以及通过何种渠道歧视，为政策干预的精准靶向提供了依据。2）测试了两种干预措施的效果：默认设置对最敌意者有效，规范助推无效，提示需要针对不同语言特征设计差异化干预策略。

title: Two Margins of Verification Design: Functional Form, Audience Separation, and the Limits of Coherence in Disclosure Regulation

detail.title: Two Margins of Verification Design: Functional Form, Audience Separation, and the Limits of Coherence in Disclosure Regulation
detail.abstract: Two prudential instincts-replacing Value-at-Risk with Expected Shortfall in bank capital, and mandating explainability for algorithmic decision systems-are each sound at their origin, and each engages only one of two margins along which verification must be designed once the regulated party shapes what its verifier sees. This paper assembles two results from companion work into a single design principle for such settings. First, verification of a disclosure cannot be gamed if and only if the verifier's read is convex in the regulated party's beliefs; coherence delivers this convexity for a verifier reading a floor the party wants low, as a court reads an auditor's established diligence, but reverses it for a verifier reading a loss the party wants read low, as a prudential regulator reads tail loss-where the coherent Expected Shortfall is itself gamed by disclosure design and the move from Value-at-Risk buys nothing, both measures conditioning on an endogenous quantile. The gaming-proof read in that direction is not a coherent tail measure but a worst expected penalty over a fixed family of scenarios, or a fixed-threshold charge. Second, when the party serves two audiences whose information can be separated only behind an imperfect seal, the deterrence cost of an explainability mandate falls almost entirely on the audience to which it is routed: a mandate directed at the verifier reproduces the deterrence-liability tension far more gently than one directed at the market, and explainability and the commitment infrastructure that contains it are complementary instruments, not substitutes. Two design margins-the functional form of the read and the audience to which disclosure is routed-are therefore distinct and separately decisive: a read gamed on the first margin fails whatever its audience, and a mandate misrouted on the second destroys deterrence whatever its functional form. We map the principle to the Basel market-risk reform, to model-risk and explainability mandates for algorithmic audit, to the rating of structured credit, and to the jurisdiction-specific composition of the legal-enforcement regime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出算法决策系统验证的两大设计边界：验证函数的凸性（功能形式）和信息披露的受众分配。其中，用预期损失（Expected Shortfall）替代风险价值（VaR）作为银行资本要求指标，以及强制算法可解释性，这两个看似合理的做法，因忽视这两个边界而可能失效。
AI.research_question: 当被监管方能够塑造监管者所见信息时，应如何设计验证机制（verification）以避免被操纵？具体而言，验证的函数形式（functional form）和受众路由（audience routing）两个维度如何独立且决定性地影响验证的有效性？
AI.motivation: 两个直觉上合理的监管措施——用Expected Shortfall替代VaR作为银行资本要求，以及强制算法可解释性——各自只触及了验证设计的两个边界之一，而忽视了另一个。因此有必要将这两个结果整合为一个统一的设计原则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 凸性验证理论（convex verification）：验证者的读取函数（read）在被监管者信念上具有凸性时，才能防止被操纵。相干风险度量（coherent risk measure）在某一方向上提供凸性，但在另一方向上却失效。信息隔离与受众理论：当被监管方面向两个受众（如监管者和市场）时，信息披露的路由选择决定了威慑成本与责任的权衡。
AI.method: 理论建模：将两个已有的研究结果整合为统一设计原则，并通过多个实际场景（Basel市场风险改革、算法审计的可解释性要求、结构化信用评级、法律执行制度）进行映射和应用分析。
AI.findings: (1) 验证函数凸性是防止操纵的充要条件。Coherent Expected Shortfall在读取尾部损失时会被披露设计所操纵，从VaR转向ES无任何改善，因为两者都以内生分位数为条件。防操纵的读取不是相干尾部度量，而是固定情景族上的最坏期望损失或固定阈值收费。(2) 当被监管方面向两个受众时，可解释性要求的威慑成本几乎完全落在被定向的那个受众身上。针对验证者的可解释性要求比针对市场的要求更温和地再现了威慑-责任张力。可解释性与包含它的承诺基础设施是互补品而非替代品。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并统一了两个独立且决定性的设计边界：验证函数的函数形式（功能形式）和受众路由。指出相干风险度量（coherence）与防操纵性（gaming-proofness）之间的矛盾关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Basel市场风险改革中ES与VaR的选择提供了理论警示；为算法审计中的模型风险管理和可解释性要求提供了设计指引；为结构化信用评级监管和法律执行制度设计提供了分析框架。

reference: National Institute of Economic and Social Research Discussion Paper Series
title: Liberalisation and Financial Crises in the Postwar OECD
affiliations: National Institute of Economic and Social Research (NIESR), National Institute of Economic and Social Research, National Institute of Economic and Social Research and Brunel University London

detail.title: Liberalisation and Financial Crises in the Postwar OECD

publicationDetails.detailsText: National Institute of Economic and Social Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the causes of crises over the post war period in 14 OECD economies. We look first at the definition of crises and survey the literature on the links between credit growth and crises over the last 100 years or so. We then examine the determinants of financial crises in market economies, stressing the roles of bank capital, banking structure, property prices and current account deficits in the post Bretton Woods era. We look at the role of credit growth in crisis determination and note that it is present in the post Bretton Woods era. We argue that increases in capital ratios would systematically reduce the risk of crisis incidence in market economies over the next few years. We test for the interaction between capital and bank cash in the determination of crises, and the causality between house price growth and credit growth. A longer-term analysis of the post-war period is undertaken, and our core results on the importance of bank capital reserves are upheld.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了二战后14个OECD经济体金融危机的成因，强调银行资本、银行结构、房地产价格和经常账户赤字的作用，并论证提高资本充足率可系统性地降低危机发生风险。
AI.research_question: 二战后OECD经济体金融危机的决定因素是什么？银行资本储备在危机防范中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 金融危机对经济造成巨大破坏，理解其成因对于预防未来危机至关重要。特别是后布雷顿森林体系时期，信贷扩张与危机之间的关系需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行资本理论、信贷周期理论、国际收支理论（经常账户赤字与危机的关系）
AI.method: 对14个OECD经济体二战后时期进行实证分析，检验银行资本与银行现金在危机决定中的交互作用，以及房价增长与信贷增长之间的因果关系。
AI.findings: 后布雷顿森林体系时期，信贷增长是危机的重要决定因素；提高资本充足率可系统性地降低危机发生风险；银行资本储备在危机防范中具有核心重要性；房价与信贷之间存在因果关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地将银行资本、银行结构、房地产价格和经常账户赤字纳入金融危机成因的统一分析框架；验证了信贷增长与危机之间的历史关联性在后布雷顿森林体系时期仍然成立。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了提高银行资本充足率以降低金融危机风险的政策依据；为银行监管和宏观审慎政策提供了实证支持。

title:
Artificial Intelligence and Competition Policy and Law Struggling Together In the Fragmented Global Economy: 
AI and Competition as the Penultimate Double-edged Sword
affiliations: Carleton University

detail.title:
Artificial Intelligence and Competition Policy and Law Struggling Together In the Fragmented Global Economy: 
AI and Competition as the Penultimate Double-edged Sword
detail.abstract:
This working paper (WP) applies a behaviorally informed, complexity science and chaos theory lens in order to better understand how artificial intelligence and competition policy and law are struggling together in the global economy that is increasingly complex, fragmented, interconnected and networked. Competition and other regulatory authorities, enterprises and more complex regulated entities, consumers, workers and other actors are all functioning under the fog of uncertainty, complexity, ambiguity and perplexity in AI/ML affected markets that rarely achieve equilibrium and the steady state. The WP has two major sections. 

Section two reviews the major sections and provisions of modern competition laws and the challenges faced by competition authorities when addressing and attempting to remedy AI driven competition and related issues and violations under each section. Section three is more AI-centric by focusing on competition, consumer, privacy, personal security, transnational, and other questions, issues and challenges, and the interactions between them, which are more integral and specific to, and are often generated and caused by, the many and diverse attributes, complexities and multifunctional properties of artificial intelligence.

Special attention in the third section is directed at the growing number of “AI and competition”
double-edged swords and continuums, whereby AI promotes fair competition and social values
at one end and undermines them at the other end, leading to complex and expanding “AI can do
everything middle-muddles” where hypocrisy and hypocrites reside. Emphasis is placed on the
distinctive attributes, complexities and double-edged sword aspects of larger and more
sophisticated and autonomous large language models (LLMs), GenAI, and Agentic and Identic AI
models, which are highly problematic for government authorities, non-state regulators, and
regulated entities and their compliance, ethics and corporate social responsibility (CSR) units.

One major theme is that all of the sections, provisions, principles, rules, tools, and investigation
and enforcement practices under modern competition and antitrust laws are relevant to, and
brought into play when, authorities are addressing and remedying AI-empowered competition law
violations. Laws and authorities with deceptive marketing provisions have an additional
advantage, in light of the expanding evidence that AI-generated consumer protection and privacy
violations such as deepfakes, dark patterns/violations of decisional privacy, misinformation,
malicious disinformation, and deceptions can become highly effective and harmful abuses of
dominance in AI/ML markets relevant to tipping-to-monopoly situations.

A second major theme is that transnational and global consensus on competition and AI and how
to address AI-empowered competition law violations is far from perfect and complete.
Nonetheless, competition law consensus is much more advanced than for non-competition laws,
regulations and regulators, while competition law enforcement is significantly impeded by the lack
of global and transnational consensus and progress on AI governance, rules, standards, and
regulations – the victim in part of the aggressive and fierce competition between the United States
and China for AI primacy and dominance.

The working paper concludes with a large bibliography, the consequence of the author’s
multidisciplinary approach and the rich and expanding AI and competition literature particularly
over the past three years.

AI.tldr: 本工作论文运用行为科学、复杂性科学与混沌理论视角，分析了在全球日益复杂、碎片化、互联互通的网络经济中，人工智能与竞争政策及法律之间的复杂互动关系。论文重点探讨了AI（尤其是大语言模型、生成式AI、代理型AI）在竞争法各条款下面临的挑战，以及AI带来的"双刃剑"效应——既促进公平竞争又可能破坏竞争。文章还指出，全球在AI治理上的共识不足（尤其是中美竞争）严重阻碍了竞争法的跨境执行。
AI.research_question: 在日益复杂、碎片化和网络化的全球经济中，人工智能与竞争政策及法律如何相互影响？竞争当局应如何应对AI驱动的竞争问题和违规行为？
AI.motivation: AI/ML影响下的市场很少达到均衡和稳态，各方（竞争监管机构、企业、消费者、工人等）都在不确定性、复杂性、模糊性和困惑的"迷雾"中运作，亟需从行为科学、复杂性科学和混沌理论的角度重新理解AI与竞争法的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为科学（behavioral science）、复杂性科学（complexity science）和混沌理论（chaos theory）
AI.method: 理论综述与文献分析，采用多学科视角整合现有AI与竞争法领域的文献
AI.findings: 1）现代竞争法的所有条款、原则、规则和执法工具都与AI驱动的竞争违规行为相关；2）拥有欺骗性营销条款的法律在处理AI生成的消费者保护与隐私违规（如深度伪造、暗黑模式、错误/恶意虚假信息）方面具有额外优势；3）AI存在"双刃剑"效应，在同一问题上既可能促进公平竞争又可能破坏竞争，导致复杂的"中间模糊地带"；4）全球在AI治理上的共识远不如竞争法共识成熟，中美在AI主导权上的激烈竞争严重阻碍了竞争法的跨境执行。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为科学、复杂性科学和混沌理论引入AI与竞争政策分析，提供了一个理解AI市场非均衡性和不确定性的新理论框架；提出了AI的"双刃剑"和"中间模糊地带"概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为竞争当局提供了应对AI驱动竞争违规行为的系统性分析框架，指出拥有欺骗性营销条款的法律在AI时代具有特殊优势，并揭示了全球AI治理共识缺失对竞争法执行的现实阻碍。

title: The Fixed-Point Operator Theory of Conscious Access: A Unified Mathematical Formalism and Empirical Protocol
affiliations: Universal Standard Axiom Corp

detail.title: The Fixed-Point Operator Theory of Conscious Access: A Unified Mathematical Formalism and Empirical Protocol
detail.abstract: We introduce the Fixed-Point Operator (FPO) Theory of Conscious Access, a unified mathematical formalism in which conscious content is characterized as the fixed point of a cognitive representation operator R. Formally, a mental state c is consciously accessed if and only if R(c) = c, where R : C → C maps internal neural representations to their globally broadcast, reportable encodings over a compact representation space C. We prove that under mild Banach-space contractivity conditions on R, conscious fixed points exist and are unique within attractor basins, providing the first existence-and-uniqueness theorem for conscious access derived from operator theory. We then demonstrate that four dominant theories of consciousness — Global Neuronal Workspace (GNW), Higher-Order Theory (HOT), Integrated Information Theory (IIT/Φ), and Predictive Processing (PP/FEP) — are recovered as special instantiations of R, unifying them within a single algebraic framework. A seven-step empirical protocol is derived directly from the fixed-point criterion, specifying measurable EEG/MEG/fMRI signatures that distinguish conscious from non-conscious states with perturbation-resistance as the key discriminating test. Pharmaceutical and clinical implications are identified for anesthetics, sedatives, and disorders of consciousness. The FPO framework resolves the operationalization problem in consciousness science by providing a computable, theory-neutral definition grounded in dynamical systems theory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出定点算子（FPO）意识通达理论，将意识内容形式化为认知表征算子R的不动点，并在巴拿赫空间压缩条件下证明了意识通达的存在唯一性定理。该框架统一了四种主流意识理论（GNW、HOT、IIT/Φ、PP/FEP），导出了可测量的EEG/MEG/fMRI实验方案，并提出了药物与临床启示。
AI.research_question: 如何为意识科学提供一个数学上可计算、理论上中立的操作性定义，以解决意识研究中的操作化难题？
AI.motivation: 意识科学长期缺乏一个统一的数学形式体系，不同理论之间难以直接比较和验证，且缺乏可操作、可计算的意识定义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不动点算子理论（Fixed-Point Operator Theory）、巴拿赫空间压缩映射原理、动力系统理论
AI.method: 数学形式化证明（存在性与唯一性定理）、理论统一化演绎（将GNW、HOT、IIT/Φ、PP/FEP纳入同一代数框架）、推导可实验检验的七步实证方案。
AI.findings: 1. 在压缩条件下，意识通达的不动点存在且唯一；2. 四种主流意识理论可视为R算子的特殊实例；3. 导出可测量的EEG/MEG/fMRI区分标记，扰动抵抗性是关键区分检验；4. 提出麻醉剂、镇静剂及意识障碍的药物与临床启示。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从算子理论推导出意识通达的存在唯一性定理，将四种主流意识理论统一在同一数学框架内，为意识科学提供了理论中立的操作性定义。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出可实验检验的七步实证方案和扰动抵抗性测试方法；为临床麻醉监测、镇静深度评估及意识障碍诊断提供理论基础。

title: Blockchain-Based "Decentralization": A Rorschach Test for Normative Priors regarding Competition
affiliations: American University - Washington College of Law

detail.title: Blockchain-Based "Decentralization": A Rorschach Test for Normative Priors regarding Competition
detail.abstract: In 2021, the Bank for International Settlements identified that blockchain-based finance was laboring under a “decentralisation illusion,” because of “the inescapable need for centralised governance and the tendency of blockchain consensus mechanisms to concentrate power.”  In other words, notwithstanding that blockchain is a decentralized technology, it cannot live up to its promoters’ promises that it will disperse economic control.  This Chapter surveys accumulated evidence that supports and underlines the importance of that conclusion.  This Chapter also argues that individuals’ continuing susceptibility to narratives about the decentralizing potential of blockchain technology reflects, at least to some degree, their normative priors about the degree to which concentration of economic power is acceptable.  In other words, blockchain-based finance can serve as a Rorschach test for attitudes towards the normative goal of “competition.”

AI.tldr: 本文指出区块链金融存在“去中心化幻觉”——尽管技术去中心化，但经济权力仍然集中，并论证人们对去中心化叙事的接受程度反映了其竞争价值观。
AI.research_question: 区块链技术是否真的能实现经济权力的去中心化？为什么人们仍相信区块链的去中心化承诺？
AI.motivation: 国际清算银行（BIS）在2021年提出“去中心化幻觉”概念，本文旨在系统梳理证据，深化这一结论，并探究个体持续相信去中心化叙事的原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 去中心化幻觉理论、集中治理的必然性、区块链共识机制中的权力集中倾向、规范先验理论、竞争价值观的投射测试。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论论证，基于已有证据的归纳分析。
AI.findings: 1) 区块链无法逃脱中心化治理的需要，共识机制倾向于集中权力；2) 个体对去中心化叙事的信任在一定程度上反映了他们对经济权力集中可接受程度的规范先验。
AI.theory_contributions: 将区块链去中心化争议从技术问题拓展至规范价值观层面，提出区块链作为“竞争”态度的罗夏测试。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示政策制定者和从业者不要被区块链的去中心化修辞迷惑，应正视区块链系统中经济权力集中的现实。

title: Education Inequality with Free Higher Education: Evidence from Iran
affiliations: and Tehran Institute for Advanced Studies

detail.title: Education Inequality with Free Higher Education: Evidence from Iran
detail.abstract: We examine why educational inequality persists even if universities are tuition-free. Using nationally representative microdata from Iran, we document steep income gradients in university entry-exam preparation and outcomes. We develop and estimate a model of college choice with tuition subsidy and endogenous exam preparation and college admission, separating the roles of finance and admission channels. Results show that free tuition only modestly changes the socioeconomic composition at selective universities because entry-level competition drives costly preparation; wealthier households secure top ranks and selective seats through better preparation. Counterfactuals suggest that targeted pre-college support is far more effective than universal tuition subsidies.

AI.tldr: 即使大学免学费，教育不平等依然存在，原因在于富裕家庭通过昂贵的备考投入在选拔性大学的入学竞争中占据优势。针对性的大学前支持比普遍学费补贴更有效。
AI.research_question: 为什么即使在免学费的大学体系中，教育不平等仍然持续存在？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对"财务约束"与"入学竞争机制"在解释教育不平等中的相对作用缺乏清晰的分离，本文试图区分这两个渠道。
AI.theoretical_framework: 大学选择模型，包含学费补贴、内生备考努力和大学录取机制。
AI.method: 利用伊朗全国代表性微观数据，构建并估计包含学费补贴、内生备考与大学录取的结构模型，进行反事实分析。
AI.findings: (1) 即使免学费，大学入学备考和结果仍存在陡峭的收入梯度；(2) 仅靠免学费政策对选拔性大学的社会经济构成改变有限；(3) 针对性的大学前支持比普遍学费补贴更有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 分离了"财务约束"与"入学竞争机制"两个渠道，揭示了即使消除学费障碍，备考成本驱动的竞争仍会导致不平等。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了明确启示：在免学费基础上，应配套针对弱势学生的大学前支持（如备考辅导、教育资源补充），而非仅依赖学费补贴。

title: Information Boundaries for Welfare Evaluation Under Unobserved Endogenous Product Quality: A Sufficient Statistics Approach
affiliations: Tohoku University - Graduate School of Information Sciences

detail.title: Information Boundaries for Welfare Evaluation Under Unobserved Endogenous Product Quality: A Sufficient Statistics Approach
detail.abstract: This study provides a model-free sufficient statistics framework to evaluate the expost welfare impact of economic shocks under unobserved endogenous product quality. Leaving quality unobserved causes three biases: distorted elasticity estimates, Spence's deadweight loss, and business-stealing externalities. We show that these are resolved by incorporating price elasticity under a fixed quality, demand curves before and after the shock, and total cost changes. Although demand and supply data are complementary overall, they resolve each bias independently. Thus, even partial data allows researchers to correct specific biases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个无需模型设定的充分统计量框架，用于评估在产品质量内生且不可观测的情况下，经济冲击的事后福利影响。研究发现，忽略质量变化会导致三种偏误：扭曲的弹性估计、斯彭斯无谓损失和商业窃取外部性。通过引入固定质量下的价格弹性、冲击前后的需求曲线以及总成本变化，可以解决这些偏误。尽管需求和供给数据总体上互补，但它们各自独立地解决每种偏误，因此即使部分数据也能帮助研究者纠正特定偏误。
AI.research_question: 在产品质量内生且不可观测的情况下，如何准确评估经济冲击的事后福利影响？
AI.motivation: 传统福利分析通常假设产品质量外生或可观测，但现实中产品质量往往是内生的且难以观测，这会导致福利评估偏误。本文旨在提出一个无需模型设定的框架来纠正这些偏误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 充分统计量框架（Sufficient Statistics Framework），结合价格弹性、需求曲线变化和总成本变化来修正福利评估偏误。
AI.method: 模型-free的充分统计量方法，通过分析需求与供给数据的不同组合来识别和纠正三种偏误。
AI.findings: 1) 忽略产品质量变化会导致三种偏误：弹性估计偏误、斯彭斯无谓损失和商业窃取外部性；2) 固定质量下的价格弹性、冲击前后需求曲线和总成本变化可以解决这些偏误；3) 需求和供给数据虽然互补，但可独立用于纠正特定偏误；4) 即使部分数据也能纠正特定偏误。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了一个无需模型设定的充分统计量框架，用于处理产品质量内生且不可观测的福利分析问题；2) 识别并分类了忽略质量变化导致的三种偏误；3) 证明了部分数据也能有效纠正特定偏误，降低了数据要求门槛。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究人员提供了一个更灵活、数据要求更低的福利评估工具，即使在数据有限的情况下也能对经济冲击的福利影响进行更准确的评估。

title: Global Geopolitical Risk, Innovation Investment, and Carbon-Energy Green Growth Outcomes: Worldwide Evidence from Government Expenditure Strategies

detail.title: Global Geopolitical Risk, Innovation Investment, and Carbon-Energy Green Growth Outcomes: Worldwide Evidence from Government Expenditure Strategies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest to be declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The corresponding lead author has all the proper rights reserved for the manuscript with its associated replication packages.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding received.

detail.abstract: Employing global coverage of economies across income groups, the study examines the impacts of global geopolitical risk (GPR) on green growth outcomes through government spending decisions. Under global geopolitical uncertainty, governments are likely to depress innovation investment expenditures on research and development (R&D). The depressed innovation investments have been driven by national incentives to prioritize military expenditure for crossborder security forces due to heightened geopolitical uncertainty. Such investment expenditure incentives lead to shrinking total reserves, for which economies may have to decrease overall government expenses and increase short-term debt financing. Depressed innovation investments with GPR-induced precautionary motives lead to unfavorable green growth outcomes, including carbon efficiency levels, renewable energy consumption, and green electricity output. The global impacts of global geopolitical uncertainty have been heterogeneous across income groups, with high sensitivity to low-income countries. The public expenditure strategies and green growth outcomes follow the aggregate multidimensional developments of financial institutions and markets as well as the stages of growth. Our global study offers insightful empirical evidence on the consequential outcomes of geopolitical uncertainties on the delayed green transition efforts of economies worldwide. Even though the impacts of GPR remain uneven across income groups and regions, mitigated geopolitical risks are critical to green growth targets globally for the Sustainable Development Goals.

AI.tldr: 本文利用全球各收入水平经济体的数据，研究了全球地缘政治风险（GPR）如何通过政府支出决策影响绿色增长成果。研究发现，地缘政治不确定性导致政府削减研发创新投资，转而优先增加军事开支，进而导致总储备减少、短期债务融资增加，最终对碳效率、可再生能源消费和绿色电力产出产生不利影响。这种影响在不同收入群体间存在异质性，低收入国家尤为敏感。
AI.research_question: 全球地缘政治风险如何通过政府支出决策影响各国的绿色增长成果？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治不确定性日益加剧，可能延缓全球绿色转型进程，但其传导机制尚不明确。本文旨在揭示地缘政治风险通过政府公共支出渠道对绿色发展的影响路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治风险理论、政府支出决策理论、预防性储蓄动机理论、绿色增长理论
AI.method: 采用覆盖全球各收入水平经济体的跨国面板数据，进行实证分析，并考察收入群体间的异质性效应。
AI.findings: （1）地缘政治不确定性导致政府削减研发创新投资，优先增加军事支出；（2）创新投资被抑制导致总储备减少、短期债务融资增加；（3）上述机制最终对碳效率、可再生能源消费和绿色电力产出产生不利影响；（4）影响具有异质性，低收入国家更为敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了地缘政治风险影响绿色转型的财政支出传导机制，拓展了地缘政治经济学与绿色增长理论的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据，表明缓解地缘政治风险对实现全球绿色增长和可持续发展目标至关重要；提示各国在应对地缘政治不确定性时应避免过度削减创新支出。

title: GBC for Shot Noise Processes
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: GBC for Shot Noise Processes
detail.abstract: Shot noise processes describe a stream of random impulses that arrive at Poisson times and decay through a deterministic response kernel. They provide a flexible and interpretable class of models for volatility, credit intensities, insurance reserves, neuronal activity, and photon counts. We give a self contained treatment of the probabilistic structure of these processes and develop a Bayesian framework for inference from discretely and noisily observed data. On the theory side we record the Laplace functional, cumulants, and Levy triplet, we identify the exponential kernel case with a non Gaussian Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process driven by a compound Poisson subordinator, and we show that the stationary law belongs to the Thorin class of generalized gamma convolutions whenever the mark tail is completely monotone. In the exponential mark case the stationary law is exactly gamma. Reading the same path as a hazard rate yields a closed form survival function and an increasing hazard with a finite plateau, linking the construction to reliability in dynamic environments. On the computation side the intractable likelihood is handled by treating the latent marked point process as auxiliary data. We give a data augmentation Gibbs sampler with birth, death, and move updates, together with a state space formulation that admits particle filtering and particle Markov chain Monte Carlo. We show that the same augmentation renders the sampler free of Metropolis steps, connect the shrinkage priors on the marks to the Lévy structure of the process itself, and, because the model is trivial to simulate but has an intractable likelihood, develop a likelihood-free generative Bayesian computation (GBC) scheme that trains a quantile neural network to produce amortized posterior draws. A simulation study recovers all structural parameters with well calibrated credible intervals and characterizes the finite sample near degeneracy between the arrival rate and the mark scale, and a further study validates the GBC estimator against particle Markov chain Monte Carlo and against the theory. We close with extensions to nonexponential kernels, generalized gamma convolution priors on the marks, and shot noise Cox processes.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地发展了shot noise过程的概率理论，并提出了基于贝叶斯推断的框架，用于从离散且有噪声的观测数据中进行参数估计和不确定性量化。
AI.research_question: 如何对shot noise过程进行严格的概率理论刻画，并构建适用于离散、含噪声观测数据的贝叶斯推断框架？
AI.motivation: Shot noise过程在波动率、信用强度、保险准备金、神经活动和光子计数等领域有广泛应用，但缺乏自洽的概率理论基础和高效的贝叶斯推断方法，尤其是在数据离散且有噪声的场景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拉普拉斯泛函、累积量、Lévy三元组；指数核情形与非高斯Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程的联系；平稳分布与Thorin类广义Gamma卷积的关系；指数标记下平稳分布为Gamma分布；将路径解读为风险率得到封闭生存函数和递增风险率。
AI.method: 数据增广Gibbs采样器（含生灭移动更新）；状态空间表示下的粒子滤波与粒子MCMC；无Metropolis步骤的采样器设计；基于似然无关的生成式贝叶斯计算（GBC），使用分位数神经网络进行摊销后验推断。
AI.findings: 模拟研究恢复了所有结构参数，置信区间校准良好；刻画了到达率与标记尺度之间的有限样本近退化性；GBC估计器与粒子MCMC及理论结果一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了shot noise过程的Lévy三元组等概率结构；揭示了指数核情形与非高斯OU过程的等价性；证明了在标记尾部完全单调时平稳分布属于Thorin类广义Gamma卷积；给出了指数标记下生存函数的封闭形式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了无需Metropolis步骤的Gibbs采样器；开发了基于分位数神经网络的生成式贝叶斯计算方法，适用于似然难以处理但易于模拟的模型；方法可扩展至非指数核、广义Gamma卷积先验和shot noise Cox过程。

title: Armed Factions and Local Electoral Competition
affiliations: Brazilian School of Economics and Finance (FGV EPGE) and Instituto de Ensino e Pesquisa (INSPER)

detail.title: Armed Factions and Local Electoral Competition
detail.abstract: Weak states often share territorial authority with armed organizations, but not all forms of criminal governance translate into electoral capture. This paper shows that the political consequences of armed territorial control depend on the group's relationship with the state. We study metropolitan Rio de Janeiro, where paramilitary militias and drug-trafficking factions control neighborhoods but differ sharply in their institutional embeddedness. Combining annual georeferenced territory maps with polling-station returns from five municipal elections, we estimate staggered difference-indifferences effects of faction territorial entry. Militia entry reduces mayoral competition: vote concentration increases, victory margins widen, the effective number of candidates falls, and turnout rises. Mechanism estimates indicate that votes shift toward eventual winners, locally leading candidates, and candidates with larger campaign budgets, consistent with coordinated electoral mobilization. Drugtrafficking faction expansion produces no comparable effects under the same empirical design, and neither faction type affects city-council competition. These patterns suggest that criminal control becomes electorally consequential when armed groups are embedded in local state authority and can exchange territorial influence for political protection. The findings distinguish territorial control from electoral capture and show how the institutional structure of organized crime shapes democratic competition in weak-state settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究巴西里约热内卢都市区，发现武装组织的地盘控制能否转化为选举俘获，取决于其与国家的关系：嵌入地方国家机构的准军事民兵组织能显著影响市长选举竞争，而毒品贩运组织则不能。
AI.research_question: 武装组织的地域控制何时以及如何转化为选举俘获？不同武装组织与国家关系对选举竞争的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 弱国家常与武装组织共享领土权威，但并非所有形式的犯罪治理都能转化为选举俘获。现有文献对"领土控制"与"选举俘获"的区分不足，且较少系统检验不同武装组织与国家关系的差异如何影响民主竞争。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关键在于武装组织与地方国家机构的"制度嵌入性"（institutional embeddedness）：当武装组织嵌入国家权力结构、能够用领土影响交换政治保护时，其领土控制才具有选举后果；否则仅停留在地方治安层面，难以影响选举竞争。
AI.method: 结合里约热内卢年度地理参考领土地图与五届市政选举的投票站数据，采用交错双重差分法（staggered difference-in-differences）估计民兵和毒品贩运组织进入某一地区对选举结果的影响。
AI.findings: 民兵进入显著降低了市长选举竞争：选票集中度上升、胜选差距扩大、有效候选人数量减少、投票率上升。投票向最终胜者、本地区领先候选人和竞选预算更高的候选人转移，表明存在协调性选举动员。毒品贩运组织扩张未产生可比效应，两类组织均不影响市议员选举。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了"领土控制"与"选举俘获"两种不同现象，揭示了犯罪组织的制度结构（与国家的关系嵌入程度）如何塑造民主竞争。为"弱国家中的民主"和"犯罪治理的政治后果"提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者识别哪些类型的武装组织对民主选举构成实质威胁提供了依据：重点应关注那些嵌入地方国家机构、能够将领土控制转化为政治影响的组织，而非仅仅关注暴力程度。

title: Political Windows and the Dynamics of Temporary Pollution Abatement

detail.title: Political Windows and the Dynamics of Temporary Pollution Abatement
detail.abstract: Many environmental policies produce sharp but short-lived improvements around politically salient dates: international summits, regulatory inspections, and pollution alerts. This paper studies when such "visibility windows" generate real abatement, when gains reverse, and how cross-jurisdictional coordination changes the welfare consequences. I develop a two-region, infinite-horizon linear-quadratic model in which a temporary increase in the weight on the core jurisdiction's pollution stock induces anticipatory abatement, post-window rebound, and a coordination wedge between a planner and a decentralized Markov-perfect equilibrium. I test the model using two quasi-experimental designs and a descriptive cross-national panel. In a stacked difference-indifferences design using China's province-by-province Central Environmental Inspection rollout, inspected provinces experience a temporary PM 2.5 decline of about 5-6 µg/m 3 during the on-site window, with flat pre-trends and reversion within months. In a within-airshed ring design, Beijing's coordinated mega-event controls reduce pollution in both the core and nearby periphery, while comparable Olympic-host designs in London and Paris show little spatial gradient. A harmonized panel of sixteen visibility-window events in six countries provides descriptive evidence consistent with the same coordination pattern. The results suggest that temporary abatement is not necessarily cosmetic, but its durability depends on institutions that internalize spatial spillovers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了环境政策在"可见性窗口期"（如国际峰会、监管检查、污染警报等）带来的暂时性改善能否产生真实的减排效果。通过构建两区域无限期线性二次模型，并利用中国中央环保督察、北京奥运/阅兵等准实验数据，发现窗口期确实能产生实质性减排（如PM2.5下降5-6 µg/m³），但效果很快逆转。关键在于，能够内部化空间溢出的制度安排（如跨区域协调）决定了减排效果的持久性。
AI.research_question: 环境政策在"可见性窗口期"产生的暂时性改善是真实的减排还是表面文章？跨辖区协调如何影响减排效果的持久性与福利后果？
AI.motivation: 许多环境政策在政治敏感期（如国际峰会、监管检查、污染警报）产生显著但短暂的改善，这种现象被广泛观察到，但其福利含义不明——究竟是"表面功夫"（cosmetic）还是能产生真实持久的减排？跨辖区协调在这一过程中的作用机制尚缺乏系统的理论研究与因果识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两区域（核心区与外围区）、无限期线性二次动态博弈模型；对比社会计划者最优与社会均衡（Markov完美均衡）；引入"可见性窗口期"核心辖区污染存量权重暂时上升的冲击。
AI.method: 理论建模（线性二次动态博弈）；中国中央环保督察的省份逐步推行作为堆叠双重差分（stacked DiD）；同一空气流域内的环状设计（within-airshed ring design）；北京奥运/阅兵等大型活动的协调控制与伦敦、巴黎奥运的对比；全球16个可见性窗口事件在6个国家的描述性面板分析。
AI.findings: （1）中国中央环保督察导致督察期间PM2.5下降约5-6 µg/m³，事前趋势平坦，但数月内逆转；（2）北京奥运/阅兵等协调控制同时降低了核心区与周边地区的污染，而伦敦、巴黎奥运则无显著空间梯度；（3）理论表明，窗口期会产生预期性减排（anticipatory abatement）、窗口后反弹（rebound）以及社会计划者与分散均衡之间的协调楔子（coordination wedge）；（4）能够内部化跨辖区空间溢出（spatial spillovers）的制度安排决定了短暂减排能否转化为持久改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统地将"可见性窗口期"现象纳入动态博弈框架，揭示了预期效应、反弹效应与协调楔子的三重机制；区分了表面文章与真实减排的理论条件；阐明了跨辖区溢出内生化对政策持久性影响的理论机理。
AI.practical_contributions: 为环境监管（如环保督察）、大型活动污染管控等政策的评估提供了因果识别证据；指出单纯依靠短期政治压力可能只能产生暂时效果，需要配套跨区域协调制度（如空气流域管理）来实现持久减排；为发展中国家的环境治理制度设计提供了"协调内部化溢出"的政策启示。

title: Artificial Intelligence Infrastructure and Regional Economic Transformation: Evidence from Emerging AI Clusters in Europe

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence Infrastructure and Regional Economic Transformation: Evidence from Emerging AI Clusters in Europe
detail.abstract: Across Europe, the build-out of artificial intelligence infrastructure is being framed as a route to regional economic transformation. The European Union has selected nineteen AI Factories attached to its supercomputing centres, alongside thirteen smaller antennas, and has committed a twenty billion euro fund toward up to five AI gigafactories, while private capital pours into data centres from Ireland to the Nordic interior. This article asks which European regions are actually emerging as AI clusters, why, and whether hosting AI infrastructure transforms a regional economy or leaves an enclave. Drawing on agglomeration theory, the concept of absorptive capacity and work on regional value capture, and on current evidence on European compute infrastructure and AI investment, it argues that AI in Europe has two distinct geographies that only partly coincide. Compute spreads widely, including to peripheries chosen for power, land and cooling. Innovation, the talent, firms, research and capital that generate value, concentrates in a small number of metropolitan hubs: London, with several times the AI engineering workforce of any other European city; Paris, now ranked among the leading global AI hubs; and a second tier including Munich, Berlin and Zurich. Mapping this evidence, including a compiled dataset of the nineteen EuroHPC AI Factories set against national AI-investment figures, the article distinguishes four kinds of emerging cluster and argues that hosting infrastructure transforms a regional economy only where institutions and absorptive capacity convert compute into local capability. On the European map that convergence is the engineered exception, not the rule. The article sets out the policy mechanisms and the empirical agenda this implies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了欧洲人工智能基础设施的地理分布，发现计算基础设施广泛分布到外围地区，而AI创新（人才、企业、研究）高度集中在伦敦、巴黎等少数大都市枢纽。只有具备制度能力和吸收能力的地方，才能将算力基础设施转化为真正的区域经济转型。
AI.research_question: 欧洲哪些区域正在成为AI集群？为什么？托管AI基础设施是否能真正转变区域经济，还是仅形成"飞地"？
AI.motivation: 欧洲各国正大力投资AI基础设施（如AI工厂、千兆工厂和数据中心），但这些投资能否真正促进区域经济转型尚不明确，存在形成"飞地经济"的风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集聚理论、吸收能力概念、区域价值捕获理论
AI.method: 基于欧洲计算基础设施和AI投资的现有证据，结合19个EuroHPC AI工厂与各国AI投资数据的汇编数据集进行空间分析。
AI.findings: 欧洲AI存在两种不同的地理分布：计算基础设施广泛扩散到外围地区（因电力、土地和冷却需求）；而创新活动（人才、企业、研究、资本）高度集中在少数大都市枢纽。识别出四种新兴集群类型。只有具备制度和吸收能力的地区才能将基础设施转化为本地能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将集聚理论、吸收能力与区域价值捕获理论整合，揭示了AI基础设施布局与创新活动地理分布之间的脱节，丰富了关于"基础设施是否带动区域发展"的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟及成员国提供AI产业集群政策制定的实证依据，指出单纯建设算力基础设施不足以实现区域经济转型，需配套制度建设和吸收能力提升机制。

title: Geometry-Aware Optimizers as Scale Mixtures: Muon, Spectral Shrinkage, and Fast Compute
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Geometry-Aware Optimizers as Scale Mixtures: Muon, Spectral Shrinkage, and Fast Compute
detail.abstract: We give a unifying account of geometry-aware optimizers, including Muon, Shampoo, and Adafactor, through the lens of scale mixtures of Gaussians and matrix-variate priors. The organizing principle is a duality: a training step is steepest descent under a chosen norm, and that norm is dual to a prior under which the step is a maximum a posteriori move. The Euclidean norm returns stochastic gradient descent, the coordinate max-norm returns sign descent and the sign geometry of Adam, and the spectral operator norm returns Muon, whose Newton-Schulz orthogonalization computes the polar factor U V ⊤ of the momentum matrix. Adaptive second-moment methods form a hierarchy of scale mixtures: Adam is a per-coordinate local scale, Adafactor is a separable rank-one scale that factors the second moment into row and column statistics, and Shampoo is a Kronecker matrix-normal scale. Muon sits at the spectral end of this hierarchy, where the update is whitened so that every singular direction moves at a common rate, the matrix analogue of the common global scale in a horseshoe prior. We make the norm-to-prior correspondence precise, show that Adafactor is the maximum-likelihood separable scale mixture, and connect fast compute, Newton-Schulz iteration and factored moments, to our generative Bayesian computation program. Illustrative numerical studies on anisotropic objectives display the invariance the geometry predicts: the spectral and Kronecker methods are unchanged under an orthogonal change of frame, while coordinate methods lose several orders of magnitude of accuracy when the same anisotropy is rotated off-axis.

AI.tldr: 本文通过尺度混合高斯分布和矩阵变量先验的统一框架，揭示了Muon、Shampoo、Adafactor等几何感知优化器的内在联系，其核心是一种对偶性：训练步骤是在选定范数下的最速下降，而该范数对偶于一个先验分布，在此先验下该步骤是最大后验移动。从Adam的坐标符号几何到Muon的谱算子范数，再到Adafactor的可分离秩一尺度和Shampoo的Kronecker矩阵正态尺度，形成了一个完整的层级体系。
AI.research_question: 如何从尺度混合高斯分布和矩阵变量先验的统一视角，解释和联系多种几何感知优化器（Muon、Shampoo、Adafactor、Adam）的数学原理？
AI.motivation: 现有优化器虽然在实践中表现优异，但缺乏统一的数学框架来解释其几何性质及其相互关系，特别是不同优化器在不同坐标系下的表现差异（如旋转不变性vs坐标敏感性）缺乏理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 范数-先验对偶性：训练步骤是在选定范数下的最速下降，该范数对偶于一个先验分布；2) 尺度混合高斯分布层级：从逐坐标局部尺度（Adam）到可分离秩一尺度（Adafactor）到Kronecker矩阵正态尺度（Shampoo）到谱端（Muon）；3) 贝叶斯生成计算框架：连接牛顿-舒尔茨迭代和因子化矩。
AI.method: 理论推导：建立范数与先验之间的精确对偶关系；层级化分类：将各优化器纳入尺度混合高斯分布的统一框架；数值实验：在各向异性目标函数上验证不同优化器的旋转不变性/敏感性。
AI.findings: 1) 欧几里得范数对应SGD，坐标最大范数对应符号下降和Adam的符号几何，谱算子范数对应Muon；2) Adafactor是可分离尺度混合的最大似然估计；3) 谱方法和Kronecker方法在正交变换下保持不变，而坐标方法在旋转各向异性时精度下降数个数量级。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了优化器中范数、先验与更新步骤之间精确的数学对偶关系；将Adam、Adafactor、Shampoo、Muon纳入统一的尺度混合高斯分布层级体系；证明Adafactor是可分离尺度混合的最大似然解。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了不同优化器在不同坐标系下的行为差异（旋转不变性vs坐标敏感性），为实践中的优化器选择提供了理论指导；连接了快速计算（牛顿-舒尔茨迭代）与生成式贝叶斯计算。

title: Labor Market Effects of Oil Supply News Shocks: Heterogeneous Responses by Demographic Groups
affiliations: University of Iowa

detail.title: Labor Market Effects of Oil Supply News Shocks: Heterogeneous Responses by Demographic Groups
detail.abstract: This paper examines the labor-market consequences of oil supply news shocks in the United States, focusing not only on aggregate employment but also on how labormarket risk is distributed across workers and places. I combine high-frequency oil supply news shocks from Känzig (2021) with a state-by-demographic panel constructed from the Current Population Survey (CPS) for 1994-2025. I then estimate local projections for employment-population ratios, labor-force participation, and unemployment, allowing the effects to vary by gender, age, education, race/ethnicity, and state energysector exposure. The results show that oil supply news shocks lower employment and raise unemployment, with particularly large adverse effects for young workers, lesseducated workers, and Black workers. At the same time, pre-existing exposure to the energy sector partly cushions local labor markets: states with larger energy-sector employment shares experience smaller employment losses and smaller increases in unemployment. This cushioning effect also varies across demographic groups, suggesting that local energy-sector exposure shapes both the overall labor-market response to oil shocks and who bears the costs of those shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文利用高频石油供给新闻冲击数据与CPS构建的州-人口统计面板，研究发现石油供给新闻冲击会降低就业、提高失业，对年轻、低学历和黑人劳动者影响尤甚，但能源部门的存在可以部分缓冲地方劳动力市场的负面影响。
AI.research_question: 石油供给新闻冲击如何影响美国劳动力市场，特别是就业总量以及不同劳动者群体和地区之间的劳动力市场风险分布？
AI.motivation: 已有研究多关注石油冲击对宏观经济总量的影响，而对劳动力市场风险的异质性分布关注不足，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于石油供给冲击理论、劳动力市场分割理论以及区域经济缓冲机制。
AI.method: 将Känzig (2021)的高频石油供给新闻冲击与1994-2025年CPS构建的州-人口统计面板相结合，采用局部投影法估计就业人口比、劳动参与率和失业率的动态效应，并按性别、年龄、教育、种族/民族及州能源部门暴露程度进行异质性分析。
AI.findings: （1）石油供给新闻冲击降低就业、提高失业；（2）年轻劳动者、低学历劳动者和黑人劳动者承受的负面冲击最大；（3）能源部门就业份额较高的州，就业损失和失业增加幅度较小；（4）能源部门的缓冲效应在不同人口群体间存在差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了石油供给冲击在劳动力市场风险分配中的异质性机制，丰富了能源冲击与劳动力市场关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者识别石油冲击中脆弱群体和地区提供了实证依据，有助于设计更具针对性的劳动力市场缓冲与救助政策。

title: Liquidity Premium and Investment Horizons

detail.title: Liquidity Premium and Investment Horizons
detail.abstract: We estimate Kyle's (1985) price-impact coefficient Lambda directly from daily equity order flow and test its ability to forecast the cross-section of subsequent stock returns. Using full CRSP data from 2020 to 2025, we construct firm-month measures of signed order flow and two estimators of Lambda: a within-month price-impact regression and an Amihud-style ratio. Signed order flow strongly predicts contemporaneous and one-month-ahead returns, while volume volatility predicts lower subsequent returns, consistent with widening price impact degrading price discovery. Fama-MacBeth regressions confirm that our order-flow signal carries significant cross-sectional return information after Newey-West adjustment. Theoretically, we resolve the liquidity premium puzzle of Constantinides (1986) through an adverse-selection mechanism: low order flow widens Lambda and depresses prices today; subsequent normalization restores prices, generating the illiquidity premium without risk-based compensation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用日度股票订单流数据直接估计Kyle（1985）的价格冲击系数Lambda，并检验其预测股票横截面收益的能力。研究发现，符号订单流能显著预测同期及未来一个月的收益，而成交量波动率则预测较低后续收益。通过Fama-MacBeth回归证实订单流信号包含显著的横截面收益信息。理论上，通过逆向选择机制解释了Constantinides（1986）的流动性溢价谜题：低订单流会扩大Lambda并压低当前价格，后续价格恢复产生了非风险补偿的流动性溢价。
AI.research_question: 订单流的价格冲击系数（Lambda）能否预测股票横截面收益？如何通过逆向选择机制解释流动性溢价谜题？
AI.motivation: 传统流动性溢价理论（Constantinides, 1986）认为流动性差的资产需要有更高的预期收益作为补偿，但这一谜题缺乏微观机制解释。同时，Kyle（1985）的Lambda作为价格影响系数缺乏直接的实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kyle（1985）的市场微观结构模型（价格冲击系数Lambda）、逆向选择理论、流动性溢价理论（Constantinides, 1986）
AI.method: 利用2020-2025年CRSP全样本日度数据，构建公司-月度层面的符号订单流和两种Lambda估计量：月度内价格冲击回归估计和Amihud风格比率。采用Fama-MacBeth横截面回归，经Newey-West调整。
AI.findings: （1）符号订单流能强预测同期及未来一个月收益；（2）成交量波动率预测较低后续收益；（3）逆向选择机制解释了流动性溢价：低订单流→高Lambda→当前价格压低→后续价格恢复产生溢价，无需风险补偿。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将Kyle（1985）的Lambda直接用于实证预测，并通过逆向选择机制为Constantinides（1986）的流动性溢价谜题提供了新的理论解释——流动性溢价源于信息不对称的暂时性价格扭曲，而非风险补偿。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了基于订单流的可操作收益预测信号，有助于交易策略构建和流动性风险管理。对市场微观结构研究和资产定价实践具有指导意义。

title: On SwiGLU versus ReLU: Gated Activations for Generative Bayesian Computation
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: On SwiGLU versus ReLU: Gated Activations for Generative Bayesian Computation
detail.abstract: The feed-forward blocks of modern transformers have moved from rectified linear (ReLU) activations to gated variants, chief among them SwiGLU, the Swish-gated linear unit. We give a self-contained mathematical account of ReLU, Swish, and SwiGLU, and we ask what the choice means for generative Bayesian computation (GBC), where a deep learner is trained to transport a base random variable to posterior draws. Two structural facts organize the comparison. First, a ReLU network is a continuous piecewise-linear map, so a ReLU quantile network yields a piecewise-constant posterior density, whereas a Swish or SwiGLU network is smooth and yields a continuous density; we sharpen this into a statement about the posterior score, showing the smooth transport admits a continuous score while the ReLU transport admits no pointwise score from the represented map, even when the two agree on the quantile to second order. Second, Bayes rule is multiplicative, and a gate computes a product exactly, while a ReLU layer must build multiplication by composition; we give a matching lower bound on the piecewise-linear cost of a single product. A gate that routes among experts is moreover a Bayesian prior whose posterior responsibilities are the product form of Bayes rule, so a sparse prior on the gate turns the multiplicative primitive into conditional computation. These observations suggest that gated smooth activations are a natural inductive bias for amortized posterior maps, a claim we make precise and then qualify. We keep the accounting honest: for piecewiselinear targets ReLU is ideal and cheaper, the worst-case approximation rates for smooth targets coincide up to logarithmic factors, and the practical gains of SwiGLU are as much about conditioning of the optimization landscape as about raw expressivity. The paper is expository and connective, and is intended to inform the architecture choices in our ongoing GBC program.

AI.tldr: 本文从生成贝叶斯计算角度，系统比较了ReLU、Swish和SwiGLU三种激活函数在深度生成式贝叶斯计算中的表现，论证了门控平滑激活函数（SwiGLU）是后验图网络的自然归纳偏置，同时指出ReLU在分段线性目标下更优，且实际增益与优化景观条件相关。
AI.research_question: 在现代Transformer的前馈模块中，从ReLU激活函数转向门控变体（尤其是SwiGLU）对生成式贝叶斯计算有何影响？不同激活函数的选择如何影响后验分布的表达、得分函数的性质以及计算效率？
AI.motivation: 生成式贝叶斯计算（GBC）中深度学习者被训练来将基础随机变量传输到后验样本，激活函数的选择直接影响后验密度估计的质量和计算效率。目前缺乏从GBC视角对ReLU、Swish和SwiGLU进行系统数学比较的工作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 生成式贝叶斯计算（GBC）框架；2) 分段线性映射与光滑映射的对比分析；3) 后验得分函数的连续性理论；4) 贝叶斯乘性规则与门控机制的形式化联系；5) 稀疏先验与条件计算的关联。
AI.method: 本文采用数学推导与理论分析的方法，对ReLU、Swish和SwiGLU三种激活函数进行自洽的数学刻画，从后验密度连续性、得分函数存在性、乘法运算的表示成本、以及近似率等维度进行系统比较。
AI.findings: 1) ReLU网络产生分段常数后验密度且无法从所表示映射中获得逐点评分函数；2) Swish/SwiGLU网络光滑，产生连续后验密度和连续得分函数；3) 门控机制精确实现乘积运算，而ReLU需通过组合构建乘法，且存在分段线性成本的匹配下界；4) 专家路由门控本质上是贝叶斯先验，后验责任呈现贝叶斯规则的乘积形式；5) 对于分段线性目标，ReLU更优且更便宜；光滑目标的最坏近似率在对数因子内一致；SwiGLU的实际收益既关乎原始表达能力，也关乎优化景观的条件性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次从生成式贝叶斯计算视角系统比较了ReLU、Swish和SwiGLU激活函数；2) 证明了光滑传输允许连续得分函数而ReLU传输无法从所表示映射中获得逐点评分函数；3) 给出了分段线性乘法成本的匹配下界；4) 将门控专家路由形式化为贝叶斯先验-后验框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为生成式贝叶斯计算程序中的架构选择提供了理论依据，表明SwiGLU等门控平滑激活函数是后验图网络的自然归纳偏置，同时提醒从业者在分段线性目标场景下ReLU可能更优，且实际收益部分来源于优化景观的改善而非纯粹的表达能力。

title: Bayesian Inference for Hawkes Processes: Theory and Computation
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Bayesian Inference for Hawkes Processes: Theory and Computation
detail.abstract: Hawkes processes are self-exciting point processes in which the occurrence of an event raises the probability of further events in the near future. They provide a parsimonious model for clustered arrival data in finance, seismology, neuroscience and social systems. This paper gives a self-contained treatment of the Hawkes process from a Bayesian viewpoint. We develop the conditional intensity and the equivalent Poisson cluster (branching) representation, establish stationarity and second-order moment structure, and derive the exact likelihood together with an O(N) recursion for the exponential kernel. On the computational side we take latent branching data augmentation as the organizing principle: it restores gamma-Poisson conjugacy and yields a Gibbs sampler whose conditional sufficient-statistic structure we make explicit and use to derive a sequential particle-learning algorithm for online inference. Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and meanfield variational inference are covered more briefly, for kernels without a clean augmentation. We treat prior specification, identifiability of the branching ratio, half-Cauchy scale priors, multivariate and marked extensions, and Bayesian nonparametric kernels. Two simulation studies recover the generating parameters and validate fit through the time-rescaling theorem, the second using a horseshoe prior to recover a sparse excitation network among event types. A worked application to two decades of global seismicity estimates the aftershock branching ratio and shows the time-rescaling diagnostic detecting the exponential kernel's departure from the Omori law. We close with an honest account of the limitations of each method. The intent is a practical reference that connects the probabilistic theory to reproducible computation.

AI.tldr: 本文从贝叶斯视角系统性地介绍了Hawkes过程（自激点过程），涵盖条件强度、泊松簇表示、似然函数、马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）和序贯粒子学习等计算方法，并通过模拟和全球地震数据验证了模型性能，最后诚实讨论了各方法的局限性。
AI.research_question: 如何从贝叶斯视角系统性地理解、推断和应用Hawkes过程？
AI.motivation: Hawkes过程在金融、地震学、神经科学和社会系统等领域广泛应用，但缺乏一个从贝叶斯视角出发的、兼具理论深度和可复现计算的系统性参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: Hawkes过程（自激点过程）；条件强度函数；泊松簇（分支）表示；平稳性与二阶矩结构；指数核的O(N)递推似然；伽马-泊松共轭性；时间重标定理。
AI.method: 潜分支数据增广吉布斯采样器；序贯粒子学习算法；Hamiltonian Monte Carlo；均值场变分推断；马蹄先验（稀疏化）；贝叶斯非参数核。
AI.findings: （1）潜分支数据增广恢复了伽马-泊松共轭性，实现了高效吉布斯采样；（2）序贯粒子学习算法适用于在线推断；（3）马蹄先验有效恢复稀疏激发网络；（4）在两次模拟研究中准确恢复生成参数；（5）全球地震数据实例中，时间重标诊断检测到指数核与奥姆里定律的偏离。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了Hawkes过程的贝叶斯理论框架，明确了条件充分统计量结构，为潜变量增广方法提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可复现的贝叶斯计算流程（吉布斯采样、序贯学习、变分推断），为不同核函数给出了具体算法选择建议，并诚实评估了各方法的局限性。

title: The 1972 Summer Institute in Urban Economics
affiliations: University of Illinois at Chicago

detail.title: The 1972 Summer Institute in Urban Economics

declarations.ethicsApproval: None required for a report on a conference.
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: The report is a detailed description of the NSF-sponsored Institute in Urban Economics held at Stanford University in August 1972.  Presentations were made by leading scholars in the field to an audience of young scholars who were scheduled to teach the subject.

AI.tldr: 这是一份1972年8月在斯坦福大学举行的NSF资助的城市经济学研究所的详细报告，主要记录该领域顶尖学者向即将教授该课程的年轻学者所做的演讲内容。
AI.research_question: 该报告未提出具体的研究问题，而是对学术研讨会的内容进行总结和记录。
AI.motivation: 为即将教授城市经济学的年轻学者提供该领域顶尖学者的学术见解和教学资源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市经济学的相关理论框架（由与会顶尖学者在演讲中阐述）。
AI.method: 学术研讨会/报告形式，由领域内知名学者进行演讲并记录。
AI.findings: 记录并呈现了1972年城市经济学领域顶尖学者的演讲内容与学术观点。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统总结了当时城市经济学领域的前沿理论进展，为年轻学者提供了理论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为即将教授城市经济学的年轻学者提供了教学素材和学术资源，有助于该学科的教学推广。

title: The 2022 and 2026 Oil Shocks: Implications and Policy Options for Puerto Rico

detail.title: The 2022 and 2026 Oil Shocks: Implications and Policy Options for Puerto Rico
detail.abstract: This policy brief offers a data-driven account of how the 2022 oil shock moved through Puerto Rico’s economy—tracing its effects across gasoline and electricity prices, inflation, output, and the labor market—and uses that episode as an empirical template for anticipating how the more recent 2026 shock could unfold.
