title: Greenwashing in Sustainable Finance: An Overview of the Literature, Future Research Directions, and a Case Study of Germany
affiliations: Otto-von-Guericke University Magdeburg

detail.title: Greenwashing in Sustainable Finance: An Overview of the Literature, Future Research Directions, and a Case Study of Germany

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal or financial relationships with any individuals or organizations that may have influenced, or could be perceived to have influenced, the study reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval and informed consent were not required because this research did not involve human participants, patients, personal data, or an individual- or company-based case study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or other financial support from any funding agency, commercial entity, or not-for-profit organization.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Charl Hugo & Cayle Lupton (Eds.), Annual Banking Law Update 2026. Juta and Company.

detail.abstract: Greenwashing has emerged as a key challenge to market integrity in sustainable finance, as sustainability claims function as investment-relevant signals under information asymmetry, costly verification and fragmented measurement of environmental performance. This chapter provides an overview and synthesis of greenwashing research in finance and law, integrating evidence from asset management (environmental, social and governance (ESG) labelling, mutual fund flows and hedge funds), corporate finance (green bonds, real-asset transactions, transformation narratives and valuation effects) and disclosure research (mandatory sustainability reporting, green taxonomy design and ESG ratings divergence). Building on these research strands, the chapter develops an integrated framework that explains greenwashing as an equilibrium response to investor demand salience, the pricing of carbon risk and climate tail risk, reputational incentives and enforcement constraints, while emphasising the role of green taxonomies and disclosure regimes in shaping incentives and verifiability. The chapter then outlines future research directions and a call to action on measurement, causal identification and comparative enforcement design. To demonstrate how anti-greenwashing norms can be operationalised through enforcement, the chapter presents a case study of the German legal and enforcement framework. It examines misleading environmental advertising and “climate neutrality” claims under the Act against Unfair Competition (UWG), capital-market disclosure and prospectus liability under the Securities Prospectus Act (WpPG) and Capital Investment Act (VermAnlG), collective redress via the Consumer Rights Enforcement Act (VDuG) and escalation pathways to administrative and criminal sanctions via the Act on Regulatory Offences (OWiG) and the German Criminal Code (StGB).

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了金融与法律领域中的"漂绿"研究，构建了一个将漂绿解释为均衡反应的综合框架，并通过德国法律与执法案例展示了反漂绿规范的运作机制。
AI.research_question: 漂绿行为在可持续金融中如何产生？现有的金融与法律研究如何理解这一现象？反漂绿规范如何通过执法得以实施？
AI.motivation: 漂绿行为严重威胁可持续金融的市场诚信，但在信息不对称、验证成本高、环境绩效衡量碎片化的背景下，需要系统的跨学科综述与整合框架来指导未来研究与监管设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、信号理论、均衡分析框架（将漂绿视为投资者需求显著性、碳风险定价、气候尾部风险、声誉激励与执法约束下的均衡反应）。
AI.method: 文献综述与综合框架构建，辅以德国法律与执法体系的案例研究。
AI.findings: 漂绿是投资者需求、定价机制、声誉激励与执法约束共同作用下的均衡现象；绿色分类法与披露制度在塑造激励与可验证性方面发挥关键作用；德国法律体系通过不公平竞争法、证券披露法、集体救济与行政/刑事制裁等多层次机制构成反漂绿执法框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将漂绿解释为均衡反应的综合理论框架，整合了资产定价、公司金融与信息披露等多个研究分支，为理解漂绿的制度性成因提供了系统视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者提供了反漂绿执法的制度设计参考（以德国为例）；为未来研究指明了测量、因果识别与比较执法设计的方向；为市场参与者理解漂绿风险与合规要求提供了框架。

title: Monopolization After Microsoft

detail.title: Monopolization After Microsoft

declarations.declarationOfInterest: My research is funded only by NYU School of Law; my wife is an antitrust attorney in private practice.

detail.abstract:
United States v. Microsoft may be the most celebrated monopolization case of all time. No other modern antitrust decision has received so much praise from across the political sp ectrum, nor been so widely accepted as an authoritative guide to the law.

This Article proposes a modest reassessment. It argues that, while Microsoft contains much to admire, it is in some important ways overrated, both as a clear statement of monopolization doctrine and as a “pro-enforcement” precedent. Despite its many virtues, the opinion is embroidered with formulations and applications of law that are contradictory, confusing, or facially unreasonable. Today, as a wave of Big Tech monopolization cases moves through the courts, these features of the decision threaten to confuse and mislead judges and litigants alike.

As we celebrate Microsoft’s 25th anniversary, we should honor the decision by moving beyond it in some important respects, in search of clearer and more appealing accounts of monopolization doctrine. The “dangerous exclusion” framework—which distinguishes tests of exclusion, contribution to monopoly, and privilege, and provides a welfarist justification defense—is one such account. Embracing it means preserving some features of Microsoft’s treatment of the law, while setting others aside, in search of a robust and principled approach that can serve in traditional markets and on the digital frontier. The time is right to resettle and refine the law of monopolization in service of the pragmatic integration of law and economics that Microsoft, in its best dimensions, did so much to promote.

AI.tldr: 本文重新评估了美国诉微软案这一里程碑式的垄断判决，指出该案虽然在许多方面值得称赞，但在垄断法律规则的明确性和作为"支持执法"的先例方面被高估了。文章提出"危险排斥"框架作为更清晰、更完善的垄断法理论，以适应当前科技巨头垄断案件审理的需要。
AI.research_question: 美国诉微软案作为垄断法先例是否被高估了？如何完善垄断法框架以适应当前反垄断实践？
AI.motivation: 微软案虽被广泛赞誉，但其法律表述存在矛盾、混淆之处。随着新一轮科技巨头垄断案进入法院，微软案的缺陷可能误导法官和诉讼当事人。
AI.theoretical_framework: "危险排斥"框架：区分排斥行为测试、垄断贡献测试和特权测试，并提供福利主义正当理由抗辩。
AI.method: 法律文本分析与判例法评析
AI.findings: 微软案在法律规则陈述和法律适用方面存在矛盾、混淆或不合理之处；"危险排斥"框架能够为传统市场和数字前沿领域提供更清晰、更有原则的垄断法方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"危险排斥"框架作为超越微软案的更清晰、更完善的垄断法理论，区分了排斥测试、垄断贡献测试和特权测试三个层次。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院审理当前科技巨头垄断案件提供了更清晰的法律分析框架，帮助避免微软案中存在的混淆和误导，促进法律与经济的务实整合。

title: Housing Boom-Bust Cycles and Entrant Earnings

detail.title: Housing Boom-Bust Cycles and Entrant Earnings
detail.abstract: Are there labor-market costs to starting a career after a local housing boom turns? I use repeated cross sections from the Current Population Survey Annual Social and Economic Supplement (CPS-ASEC) to compare entrant cohorts in high-boom states with entrants in lower-boom states around state housing peaks. Cohorts entering after the peak in high-boom states earn 5.7 percent less, and 8.2 percent less in the late post-peak window. Randomization inference and American Community Survey state-of-birth checks support the earnings result, and Quarterly Workforce Indicators new-hire evidence points to a weaker entry ladder.

AI.tldr: 论文研究发现，在房地产繁荣高峰期后进入劳动力市场的毕业生，其收入显著降低（约5.7%-8.2%），主要原因是进入职场的初始阶梯变弱。
AI.research_question: 在本地房地产繁荣周期转向后开始职业生涯，是否会带来劳动力市场的成本？
AI.motivation: 探究宏观住房市场周期对初入职场者长期收入的影响，弥补现有文献对"进入时机"与"区域经济周期"交叉研究的不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场进入时机理论、区域经济周期理论、人力资本积累理论
AI.method: 利用CPS-ASEC重复截面数据，比较房地产繁荣高峰前后各州不同入市队列的收入差异；采用随机化推断和美国社区调查出生州数据进行稳健性检验；使用季度劳动力指标（QWI）新雇用数据验证"进入阶梯"机制。
AI.findings: 在房地产繁荣高峰期后进入劳动力市场的群体，收入下降5.7%（后期窗口达8.2%）；稳健性检验支持该结论；新雇用数据显示入市阶梯显著弱化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"宏观住房周期"与"劳动力市场进入时机"相结合，揭示了区域经济繁荣转向对新人收入的因果影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于住房市场调控与劳动力市场干预的参考依据，提示应关注宏观周期对年轻劳动者的长期负面影响。

title: Accumulate or Vanish: Deriving Marx's Charaktermaske from the Market Selection of Reinvestment Strategies

detail.title: Accumulate or Vanish: Deriving Marx's Charaktermaske from the Market Selection of Reinvestment Strategies
detail.abstract: Marx's capitalist is a Charaktermaske: a character mask, the personification of capital, whose purpose is imposed by the movement of value rather than by psychology. The modality of this claim has been disputed for a century: is each capitalist compelled to accumulate (the Zwang reading of Postone, Arthur, and Mau), or is the accumulating capitalist simply what survives (the filtering register of Alchian and Friedman)? We show the filtering half is a theorem. In a minimal accumulation process where each agent readvances a fraction α t ∈ [0, 1] of its capital into a circuit valorizing at rate δ, survival in wealth share is, in a population containing a full reinvestor, equivalent to ∑ t (1-α t) < ∞: survivors reinvest everything, in the full limit. Under stochastic valorization, survival against a log-optimal (Kelly) incumbent is equivalent to a finite cumulative expected loggrowth deficit; the surviving disposition is Kelly log-optimality, interior (α * < 1) under heavy downside risk, recovering the hoard as an internal moment of the capital-form. The mathematics is deliberately classical; the contribution is the bridge and its boundary. Exact survival characterizations and cash margins exist in the equilibrium market-selection literature (Massari; Drokin and Zhitlukhin; Easley, Kolumbus and Tardos); what has no counterpart there is the price-free regime of differential compounding with the reinvestment fraction as a preference-free strategy, where the Marxian claim lives. Filtering does not deliver the Zwang reading, which requires structurally enforced consequences for the individual bearer; we state this, with permutable bearers and active recapture as further candidate ingredients, as an open program. The result executes a possibility Elster conceded in 1982 and that the Marxological literature, including Mau's treatment of competition, has left without a mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数学模型证明，在资本积累过程中，能够生存下来的资本家必然是那些近乎完全再投资的人（过滤机制），但这只是竞争筛选的结果，而非每个资本家被迫如此（Zwang论断）。文章区分了这两种解读，并明确指出过滤机制无法推导出强制积累的结论。
AI.research_question: 马克思所说的资本家是"人格化的资本"——其积累行为由资本运动而非心理驱动——这一论断，究竟是每个资本家都被迫积累（Zwang），还是积累者只是竞争筛选后的幸存者（过滤）？
AI.motivation: 马克思"资本家是Charaktermaske（人格面具）"这一核心论断的模态（是强制还是筛选）争论了一个世纪，但缺乏形式化机制。Elster（1982）承认过滤逻辑的可能性，但马克思学界从未提供具体机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马克思资本理论（Charaktermaske、资本运动逻辑）、竞争与积累理论；现代金融与演化经济学中的市场选择理论（Kelly准则、对数最优策略）；Alchian-Friedman的演化筛选观点与Postone-Arthur-Mau的强制积累观点。
AI.method: 数学建模与证明。构建最小化积累过程模型：每个代理每期将α_t比例资本再投资，增值率δ。定义生存条件（财富份额不趋于零），证明生存等价于∑(1-α_t) < ∞，即极限情况下几乎完全再投资。进一步引入随机增值，证明生存等价于对数最优（Kelly）策略，且在下行风险大时最优再投资率α* < 1（即出现"窖藏"）。
AI.findings: （1）过滤机制可被严格证明：在包含至少一个完全再投资个体的群体中，生存的必要充分条件是累计未投资比例有限，即幸存者极限上全部再投资；（2）随机条件下，生存等价于对数最优策略，可能包含内部窖藏（α* < 1）；（3）过滤逻辑无法导出Zwang论断，后者需要额外的结构性约束（如主体可互换、主动回收机制）；（4）本文为Elster承认的逻辑可能性提供了具体机制。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将马克思资本理论中"过滤"解读从隐喻转化为可证明的数学定理；（2）清晰界定了"过滤"与"强制"两种解读之间的逻辑界限，指出前者不足以推出后者；（3）揭示了窖藏作为资本形式的内在环节而非外部偏离；（4）将马克思的积累逻辑与金融经济学中的Kelly准则和市场选择理论连接起来。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为马克思竞争和积累理论提供了严格的形式化基础；（2）澄清了关于资本积累机制的长达一个世纪的争论；（3）指出了未来研究需要补充的要素（主体可互换性、主动回收机制）以建立完整的强制积累理论。

title: The Bank of Canada's Communication Conundrum: How to Explain Inflation
affiliations: C.D. Howe Institute, University of Quebec at Montreal (UQAM) - Centre de recherche sur l'emploi et les fluctuations économiques (CREFÉ) and Queen's University - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Bank of Canada's Communication Conundrum: How to Explain Inflation
detail.abstract:
• This E-Brief is the third in a series related to the Bank of Canada’s 2026 renewal of its inflation-targeting agreement with the federal government.
  • We examine the desirable properties of underlying inflation measures and assess whether the measures available to the Bank meet those criteria.
  • We find that the Bank’s current measures provide useful information about underlying inflation, but the Bank should continue exploring improved measures to help guide its policy decisions.
  • However, the measures that help policymakers assess underlying inflation are not necessarily the best tools for communicating monetary policy to the public. The Bank should place greater emphasis on its inflation forecast and policy path when explaining its decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了加拿大央行用于衡量潜在通胀的指标，发现当前指标虽有参考价值，但需进一步改进；同时指出，与公众沟通时应更侧重通胀预测和政策路径，而非潜在通胀指标本身。
AI.research_question: 加拿大央行现有的潜在通胀指标是否具备理想属性？这些指标在政策制定和公众沟通中的适用性如何？
AI.motivation: 为加拿大央行2026年通胀目标协议续约提供分析依据，探讨如何改进潜在通胀的衡量与沟通策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 潜在通胀指标的理论属性（如稳定性、前瞻性、可解释性等），以及货币政策沟通的有效性理论。
AI.method: 文献梳理与指标评估，对比加拿大央行现有潜在通胀指标与理想标准之间的差距。
AI.findings: 1. 当前潜在通胀指标对政策制定有参考价值，但仍有改进空间；2. 衡量潜在通胀的最佳指标不一定适合公众沟通；3. 央行应更注重用通胀预测和政策路径来解释决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了潜在通胀指标在"政策分析"与"公众沟通"中的不同功能，丰富了货币政策沟通理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大央行2026年通胀目标续约提供了具体建议：继续探索改进潜在通胀指标，并在公众沟通中转向以通胀预测和政策路径为核心。

title: A Hybrid Framework for the Discount for Lack of Marketability

detail.title: A Hybrid Framework for the Discount for Lack of Marketability
detail.abstract: The most popular option-theoretic methods towards an estimation of the Discount for Lack of Marketability ("DLOM") each suffer from particular limitations that complicate their usage by practitioners. To address this, we propose a hybrid framework that formulates the DLOM as the maximum of an at-the-money vanilla put and a floating-strike Asian put (equivalently, a put on the greater of a fixed and a floating-average strike) capturing both the full extent of downside risk and some measure of lost upside potential, without recourse to the explosive discounts of a lookback formulation. We derive a closed-form analytic approximation which is bounded below by the Chaffe discount by construction. We prove that this bound survives the moment-matching approximation, holding identically within the closed form itself at every volatility and restriction period. Monte Carlo simulation confirms that the closed form reproduces the true hybrid put to within roughly a tenth of a percentage point on average, with a worst-case deviation of 1.5 percentage points confined to the high-volatility, long-tenor region of the parameter space, while producing non-explosive discounts throughout.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个混合框架来估计缺乏市场流动性折扣（DLOM），将其定义为普通平值看跌期权与浮动行权价亚式看跌期权的最大值，并推导出封闭形式的解析近似解，该解在构建上受Chaffe折扣约束，且通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证了其高精度与非爆炸性特征。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个既能捕捉全部下行风险又能衡量部分上行潜力损失、同时避免爆炸性折扣的DLOM估计框架？
AI.motivation: 现有的期权理论方法在估计缺乏市场流动性折扣（DLOM）时各有局限，难以被实践者有效使用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期权定价理论、混合期权框架（普通平值看跌期权 + 浮动行权价亚式看跌期权）、封闭形式解析近似、矩匹配方法。
AI.method: 推导封闭形式解析近似解，通过矩匹配进行逼近，并利用蒙特卡洛模拟验证精度。
AI.findings: 封闭形式近似解在构建上受Chaffe折扣约束；该约束在矩匹配近似中依然成立；蒙特卡洛模拟显示平均误差约0.1个百分点，最差偏差1.5个百分点（高波动、长期限区域），且折扣值在整个参数空间内非爆炸性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个结合普通看跌期权与亚式看跌期权的混合DLOM框架，避免了传统回望期权的爆炸性折扣问题；证明了封闭形式解受Chaffe折扣下界约束且该约束在近似中保持成立。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供了一个易于使用、精度高且数值稳定的DLOM估计工具，适用于不同波动率和限制期限的场景。

title: Tariffs and the Rule of Law: Is International Trade Moving Towards Legal Order or Power Politics
affiliations: and Dr. B.R Ambedkar National Law University , Sonepat

detail.title: Tariffs and the Rule of Law: Is International Trade Moving Towards Legal Order or Power Politics
detail.abstract:
In the era of rising economic nationalism, the intersection of trade law and executive power has become increasingly contentious. The resurgence of economic protectionism has strained the legal framework of international trade policy – creating cracks in the well settled global demand and supply chain.

This paper dives into the United States invocation of “““Article XXI” of the GATT”” under its “America First Trade Policy”, framing broad reciprocal tariffs as national security measures – challenging the foundational principles of international trade governance. Such unilateralism challenges the integrity of the WTO’s dispute resolution system and threatens the principle of rule of law in trade governance. The paper analyses key WTO disputes, including China’s challenge and India’s copper tariff case, illustrating how strategic unilateralism destabilizes legal predictability and undermines institutional integrity, undermining core principles such as non-discrimination and transparency.

It further investigates the economic fallout of tariff wars, including fragmentation of global supply chain. Special attention is given to India’s economic vulnerability – with sectoral impacts MSME exports. The paper also highlights shifting trade alliances and the rise of alternate trade manufacturing hubs, revealing how protectionist policies reshape global commerce. The analysis reveals how power politics increasingly supersedes legal norms, destabilizing global supply chains and marginalizing developing economies. It calls for a renewed commitment to legal restraint, multilateral cooperation, and institutional accountability to preserve the rule of law in global commerce.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国援引GATT第XXI条国家安全例外条款，以“美国优先贸易政策”之名对多国加征对等关税，从而挑战WTO争端解决机制和国际贸易法治根基的现象。文章通过分析中国及印度铜关税案等关键争端，揭示了战略单边主义如何破坏法律可预测性和制度完整性，并探讨了关税战对全球供应链、发展中国家（尤其是印度中小微企业）的经济影响，以及贸易联盟重组与替代制造中心的兴起。最终呼吁回归法律克制、多边合作和制度问责，以维护全球商业中的法治原则。
AI.research_question: 美国援引GATT第XXI条国家安全例外实施单边关税的做法如何挑战WTO法律框架和国际贸易法治？这种战略单边主义对全球经济秩序、发展中国家（尤其是印度）以及全球供应链重组产生了怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 在经济民族主义抬头、贸易保护主义回潮的时代背景下，美国以国家安全为由推行单边关税政策，严重冲击了以WTO为核心的多边贸易体制。作者旨在揭示这种战略单边主义对国际法治原则、制度完整性和全球经济格局的系统性破坏，并呼吁重建多边合作与法治约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易法治原则（规则导向、非歧视性、透明度原则）；WTO争端解决机制的制度理论；国家安全例外条款（GATT第XXI条）的法律解释与适用边界；战略单边主义与国际关系中的权力政治理论；全球供应链治理理论。
AI.method: 案例分析法（包括中国诉美国关税案、印度铜关税案等WTO关键争端）；规范性法律分析（对GATT第XXI条的法律解释与批判）；经济影响分析（关税战对全球供应链、发展中国家、印度中小微企业的冲击）；地缘政治经济分析（贸易联盟重组、替代制造中心兴起）。
AI.findings: 1）美国援引国家安全例外条款的行为实质上是以权力政治取代法律规范，破坏了WTO争端解决机制的制度完整性；2）关税战导致全球供应链碎片化，发展中国家（尤其是印度中小微企业）面临严重经济脆弱性；3）保护主义政策催生了替代贸易联盟和制造中心的崛起，重塑全球商业版图；4）法律可预测性和制度诚信被战略单边主义系统性削弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）系统揭示了战略单边主义对国际贸易法治原则（非歧视、透明度、法律可预测性）的多维侵蚀机制；2）拓展了GATT第XXI条安全例外条款的滥用分析框架，将其与WTO制度完整性危机联系起来；3）构建了保护主义政策→法律秩序瓦解→供应链碎片化→发展中国家边缘化的因果链分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为WTO改革和多边贸易体制的修复提供了方向性建议（法律克制、多边合作、制度问责）；2）为发展中国家（特别是印度）识别和应对贸易保护主义冲击提供了政策参考；3）揭示了全球供应链重组趋势，为企业与政策制定者调整贸易战略提供了依据；4）呼吁国际社会重新承诺法治原则，对抗单边主义对全球商业秩序的侵蚀。

title: The Manufactured Dependency: Engineered Compulsion in Games as a Service and Four Doctrines That Now Reach It

detail.title: The Manufactured Dependency: Engineered Compulsion in Games as a Service and Four Doctrines That Now Reach It
detail.abstract: For years, the claim that games built as a service engineer compulsion and profit from it was treated as a cultural grievance with no legal handle. That has changed. This article argues that manufactured dependency, the deliberate engineering of compulsive engagement and its monetization through mechanics structured like gambling, is now actionable across four independent legal vectors: negligent and defective design, consumer protection and deception, gambling aimed at minors, and contract unconscionability. Each vector is independently sufficient, and a single stretch of 2026 produced a jury verdict holding addictive design a substantial factor in a minor's injury. The article then develops a disability axis that rides alongside the four vectors. Rather than forcing a plaintiff through the statutory exclusion for compulsive gambling, it routes through a cleanly covered disability and treats the clinical picture as evidence of harm. It also identifies a judicial estoppel trap. A defendant that invokes the gambling exclusion to defeat a disability claim must characterize its own product as gambling, which is the admission the gambling and consumer protection vectors need. The empirical predicate is not incidental. The evidence indicates that loot box spending, and therefore revenue, concentrates in the players who show problem gambling behavior. The dependence is the revenue engine, not a side effect.

AI.tldr: 本文论证，游戏即服务模式中通过赌博化机制制造的成瘾性依赖，如今可通过过失设计、消费者保护、未成年人赌博、合同显失公平四条独立法律路径追责。2026年一项陪审团裁决已认定成瘾设计是未成年人伤害的实质性因素。文章还提出残疾诉讼轴心，并指出被告援引赌博豁免将自陷于承认产品为赌博的司法禁反言陷阱。
AI.research_question: 游戏即服务模式中人为制造的成瘾性依赖是否以及在何种法律路径下可被追责？
AI.motivation: 长期以来，游戏成瘾设计及其通过赌博化机制盈利的行为缺乏法律约束，但2026年出现的关键陪审团裁决表明法律环境已发生根本变化，亟需系统性的法律分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 侵权法（过失设计与缺陷设计）、消费者保护法（欺骗行为）、赌博法（针对未成年人的赌博行为）、合同法（显失公平）、残疾法（将游戏成瘾纳入残疾保护范畴）、司法禁反言原则。
AI.method: 法律文本分析与判例研究，结合实证证据（战利品箱消费与问题赌博行为的相关性数据）进行法律论证。
AI.findings: 四条法律路径各自独立成立；2026年陪审团已认定成瘾设计是未成年人伤害的实质性因素；战利品箱收入集中于问题赌博行为者，成瘾本身就是收入引擎而非附带效应；提出残疾诉讼轴心可绕开法定赌博排除条款；识别出司法禁反言陷阱——被告若援引赌博豁免则自认产品为赌博。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将游戏成瘾设计的法律追责路径整合为四条并行且独立的法学框架，并提出残疾轴心与司法禁反言陷阱两个创新法律策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 为律师和原告提供了可操作的多路径诉讼策略；为监管机构审查游戏商业模式提供了法律依据；揭示了游戏公司援引赌博豁免的自相矛盾风险。

title: Land Interventions and Urban Vitality: Evidence from Neighborhood Traffic
affiliations: California State University, Fullerton, University of Pennsylvania - Statistics Department and University of Pennsylvania - Wharton School, Department of Real Estate

detail.title: Land Interventions and Urban Vitality: Evidence from Neighborhood Traffic
detail.abstract: How do vacant land interventions reshape neighborhood traffic during and after a severe economic shock? Using the COVID-19 pandemic as an exogenous shock to aggregate demand, we compare mobility trajectories around formerly vacant lots that were greened or redeveloped through new construction, relative to lots that remained vacant. Our matched difference-indifferences estimates are consistent with a spatial coordination game characterized by multiple equilibria. We show that the capital required to anchor neighborhood commercial vitality depends on the strength of local network externalities. For agglomeration-sensitive amenities, greening stabilizes nearby visits relative to persistent vacancy, but the rebound in visits is stronger around new construction, suggesting that durable real estate investment provides a stronger anchor for recovery. For other amenities, both interventions mitigate the decline in local visits. These results suggest that vacant land policy should match the intensity of intervention to the structure of local demand: greening offers scalable blight remediation and neighborhood stabilization, while new construction is needed where recovery depends more strongly on agglomeration-sensitive visit activity.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用COVID-19作为外生冲击，比较了空地绿化与新建开发对周边社区交通流动轨迹的影响，发现空地干预的效果取决于当地网络外部性的强度。绿化可稳定访问量，而新建开发在集聚敏感型设施上能提供更强的复苏锚定效应。
AI.research_question: 空地干预（绿化 vs. 新建开发）如何在严重经济冲击期间及之后重塑社区交通流动？
AI.motivation: 空地是城市衰败的典型特征，但不同干预方式（低成本绿化与高密度新建开发）对社区经济韧性的差异化影响尚不明确。COVID-19提供了外生需求冲击，为识别这一因果效应提供了契机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间协调博弈（Spatial Coordination Game）与多重均衡（Multiple Equilibria）理论，强调网络外部性（Network Externalities）在决定社区商业活力锚定中的作用。
AI.method: 匹配双重差分法（Matched Difference-in-Differences），以长期空置地块为对照组，比较绿化与新建开发地块周边的移动轨迹。
AI.findings: （1）绿化能稳定访问量，缓解下滑；（2）新建开发在集聚敏感型设施上带来更强的访问反弹；（3）锚定社区商业活力所需资本取决于本地网络外部性的强度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将空间协调博弈理论引入空地干预研究，揭示了不同资本密度干预措施在多重均衡下的差异化锚定效应，丰富了城市经济学中关于邻里复苏的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市空地政策制定提供了"干预强度-需求结构"匹配策略：绿化适用于大规模、低成本的衰败修复与社区稳定；新建开发适用于依赖集聚效应的区域经济复苏。

title: The Manufactured Line: How Nexus Doctrine and Clickwrap Enforceability Deny the Disabled and the Consumer From Opposite Directions

detail.title: The Manufactured Line: How Nexus Doctrine and Clickwrap Enforceability Deny the Disabled and the Consumer From Opposite Directions
detail.abstract: This Article identifies a single doctrinal maneuver operating across two unrelated bodies of law. In disability access law, the nexus doctrine under Title III of the Americans with Disabilities Act treats the absence of a physical place as a reason to deny coverage to a digital service. In consumer contract and copyright law, the rule that software is licensed rather than sold treats the presence of a physical copy as insufficient to confer ownership or control, because an amendable license governs the object the buyer holds. The two rules point in opposite directions, yet they resolve in the same direction, against the person and toward the firm. The physical and digital boundary, this Article argues, is not a neutral descriptive fact that courts discover. It is a normative lever that courts and firms deploy, and its deployment tracks power rather than principle. Part III develops the disability half through the Title III circuit split. Part IV develops the consumer half through the line running from shrinkwrap enforceability to Vernor v. Autodesk. Part V draws the symmetry and argues that the boundary's manipulability, rather than either doctrine standing alone, is the phenomenon worth naming. A short concluding Part proposes that courts treat the physical and digital line as a lever to be justified in each instance, not a fact to be honored by default.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了一个贯穿两个无关法律领域的共同操作手法：在无障碍访问法中，物理场所的缺失被用作拒绝数字服务覆盖的理由；而在消费者合同和版权法中，物理副本的存在却被认为不足以赋予所有权或控制权。这两个看似相反的规则都朝着对个人不利、对企业有利的方向解决。文章认为，物理与数字的边界并非法院发现的客观事实，而是法院和企业部署的规范性杠杆，其运作追踪的是权力而非原则。
AI.research_question: 在两个无关的法律领域（残疾人无障碍访问法与消费者合同/版权法）中，物理与数字边界的法律操作是否存在对称性？这种边界是中立事实还是权力杠杆？
AI.motivation: 揭示法院在两个无关法律领域中对"物理—数字"边界采取不一致但结果对称的处理方式，指出这种边界不是客观事实而是可操弄的规范性工具，其运作最终服务于企业而非个人。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律与权力分析；物理/数字边界的规范性建构理论；不对称的法律操作对称性。
AI.method: 法律 doctrinal 分析：通过 Title III 巡回法院分裂（无障碍法）和从拆封合约可执行性到 Vernor v. Autodesk 案（消费者法）两条线索进行对称性论证。
AI.findings: 两个领域的物理/数字边界规则指向相反方向，但结果一致：均不利于个人、有利于企业。物理与数字的边界是规范性杠杆而非描述性事实，其部署追踪的是权力而非原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"边界可操弄性"（boundary's manipulability）本身是值得命名的现象，超越了单个 doctrine 的局限；主张物理/数字线应被视为需要每次证明其正当性的杠杆，而非默认应予尊重的事实。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院提供新的裁判视角：要求法官在每次案件中主动证明物理/数字边界的正当性，而非默认接受其作为事实依据。

title: Technological Asymmetry, Product Differentiation and Merger
affiliations: University of Calcutta - Department of Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Technological Asymmetry, Product Differentiation and Merger

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract:
In a globalised business environment competition and cooperation go hand in hand. Intense competition induces firms to cooperate with one another in many ways more in strategic sense than in non-strategic sense. In an interdependent system each internalizes others’ possible reactions while making a decision. As such different types of strategic decisions have become the order of the day.

Merger is one such strategic move what firms take for a wide range of purposes, for example, to increase market share to achieve various types of synergic gains through economies of scale and scope and so on. Usually there are three types of mergers: horizontal, vertical and conglomerate. We have considered in our exercise horizontal merger. Salant, Switzer and Reynolds (1983) have shown when firms are symmetric and product is homogeneous, bilateral horizontal merger is not profitable. Perry and Porter (1985) contest their position, and they have shown that horizontal merger is profitable in the presence of synergic gain arising out of cooperation even when products are homogeneous. Deneckre and Davidson (1985) show that a merger of any size is privately profitable when firms produce differential products and compete in prices.  Singh and Vives (1984) demonstrate that in a differentiated duopoly it is a dominant strategy for each firm to choose the quantity, provided the goods are substitutes. 

The objective of this exercise is to explore in a game theoretic framework the conditions under which horizontal merger is possible in an oligopolistic market with differential products and technologically asymmetric firms. In our analysis we have combined all the fundamental results mentioned above in a single structure. We show that in an oligopoly when firms are engaged in Cournot competition there exist a range of product differentiation and technological asymmetry for which merger is profitable. It also shows that product differentiation and synergic gain are equivalent in terms of consequences for the firms to decide whether to cooperate or not.

AI.tldr: 本文基于博弈论框架，研究在差异化产品和异质性技术的寡头垄断市场中，横向并购在何种条件下有利可图。研究发现，在产品差异化程度和技术不对称性的一定范围内，古诺竞争下的企业并购是盈利的，且产品差异化与协同效应在企业并购决策中具有等价作用。
AI.research_question: 在差异化产品和异质性技术不对称的寡头垄断市场中，横向并购在何种条件下是可行的（有利可图的）？
AI.motivation: 已有文献（如Salant等1983）认为对称同质产品下双边横向并购不盈利，而Perry & Porter（1985）和Deneckre & Davidson（1985）分别从协同效应和差异化产品角度提出不同观点。本文旨在将这些基础结果统一在单一框架中，探索更一般化的并购盈利条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论（Game Theory）；古诺竞争（Cournot Competition）；横向并购理论；产品差异化理论；技术不对称性分析；协同效应理论。
AI.method: 采用博弈论框架下的理论建模与数理分析，将产品差异化、技术不对称性和协同效应纳入统一的寡头垄断模型中进行均衡分析。
AI.findings: （1）在产品差异化和技术不对称性的一定范围内，古诺竞争下的横向并购是盈利的；（2）产品差异化与协同效应在影响企业并购决策方面具有等价性，即两者对并购可行性的影响路径和后果相似。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将Salant等、Perry & Porter、Deneckre & Davidson以及Singh & Vives等经典结果统一在一个理论框架中；（2）提出并论证了产品差异化与协同效应在企业并购决策中的等价性，为并购理论提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者在差异化产品和异质性技术条件下制定横向并购策略提供了理论依据和条件参考，帮助企业识别在何种市场结构下并购更可能创造价值。

title: The Cultural Foundations of Liberty: Hayek, the American Founding and Albanian Lawlessness
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Cultural Foundations of Liberty: Hayek, the American Founding and Albanian Lawlessness

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial interests, personal relationships, or competing interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it did not involve human participants, clinical research, or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or financial support from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

keywords: Friedrich Hayek Liberty Political Philosophy American Founding Constitutionalism Civic Culture Rule of Law Local Self-Government Democratic Institutions Albania

detail.abstract: This paper examines the cultural foundations of liberty through the political thought of Friedrich A. Hayek, the constitutional principles of the American Founding, and a comparative analysis of post-communist Albania. It argues that enduring freedom depends not only on formal institutions or constitutional design but also on the civic habits, moral norms, and cultural traditions that enable those institutions to function effectively. Drawing on Hayek’s concepts of local self-government, the rule of law, and higher law, the paper contends that liberty is sustained by citizens who internalize responsibility, respect general rules, and participate in self-governing communities. The American experience illustrates how civic education, local governance, and constitutional restraint reinforced a culture capable of preserving freedom across generations. In contrast, Albania demonstrates the limitations of institutional reform in the absence of corresponding cultural development, as patronage networks, collectivist legacies, and weak civic norms continue to undermine democratic governance and the rule of law. By integrating political philosophy with comparative historical analysis, the paper argues that liberty is fundamentally a cultural achievement. Democratic institutions may establish the framework for freedom, but their long-term success ultimately depends on the moral character, civic responsibility, and constitutional habits of the societies in which they operate.

AI.tldr: 本文通过哈耶克的政治思想、美国建国宪法原则与后共产主义阿尔巴尼亚的比较分析，论证持久的自由不仅依赖于正式制度或宪法设计，更依赖于使这些制度有效运作的公民习惯、道德规范和文化传统。自由本质上是一种文化成就。
AI.research_question: 自由的文化基础是什么？正式制度之外，哪些文化因素（公民习惯、道德规范、文化传统）对维持持久自由至关重要？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注自由的形式制度与宪法设计，忽视了支撑这些制度有效运作的文化根基。阿尔巴尼亚等国的制度移植失败表明，缺乏相应的文化土壤，自由制度难以持久。
AI.theoretical_framework: 哈耶克的地方自治、法治与高级法思想；美国建国者的宪政原则与公民教育理念；比较政治学中的制度与文化互动理论。
AI.method: 政治哲学分析与比较历史分析相结合，通过美国（成功案例）与阿尔巴尼亚（失败案例）的对比，论证文化在维护自由中的关键作用。
AI.findings: 1. 自由依赖于内化了责任、尊重普遍规则并参与自治的公民。2. 美国通过公民教育、地方治理和宪法约束培育了维护自由的文化。3. 阿尔巴尼亚因庇护网络、集体主义遗产和薄弱的公民规范，制度移植未能带来真正的自由与法治。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自由的分析从制度层面拓展到文化层面，论证自由本质上是一种"文化成就"，为理解制度与文化的互动关系提供了整合性框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为转型国家提供了重要启示：制度移植必须辅以文化培育，包括公民教育、道德规范建设和地方自治习惯的养成，否则民主制度难以持久。

title: Seemingly Anchored Inflation Expectations
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Seemingly Anchored Inflation Expectations
detail.abstract: Empirical evidence commonly cited as indicating that inflation expectations have become better anchored includes the declining sensitivity of expectations to inflation surprises over time, particularly around the adoption of inflation targeting. These patterns are typically attributed to the influence of explicit or implicit inflation targets on inflation expectations. We show that this evidence is consistent with a model of experience-based learning in which individuals learn solely from their lifetime history of realized inflation, without anchoring their expectations to an announced inflation target. In this model, the prolonged experience of low short-run inflation persistence in the pre-COVID decades renders long-run expectations insensitive to inflation surprises, matching the patterns observed in empirical anchoring tests. A unique prediction of the experience-based learning model is also borne out in the data: the decline in surprise sensitivity since the 1980s is strongest among younger individuals. The memory of low inflation persistence experiences further explains why long-run inflation expectations remained stable in the face of the post-COVID inflation surge. At the same time, simulations indicate that the sensitivity of long-run expectations to inflation surprises would rise sharply if individuals were to experience another sustained episode of highly persistent inflation. Overall, long-run inflation expectations may be less firmly anchored than commonly believed.

AI.tldr: 本文通过基于经验的学习模型证明，通胀预期对通胀意外敏感度下降的现象并非源于通胀目标锚定，而是源于个体从自身经历中学习的结果。模型预测得到数据支持，且表明长期通胀预期的锚定程度可能比普遍认为的要弱。
AI.research_question: 通胀预期对通胀意外敏感度下降的现象，究竟是由于通胀目标锚定，还是源于个体基于自身经验的学习过程？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常将通胀预期敏感度下降归因于通胀目标制，本文质疑这一主流解释，提出基于经验学习的替代机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经验的学习模型（Experience-Based Learning Model），个体仅依据其一生经历的实际通胀历史进行学习，而非锚定于官方宣布的通胀目标。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建基于经验的学习模型；实证检验：利用微观数据检验模型独特预测（年轻人敏感度下降更显著）；模拟分析：模拟高持续性通胀情景下预期敏感度的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 经验学习模型可以复现通胀预期敏感度下降的模式；2. 1980年代以来敏感度下降在年轻人中最为显著，支持经验学习假说；3. 低通胀持续性记忆解释了后疫情时代长期通胀预期的稳定；4. 若再次经历高持续性通胀，长期预期对通胀意外的敏感度将大幅上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了基于经验学习机制解释通胀预期锚定现象的理论，挑战了传统通胀目标制的解释，揭示了锚定的脆弱性。
AI.practical_contributions: 对央行政策具有重要警示意义：长期通胀预期可能并未真正锚定，一旦通胀持续性回升，预期可能迅速脱锚，央行不应过度依赖当前的低敏感度来判断预期锚定程度。

title: The Cost of Industrial Destruction: Evidence from Ukrainian Strikes on Russian Refineries
affiliations: Sapienza University of Rome and Masaryk University

detail.title: The Cost of Industrial Destruction: Evidence from Ukrainian Strikes on Russian Refineries
detail.abstract: We study the local economic effects of Ukrainian long-range strikes on Russian oil refineries, combining a manually verified event-level record of refinery strikes with quality-screened daily satellite radiance from NASA Black Marble. The analysis covers 29 large Russian refineries, 22 of which sustain verified direct hits over June 2022-May 2026. Using a monthly staggered difference-indifferences design that compares refineries after their first verified strike with not-yet-struck and neverstruck refineries, we find that nighttime radiance falls immediately and persistently after a refinery enters the strike campaign: by roughly 30 percent in the innermost measured ring around the facility and by 15-18 percent within five kilometers, with the effect attenuating until it becomes small at twenty-five kilometers. The innermost ring shows no recovery within the first post-strike year. A complementary daily instrumental-variables design uses directional wind alignment to shift strike incidence and traces the strike-day dynamic at higher frequency. Radiance rises at short horizons, consistent with a fire-related light signature corroborated by independent NASA FIRMS detections, and turns negative at a six-month horizon, with weak-instrument-robust inference. Applying the same satellite product and empirical specification to 106 non-refinery deep-strike targets produces no comparable contraction, weighing against a generic-war-disruption interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用手动核实的炼油厂袭击事件记录和NASA卫星夜间辐射数据，采用双重差分法发现乌克兰远程打击使俄罗斯炼油厂周边夜间辐射立即且持续下降约30%，且一年内未恢复。
AI.research_question: 乌克兰远程打击对俄罗斯炼油厂及周边地区的局部经济影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 俄乌冲突中，乌克兰对俄罗斯炼油厂的远程打击频繁发生，但其经济影响缺乏定量证据。本研究旨在利用高频率卫星数据量化这些打击的局部经济效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于局部经济冲击理论、战争经济影响理论以及空间溢出效应理论，分析炼油厂被击中后的经济活动（以夜间辐射为代理变量）变化及其空间衰减模式。
AI.method: 1. 手动核实炼油厂袭击事件记录（29个大型炼油厂，22个被击中）。2. 采用NASA Black Marble每日卫星辐射数据。3. 月度交错双重差分法（staggered DiD）估计平均处理效应。4. 每日工具变量设计（利用风向对齐作为工具变量）进行高频动态分析。5. 对106个非炼油厂目标进行安慰剂检验。
AI.findings: 1. 夜间辐射在首次被击中后立即且持续下降：最内环约30%，5公里内15-18%，25公里处效应微弱。2. 最内环一年内未见恢复。3. 高频分析显示短期内辐射上升（火灾信号），6个月后转为负值。4. 非炼油厂目标无类似收缩，排除一般战争干扰解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 为战争中的局部经济冲击提供了高分辨率量化证据，证明了战略轰炸对特定工业设施的精准打击具有显著且持久的局部经济衰减效应，且效应随距离衰减。同时，发现了火灾信号的短期异常辐射模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估战争策略（特别是远程精确打击）的经济后果提供了实证依据；展示了利用卫星夜间灯光数据实时监测经济活动的可行性；对俄乌冲突中损失评估和政策应对具有参考价值。

title:
The Digitalization of Sovereign Capital
A General Theory and Three Living Laboratories of Natural-Capital Sovereignty: Norway, Australia, and Costa Rica

detail.title:
The Digitalization of Sovereign Capital
A General Theory and Three Living Laboratories of Natural-Capital Sovereignty: Norway, Australia, and Costa Rica

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not required
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no financial support for this research

detail.abstract:
The twenty-first century is witnessing a structural transformation in the legal architecture of sovereign capital. Historically associated with territory, extraction, industrial production, taxation, monetary administration, and physical infrastructure, sovereign wealth increasingly extends toward digitally represented systems of public value, strategic financial structures, maritime jurisdictions, biodiversity metrics, orbital infrastructure, sovereign data systems, and long-term intergenerational state assets. This paper advances the thesis that the digitalization of sovereign capital constitutes an emerging stage in the historical evolution of sovereignty itself, and that the phenomenon should therefore be examined through the combined lenses of public finance, legal governance, continuity of institutions, sovereign liquidity, digital infrastructure, and strategic state architecture (1)(2)(3)(4). The paper develops the concept of digitally represented public value and introduces the correlative notion of synthetic sovereignty: the juridical and economic capacity of a State to generate, capture, and retain value at a diminishing margin of material extraction or consumption. It argues that States are entering a period in which strategic public wealth may increasingly depend not merely upon the ownership of resources, but upon the juridical capacity to identify, represent, govern, preserve, finance, audit, and administer sovereign capital through digitally integrated institutional systems. The analysis examines sovereign wealth funds, the balance-sheet State, regulated digital assets, central bank digital currencies, sovereign liquidity systems, maritime capital, blue economy governance, data infrastructure, cybersecurity, orbital systems, artificial intelligence, digital public infrastructure, and representational sovereignty, and it tests these propositions against the comparative architectures of Norway, Australia, and Costa Rica (5)(6)(7)(8)(9).
These propositions are not pursued exhaustively — the field is too large for that — but are read through three living laboratories of natural-capital sovereignty: Norway, Australia, and Costa Rica. The three are chosen because each governs an exceptional endowment of natural wealth; because Norway furnishes the founding and most successful paradigm against which the others may be read; and because Australia and Costa Rica share the institutional gravitation of the Asia-Pacific. They are treated not as adversarial benchmarks but as illustrations, through which the general theory descends from epistemological reflection toward the analytical and applied registers of governance and public finance, disclosing the structural challenges and the potential benefits that the digitalization of sovereign capital entails. The central claim is not technological. It is juridical and institutional: the digitalization of sovereign capital reorganizes the ways in which public value becomes visible, governable, capable of being financed, verifiable, preservable, and transferable across generations. The comparative material also discloses a recurring paradox — that the dematerialization of value is frequently financed by an intensification, rather than a cessation, of physical throughput. The paper concludes that the future of sovereign capital may be determined less by resource abundance alone than by the legal architecture through which sovereign value is organized, disciplined, protected, and transmitted within increasingly digital systems of public administration (10)(11)(12).

AI.tldr: 本文提出主权资本数字化是主权历史演变的新阶段，通过挪威、澳大利亚、哥斯达黎加三个案例，论证国家财富正从物质资源所有权转向通过数字制度体系识别、代表、治理和传递公共价值的法律能力，并提出了"合成主权"这一核心概念。
AI.research_question: 主权资本的数字化转型如何重塑公共价值的可见性、可治理性、可融资性、可验证性、可保存性和跨代传递性？
AI.motivation: 21世纪主权资本的架构正在发生结构性转型，从传统的领土、资源、工业等物质形态转向数字化的公共价值体系，但现有研究缺乏从主权演化视角对这一现象的系统性理论分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权演化理论、数字公共价值理论、合成主权（Synthetic Sovereignty）概念；理论视角涵盖公共财政、法律治理、制度连续性、主权流动性、数字基础设施和战略国家架构。
AI.method: 比较案例分析，选取挪威、澳大利亚、哥斯达黎加三个"自然资本主权的活实验室"进行跨国家比较研究。
AI.findings: 主权资本数字化重新组织公共价值在数字系统中的可见性、可治理性、可融资性、可保存性和跨代传递性；存在一个悖论：价值的非物质化往往由物质吞吐量的强化而非停止来融资；主权资本的未来更多取决于组织主权价值的法律架构而非资源丰裕度本身。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"合成主权"概念，即国家在物质开采或消耗边际递减的情况下生成、捕获和保留价值的司法与经济能力；将主权资本数字化定位为主权历史演化的一个新阶段。
AI.practical_contributions: 为主权财富基金、央行数字货币、数字公共基础设施、网络安全、轨道系统、人工智能等领域的治理与公共财政实践提供了分析框架；揭示了自然资源型经济体在数字化转型中的结构性挑战与潜在收益。

title: Who Controls African Money? Currency, Empire, and the Fight for Economic Freedom

detail.title: Who Controls African Money? Currency, Empire, and the Fight for Economic Freedom

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, institutional affiliations, or conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, interviews, surveys, experiments, or identifiable personal information requiring ethical approval or informed consent. The manuscript is based entirely on analysis of published literature, historical records, policy documents, and publicly available secondary sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant, financial support, or funding from any public, commercial, governmental, or not-for-profit funding agency. The manuscript was independently conceived, researched, and written by the author.

detail.abstract:
My current book project, Who Controls African Money? Currency, Empire, and the Fight for Economic Freedom, examines the politics of money as a central but often neglected dimension of Africa's developmental challenges. The book argues that monetary arrangements are not merely technical instruments of economic management but institutional expressions of power, sovereignty, and political authority. It investigates how colonial currency systems, externally imposed monetary disciplines, financial liberalisation, debt dependency, and global financial hierarchies continue to shape Africa's position within the international economy long after the formal end of colonial rule.

At the heart of the project is the argument that contemporary forms of economic dependency cannot be fully understood without examining the governance of money itself. The book explores how exchange rate regimes, reserve accumulation strategies, central banking orthodoxies, debt conditionalities, and external financial surveillance constrain developmental possibilities across the continent. It further examines the political economy of monetary sovereignty and the prospects for regional and continental financial integration as instruments of economic emancipation.

Closely connected to this work is my broader interest in the political economy of development and underdevelopment in Africa. I am particularly interested in how global capitalism, financialisation, unequal exchange, and the international monetary system interact with domestic institutions and class structures to shape developmental trajectories in postcolonial societies. My research seeks to bridge sociology, economics, political science, and history in order to produce a more integrated understanding of development processes and constraints.

AI.tldr: 本书探讨货币安排如何作为权力、主权和政治权威的制度性表达，持续塑造非洲在后殖民时代的经济依附地位，并分析区域金融一体化作为经济解放工具的前景。
AI.research_question: 货币治理（包括汇率制度、储备积累策略、央行正统、债务条件及外部金融监管）如何影响非洲的发展可能性？当代经济依附如何通过货币安排得以延续？
AI.motivation: 货币是非洲发展挑战中被忽视的核心维度。仅关注贸易或生产层面的依附不足以理解非洲经济困境，必须深入分析货币治理本身如何作为权力工具持续发挥作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 殖民货币制度理论、货币主权政治经济学、全球金融等级体系、不平等交换理论、后殖民国家发展理论。
AI.method: 跨学科分析框架，融合社会学、经济学、政治学与历史学的综合研究方法，以历史制度分析和政治经济学批判为主。
AI.findings: 殖民时期的货币制度安排在后殖民时代以新形式延续；外部强加的货币纪律、金融自由化、债务依附和全球金融等级制度共同限制了非洲的政策空间与发展自主性；区域金融一体化是潜在的经济解放路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 将货币治理作为分析后殖民依附的核心维度，补充了传统发展理论对货币主权问题的忽视，推进了关于全球金融等级体系与非洲发展的理论整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲国家探索货币主权策略和区域金融一体化路径提供政策方向，揭示国际金融机构条件性政策的深层权力逻辑。

title: Programmable Sovereignty: Coordinated Specialization as a Response to the N-2 Problem in AI
affiliations: Bruegel and Independent

detail.title: Programmable Sovereignty: Coordinated Specialization as a Response to the N-2 Problem in AI
detail.abstract: The dominant scholarly and policy framing of artificial intelligence (AI) power treats sovereignty as a function of production: a state is sovereign over AI to the degree that it builds, owns, and can reproduce the technological stack on which AI depends. On this view, meaningful AI sovereignty is available only to the United States and, to a lesser extent, China — producing what we term the N‑2 problem, in which every other state faces structural dependence on one or both. A separate and largely disconnected literature treats digital sovereignty as a function of governance: the capacity to shape how technology behaves through rules, standards, and market leverage, independent of who builds the underlying systems. This paper integrates these two literatures and, in doing so, makes two contributions. First, it defines programmable sovereignty precisely, as soft governance anchored by a deliberately minimal degree of hard-stack control — above all pooled compute capacity — sufficient to make governance commitments credible and dependence reversible, without requiring the costly and largely unattainable goal of full-stack AI autonomy. Second, the paper develops coordinated  specialisation as the institutional mechanism through which N‑2 states can convert individual complementary capacities into a credible and minimally self-sufficient shared coalition AI stack. We illustrate the feasibility and limits of coordinated specialisation through three existing institutional precedents (EuroHPC, India Stack, and the ASEAN Digital Economy Framework) and close with policy implications for the European Union, Asia-Pacific coalition partners, and prospective coalitions generally.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可编程主权"概念，主张N-2国家（除美中外）可通过协调专业化机制建立最小化但可信的共享AI堆栈，在不追求全面自主的前提下实现AI治理主权。
AI.research_question: N-2国家（除美国和中国之外的国家）如何在不实现全栈AI自主的情况下，获得有意义的AI主权？
AI.motivation: 现有文献将AI主权要么视为生产问题（谁构建技术堆栈），要么视为治理问题（谁制定规则），二者脱节。这导致N-2国家面临结构性依赖困境，需要一种整合性的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可编程主权（Programmable Sovereignty）：以最小程度的硬堆栈控制（尤其是 pooled compute capacity）为锚点的软治理；协调专业化（Coordinated Specialisation）：N-2国家通过制度机制将互补能力转化为可信且最小自足的共享联盟AI堆栈。
AI.method: 理论整合与概念建构，辅以三个制度先例（EuroHPC、India Stack、ASEAN数字经济框架）的可行性论证。
AI.findings: 可编程主权在理论上可行：N-2国家无需追求全栈AI自主，只需通过协调专业化建立最小化但可信的共享堆栈，使治理承诺可信且依赖性可逆。三个先例分别展示了不同层面的可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 整合了AI主权的生产视角与治理视角两派文献；2. 提出"可编程主权"这一新概念，精准定义了介于完全依赖与完全自主之间的中间状态；3. 提出"协调专业化"作为实现该主权的制度机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟、亚太联盟伙伴及其他潜在联盟提供了政策路径：通过协调专业化构建共享AI能力，在本土管控与全球整合之间找到可行的中间道路。

title: Are LLMs Reliable Coders of Communication Content in Economic Experiments? Working Paper #0115
affiliations: , affiliation not provided to SSRN and New York University of Abu Dhabi

detail.title: Are LLMs Reliable Coders of Communication Content in Economic Experiments? Working Paper #0115
detail.abstract: Analysis of free-form communication from experiments has largely relied on manual coding by research assistants (RAs), a costly and time-consuming process. We outline an easily implemented method for coding communication data using large language models (LLMs) and propose a novel standard for evaluating the performance of LLM-based coding ("reliability"). Using data from three published articles, we find that LLM-based coding meets our two reliability conditions: (1) differences between LLM-based and RA-based coding are no larger than differences between the RA-based and original coding and (2) the LLM-based coding largely replicates qualitative conclusions from the original papers. That said, there are cases where the LLM-based coding agrees poorly with the RA-based coding or fails to replicate statistical results from the original papers. We demonstrate that these problems can be ameliorated with better prompt design. We conclude that use of LLMs can reduce research costs and time without sacrificing reliability, making content analysis a more accessible tool for experimental economists. However, only with a combination of test coding by RAs and prompt design by researchers can we avoid significant problems with LLM-based coding, highlighting the continued importance of human input.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用大语言模型（LLM）对实验中的自由形式沟通数据进行编码，证明其可靠性不亚于传统的人工编码，同时大幅降低研究成本和时间。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型能否可靠地替代人工研究助理（RA）对实验经济学中的自由形式沟通数据进行内容编码？
AI.motivation: 传统依赖RA进行手动编码的方式成本高、耗时长，限制了内容分析工具在实验经济学中的广泛应用，亟需更高效的替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内容分析方法论；LLM编码可靠性标准（与RA编码差异不超过RA与原始编码的差异，且能复制原文定性结论）。
AI.method: 使用三篇已发表论文的数据，将LLM编码结果与RA编码结果进行对比，检验两个可靠性条件；并通过提示工程优化编码效果。
AI.findings: LLM编码满足两个可靠性条件，能复制原文的定性结论；但在某些案例中与RA编码一致性较差或无法复制统计结果，可通过更好的提示设计改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了评估LLM编码质量的新标准（"可靠性"）；证明了LLM可作为内容分析的有效工具，拓展了实验经济学方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 大幅降低内容分析的成本和时间门槛；强调RA测试编码与研究者提示设计相结合的必要性，为人机协作提供了实践指南。

title: Openness, Integration, and the International Monetary Order
affiliations: Boston University, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco,  and

detail.title: Openness, Integration, and the International Monetary Order

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The views expressed here are solely those of the authors and do not necessarily represent those of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco or the Federal Reserve System. Jingye Wang is the corresponding author of this paper. We thankPierreDeLeo,ŞebnemKalemli-Özcan, RobertKollmann,and Dmitry Mukhin for helpful comments.

detail.abstract: This paper develops a calibrated general-equilibrium model to study how different configurations of trade and financial policy reshape the hierarchy of global currencies-and the U.S. dollar's position at its anchor. Currency safety and anchor status arise endogenously from each economy's 'effective size'-the weight its domestic shocks carry in setting world prices. Tariffs reduce this effective size on the goods side; capital controls do the same on the financial side. A unifying result emerges: The economy that maintains the deepest integration with the global trading network retains the largest safety premium and gains anchor status. We use this framework to evaluate the effects of three policy levers for Europe that affect the effective size of the euro: internal harmonization and enlargement, trade openness, and capital-account openness. The stakes are large: In our model, shifts in currencies' safety can redirect global capital flows and alter sovereign borrowing costs by hundreds of billions of dollars annually.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个校准的一般均衡模型，研究贸易与金融政策的不同配置如何重塑全球货币的层级结构以及美元的主导地位。研究发现，货币的安全性和锚定地位内生取决于各经济体的"有效规模"——其国内冲击对世界价格的权重。关税和资本管制分别从商品和金融两侧削弱有效规模。保持与全球贸易网络深度融合的经济体能够获得最大的安全溢价和锚定地位。文章利用该框架评估了三种影响欧元有效规模的政策杠杆（内部协调与扩张、贸易开放、资本账户开放），发现货币安全性的转移每年可改变数千亿美元的全球资本流向和主权借贷成本。
AI.research_question: 贸易与金融政策的不同配置如何通过影响经济体的"有效规模"来重塑全球货币的层级结构以及美元的主导地位？
AI.motivation: 理解货币安全性和锚定地位的内生决定机制，并量化评估欧洲政策选择（内部协调、贸易开放、资本账户开放）对欧元有效规模及全球货币格局的潜在影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡模型，其中货币安全性与锚定地位由经济体的"有效规模"（国内冲击对世界价格的权重）内生决定；关税与资本管制分别从商品和金融两侧削弱有效规模。
AI.method: 构建并校准一个一般均衡模型，模拟不同贸易与金融政策配置下的货币层级变化，并评估三种政策杠杆对欧元有效规模的影响。
AI.findings: 与全球贸易网络保持深度融合的经济体能够获得最大的安全溢价并占据锚定地位；货币安全性的转移可以每年改变数千亿美元的全球资本流动和主权借贷成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"有效规模"这一统一框架，将贸易政策（关税）与金融政策（资本管制）纳入同一分析体系，内生地解释了货币安全性和锚定地位的形成机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲政策制定者评估内部协调、贸易开放和资本账户开放对欧元国际地位的影响提供了量化分析工具，揭示了货币政策之外的实体经济和金融一体化政策对货币地位的巨大影响。

title: Jurisdictional Bifurcation, Textual Mystification and the Question of Proper Forum for the Adjudication of Maritime Labour Disputes in Nigeria: A Search for Coherence
affiliations: Phoenix & Volge (Legal Practitioners and Arbitrators) and

detail.title: Jurisdictional Bifurcation, Textual Mystification and the Question of Proper Forum for the Adjudication of Maritime Labour Disputes in Nigeria: A Search for Coherence
detail.abstract: The amendment to the Constitution by virtue of the Third Alteration Act, 2010 made the National Industrial Court of Nigeria, a superior Court of regard with coordinate jurisdiction with the Federal High Court and the High Courts of the Federating State, and granted it, exclusive jurisdiction over labour and employment matters or causes. The same Constitution vested exclusive admiralty jurisdiction in the Federal High Court of Nigeria. However, under the extant international and domestic legal regimes, labour related matters, particularly seafarers' wages, are considered as maritime claims, which are not only intrinsic to admiralty practice, but an integral part of the admiralty jurisdiction cognisable under international law, domestic legislation and industry custom and practices. To this end, there are conflicting judicial authorities and scholarly opinions as to whether upon a proper interpretation and construction of non-obstante clause used in the both Section 251 and 254 C of the Constitution, the admiralty jurisdiction of the Federal High Court was effectively whittled down, to vest jurisdiction over maritime labour claims in the National Industrial Court, to the exclusion of the Federal High Court. The Court of Appeal recently answered the question in the affirmative, with far-reaching adverse implications. The position of the court created an absurd situation, by unwittingly unbundling the established norms and practice for the protection of seafarers. The decision specifically deprived seafarers of their right to enforce their maritime lien in respect of their unpaid wages, by taking out an action in rem, with the possibility of arresting the ship or the relevant property to secure an indemnity or security for their claims. The doctrinal method was used in this inquiry, to ascertain the palpable cause of the lingering absurdity. It was observed that the Court embarked on a cloistered construction of the text of the constitution, and largely dwelt on the legal effect of the non-obstnte clause used in the conflicting provisions, without any recourse to external aids to gain historical, contemporary and contextual perspective, in order to arrive at the true intendment of the draftsman. The court basically placed reliance establish principle for construction of statute, which in any case, has been found to be inadequate, when it comes to constitutional interpretation, which is placed on a higher pedestal. It is therefore submitted that, had the court applied the liberal and cloistered approach based on established principle of constitutional interpretation, it would have reached a different conclusion. It is recommended that, the Appellate court could reverse its earlier decision reach per incuriam, when the occasion arises, or it may be more practicable to amend the relevant provision relating to the jurisdiction of the National Industrial Court, with a rider that expressly exclude maritime labour claims.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨尼日利亚宪法修正后，国家工业法院与联邦高等法院在海事劳动案件（特别是海员工资）管辖权上的冲突。上诉法院将管辖权划归工业法院，但此举剥夺了海员通过对物诉讼扣押船舶以保障工资债权的权利。作者认为法院采用了过于封闭的文义解释，建议通过修法明确排除海事劳动案件。
AI.research_question: 在尼日利亚宪法第251条（联邦高等法院海事管辖权）与第254C条（国家工业法院劳动管辖权）均包含" notwithstanding"条款的情况下，海事劳动索赔（特别是海员工资）的管辖权应归属于联邦高等法院还是国家工业法院？
AI.motivation: 上诉法院将海事劳动管辖权判归工业法院的裁决，实质上剥夺了海员通过对物诉讼（action in rem）扣押船舶以保障工资债权的权利，打破了保护海员的既定国际规范和实践，造成了法律上的荒谬局面。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法解释原则（liberal and purposive approach vs. cloistered textual construction）、非 obstante条款（notwithstanding clause）的解释规则、海事法中对物诉讼与海事优先权（maritime lien）理论。
AI.method: doctrinal method（教义学/法学理论研究方法），通过分析宪法条文、判例法、国际法（如国际海事公约）及学术观点进行规范分析。
AI.findings: 上诉法院采取了封闭的文义解释方法，仅依据非 obstante条款的字面效力做出判决，未借助历史、当代和上下文等外部解释资源来探究制宪者真意。该判决导致海员无法行使海事优先权和对物诉讼权利，与保护海员的国际法律框架相悖。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在宪法解释中，适用于普通制定法的"明确含义原则"（plain meaning rule）可能不足；宪法解释应采用更自由、目的论的方法，借助外部资源探究制宪者意图。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出两条解决方案：1）上诉法院可在适当时机推翻之前的判决（per incuriam）；2）更务实的做法是修宪，在国家工业法院管辖权条款中明确排除海事劳动案件。

title: Posterior Consistency and Discretization Invariance for Bayesian Inverse Problems with Score-Based Priors

detail.title: Posterior Consistency and Discretization Invariance for Bayesian Inverse Problems with Score-Based Priors
detail.abstract:
Score-based generative models are widely used as learned priors in Bayesian inverse problems, yet the posterior measure itself -- its existence in infinite-dimensional Hilbert space, its continuity in the data, and its statistical concentration -- remains essentially unstudied outside the Gaussian-prior regime.

We provide a theory for linear forward maps G in the main text; Appendix D sketches an extension to one-sided Holder-stable nonlinear G that we expect to admit a full treatment in follow-up work. We assume Gaussian observation noise and a prior defined implicitly by an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck SDE with learned score s_theta. (i) Well-posedness: Cameron-Martin Lipschitz and affine-growth hypotheses (verifiable for spectral-norm MLPs, truncated FNOs) yield a well-defined posterior, locally Hellinger-stable in y with C_R = C_0(1+R)^2 exp(eta R^2) as in Stuart (2010, Theorem 4.2); absolute continuity is handled through a finite-horizon Girsanov integrability condition. (ii) Discretization invariance: d_H(mu_N^y, mu^y) <= C(sqrt(epsilon_N^score) + sqrt(lambda_{N+1})) with identifiable score and covariance terms. (iii) Conditional contraction: Knapik et al.'s Ghosal-van der Vaart contraction template transfers to score-based priors once two local inputs are verified: Gaussian small-ball comparability at the truth and exponentially consistent tests. The contraction theorem gives the resulting sigma^{2 beta/(2 beta+1)} rate in the non-smoothing testing geometry. (iv) Identifiability: injectivity of G on the closed support of the base measure -- kernel recovery at full support and symmetry obstructions (e.g., Z/2) otherwise.

This complements concurrent sampler-focused theory. We release reproducible 1D PyTorch code and committed pilot npz files illustrating qualitative contraction; reported numerics are not a sharp-rate certification.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了基于分数的生成模型在贝叶斯逆问题中作为先验时的后验测度理论，证明了在希尔伯特空间中的适定性、离散化不变性、条件收缩速率和可识别性，为非线性逆问题的非高斯先验提供了严格的数学基础。
AI.research_question: 在无限维希尔伯特空间中，基于分数的生成模型作为贝叶斯逆问题先验时，其后验测度是否存在、是否关于数据连续、是否具有统计集中性？
AI.motivation: 基于分数的生成模型已被广泛用作贝叶斯逆问题的学习先验，但后验测度本身在无限维空间中的存在性、连续性和统计集中性在非高斯先验情形下基本未被研究。填补这一理论空白对于理解该类方法的数学基础至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: Cameron-Martin空间理论、Girsanov定理、Hellinger稳定性、Knapik等人的收缩速率模板、高斯小球比较性检验
AI.method: 理论分析为主，假设线性正向映射G（附录拓展至单侧Hölder稳定的非线性G）、高斯观测噪声、由Ornstein-Uhlenbeck SDE和学习的得分函数s_theta定义的隐式先验，从适定性、离散化不变性、条件收缩和可识别性四个维度展开证明。
AI.findings: (i) 在Cameron-Martin Lipschitz和仿射增长假设下，后验存在且局部Hellinger稳定；(ii) 离散化误差由得分函数误差和协方差截断项界定的上界控制；(iii) 条件收缩速率达到sigma^{2 beta/(2 beta+1)}；(iv) 在基测度的闭支撑上，G的单射性决定了可识别性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次建立了基于分数的生成先验在无限维贝叶斯逆问题中的后验测度理论，将经典的Gaussian先验理论（Stuart 2010）拓展至非高斯先验情形，并证明了收缩速率与可识别性条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可复现的1D PyTorch代码和npz数据文件，展示了定性的收缩现象，为实际应用中的先验选择和算法设计提供了理论指导。

title: Forward Information Leakage in a Widely-Used Open-Source Chinese Financial Data Interface: A Deconfounded Statistical Audit

detail.title: Forward Information Leakage in a Widely-Used Open-Source Chinese Financial Data Interface: A Deconfounded Statistical Audit
detail.abstract:
AKShare is among the most widely-used open-source Python interfaces for Chinese A-share data (>8,000 GitHub stars), broadly adopted in academic empirical work and practitioner communities. We audit the point-in-time validity of AKSharesupplied price-to-earnings (PE) data for Beijing Stock Exchange (BSE) stocks. 
Our identification exploits an accounting identity: implied earnings, recovered as close price / PE, can mechanically change only when the data provider updates its earnings input. Under strict point-in-time construction, such updates should occur on or after a firm's earnings release. We compare the timing of genuine impliedearnings updates against China's legally mandated disclosure deadlines (Apr 30, Aug 31, Oct 31). 
We first show that the naive approach — counting jumps in the PE ratio itself — is heavily confounded: 74% of large PE-ratio jumps coincide with a large same-day price move, i.e., they are price-driven, not earnings-driven. After removing this confound and isolating the 451 genuine implied-earnings updates in our panel (181 BSE stocks, 2022–2026), 99.8% occur before the legal disclosure deadline, and 0.2% on or after. The result is stable across 10%/15%/20% jump thresholds.
We are deliberately careful about interpretation. About 56% of these updates fall in the seven days immediately preceding the deadline — a pattern also consistent with legitimate early actual disclosure, since firms typically report before the lastallowed date. The irreducible evidence of forward bias is the residual 31% of updates that land 31–90 days before the legal deadline, clustering near the fiscal period-end (e.g., H1 earnings stamped near June 30 rather than the Aug 31 deadline). No firm legally discloses that early; this residual is the signature of period-end / retrospective backfill at the upstream provider. A controlled lag experiment corroborates an exploitable magnitude: imposing a 2–3 month lag on PE in a representative BSE strategy reduces its in-sample t-statistic by 1.4–1.5 units.
We conclude that AKShare PE data is not point-in-time relative to legal disclosure for a non-trivial share of observations, that the bias is large enough to convert a marginal factor result (t≈2) into an apparently robust one (t≈3), and we propose mitigation strategies and a definitive follow-up test against actual announcementdate data.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了AKShare提供的北京证券交易所股票市盈率（PE）数据的时间点有效性（point-in-time validity），发现约31%的隐含盈利更新发生在法定披露截止日前31-90天（集中在财政期末附近），表明上游数据提供商存在期末/回顾性回填（backfill）的前瞻偏差（forward bias），该偏差足以将t统计量从约2提升至约3，使边缘显著的结果变得看似稳健。
AI.research_question: AKShare提供的中国A股PE数据是否具有严格的时间点有效性（point-in-time validity），即盈利数据的更新是否仅在或晚于公司实际盈利发布日期发生？
AI.motivation: AKShare是目前最广泛使用的中国A股数据开源Python接口（8000+ GitHub星级），被学术界和从业者社区大量用于实证研究。如果其数据存在前瞻偏差（forward bias），将严重影响基于该数据的实证结论的可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利用会计恒等式：隐含盈利 = 收盘价 / PE。隐含盈利的变化只能由数据提供商更新盈利输入引起。在严格时间点构建下，这种更新应发生在公司盈利发布之时或之后。
AI.method: 1. 识别PE比率的大幅跳跃（10%/15%/20%阈值）；2. 剔除由价格变动驱动的跳跃（74%的PE跳跃与同日价格大幅变动重合）；3. 隔离出451个真正的隐含盈利更新事件；4. 将这些更新的时间与中国法定披露截止日期（4月30日、8月31日、10月31日）进行比较；5. 进行滞后实验（imposing 2-3 month lag）测试偏差对实证结果的量化影响。
AI.findings: 1. 99.8%的隐含盈利更新发生在法定截止日期之前，0.2%在截止日或之后。2. 约56%的更新集中在截止日期前7天内（与合法提前披露一致）。3. 31%的更新发生在法定截止日期前31-90天，集中在财政期末附近（如H1盈利在6月30日附近而非8月31日截止日期前更新），这无法由合法提前披露解释，是前瞻偏差的确凿证据。4. 滞后实验表明，施加2-3个月的滞后期会使代表性BSE策略的样本内t统计量降低1.4-1.5个单位。
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融数据的时间点有效性审计提供了方法论框架，特别是揭示了PE比率跳跃中的"价格驱动混淆"（74%的PE跳跃由价格变动而非盈利更新驱动），以及如何通过会计恒等式识别真正的前瞻偏差。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示使用AKShare数据的学术研究者和从业者：其PE数据存在非平凡比例的前瞻偏差（约31%），该偏差足以将边缘显著（t≈2）的结果转换为看似稳健（t≈3）的结果。提出了缓解策略（如施加2-3个月的滞后）和后续验证方向（与实际公告日期数据对比）。

title: Laundering in Play? eSports Virtual Economies, Skin Markets, and the Reach of the Recast EU Anti-Money Laundering Framework

authors.last_name: Faculty of Law, Palacký University Olomouc, Czech Republic

affiliations: , Faculty of Law, Palacký University Olomouc, Palacký University Olomouc, Palacký University Olomouc - Faculty of Law and Faculty of Law, Palacký University Olomouc, Czech Republic

detail.title: Laundering in Play? eSports Virtual Economies, Skin Markets, and the Reach of the Recast EU Anti-Money Laundering Framework
detail.abstract: The free-to-play business model that sustains the world's leading eSports titles rests on elaborate internal economies in which players buy, earn, and trade virtual currencies and cosmetic items. This chapter argues that those economies are not merely a consumer-protection concern but a structural money-laundering vulnerability that the European Union's recently recast anti-money laundering framework leaves substantially unaddressed. It examines how the EU's new antimoney laundering framework applies to laundering risks in eSports. It analyses the 2024 antimoney laundering package (Regulation 2024/1624, Directive 2024/1640, Regulation 2024/1620 establishing the Anti-Money Laundering Authority, and the recast Transfer of Funds Regulation 2023/1113) together with the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation 2023/1114. On that basis, it develops a typology of laundering vectors observable in the ten most-watched eSports titles of 2024 and maps each vector against the obligations introduced by the new regime. The chapter ultimately finds that the 2024 package leaves a significant gap. Because it defines "crypto-asset" by reference to the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation, and because that definition depends on both technology and transferability, conventional in-game currencies, the tradable skins of the minority of titles that permit secondary trading, and most non-fungible in-game items fall outside the preventive, obliged-entity perimeter of the anti-money-laundering framework. The gap is one of preventive supervision and not of criminal money-laundering liability, which may attach to dealing in such proceeds whatever the form of the asset. The exclusion is shown to be a deliberate feature of the framework's architecture rather than a drafting oversight, and therefore far harder to remedy than the existing literature has assumed. The chapter closes by proposing solutions consistent with the Union's stated commitment to protecting players and the integrity of the financial system.

AI.tldr: 本文论证免费电子游戏的内在经济体系存在结构性洗钱漏洞，欧盟2024年反洗钱新框架因对"加密资产"的定义依赖技术性和可转让性标准，将传统游戏货币、可交易皮肤及大多数NFT游戏内物品排除在预防性监管范围之外，且这一排除是框架的故意设计而非疏忽，难以通过简单修订弥补。
AI.research_question: 欧盟2024年新反洗钱框架如何适用于电子竞技中的洗钱风险？现有框架是否充分覆盖免费游戏内经济体系中的洗钱漏洞？
AI.motivation: 免费游戏模式支撑着全球领先的电竞游戏，其内部经济体系涉及虚拟货币和装饰品的买卖、赚取和交易，但这些经济体系不仅是消费者保护问题，更可能成为结构性洗钱漏洞，而现有文献和监管框架对此关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 洗钱风险识别与监管覆盖理论；反洗钱预防性监管与刑事责任的区分；加密资产定义的技术性标准（依赖区块链技术及可转让性）。
AI.method: 法律文本分析（欧盟2024年反洗钱一揽子法规及MiCA法规）；类型学构建（基于2024年十大最受欢迎电竞游戏开发洗钱向量类型）；映射分析法（将各洗钱向量与新监管框架的义务要求进行对照）。
AI.findings: 欧盟2024年反洗钱框架存在重大预防性监管缺口：传统游戏内货币、允许二级交易游戏的皮肤、以及大多数NFT游戏内物品均被排除在预防性监管范围之外。该排除是框架架构的故意特征而非起草疏忽，因此比现有文献假设的更难补救。但这一缺口仅限于预防性监管层面，不涉及刑事洗钱责任。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了反洗钱监管框架中"加密资产"定义依赖MiCA标准所产生的结构性排除效应；区分了预防性监管缺口与刑事责任之间的界限；提出该排除是故意架构设计而非起草疏忽的新观点，挑战了现有文献的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟及各国监管机构识别和修补游戏内经济体系洗钱漏洞提供类型学分析工具和具体政策建议；提醒游戏运营商注意其平台可能被利用为洗钱渠道的合规风险。

keywords: Fiscal Theory of The Price Level
Fiscal Theory of The Price Level

detail.abstract: We present an internally consistent model in which the price level is pinned by backing with no government — a backing theory of the price level (BTPL) — that prices the issuer's whole portfolio, generalizing the valuation logic the fiscal theory of the price level (FTPL) applies to the state's claim alone: FTPL's equation is the single-leaf case ( , the endogenous book's feedback modulus), the surplus claim counted as the only asset and the endogenous inside book set to zero, so determinacy becomes a condition ( , Theorem 4.1) rather than an artifact of truncation. It answers the quantity theory's question with no quantity in the numerator — built as a valuation fixed point over the balance sheets of a stock-flow-consistent agent-based economy. Money and all claims are marked to issuer backing by a Merton (1974) structural-credit valuation placed on the network of claims and solved to a fixed point in the Eisenberg–Noe (2001) tradition — a mark-to-market network valuation in the sense of Barucca et al. (2020), not the literal clearing-payment vector — with the absolute level pinned by a real anchor. (By network we mean throughout the web of who-owes-whom: agents are nodes, and each deposit or loan is an edge whose value depends on the others.) The value of money solves , fusing the absolute-level (FTPL/backing) and network-valuation (Eisenberg–Noe/Merton) literatures with private credit and a real anchor in place of government claims. Here is the anchor's goods-value, the marked loan book, and the deposit stock (defined at §1.4). The central result is a determinacy theorem: with an exogenous anchor and bounded real collateral the fixed point has a unique positive root, while strong endogenous-anchor feedback creates multiplicity — so anchor exogeneity is a clean sufficient condition, not an equivalence. We then show determinacy and dynamic stability are separate: a reduced-form round map exhibits a leverage-driven Neimark–Sacker fragility — a slow cycle short simulations can miss —even where the level is pinned. The same fixed point yields a regime map (no anchor, floating backing, convertible par, central-bank par) in which the classical doctrines appear as restrictions of one object — a restricted, structural unification. Two signatures make it empirical: the sign of flips between convertible-par and floating regimes, and a unit root appears only with no anchor. Scope, stated up front: the components are prior art; the backing price is a read-only valuation fixed point over the model's balance sheets, not live price formation in the agent-based round (administered prices today); the dynamic result is an explicit reduced form, and its leverage-only Neimark–Sacker threshold is itself a reduced-form artifact — the structurally-bounded Merton channel is sub-critical on its own, so the bifurcation proper requires the expectational or insolvency channels (§5.4); and there is no empirical validation

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个"价格水平背书理论"(BTPL)，将FTPL的单期政府债权逻辑推广到整个经济网络的资产负债表上，通过Merton(1974)和Eisenberg-Noe(2001)的固定点网络估值来钉住价格水平，并证明锚定外生性是价格水平确定性的充分条件，但确定性与动态稳定性是分离的——杠杆驱动的Neimark-Sacker分岔可能导致慢周期脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 如何在没有政府的条件下，仅通过私人信贷和实际锚定物来钉住价格水平？价格水平的确定性与动态稳定性之间的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: FTPL仅适用于政府债权，无法解释私人经济中价格水平的确定机制。本文试图将FTPL的逻辑推广到整个经济网络，构建一个无需政府、基于资产负债表的统一价格水平理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价格水平背书理论(BTPL)、财政价格水平理论(FTPL)、Merton(1974)结构信用估值、Eisenberg-Noe(2001)网络清算固定点、Barucca et al.(2020)按市价计值的网络估值、Neimark-Sacker分岔理论。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建一个存量-流量一致、基于代理人的经济模型，将货币和所有债权通过Merton结构信用估值在债权网络上进行按市价计值，求解Eisenberg-Noe传统的固定点，融合FTPL/背书逻辑与网络估值文献。
AI.findings: (1) 当实际锚定物外生且真实抵押品有界时，固定点存在唯一正根（确定性定理）；(2) 强内生锚定反馈会导致多重均衡；(3) 确定性与动态稳定性是分离的：即使价格水平被钉住，约化轮次映射也可能出现杠杆驱动的Neimark-Sacker分岔（慢周期脆弱性）；(4) 不同货币制度（无锚、浮动背书、可兑换平价、央行平价）是该统一框架的特例。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将FTPL从仅适用于政府债权推广到整个经济网络的资产负债表；(2) 融合了FTPL/背书理论与网络估值（Eisenberg-Noe/Merton）两大文献；(3) 证明锚定外生性是价格水平确定性的充分条件而非等价条件；(4) 揭示了确定性与动态稳定性之间的分离关系。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 提供了区分不同货币制度（可兑换平价与浮动背书）的经验可检验特征——符号翻转和单位根；(2) 提醒政策制定者：即使价格水平被钉住，经济系统仍可能面临由杠杆驱动的动态不稳定性（慢周期），短时间模拟可能遗漏这种脆弱性。
