title: Addressing the Gap: A Review of Fintech Literature in the Age of Finance 4.0 and Agentic AI
affiliations: and Indian Institute of Foreign Trade

detail.title: Addressing the Gap: A Review of Fintech Literature in the Age of Finance 4.0 and Agentic AI

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Journal of Business and Management (IJBM), volume 5, issue 1, 2026[10.56879/ijbm.v5i1.19]

detail.abstract: As the financial industry is moves towards Finance 4.0 and Agentic AI, the FinTech landscape is undergoing a structural shift from traditional systems to advance artificial intelligence (AI), where AI now uses reasoning, planning, and multi-step actions. The existing literature on Fintech has largely focused on early-stage adoption and fails to capture this current shift. This study addresses this gap by combining a bibliometric analysis of 318 Scopus articles (2015-2024) with a narrative literature review of the most-cited and a selection of high-impact non-Scopus papers, including leading working papers and publications from high-impact journals. Our findings reveal three research streams: (1) Adoption & Innovation, (2) Market Impact & Inclusion, and (3) Regulation & Stability. We further map these themes to five foundational theories: Diffusion Theory, the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM), Financial Intermediation Theory, Inclusion Theory, and Regulatory Arbitrage Theory. The study provides empirical validation for established models while identifying critical gaps and future research directions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献计量分析和叙事文献综述，整合了2015-2024年间FinTech研究，识别出三大研究流（采纳与创新、市场影响与包容、监管与稳定），并将其映射到五大理论基础，为金融4.0和Agentic AI时代的FinTech研究提供了系统性框架。
AI.research_question: 在金融行业向Finance 4.0和Agentic AI转型的背景下，现有FinTech研究的主题结构、理论基础和研究空白是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有FinTech文献多聚焦于早期采纳阶段，未能捕捉当前从传统系统向高级AI（具备推理、规划和多步骤行动能力）的结构性转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 五大基础理论：扩散理论（Diffusion Theory）、技术接受模型（TAM）、金融中介理论（Financial Intermediation Theory）、包容理论（Inclusion Theory）、监管套利理论（Regulatory Arbitrage Theory）。
AI.method: 结合文献计量分析（318篇Scopus论文，2015-2024）与叙事文献综述（涵盖高被引论文及高影响力非Scopus论文，包括领先工作论文和顶级期刊出版物）。
AI.findings: 识别出三大研究流：（1）采纳与创新；（2）市场影响与包容；（3）监管与稳定。为已有模型提供了实证验证，同时指出了关键研究空白和未来方向。
AI.theory_contributions: 将三大研究流系统性地映射到五大基础理论，验证了经典理论在新情境下的适用性，并明确了理论整合与拓展的空白点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为FinTech研究者、政策制定者和行业从业者提供了系统性知识图谱，帮助理解金融4.0和Agentic AI时代的研究重点与方向。

title: Quantifying Backtest Overfitting from Information Leakage: A Walk-Forward and Embargo-Based Diagnostic Framework Applied to Deep Learning Return Forecasts
affiliations: and

detail.title: Quantifying Backtest Overfitting from Information Leakage: A Walk-Forward and Embargo-Based Diagnostic Framework Applied to Deep Learning Return Forecasts
detail.abstract: Reported backtest performance in applied financial machine learning is frequently inflated by information leakage between training and evaluation samples, yet the magnitude of this inflation is rarely measured directly. We introduce a controlled diagnostic protocol that (i) deliberately injects two common and realistic leakage mechanisms-full-sample feature scaling and globally computed rolling statisticsinto a return-forecasting pipeline; (ii) evaluates two structurally distinct deep learning architectures, a recurrent sequence model and a convolutional image-encoding model, under three validation regimes of increasing rigor (a single train/test split, non-anchored walk-forward validation, and walk-forward validation combined with an embargo period); and (iii) quantifies the resulting change in backtested trading performance at each stage. Applied to a single-asset case study (SPDR S&P 500 ETF, 2016-2023), the framework reveals that leakage inflation is large, fold-size dependent, and architecturespecific: removing leakage reduces the recurrent model's backtested return by 123 percentage points under a moderate-frequency retraining schedule and by 506 percentage points under a high-frequency schedule, while the convolutional model's apparent performance under leakage is suppressed rather than inflated, reversing in sign once leakage is removed. These findings indicate that the direction and magnitude of leakage-induced bias cannot be assumed a priori and depends on the interaction between the contamination mechanism and the model's input representation. We argue that backtest results obtained under a single validation protocol should not be trusted in isolation, and we propose the embargo period-set equal to the prediction horizon-as a low-cost, broadly applicable correction.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控诊断协议，系统量化了金融机器学习回测中信息泄漏导致的绩效膨胀程度。以SPDR S&P 500 ETF为案例，发现泄漏使回测收益膨胀幅度极大（可达506个百分点），且方向和大小取决于泄漏机制与模型输入表征的交互作用，不可先验假设。
AI.research_question: 金融机器学习回测中，信息泄漏导致的绩效膨胀程度有多大？泄漏偏误的方向和大小是否可先验假设？
AI.motivation: 回测绩效常因训练集与评估集之间的信息泄漏而被夸大，但泄漏导致的膨胀幅度很少被直接测量，研究者缺乏对此问题的量化认知。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息泄漏机制（全样本特征缩放、全局滚动统计量）；深度学习架构（循环序列模型、卷积图像编码模型）；验证制度（单次训练/测试分割、非锚定滚动验证、含禁入期的滚动验证）。
AI.method: 设计受控诊断协议：故意注入两种常见泄漏机制，评估两种深度学习架构在三种验证制度下的表现，量化回测交易绩效在各阶段的变化。以SPDR S&P 500 ETF（2016-2023）进行单资产案例研究。
AI.findings: 泄漏膨胀幅度巨大、依赖于折叠大小和架构类型。去除泄漏后，循环模型回测收益在中等频率重训练下降123个百分点，高频重训练下降506个百分点；卷积模型在有泄漏时表现被抑制，去除泄漏后收益符号反转。泄漏偏误的方向和大小取决于泄漏机制与模型输入表征的交互作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化了不同泄漏机制与不同深度学习架构交互作用下的回测绩效偏误方向和大小，证明泄漏偏误不可先验假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出单一验证协议下的回测结果不可轻信；建议将禁入期设为预测视界作为低成本、广泛适用的纠正措施。

title: Beyond Black Gold : The Future of Energy and Oil Producing Nations and Opportunities

detail.title: Beyond Black Gold : The Future of Energy and Oil Producing Nations and Opportunities
detail.abstract: This paper delves into the long-term consequences of a global shift away from fossil fuels, as stated in the Paris Agreement, focusing on the economic, political, and social landscapes of energy and oil-India, with its growing economy and ambitious renewable energy goals, presents a contrasting picture. Its potential to become a leader in clean energy solutions offers a unique opportunity to navigate the energy transition while achieving sustainable growth. This paper aims to analyse India's position in the renewable sector within this context.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了《巴黎协定》下全球摆脱化石燃料的长期影响，聚焦印度在能源转型中的经济、政治和社会格局，探讨其如何通过可再生能源领导地位实现可持续增长。
AI.research_question: 在全球从化石燃料转向清洁能源的背景下，印度在可再生能源领域的定位及其实现可持续增长的战略路径是什么？
AI.motivation: 全球能源转型（如《巴黎协定》）对能源和石油国家产生深远影响，而印度作为经济增长迅速且拥有雄心勃勃可再生能源目标的国家，其独特的发展模式为研究能源转型提供了重要案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源转型理论、可持续发展理论、地缘政治经济学
AI.method: 文献分析与案例研究（本文为概念性/综述型研究）
AI.findings: 印度具备成为清洁能源领导者的潜力，其可再生能源发展可为全球能源转型提供示范；能源转型过程中需平衡经济增长与可持续发展目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了能源转型理论在发展中国家的应用，拓展了可持续发展理论与新兴经济体清洁能源战略的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及其他发展中国家制定可再生能源政策提供战略参考；为全球能源治理中发展中国家角色定位提供实践启示。

title: Balancing Innovation, Regulation and Financial Stability: Policy Priorities for India's Digital Financial Ecosystem
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Balancing Innovation, Regulation and Financial Stability: Policy Priorities for India's Digital Financial Ecosystem

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on publicly available secondary data and does not involve human participants, clinical trials, or personal data collection. Therefore, ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: India's financial sector has experienced a significant transformation over the last decade, driven by the rapid adoption of digital technologies, expansion of financial infrastructure, and emergence of innovative financial service providers. Initiatives such as the Unified Payments Interface (UPI), Aadhaar-enabled services, Jan Dhan Yojana, and Account Aggregator framework have collectively contributed to greater financial inclusion and improved efficiency within the financial system. Simultaneously, the rise of FinTech firms, digital lending platforms, and data-driven financial services has introduced new opportunities as well as regulatory challenges. While innovation has improved access, reduced transaction costs, and strengthened economic participation, it has also created concerns relating to cybersecurity, consumer protection, data privacy, operational resilience, and financial stability. As financial services become increasingly interconnected and technology-dependent, regulators face the complex task of encouraging innovation while preserving confidence in the financial system. This paper examines the evolving relationship between financial innovation, regulation, and financial stability in India. It analyzes the opportunities generated by digital finance, identifies emerging risks, and proposes policy measures aimed at creating a resilient, inclusive, and innovation-friendly financial ecosystem. The paper argues that India's future success will depend upon a regulatory approach that supports technological advancement while ensuring prudent risk management and consumer protection.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度金融业数字化转型带来的机遇与风险，探讨了金融创新、监管与金融稳定之间的动态关系，并提出了构建韧性、包容且创新友好的金融生态系统的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 在印度金融数字化转型背景下，金融创新、监管与金融稳定之间如何演变？如何平衡创新激励与风险管控？
AI.motivation: 印度金融体系正经历深刻变革，数字化带来了普惠金融和效率提升，但同时也引发了网络安全、数据隐私、消费者保护等新型风险，监管部门面临平衡创新与稳定的复杂挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融创新理论、金融监管理论、金融稳定理论，以及金融科技生态系统理论。
AI.method: 定性分析，基于对印度金融数字化转型的现状梳理与案例研究（如UPI、Aadhaar、Jan Dhan Yojana等），结合政策分析与风险识别。
AI.findings: 数字金融改善了金融可及性、降低了交易成本、增强了经济参与；但同时带来了网络安全、消费者保护、数据隐私、运营韧性及金融稳定等方面的风险。监管需要在鼓励创新与维护系统信心之间寻求平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统阐述了数字金融时代金融创新与金融稳定之间的张力关系，丰富了新兴市场国家金融监管转型的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及类似新兴经济体制定数字金融监管政策提供了具体建议，强调了在支持技术创新的同时确保审慎风险管理和消费者保护的重要性。

title:
The Password Paradox:
Why the World's Least Trusted Security Tool Still Guards Most of the Internet -And What Comes Next

detail.title:
The Password Paradox:
Why the World's Least Trusted Security Tool Still Guards Most of the Internet -And What Comes Next

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this article. Where the article references the author's previously published works, these are cited for illustrative and comparative purposes only and do not represent a financial conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This article does not involve human participants, patient data, or original clinical or behavioral research requiring ethics review. It synthesizes and analyzes publicly available industry, government, and academic data.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
Passwords remain the primary authentication method for seventy-six percent of organizations worldwide, despite near-universal agreement among security professionals that they are the weakest link in modern cyber defense. This article traces the password's origin at MIT in 1961 through six decades of escalating attacks and defenses, examines the current data on breach costs and credential theft, and evaluates the passwordless technologies — passkeys, FIDO2, and WebAuthn — now positioned to replace them. It further examines what this shift means for the cybersecurity labor market: a global workforce gap exceeding 4.8 million positions, and a hiring landscape that increasingly rewards demonstrable, narrow technical skill over credentials alone. The conclusion is neither alarmist nor complacent: passwords will not disappear on the timeline the industry once predicted, but organizations and individuals who build layered, passkey-forward defenses today will be measurably more resilient than those waiting for the problem to solve itself.

In March 2026, an identity security firm asked more than a thousand IT and security leaders a simple question: how are you authenticating your users? The answer should unsettle anyone who has spent the last several years reading confident predictions that passwords were finally on their way out. Seventy-six percent of organizations reported that legacy passwords remain their primary authentication method. Only forty-three percent had deployed any form of passwordless authentication at all, and of those, most had rolled it out to less than half their workforce.

This is the paradox at the center of modern cybersecurity. Nearly every serious technologist agrees that the password, as an idea, is broken. It is guessable, reusable, phishable, and endlessly recycled by users who have long since stopped trying to invent something new for the fortieth account they have opened this year. And yet, more than sixty years after the first computer password was issued at MIT in 1961, we are still typing them, still resetting them, and still losing them to attackers by the billions.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了密码自1961年MIT起源至今六十余年的演进历史，分析了当前密码作为主要认证方式的困境（76%的组织仍依赖密码），评估了无密码技术（passkeys、FIDO2、WebAuthn）的现状与前景，并探讨了密码向无密码转型对网络安全劳动力市场的影响。结论认为密码不会迅速消失，但率先构建分层、以passkey为核心的防御体系的组织将更具韧性。
AI.research_question: 密码为何在公认安全薄弱的情况下仍被76%的组织作为主要认证方式？无密码技术（passkeys、FIDO2、WebAuthn）能否真正替代密码？这一转型对网络安全劳动力市场有何影响？
AI.motivation: 尽管安全专业人士普遍认为密码是最薄弱的网络安全环节，且无密码技术已发展多年，但密码仍占据主导地位。这一"悖论"需要被系统性地解释，同时需要评估无密码转型的真实进展及其对就业市场的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 密码安全的历史演进框架（从1961年MIT到现代）；网络安全悖论（专家共识与实践脱节）；技术替代与制度惯性的冲突；网络安全劳动力市场供需理论。
AI.method: 历史追溯法（追踪密码60年发展历程）；实证调查（2026年对1000+IT和安全领导者的问卷）；数据分析和案例研究（泄露成本、凭证窃取数据评估）；技术评估（passkeys、FIDO2、WebAuthn等技术分析）。
AI.findings: 76%的组织仍将传统密码作为主要认证方式；仅43%的组织部署了某种形式的无密码认证，且大部分仅覆盖不到一半员工；无密码技术（passkeys/FIDO2/WebAuthn）已具备替代条件，但普及缓慢；网络安全劳动力缺口超480万，就业市场更青睐可验证的狭隘技术技能而非学历证书；密码不会如行业曾预测的那样迅速消失。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了网络安全领域"专家共识与技术采纳之间的系统性滞后"这一理论现象；为技术替代理论提供了密码→无密码转型的实证案例；丰富了关于安全实践中"知道该做什么却未做"的认知-行为鸿沟研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织和安全领导者提供密码向无密码转型的现状基准（76%仍用密码、43%开始部署）；建议构建分层、passkey优先的防御体系；为网络安全从业者和求职者指明技能发展方向（窄而深的技术能力比学历证书更重要）；为理解全球480万网络安全岗位缺口与技能需求变化提供参考。

title: The Impact of Professional Sports Franchise Movements on Urban Crime Rates

detail.title: The Impact of Professional Sports Franchise Movements on Urban Crime Rates
detail.abstract: While municipalities often justify large public subsidies for professional sports franchises through expected social benefits, the long-term externalities on public safety remain largely underexplored. A broad literature finds these stadiums generate negligible economic growth, making their social impact critical for policy evaluation. This paper investigates the structural effect of professional sports team entries and exits on local urban crime rates. Using a comprehensive, long-term panel of United States cities from 1985 to 2019, the study employs the Synthetic Difference-inDifferences (SDID) estimator as its primary identification strategy. The findings demonstrate that the crime externalities of professional sports are highly sensitive to market saturation. In solo markets, franchise movements generate significant and directionally symmetric shocks. The arrival of a city's first major franchise structurally increases violent (assault and robbery) and short-run property crime (burglary), whereas the departure of a sole franchise leads to a decrease in violent crime (robbery and rape). However, in established multi-team markets, the marginal addition or loss of a franchise yields no statistically significant changes in crime. Ultimately, the initial transition between zero and one team creates profound disruptions to local public safety, while subsequent movements in saturated markets have essentially no marginal effect.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1985-2019年美国城市面板数据，采用合成双重差分法（SDID）研究发现，职业体育球队的进入与退出对城市犯罪的影响高度取决于市场饱和度：在单队市场中，球队变动会显著影响暴力犯罪和财产犯罪，但在多队成熟市场中则无显著边际效应。
AI.research_question: 职业体育球队进入与退出对当地城市犯罪率有何结构性影响？这种影响如何随市场饱和度变化？
AI.motivation: 城市常以社会效益为由为大型体育场馆提供巨额补贴，但现有文献证明这些场馆的经济增长效应微乎其微，而其对公共安全的长期外部性尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 犯罪外部性理论、市场饱和度理论
AI.method: 采用1985-2019年美国城市面板数据，以合成双重差分法（Synthetic Difference-in-Differences, SDID）作为主要识别策略。
AI.findings: （1）独队市场中，球队进入显著增加暴力犯罪（袭击、抢劫）和短期财产犯罪（入室盗窃），球队离开则显著减少暴力犯罪（抢劫、强奸）；（2）多队成熟市场中，球队的边际增减对犯罪无统计显著影响；（3）从0到1队的初始转变对公共安全产生深远冲击，而饱和市场的后续变动几乎无边际效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示了职业体育犯罪外部性的非对称性特征，即犯罪效应仅存在于市场饱和度从无到有的临界转变阶段，丰富了城市经济学与犯罪经济学中关于体育设施外部性的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府评估体育场馆补贴政策的真实社会成本提供了关键经验证据，提示决策者应重点考虑在尚未拥有职业球队的城市引入球队可能带来的公共安全风险，而多队市场的补贴合理性则面临更大挑战。

title: The Influence of Fintech Integration on the Technical Efficiency of Indian Banks: A Two-Step DEA Approach
affiliations: and Indian Institute of Foreign Trade

detail.title: The Influence of Fintech Integration on the Technical Efficiency of Indian Banks: A Two-Step DEA Approach

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency.

detail.abstract: Financial innovation worldwide has left traditional banks with no option but to provide digital fintech services, such as digital payments and peer-to-peer lending. Banks either developed digital units internally or formed external partnerships to integrate Fintech capabilities in their day-today operations. This study defines Fintech integration as the provision of digital services by banks and examines its effect on technical efficiency using a two-step Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) approach, followed by a panel regression model to evaluate the influence of specific financial variables on technical efficiency. Efficiency is decomposed into technical efficiency (optimal use of resources), pure technical efficiency (managerial effectiveness in using inputs), and scale efficiency (effects due to bank size). The data for the study comprises 21 Indian banks that implemented major Fintech initiatives, sourced from Bloomberg. The study found that persistent inefficiencies arise from suboptimal scale, input waste, and poor management. Panel regression analysis reveals that the operational impacts of Fintech integration vary significantly across the dimensions of intermediation. Larger bank size emerges as a powerful determinant of efficiency in deposit mobilisation and revenue generation, suggesting economies of scale. Also, higher loan intensity significantly accelerates the core deposit-to-loan transformation but poses a barrier to banks' interest income generation post-Fintech integration. Similarly, while high intermediation costs reduce efficiency in deposit mobilisation, they are strongly positively associated with creditprocessing efficiency, capturing the positive payoff of investments in Fintech capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨印度银行整合金融科技（数字支付、P2P借贷等）后对其技术效率的影响。通过两步DEA分析和面板回归，发现银行规模是效率的关键决定因素，但金融科技整合对不同中介维度的影响存在显著差异：高贷款强度加速存贷转换却抑制利息收入，高中介成本降低存款效率但提升信贷处理效率。
AI.research_question: 银行整合金融科技（提供数字服务）如何影响其技术效率？具体而言，金融科技整合对不同中介维度（存款动员、收入生成、信贷处理）的效率影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 全球金融科技创新迫使传统银行必须提供数字服务，但金融科技整合对银行运营效率的实际影响尚不明确。现有研究缺乏对效率的多维度分解（技术效率、纯技术效率、规模效率）以及金融变量交互作用的深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 效率分解理论（技术效率、纯技术效率、规模效率）；规模经济理论；金融中介理论
AI.method: 两步法：第一步使用数据包络分析（DEA）分解效率；第二步采用面板回归模型评估具体金融变量对效率的影响。数据来源为Bloomberg，样本为21家实施了重大金融科技项目的印度银行。
AI.findings: （1）低效率源于规模不经济、投入浪费和管理不善；（2）金融科技整合对不同中介维度的运营影响存在显著差异；（3）较大银行规模是存款动员和收入生成中效率的关键决定因素，体现规模经济；（4）高贷款强度加速核心存贷转换，但阻碍利息收入生成；（5）高中介成本降低存款动员效率，但与信贷处理效率呈强正相关，反映了金融科技投资的回报。
AI.theory_contributions: 细化了金融科技整合对银行效率影响的理论机制，揭示了效率维度的异质性效应，特别是金融科技整合在不同中介功能中的差异化作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行管理者提供决策参考：大型银行在存款动员和收入生成方面更具优势；需平衡贷款强度对存贷转换和利息收入的矛盾影响；中介成本对存款和信贷处理效率的不同效应需区别管理。

title: Entrepreneurship Education and Career Trajectories
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: Entrepreneurship Education and Career Trajectories

declarations.ethicsApproval: The research design was approved by the university’s Institutional Review Board (IRB).

detail.abstract: As entrepreneurship education has become increasingly prevalent in higher education, its broader consequences for students' career development have attracted growing attention. Supporters argue that entrepreneurship programs generate long-term value by cultivating transferable skills that benefit participants beyond venture creation. Critics, however, contend that such programs may crowd out other educational investments and potentially undermine academic and labor market outcomes. Despite ongoing debate over its net impact, existing research has focused primarily on whether entrepreneurship education increases entrepreneurial activity, leaving its effects on broader career trajectories underexplored. Drawing on ten years of longitudinal data from a university startup incubator, this study examines the impact of an entrepreneurship education program by comparing the post-graduation career trajectories of accepted and rejected applicants. The results show that exposure to entrepreneurship education does not necessarily increase entrepreneurial activity immediately after graduation. However, participation is associated with sustained career advantages, even among students who do not pursue entrepreneurship in the short term. Specifically, participants demonstrate better job matching, as reflected in higher earnings, longer tenure with their initial employers, and greater stability in occupational type. These findings provide empirical evidence that entrepreneurship education can generate enduring positive returns in the broader labor market. They also offer important implications for universities and organizations evaluating whether to invest in entrepreneurship programs, suggesting that the value of such programs extends beyond the creation of new ventures.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用某大学创业孵化器十年纵向数据，比较被录取和未录取申请者的职业轨迹，发现创业教育虽不立即提升创业活动，但能带来长期职业优势，如更高收入、更长任职时间和更稳定的职业类型。
AI.research_question: 创业教育如何影响学生毕业后的长期职业发展轨迹，而不仅仅是短期创业行为？
AI.motivation: 创业教育日益普及，但其对广泛职业发展的长期影响尚存争议；现有研究过度聚焦于创业行为本身，忽略了更广泛的劳动力市场结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论（可迁移技能的培养）、职业匹配理论（更好的工作匹配带来更优职业结果）
AI.method: 利用大学创业孵化器十年纵向数据，采用准实验设计，比较被录取申请者（参与组）与未被录取申请者（对照组）的毕业后的职业轨迹。
AI.findings: 创业教育虽不立即提升创业活动，但参与者表现出更好的职业匹配：更高收入、更长初始雇主任职时间、更稳定的职业类型。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了创业教育研究的视角，从"是否创业"转向"更广泛的职业发展"，为人力资本理论的迁移效应提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高校和企业评估创业教育投资提供依据，证明其价值超越新创企业本身，可提升毕业生整体劳动力市场表现。

title: The Dark Side of Globalization: Quantity, Quality, and Cost-Effectiveness Enhancement of Disinformation via AI
affiliations: , University of Zilina and University of Zilina

detail.title: The Dark Side of Globalization: Quantity, Quality, and Cost-Effectiveness Enhancement of Disinformation via AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable — this study relies exclusively on secondary, publicly available data (platform reports, published research); no human subjects research was conducted.
declarations.funderStatement: VEGA grant 1/0324/25 — "Longitudinal research on media literacy in the context of sustainable social development in Slovakia"

publicationDetails.detailsText: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the international scientific conference "Globalization and its socio-economic consequences 2025," University of Žilina

detail.abstract: Digital transformation has made artificial intelligence a significant amplifier of disinformation operations. Generative AI technologies have substantially lowered technical and economic barriers to producing convincing, multimodal false content at industrial scale, posing risks to democratic processes, social cohesion, and information integrity. However, theoretical predictions about AI's transformative impact remain largely untested against empirical evidence from documented operations. This study examines whether scholarly predictions about AI's enhancement of disinformation correspond to operational realities through systematic analysis of documented state-sponsored campaigns. The research tests three primary hypotheses: that AI increases disinformation quantity, enhances content quality and credibility, and improves operational cost-effectiveness, while distinguishing between legitimate concerns and potentially overblown fears. The study employs mixed-methods analysis combining comprehensive literature review with detailed case studies of eight AI-enabled information operations conducted between 2021-2025. Empirical validation draws from platform threat intelligence reports, platform adversarial behavior analyses, platform takedown disclosures and peer-reviewed research, focusing on operations targeting Western democracies and European audiences. AI demonstrably transforms operational capabilities through undisputable quantity and cost-effectiveness enhancements, with AI-generated content engagement rates exceeding organic content rates. However, authentic audience impact remains limited-almost all reviewed operations achieved minimal genuine engagement despite technological sophistication. The analysis reveals an emergent "LLM grooming" threat, where bad actors systematically contaminate AI training datasets, evidenced by leading chatbots reproducing Russian disinformation 31.8% of the time. Slovakia's vulnerabilities underscore the importance of building societal resilience alongside technological countermeasures.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过系统分析2021-2025年间八个国家支持型AI赋能信息操作案例，发现AI确实显著提升了虚假信息的数量、质量和成本效益（AI生成内容的参与率高于有机内容），但真实受众影响有限——绝大多数操作尽管技术先进，却仅实现了极小的真实参与。研究还揭示了新兴的"LLM培养"威胁，即恶意行为者系统性地污染AI训练数据集，证据显示主流聊天机器人有31.8%的概率重复俄罗斯虚假信息。
AI.research_question: 关于AI增强虚假信息的学术预测是否与实际操作现实相符？AI是否以及在多大程度上提升了虚假信息的数量、质量和成本效益？
AI.motivation: 数字化转型使AI成为虚假信息操作的重要放大器，生成式AI大幅降低了制作令人信服的多模态虚假内容的技术和经济门槛，对民主进程、社会凝聚力和信息完整性构成风险。然而，关于AI变革性影响的理论预测很大程度上尚未经过经验证据的检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三个主要假设：AI增加虚假信息数量；AI提升内容质量和可信度；AI提高操作成本效益。同时区分合理关切与可能被夸大的恐惧。
AI.method: 混合方法分析：综合文献综述与2021-2025年间八个AI赋能信息操作的详细案例研究。经验验证来源包括平台威胁情报报告、平台对抗行为分析、平台查封披露和同行评审研究，重点关注针对西方民主国家和欧洲受众的操作。
AI.findings: AI通过无可争议的数量和成本效益增强明显改变了操作能力，AI生成内容的参与率超过有机内容。但真实受众影响有限——几乎所有被审查的操作尽管技术先进，却实现了最小的真实参与。揭示了新兴的"LLM培养"威胁，证据显示主流聊天机器人有31.8%的概率重复俄罗斯虚假信息。斯洛伐克的脆弱性凸显了在技术对策之外建立社会韧性的重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为关于AI对虚假信息操作变革性影响的理论预测提供了首次系统性的实证检验，区分了合理关切与可能被夸大的恐惧，并揭示了"LLM培养"这一未被充分认识的新兴威胁。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者和平台运营者的启示：AI确实显著提升了虚假信息操作的数量和成本效益，但受众真实影响有限，因此需要同时关注技术对策（如检测AI生成内容）和社会韧性建设（如斯洛伐克案例所示）。LLM训练数据污染问题需要紧急关注。

title: Sovereign Defaults and Trade: External vs. Domestic Creditors * Dennis Essers † National Bank of Belgium
affiliations: , Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca - Department of Economics, Management and Statistics (DEMS) and

detail.title: Sovereign Defaults and Trade: External vs. Domestic Creditors * Dennis Essers † National Bank of Belgium
detail.abstract: This paper shows that the trade costs of sovereign default depend on the identity of defaulted creditors. Comparing external and domestic defaults on privately held debt across 128 developing countries over 1980-2019, and applying both two-way fixed effects and stacked difference-indifferences estimators, we find that external defaults are associated with large and persistent import contractions, while domestic defaults have smaller and short-lived effects. This asymmetry is concentrated in imports of capital goods and is mirrored by declines in international lending to the private sector and in medium-to-long-term export credit insurance after external, but not domestic, defaults. By contrast, exports do not change significantly after either type of default. The results point to disruptions in cross-border trade finance as a key channel linking external defaults to trade, and highlight creditor composition as a central determinant of default-related trade costs.

AI.tldr: 本文发现主权违约的贸易成本取决于违约债权人的身份。外部违约（对国外私人债权人）会导致大规模且持续的进口收缩，而国内违约（对国内私人债权人）的影响较小且短暂。这种不对称性主要集中在资本品进口，并且与外部违约后国际贷款和出口信贷保险的下降相呼应。研究结果指出跨境贸易融资的中断是连接外部违约与贸易的关键渠道。
AI.research_question: 主权违约的贸易成本如何取决于违约债权人的身份（外部债权人 vs. 国内债权人）？
AI.motivation: 已有研究关注主权违约对贸易的影响，但鲜有区分违约对象（外部 vs. 国内债权人）的异质性效应。本文旨在填补这一空白，揭示债权人身份如何影响违约后的贸易成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨境贸易融资渠道：外部违约会扰乱国际贷款和出口信用保险市场，进而抑制进口，尤其是资本品进口；而国内违约不涉及跨境金融渠道，因此贸易影响有限。
AI.method: 使用128个发展中国家1980-2019年的面板数据，采用双向固定效应（TWFE）和堆叠双重差分（stacked DiD）估计量进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）外部违约与大规模、持续的进口收缩相关，国内违约影响较小且短暂；（2）不对称效应集中于资本品进口；（3）外部违约后，国际私营部门贷款和中长期出口信用保险下降；（4）两种违约后出口均无显著变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统区分外部和国内主权违约对贸易的异质性影响，揭示了债权人身份作为违约贸易成本关键决定因素的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：主权违约对实体经济的损害程度取决于违约对象，外部违约通过贸易融资渠道产生更严重的贸易成本，这有助于设计更精准的债务重组策略和风险预警机制。

title: Does Digital Public Infrastructure Create Public Value? Evidence from Indian States, 2015-2023
affiliations: and Indian Institute of Foreign Trade

detail.title: Does Digital Public Infrastructure Create Public Value? Evidence from Indian States, 2015-2023
detail.abstract: This study empirically investigates whether Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) within the India Stack generates measurable public value in Indian states between 2015 and 2023 through financial inclusion, and whether this, in turn, boosts aggregate economic output. Analysing data from 28 Indian states, the research reveals that increased RuPay penetration significantly drives financial inclusion. Specifically, a ten per cent rise in RuPay usage leads to a five per cent increase in per capita bank account numbers and a nine per cent increase in deposit balances. However, the study also finds that increased digital infrastructure does not translate to higher economic growth within the nine-year timeframe. Interestingly, the infrastructure expands most effectively in states with lower literacy rates, areas historically neglected by traditional banking systems. Ultimately, these findings provide the first systematic evidence that the true public value of digital infrastructure in India is distributive rather than productive. While it successfully brings financial services to previously marginalised populations, it does not directly boost aggregate economic output. This crucial distinction reshapes how policymakers should evaluate the success of future digital initiatives.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2015-2023年印度28个邦的数据，实证发现印度数字公共基础设施（India Stack）通过RuPay卡渗透显著推动金融包容性，但并未在9年时间内转化为更高的经济增长。数字基础设施的真正公共价值在于分配性（将金融服务带给边缘化群体）而非生产性（直接提升经济产出）。
AI.research_question: 印度数字公共基础设施（India Stack）是否通过金融包容性产生可衡量的公共价值，以及这种价值是否进而推动总体经济产出？
AI.motivation: 数字公共基础设施（如India Stack）被广泛推广，但其实际公共价值（是生产性还是分配性）缺乏系统性的实证证据。本研究旨在填补这一空白，为政策制定者提供评估数字基础设施成功的理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字公共基础设施的公共价值理论——区分"生产性价值"（直接促进经济增长）与"分配性价值"（将金融服务扩展到边缘化群体）。
AI.method: 基于印度28个邦2015-2023年面板数据的实证分析，采用计量经济学方法检验RuPay渗透率与金融包容性、经济增长之间的关系。
AI.findings: （1）RuPay渗透率每提高10%，人均银行账户数增加5%，存款余额增加9%；（2）数字基础设施增加并未在9年时间内转化为更高的经济增长；（3）基础设施在最贫困、识字率低的邦扩张最为显著，这些地区传统银行服务长期不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供系统性证据，证明数字公共基础设施的公共价值本质上是分配性的而非生产性的，从而重塑了评估数字基础设施成功的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供重要启示：评价数字基础设施项目时不应仅关注GDP增长等生产性指标，而应重视其在金融包容性和缩小数字鸿沟方面的分配性价值。

title: Pólya-Gamma Swish Networks
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Pólya-Gamma Swish Networks
detail.abstract: Swish and its gated variant SwiGLU are the default nonlinearities in modern deep architectures, yet their sigmoid factor obstructs both closed-form probabilistic analysis and conditionally linear computation. We show that the Pólya-Gamma identity of Polson et al. (2013) yields an exact Gaussian mixture representation of the Swish and SiLU activations: conditional on a single Pólya-Gamma latent variable, a Swish unit is affine-Gaussian in its pre-activation, so a Swish-GLU layer is conditionally linear-Gaussian in its weights. The mixing expectation is a one-dimensional integral against a Pólya-Gamma measure of low effective dimension, which makes it a natural target for Halton quasi-Monte Carlo. We give the representation together with its gradient and predictive moments, a node-efficient Halton scheme with a Koksma-Hlawka error bound and its scrambled unbiased variant, and a conditionally conjugate Gibbs step for Bayesian training that extends the nonconjugate and nonlinear state-space data-augmentation program of Carlin and Polson (1991) and Carlin et al. (1992). A numerical study confirms that Halton driving reaches a target accuracy with about an order of magnitude fewer augmentation nodes than plain Monte Carlo, and that the conjugate sampler recovers the weights of a Swish gating layer. Throughout we are explicit about the regime where the representation helps and where the exponential tilt limits it.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Pólya-Gamma恒等式，将Swish和SiLU激活函数表示为精确的高斯混合模型，使得Swish-GLU层在给定潜在变量条件下变为条件线性高斯，并提出了Halton准蒙特卡洛采样方案和共轭吉布斯采样器，实现了约一个数量级的计算效率提升。
AI.research_question: 如何将Swish/SiLU激活函数及其门控变体SwiGLU转化为可进行闭式概率分析和条件线性计算的形式？
AI.motivation: Swish和SwiGLU是现代深度架构中的默认非线性函数，但其sigmoid因子阻碍了闭式概率分析和条件线性计算，限制了其在贝叶斯推断和状态空间模型中的应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: Pólya-Gamma恒等式（Polson et al., 2013）；高斯混合表示；Halton准蒙特卡洛方法；Koksma-Hlawka误差界；共轭吉布斯采样（Carlin and Polson, 1991; Carlin et al., 1992）。
AI.method: 理论推导：利用Pólya-Gamma恒等式推导Swish/SiLU的高斯混合表示；数值方法：Halton准蒙特卡洛方案及其无偏加扰变体；贝叶斯推断：条件共轭吉布斯采样步骤。
AI.findings: (1) Swish/SiLU可表示为关于Pólya-Gamma潜在变量的高斯混合；(2) Halton准蒙特卡洛相比普通蒙特卡洛约减少一个数量级的增广节点需求；(3) 共轭采样器能有效恢复Swish门控层的权重；(4) 明确了该表示的有效区间和指数倾斜的限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将Pólya-Gamma恒等式应用于Swish/SiLU激活函数，建立了精确的高斯混合表示理论，为非线性激活函数的贝叶斯分析提供了新工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了高效的Halton准蒙特卡洛采样方案（带误差界和无偏变体）以及共轭吉布斯采样器，显著降低了计算成本，适用于贝叶斯深度学习中的不确定性量化。

title: Endogenous Belief Hazards

detail.title: Endogenous Belief Hazards

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nothing to declare
declarations.ethicsApproval: Nothing to declare
declarations.funderStatement: Nothing to declare

detail.abstract: When an agent selects among models by testing rather than by averagingholding one until its own record rejects it, then re-selecting-the rate at which she abandons it is an endogenous belief hazard, derived from the rule and governed by a state the belief does not contain. The primitive is Ortoleva's, cast in continuous time. The belief is not a sufficient statistic for its own revision: the missing coordinate is the record under which it has survived, so two forecasters sharing every public-data posterior can face different hazards. Across a population that watches one path and differs only in surprise tolerance, the belief cross-section is the exact pushforward of that tolerance distribution. And because the trigger is the improbability of the record, not the payoff, the hazard is invariant to the stakes-the model's structural restriction: what the data could refute, and what separates inference-governed revision from its cost-based alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文研究代理人通过“检验”而非“平均”来选择模型的信念更新过程。当代理人坚持一个模型直到其表现记录被拒绝时，放弃率是一个内生的信念风险，由规则决定且受信念未包含的状态影响。信念不是自身更新的充分统计量，缺失的坐标是模型存活的记录历史。不同容差水平的人群面对同一数据路径时，信念横截面恰好是容差分布的推送。由于触发因素是记录的不可能性而非收益，风险对赌注不变——这是模型的结构性限制，也是推断驱动的修正与基于成本的替代方案的区别。
AI.research_question: 当代理人通过检验（testing）而非平均（averaging）来选择模型时，信念风险如何内生决定？信念是否是其自身更新的充分统计量？
AI.motivation: 传统贝叶斯更新中信念是充分统计量，但现实中代理人可能坚持某一模型直到被驳斥，这种检验机制下的信念动态与标准设定不同，需要理论刻画。
AI.theoretical_framework: Ortoleva (2012)的模型选择理论，扩展至连续时间；内生的信念风险（endogenous belief hazard）；信念非充分统计量；容差分布推送（pushforward）。
AI.method: 连续时间理论建模，推导检验策略下的信念动态，分析信念风险的结构特征。
AI.findings: (1) 信念不是自身更新的充分统计量，缺失的是模型存活的记录历史；(2) 两预测者共享相同后验但面临不同风险；(3) 人群信念横截面是容差分布的精确推送；(4) 信念风险对赌注不变，区分推断驱动与成本驱动的模型选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出检验机制下信念非充分统计量的新观点，界定内生信念风险的结构特征，区分推断驱动与成本驱动的模型选择。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现实中代理人坚持或放弃模型的行为提供理论基础，对预测市场、模型选择策略等领域有启示。

title: Orbital Supercomputing: Engineering Challenges and the "Picks and Shovels" Investments
affiliations: Meta Platforms Inc

detail.title: Orbital Supercomputing: Engineering Challenges and the "Picks and Shovels" Investments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no affiliations with, and has received no compensation from, any of the firms mentioned in this paper. The author discloses that they hold personal investment positions in the publicly traded equities included in the GOSIX index.

detail.abstract: As global capital markets validate the transition toward space-based infrastructure, orbital computing is emerging as the next frontier for high-performance computing (HPC) and artificial intelligence (AI). However, deploying advanced semiconductor silicon into the vacuum of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) introduces severe physical and engineering constraints. This paper identifies key "picks and shovels" investment opportunities by providing a comprehensive analysis of the core hardware bottlenecks governing orbital compute nodes, specifically thermal management, radiation mitigation, power distribution, optical communication, and launch survivability. In doing so, we highlight the specialized component, material, and subsystem providers that represent an overlooked hardware infrastructure layer compared to primary launch operators. Finally, we introduce the Global Orbital Supercompute Infrastructure Index (GOSIX; website: https://gosix.org), a biproportional thematic-factor tracking framework to isolate and measure this critical hardware and material science layer.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了轨道计算领域核心硬件瓶颈（热管理、辐射缓解、电力分配、光通信、发射生存性），并提出GOSIX指数作为追踪该硬件基础设施层的工具，指出专用组件、材料和子系统供应商是被忽视的投资机会。
AI.research_question: 在太空基础设施发展的背景下，轨道计算节点的核心硬件瓶颈是什么？哪些"镐和铲"（关键硬件材料和子系统）供应商代表被忽视的投资机会？
AI.motivation: 全球资本市场正在验证向天基基础设施的转型，轨道计算正成为高性能计算和人工智能的下一个前沿领域。然而，将先进半导体部署到近地轨道真空环境中面临严重的物理和工程限制，现有研究多关注发射运营层面，而忽略了底层硬件基础设施层的投资价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 硬件瓶颈分析框架（热管理、辐射缓解、电力分配、光通信、发射生存性）；主题因子投资追踪框架（GOSIX双比例指数模型）
AI.method: 对轨道计算节点的核心硬件瓶颈进行综合分析，识别关键组件、材料和子系统供应商；构建GOSIX（全球轨道超级计算基础设施指数），采用双比例主题因子追踪框架来隔离和量化硬件与材料科学层。
AI.findings: 确定了五大核心硬件瓶颈领域（热管理、辐射缓解、电力分配、光通信、发射生存性）；指出相较于主要发射运营商，专用组件、材料和子系统供应商构成了被忽视的硬件基础设施层；构建了GOSIX指数作为追踪工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了轨道计算硬件基础设施的系统性分析框架，将关注点从发射运营层面拓展到硬件组件和材料层面；引入GOSIX双比例主题因子追踪方法，为太空计算基础设施投资提供了可量化的追踪工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者识别了太空计算领域中被低估的"镐和铲"投资机会；提供了GOSIX指数作为衡量和追踪该新兴硬件基础设施层的实用工具；为政策制定者和行业参与者理解轨道计算节点面临的核心工程挑战提供了系统视角。

title: Beyond Beta: Stock Convexity and the Convexity Gap
affiliations: and

detail.title: Beyond Beta: Stock Convexity and the Convexity Gap

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no financial conflicts of interest related to this research. The analysis was conducted using publicly available market data and SEC filings. Michael Milligan is the originator of the Stock Convexity and Predictive Convexity Score framework.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research uses only publicly available historical market data and SEC filings; no human or animal subjects were involved.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces Stock Convexity, a measure of the asymmetry between a stock's drawdown and its subsequent recovery during market-stress events, and the Predictive Convexity Score (PCS), a fundamentals-based forward-looking signal computed from trailing twelve-month revenue growth, adjusted earnings growth, and their interaction. Across 18 market events spanning 1966 to 2022, comprising 13,925 stock-event observations from the merged CRSP-Compustat universe, stocks in the top PCS tier exhibit consistently larger convexity ratios than stocks in the bottom tier. In Fama-MacBeth cross-sectional regressions on 289 normal-market months from 1963 to 2024, the Tier 1 minus Tier 4 monthly premium is +0.009253 (Newey-West t = 8.36) after controlling for beta, size, book-to-market, and momentum, approximately 11.7 percent per year. A live two-year portfolio implementation (April 2024 to April 2026) returned 43.10 percent against 37.67 percent for the S&P 500 (Sharpe 0.877 vs. 0.739, alpha +5.43%). The convexity premium runs opposite in sign to the expected idiosyncratic skewness premium of Boyer, Mitton, and Vorkink (2010), establishing that PCS is not a relabeling of priced skewness. The framework proposes that the mean-variance tradition's symmetric-return assumption omits a measurable, fundamental-grounded asymmetry with material implications for portfolio construction and active management. This paper consolidates and substantially extends the empirical and conceptual groundwork of two earlier working papers by the same authors, Milligan and Milligan (2026a) and Milligan and Milligan (2026b), adding the formal asset-pricing tests, the 18-event historical panel, and the live portfolio implementation reported here.

AI.tldr: 本文提出股票凸性（Stock Convexity）和预测凸性评分（PCS），发现基于基本面构建的PCS能够有效预测股票在市场压力事件后的恢复不对称性，且该溢价不能被传统因子和偏态溢价所解释，为投资组合构建提供了新的维度。
AI.research_question: 股票收益在市场压力事件中的下跌与后续恢复是否存在可预测的不对称性？这种不对称性是否蕴含可被定价的截面溢价？
AI.motivation: 均值-方差传统假设对称性收益，忽略了股票在市场压力事件中下跌与恢复之间的不对称性。作者试图寻找一种基于基本面的前瞻性指标来捕捉这种不对称性，并检验其是否具有资产定价含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 股票凸性（Stock Convexity）概念；均值-方差框架的对称性假设批判；预期特质偏态溢价（Boyer, Mitton, and Vorkink, 2010）对比。
AI.method: 基于滚动12个月营收增长、调整后盈利增长及其交互项构建PCS；18个市场事件（1966-2022）共13,925个股票-事件样本进行凸性比率比较；Fama-MacBeth截面回归（1963-2024，289个正常市场月份）；两年期实时投资组合回测（2024年4月至2026年4月）。
AI.findings: 高PCS层级股票凸性比率显著高于低层级；Tier 1减Tier 4月度溢价为+0.009253（t=8.36），年化约11.7%；两年实时组合回报43.10%（S&P 500为37.67%），Sharpe比率0.877 vs 0.739，Alpha +5.43%；PCS溢价与预期特质偏态溢价符号相反，说明并非偏态溢价的重新标签。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"股票凸性"这一新概念，刻画股票下跌-恢复的不对称性；证明该不对称性具有基本面依据且可预测；区分了凸性溢价与偏态溢价，丰富资产定价理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供PCS作为可操作的选股信号；实时组合表现优于S&P 500且具有更高Sharpe比率；为主动管理和组合构建提供超越均值-方差框架的新工具。

title: Standards-Governance Institution for Recreation, Culture, Hospitality, and Restorative Life in the NewVistas Constitutional Economy
affiliations: Quaid-i-Azam University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Standards-Governance Institution for Recreation, Culture, Hospitality, and Restorative Life in the NewVistas Constitutional Economy
detail.abstract: The article argues that recreation is not merely entertainment, culture is not decorative surplus, and hospitality is not reducible to tourism. Together, these domains sustain movement, social connection, mental recovery, skill formation, family life, beauty, public celebration, and community retention. Yet the NewVistas framework does not convert them into state provision. Agency 6 governs the standards under which certified stewards and contractors may operate recreation, cultural, hospitality, park, resort, event, tourism, and restorative-life services, while remaining constitutionally prohibited from operating venues, employing providers, owning assets, underwriting insurance, or holding reserve funds. The paper develops an axiomatic-constrained systems framework to define Agency 6's proper domain, functions, and institutional limits. First, a human-continuity model represents vitality as a stock that depreciates under labor stress, care burden, operational fatigue, and social isolation, but is renewed through certified recreation, culture, hospitality, movement, fellowship, travel, rest, music, art, and public gathering. Second, an admissibility-frontier model specifies the safety, supervision, accessibility, capacity, emergencyresponse, equipment, youth-protection, environmental, and liability conditions under which proposed recreation or hospitality activities become standards-compliant. Third, an insurabilityboundary model shows that Agency 6 supports insurance eligibility by defining safety and certification conditions, while underwriting, premiums, reserves, and claim settlement remain outside its authority, particularly under Agency 21. Fourth, a capacity-trigger model identifies congestion in recreation and hospitality assets through utilization indicators and generates stewardfacing capacity signals without authorizing Agency 6 to build facilities, lease land, hire instructors, or operate programmes. The results show that Agency 6 resolves a central institutional problem: restorative life is too important to be left to unstructured markets alone, but too plural and intimate to be administered by a central cultural bureaucracy. Agency 6 therefore governs boundary conditions rather than service delivery. Facility custody remains with Agency 2, title with Agency 8, equipment with Agencies 3 and 9, accounting with Agency 16, aggregate metrics with Agency 18, audit with Agency 15, and underwriting with Agency 21. The paper concludes that Agency 6 preserves human renewal by making recreation, culture, hospitality, beauty, movement, fellowship, and restorative life safe, insurable, accessible, Life-Plan-compatible, and steward-operable without centralizing the cultural life of the community.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个公理约束下的系统框架，界定“机构6”在娱乐、文化、 hospitality 等恢复性生活领域的治理边界：它制定标准但禁止直接运营、雇人、拥有资产或承保，从而在市场化混乱与中央官僚化之间找到制度平衡。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个既能保障恢复性生活（娱乐、文化、 hospitality 等）的质量与安全，又避免中央集权式文化官僚体制或完全无结构市场失灵的治理机构？
AI.motivation: 娱乐、文化、 hospitality 等领域对人类活力恢复至关重要，但NewVitas框架未将其纳入国家直接供给。现有制度要么依赖完全无序的市场（导致不安全、不可及），要么走向中央文化官僚体系（扼杀多样性与亲密性），缺乏一个边界清晰的标准制定型机构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公理约束系统框架，包含四个人力活力连续模型（活力折旧与恢复）、准入门槛模型（安全/监管等条件）、可保性边界模型（机构6参与保险资格界定但不行使承保职能）、容量触发模型（利用指标触发容量信号而非直接建设设施）。
AI.method: 公理化建模与系统边界分析，通过四个相互衔接的数学模型（活力连续模型、准入门槛模型、可保性边界模型、容量触发模型）界定机构6的职能域与制度约束。
AI.findings: 机构6通过设定标准（安全、监督、可达性、容量、应急、设备、青少年保护、环境、责任等）治理恢复性生活领域，但宪法禁止其运营场所、雇佣提供者、拥有资产、承保或持有储备金。设施保管、产权、设备、会计、审计、承保等职能分别由其他机构承担。该设计解决了“恢复性生活太重要不能完全交给市场，又太多元私密不能由中央文化官僚机构管理”的核心制度困境。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种介于市场化供给与国家直接供给之间的“标准制定型机构”治理范式；发展了公理约束框架下多模型集成的制度设计方法论；将恢复性生活（活力恢复）纳入制度经济学的分析视野。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大规模社会治理架构（如NewVistas框架）提供了一种可操作的机构职能划分方案；明确了娱乐、文化、 hospitality 等领域治理的边界条件，避免职能重叠或空白；为社区层面的恢复性生活服务提供了安全、可保、可及且与人生计划兼容的制度保障。

title: Disengaged: Digital Life, Marriage, and the Young Male Labor-Force Decline
affiliations: and University of Cincinnati - Department of Economics

detail.title: Disengaged: Digital Life, Marriage, and the Young Male Labor-Force Decline

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We have no conflict of interest related to this paper
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human subjects took part in this paper
declarations.funderStatement: We received no funding for this paper
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: No clinical trial took place for this paper

detail.abstract:
Labor-force participation among young non-college educated men fell 3.2 points after

the mid-2000s and, alone among major groups, never recovered. Part of the decline

ran through marriage rather than work. Single men’s participation rate never broke;

what shifted was composition. Because married men participate eight to eleven points

above single men, the roughly ten-point fall in the married share explains about a

third of the decline. Run identically for women, the same shift reverses sign and

explains most of a symmetric rise, redistributing labor supply across the genders. A

within-zone cohort comparison ties the decline to the 4G rollout.

AI.tldr: 美国非大学学历年轻男性的劳动参与率在2000年代中期后下降了3.2个百分点，且未能恢复。其中约三分之一的下降可通过婚姻率下降（已婚男性参与率比单身男性高8-11个百分点）来解释；类似分析在女性中则呈现相反模式。研究进一步通过区域内的队列比较，将这一下降与4G网络部署联系起来。
AI.research_question: 为什么美国非大学学历年轻男性的劳动参与率在2000年代中期后持续下降且未恢复？婚姻结构变化和4G技术普及在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 非大学学历年轻男性是劳动力市场中一个重要且受关注度高的群体，其劳动参与率的持续下降具有显著的社会经济影响。已有研究多关注整体趋势，而本文试图分解婚姻结构变化和技术冲击（4G）的贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动供给理论、婚姻溢价理论、技术冲击与劳动力市场替代理论。
AI.method: 描述性统计分解（按婚姻状态分解参与率变化）、组间比较（已婚vs单身）、以及区域内队列比较（within-zone cohort comparison）识别4G部署的因果效应。
AI.findings: 1）非大学学历年轻男性劳动参与率下降3.2个百分点；2）下降主要通过婚姻渠道而非工作渠道传导；3）已婚男性参与率比单身男性高8-11个百分点；4）已婚比例下降约10个百分点，解释约三分之一的总体下降；5）对女性做同样分析，结果符号反转，解释了大部分女性参与率的上升；6）4G网络部署是导致该下降的重要原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 将婚姻结构变化纳入劳动参与率下降的分析框架，区分了"工作"与"婚姻"两条传导路径；揭示了技术冲击（4G）通过影响婚姻组成间接改变劳动供给的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解非大学学历男性劳动参与率长期低迷提供了新的解释维度（婚姻结构+技术冲击），对劳动力市场政策、婚姻家庭政策以及数字基础设施建设的社会影响评估具有参考价值。

title: Audit-Grade Machine Learning for Quantitative Finance: A Reproducibility Synthesis
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Audit-Grade Machine Learning for Quantitative Finance: A Reproducibility Synthesis
detail.abstract:
Machine learning is now central to quantitative finance, yet the field has no settled standard for when an ML result is trustworthy enough to deploy or to build upon. This paper synthesises the state of audit-grade evaluation in ML-finance: results that are reproducible from disclosed code and data, statistically significant under formal predictive-accuracy testing, and replayable from a tamper-evident audit trail under regulator inspection. We situate the problem within the broader replication-crisis literature (from Ioannidis (2005) and the Open Science Collaboration (2015) in science at large, to Hou, Xue, and Zhang (2020) and Harvey, Liu, and Zhu (2016) in empirical finance, to Gundersen and Kjensmo (2018) and the Pineau et al. (2021) reproducibility program in machine learning) and within the model-risk-management regulation that now codifies replayability as a supervisory expectation (SR 11-7, the EU AI Act, and the newer UK PRA, Singapore MAS, and Canada OSFI regimes).

Against that backdrop we bring four measurement instruments and open-source tools to bear on the ML-finance corner of the problem. A Reproducibility Disclosure Score (RDS) applied to 99 ML-finance studies finds a mean of 0.78, with full disclosure (code + open data) at only 16% and falling since 2020; a significance-test re-analysis of 30 volatility-forecasting comparisons finds that 12 of 14 reproducible headline wins (86%) do not survive Diebold-Mariano, Model Confidence Set, or SPA testing; and two MIT-licensed packages (vol-eval for forecast evaluation and mr-audit for SR 11-7 / EU AI Act audit trails) show that the tooling to close the gaps already exists. From these we identify three structural gaps in current practice (disclosure, significance testing, replayability), argue each is closable with modest engineering plus modest editorial discipline, and offer four editorial recommendations implementable at the manuscript level by a single reviewer or editor.

The empirical measurements are drawn from the author's prior work and are cited as such; the contribution of this paper is the field-level synthesis (placing those measurements within the wider reproducibility and model-risk literatures) and the implementable agenda that follows from it.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了机器学习在量化金融中的可审计评估标准，发现当前研究存在可重复性披露不足、统计显著性检验不达标、可回放性缺失三大结构性问题，并提供了测量工具和编辑层面的改进建议。
AI.research_question: 机器学习在量化金融领域的结果在何种程度上满足可审计标准（可再现、统计显著、可回放），以及如何弥补当前实践中的差距？
AI.motivation: 机器学习已成为量化金融的核心工具，但该领域缺乏统一的可信度标准。现有研究普遍存在复制危机问题，且监管机构（如SR 11-7、欧盟AI法案等）已将可回放性作为监管期望，因此亟需对现状进行系统性评估并提出改进方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复制危机文献（Ioannidis 2005；Open Science Collaboration 2015）、实证金融复制危机（Hou, Xue, & Zhang 2020；Harvey, Liu, & Zhu 2016）、机器学习可重复性项目（Gundersen & Kjensmo 2018；Pineau et al. 2021）、模型风险管理监管框架（SR 11-7、欧盟AI法案、英国PRA、新加坡MAS、加拿大OSFI）。
AI.method: 1) 可重复性披露得分（RDS）：对99篇ML金融研究进行评分；2) 统计显著性再分析：对30个波动率预测比较进行Diebold-Mariano、Model Confidence Set、SPA检验；3) 提供两个开源工具包（vol-eval和mr-audit）展示技术可行性。
AI.findings: 1) RDS均值为0.78，完全披露（代码+开放数据）仅占16%，且自2020年以来呈下降趋势；2) 14个可再现的"头条胜出"结果中，12个（86%）无法通过正式统计显著性检验；3) 存在三大结构性差距：披露不足、显著性检验缺失、可回放性缺失。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ML金融领域的可审计评估问题嵌入更广泛的复制危机文献和模型风险监管文献中进行系统性整合，提供了跨领域的问题定位和理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了量化的RDS指标以衡量研究可重复性；2) 提供了vol-eval和mr-audit两个开源工具包；3) 提出了四项可在稿件层面实施的编辑建议，可被单一审稿人或编辑采纳。

title: Fintech Access and the Gender Credit Gap among India's Small Entrepreneurs: Evidence from a CMIE 2025 Data
affiliations: and Indian Institute of Foreign Trade

detail.title: Fintech Access and the Gender Credit Gap among India's Small Entrepreneurs: Evidence from a CMIE 2025 Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency.

detail.abstract: This study examines whether fintech readiness, proxied by joint ownership of a mobile phone and a bank account, narrows the gender gap in formal bank credit access for small entrepreneurs using the nationally representative microdata on 80,910 small shopkeepers and street vendors of India from 2025 waves of the Centre for Monitoring Indian Economy's (CMIE) Consumer Pyramids Household Survey (CPHS). The study applies logistic regression models with an interaction between gender and fintech, using survey weights and primary sampling units-clustered standard errors. It found that fintech readiness is associated with a 3.0 percentage-point increase in the probability of holding a formal bank business loan for men, but with no statistically significant change for women, yielding a gender gap of-4.46 percentage points (95% bootstrap CI: [-8.15,-0.32]). The interaction is significant at conventional levels under primary sampling units and statelevel clustering of standard errors. The pattern is consistent with the social-embeddedness view of gender and credit. It implies that digital financial infrastructure does not resolve the gendered barriers that women small entrepreneurs face in accessing formal bank credit in India. The study also discusses limitations, including the cross-sectional design, the sensitivity of the estimate to state fixed effects, and the implications for fintech-driven financial inclusion policy in developing countries.

AI.tldr: 本文利用印度2025年CMIE-CPHS数据（80,910名小商贩），研究发现金融科技准备度（同时拥有手机和银行账户）使男性小企业主获得正规银行贷款的概率提高3.0个百分点，但对女性无显著影响，性别差距约为-4.46个百分点。这表明数字金融基础设施并未消除女性面临的社会嵌入性信贷障碍。
AI.research_question: 金融科技准备度（同时拥有手机和银行账户）是否缩小了小企业主在获取正规银行信贷方面的性别差距？
AI.motivation: 尽管金融科技被认为能降低信贷获取门槛，但女性小企业主在发展中国家仍面临系统性信贷歧视。现有研究缺乏对金融科技是否真能弥合性别差距的大规模实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会嵌入性视角（Social-Embeddedness View of Gender and Credit）：女性的信贷获取障碍嵌入在社会关系、信任网络和制度偏见中，单纯的技术基础设施不足以克服这些根深蒂固的社会壁垒。
AI.method: 使用印度CMIE CPHS 2025年数据（80,910名小店主和街头小贩），采用逻辑回归模型，纳入性别与金融科技准备度的交互项，使用调查权重和PSU聚类稳健标准误，并进行Bootstrap置信区间估计。
AI.findings: 金融科技准备度使男性获得正规商业贷款的概率提高3.0个百分点，但对女性无统计显著影响；性别差距为-4.46个百分点（95% Bootstrap CI: [-8.15, -0.32]）；交互项在PSU和省级聚类标准误下均显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"社会嵌入性"理论提供了大规模微观实证证据，表明数字金融基础设施无法自动克服女性面临的社会结构性信贷壁垒。
AI.practical_contributions: 对发展中国家金融科技驱动普惠金融政策提出警示：仅靠提供数字基础设施无法消除性别信贷差距，需要配套的社会、制度和行为干预措施。

title: Does Combatant Status Matter? US Banks and Fintech Firms' Equity Responses to the Iran-Israel War and Operation Epic Fury
affiliations: and Indian Institute of Foreign Trade

detail.title: Does Combatant Status Matter? US Banks and Fintech Firms' Equity Responses to the Iran-Israel War and Operation Epic Fury

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency.

detail.abstract: This study examines how the United States (US) and Iran's military escalation between February and April 2026 (Operation Epic Fury) was transmitted to US-listed financial intermediaries. Using daily firm-level data for ten traditional banks and ten fintech platforms, the study documents a sharp divergence in equity returns. Over an eleven-day window focused directly on the operation's announcement, banks register an average cumulative average abnormal return (CAAR) of-8.7%. In comparison, fintech platforms gain 5.7%, a statistically significant 14.4-percentage-point gap. Panel difference-indifferences (DiD) regressions with firm fixed effects confirm a robust positive fintech × event interaction across multiple event-window definitions. Remarkably, this asymmetry was not seen during the June 2025 Iran and Israel Twelve-Day War, a conflict in which the US played only a peripheral role, isolating direct US combatant status as the trigger for a significant reallocation of equity value from traditional banks to fintech platforms. The asymmetry is consistent with several non-mutually exclusive channels, such as bank net interest margin compression from a flattening yield curve, sustained equity risk appetite among growth-oriented fintech firms, and the non-realisation of feared cyber-retaliation risk. However, the study design identifies combatant status as the trigger rather than decomposing the response into individual channels.

AI.tldr: 研究美国与伊朗2026年军事升级（"史诗之怒行动"）期间，传统银行与金融科技公司股票回报出现显著分化：银行累计异常收益为-8.7%，金融科技公司为+5.7%，差距达14.4个百分点。这种分化在美国仅起次要作用的2025年以伊战争中未出现，表明美国直接参战状态是触发资金从传统银行向金融科技重新配置的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 美国作为直接参战国的军事升级如何传导至美国上市金融中介机构（传统银行与金融科技平台）的股票回报？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治冲突对金融市场的冲击日益显著，但现有研究缺乏对"美国直接参战"这一特定状态下不同类型金融中介差异化反应的系统分析，尤其是传统银行与金融科技平台之间的结构性差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件研究法（累计异常收益CAAR）、双重差分模型（DiD）、净息差压缩理论（收益率曲线平坦化）、股权风险偏好理论、网络攻击风险预期理论。
AI.method: 基于日度公司层面数据，选取10家传统银行和10家金融科技平台，采用事件研究法计算累计异常收益（CAAR），并运用含公司固定效应的面板双重差分回归（DiD），定义多个事件窗口检验稳健性。同时以2025年以伊战争作为对照事件。
AI.findings: （1）"史诗之怒行动"公告后11天窗口内，银行CAAR为-8.7%，金融科技平台为+5.7%，差距14.4个百分点且统计显著；（2）DiD回归证实金融科技×事件交互项显著为正；（3）2025年美国仅起次要作用的以伊战争中未观察到该分化，表明美国直接参战状态是触发分化的关键条件；（4）分化的潜在渠道包括银行净息差压缩、金融科技持续的风险偏好以及网络攻击风险未兑现。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次区分"美国直接参战"与"美国非直接参战"两种地缘政治情境下金融中介的差异化反应，揭示了军事冲突传导至金融市场的条件异质性；提出并检验了多个非互斥传导渠道（利差渠道、风险偏好渠道、网络风险渠道）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者在地缘政治冲突期间进行金融行业资产配置提供决策参考；为金融监管机构理解战争状态下系统性风险的结构性转移提供实证依据；提示金融科技平台在军事冲突中可能具有的"避险"属性。

title: Designing Performance-Based Promotion Models for Hybrid Public-Private Institutions: A Policy and Systems Proposition
affiliations: Ladoke Akintola University of Technology

detail.title: Designing Performance-Based Promotion Models for Hybrid Public-Private Institutions: A Policy and Systems Proposition
detail.abstract: Hybrid public-private institutions occupy an awkward middle ground between the rule-bound, tenure-oriented promotion cultures of the public sector and the outcome-oriented, incentive-driven cultures of the private sector. Designing promotion models for such institutions is therefore not a matter of importing either template wholesale, but of reconciling two logics. This paper develops a policy and systems proposition for performance-based promotion in hybrid institutions, building on Elikwu (2025). We frame promotion design as a systems problem in which measurement, incentives, fairness, and institutional mission interact, and we propose design principles that balance objectivity with contextual judgment. We connect the argument to the broader theme of measurement-driven management that runs through performance monitoring in other domains-including risk monitoring (Oyekola, Elikwu, & Odunaike, 2022)-and argue that the design challenges are structurally similar: how to measure what matters, how to avoid gaming, and how to keep human judgment in the loop. The contribution is a design framework and a set of implementation cautions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨混合型公私机构（hybrid public-private institutions）的绩效导向晋升模型设计，提出在公共部门的规则导向文化与私营部门的结果导向文化之间构建平衡的系统性设计框架与原则。
AI.research_question: 混合型公私机构应如何设计绩效导向的晋升模型，以在规则导向与结果导向两种逻辑之间取得平衡？
AI.motivation: 混合型公私机构处于公共部门与私营部门之间的尴尬地带，简单的模板移植不可行，需要调和两种不同的组织逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统理论（将晋升设计视为测量、激励、公平性与机构使命互动的系统问题）；测量驱动管理理论（借鉴绩效监控、风险监控等领域的结构相似性）。
AI.method: 政策与系统命题推导（proposition-building approach），基于已有文献（Elikwu, 2025）进行理论建构，并通过跨领域类比（风险监控）进行论证。
AI.findings: 提出了一套设计原则，平衡客观性与情境判断；识别了绩效晋升设计的核心挑战：测量什么重要的事、如何避免操纵（gaming）、如何将人类判断纳入流程。
AI.theory_contributions: 将混合型机构的晋升设计视为一个跨领域的系统性测量问题，揭示了其与风险监控等领域的结构相似性，拓展了测量驱动管理的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为混合型公私机构提供了一套可操作的设计框架（design framework）和实施警示（implementation cautions），帮助管理者在激励、公平与使命之间取得平衡。

title: A Systems View of Resilience: Common Principles Across Financial and Infrastructure Risk
affiliations: Ladoke Akintola University of Technology

detail.title: A Systems View of Resilience: Common Principles Across Financial and Infrastructure Risk
detail.abstract: Resilience is pursued in many domains-banking, power systems, supply chains-usually as if each were a separate specialty. This paper argues that resilience has a common systems logic that transcends domain, and that recognizing it enables valuable cross-domain transfer. We draw together financial risk management, where real-time monitoring (Oyekola, Elikwu, & Odunaike, 2022) and stress testing (Odunaike, Agbaakin, & Elikwu, 2024) instantiate resilience, and power systems, where intelligent monitoring and control do the same (Olugbemi & Elikwu, 2025). Using the vocabulary of systems thinking, we identify shared principles-observability, redundancy, graduated response, and adaptivity-and show how each appears in both domains. The contribution is a unifying framework that treats resilience as a general property of complex systems and points toward the transfer of techniques across fields that rarely speak to one another.

AI.tldr: 本文提出韧性（resilience）具有超越具体领域的通用系统逻辑，通过整合金融风险管理与电力系统的实践，识别出可观测性、冗余、分级响应和适应性四个共同原则，构建了一个跨领域通用的韧性分析框架。
AI.research_question: 不同领域的韧性是否存在共同的系统逻辑？能否通过跨领域转移来提升对韧性这一复杂系统普遍属性的理解？
AI.motivation: 韧性在银行、电力系统、供应链等多个领域被分别研究，但各领域之间缺乏交流，导致知识碎片化。作者认为韧性具有超越具体领域的共同系统逻辑，识别这一逻辑有助于有价值的跨领域知识转移。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统思维（systems thinking），将韧性视为复杂系统的一种普遍属性。
AI.method: 跨领域比较与整合分析：将金融风险管理（实时监控、压力测试）与电力系统（智能监控与控制）进行对照，运用系统思维的词汇识别共同原则。
AI.findings: 识别出四个跨领域共通的韧性原则：可观测性（observability）、冗余（redundancy）、分级响应（graduated response）和适应性（adaptivity），并展示了这些原则在金融和电力两个领域的具体体现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一框架，将韧性视为复杂系统的普遍属性，打破了领域壁垒，为跨领域技术转移提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同领域（如银行、电力系统、供应链等）之间相互借鉴韧性管理技术提供了路径，促进那些很少相互交流的领域之间的经验转移。

title: Bridging Continuous Monitoring and Scenario Stress Testing: Toward an Integrated Credit Risk Architecture
affiliations: Ladoke Akintola University of Technology

detail.title: Bridging Continuous Monitoring and Scenario Stress Testing: Toward an Integrated Credit Risk Architecture
detail.abstract: Credit risk management has developed two powerful but largely separate capabilities: real-time monitoring, which senses deterioration as it happens, and stress testing, which evaluates the portfolio against severe hypothetical scenarios. This paper argues that treating these as separate is a lost opportunity, and develops an integrated architecture in which continuous monitoring and scenario stress testing inform each other. Building on real-time AI-based monitoring (Oyekola, Elikwu, & Odunaike, 2022) and macroeconomic-shock stress testing (Odunaike, Agbaakin, & Elikwu, 2024), we specify the feedback loops that connect the two: monitoring signals that flag drift toward stress scenarios, and stress results that inform monitoring thresholds. We extend the architecture to structural drivers such as climate (Saadu-Ayuba, Elikwu, & Odunaike, 2019), yielding a three-horizon system that spans the immediate, the scenario-conditional, and the structural. The contribution is an integration blueprint and a discussion of the organizational changes it requires.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将信用风险管理的实时监控与压力测试两大能力整合为一个统一架构，通过反馈循环实现两者相互支撑，并扩展至气候等结构性因素，形成三时间维度的风险管理系统。
AI.research_question: 如何将信用风险中的实时监控与压力测试整合为一个相互反馈的统一架构？
AI.motivation: 当前信用风险管理中，实时监控与压力测试作为两种强大但彼此独立的能力，未能发挥协同效应，这构成一个"失去的机会"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AI实时监控（Oyekola等, 2022）与宏观经济冲击压力测试（Odunaike等, 2024）的既有框架，构建反馈循环机制。
AI.method: 概念框架构建与架构设计，通过规范反馈回路（监控信号触发压力情景、压力结果调整监控阈值）实现整合。
AI.findings: 提出三时间维度系统：即时监控层、情景条件层、结构性（气候）层，明确了各层之间的反馈机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了实时监控与压力测试整合的理论蓝图，拓展了风险管理理论的系统性与动态性视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了可操作的风险管理整合架构，并讨论了实施所需的组织变革。

title: Place-Based Credit inside Functional Regional Economies: Spatial Incidence, Reallocation, and Urban Hierarchy

detail.title: Place-Based Credit inside Functional Regional Economies: Spatial Incidence, Reallocation, and Urban Hierarchy
detail.abstract: Because workers, firms, suppliers, and credit relationships cross municipal borders, a local policy gain can create regional activity, displace activity from nearby places, or change which tier of the regional hierarchy captures formal employment and establishments. This paper studies that spatial-incidence problem using Brazil's Northeast Constitutional Financing Fund (FNE), a large place-based credit program that changes the cost and availability of productive capital across eligible municipalities. Predicted exposure combines predetermined sectoral structure with external sector-year movements in subsidized credit, and the baseline design compares municipalities within the same Immediate Region and year. Exposed municipalities expand formal employment, establishments, and payroll; the rest of the region does not contract; regional formal aggregates rise; and exposed municipalities gain shares of regional formal activity. Effects are concentrated outside regional cores and strengthen among less central or smaller non-core municipalities. Because regional value added and value-added intensity do not rise, the evidence shows that place-based credit expands and decentralizes formal scale more clearly than it generates regional value-added upgrading.

AI.tldr: 本文研究巴西东北部宪法融资基金（FNE）这一大规模地方信贷政策，发现受补贴的 municipalities 扩大了正式就业、企业和工资单，但区域增加值并未显著提升，表明地方信贷主要推动正式经济规模扩张与空间分散，而非区域附加值升级。
AI.research_question: 地方信贷政策（FNE）对区域经济活动的影响是促进本地增长、替代邻近区域，还是改变区域层级结构？其空间归宿（spatial incidence）如何？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对地方政策的空间溢出效应关注不足，尤其是信贷政策如何通过跨市边界的经济联系影响区域整体活动分布，以及政策收益是否真正惠及目标区域而非被其他地方吸收。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间归宿理论（spatial incidence）、地方信贷政策效应、区域层级结构理论
AI.method: 利用巴西FNE政策的准自然实验，结合预设的行业结构与外部部门-年份补贴信贷变动构建预测暴露度，采用基准设计比较同一直接区（Immediate Region）和年份内不同城市的差异。
AI.findings: 受政策暴露的城市正式就业、企业数和工资单显著扩张；其余区域未收缩；区域正式总量上升；受暴露城市在区域正式活动中的份额增加。效应集中在区域核心之外，且在更边缘或较小的非核心城市更强。区域增加值和增加值强度未上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了地方信贷政策的空间归宿——扩张并分散正式经济规模，而非推动区域附加值升级；提供了信贷政策影响区域层级结构（核心-外围）的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中地区政策制定者提供参考：地方信贷能促进边缘地区正式就业和企业增长，但未必提升区域整体增加值；政策设计需考虑空间溢出和层级结构效应。

title: Where Credit is Cheap, Income Shifts
affiliations: University of Sussex Business School, Durham Business School and University of Southampton

detail.title: Where Credit is Cheap, Income Shifts
detail.abstract: We study whether firms shift income across domestic subsidiaries to obtain cheaper credit. We find that U.S. parent firms engage in income shifting motivated by banking market competition. Subsidiaries in states with more competitive banking markets report systematically higher profitability, consistent with parent firms reallocating income to entities where improved financials translate into cheaper credit. Standalone firms in the same banking markets show no comparable profitability gain, and the pattern does not appear in real operating metrics, indicating that the effect reflects income reallocation rather than genuine productivity differences. The combination of shifted income and competitive banking amplifies the loan spread benefit of banking competition for highly profitable subsidiaries. Event-study evidence around bank merger shocks indicates that a reduction in local banking competition lowers subsidiary profitability and raises subsidiaries' loan spreads. The results reveal a non-tax motive for domestic income shifting and suggest that banking market structure shapes not only how firms borrow but also how they report income.

AI.tldr: 研究发现美国母公司出于获得更廉价信贷的动机，在子公司之间进行国内收入转移，将收入重新分配给位于银行竞争更激烈市场的子公司，以改善其财务报表从而获得更低贷款利率。
AI.research_question: 企业是否会为了获取更便宜的信贷而在国内子公司之间进行收入转移？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注跨国收入转移的税收动机，但对国内收入转移的非税动机知之甚少；同时银行市场竞争如何影响企业融资行为已有研究，但尚未探讨企业是否会主动调整收入报告以利用竞争性银行市场获取更优贷款条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 收入转移理论、银行市场竞争理论、信息不对称与信贷定价理论
AI.method: 实证分析，使用美国企业数据；比较母公司与子公司的盈利能力差异；对比独立公司作为对照组；真实经营指标检验；银行并购冲击的事件研究法。
AI.findings: 位于银行竞争更激烈州的子公司报告的系统性更高盈利能力；独立公司在相同银行市场中没有类似盈利提升；真实经营指标未发现类似模式；收入转移与银行竞争共同放大高盈利子公司的贷款利差收益；银行并购导致竞争降低的事件降低了子公司盈利能力并提高了贷款利差。
AI.theory_contributions: 发现了国内收入转移的非税收动机——获取更廉价信贷，拓展了收入转移理论的应用范围；揭示了银行市场结构不仅影响企业融资方式，还影响企业收入报告行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 对企业财务报告和融资策略有启示：企业在选择子公司所在地和进行内部资源配置时，会考虑当地银行市场竞争环境；对监管机构有启示：银行市场竞争格局的变化可能引发企业财务报告的连锁反应。

title: Personalized Bayesian Causal Inference: The Probability of Individual Effect
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, George Mason University and

detail.title: Personalized Bayesian Causal Inference: The Probability of Individual Effect
detail.abstract: The average treatment effect (ATE) is an accounting identity: a population average whose value depends on the reference population, not on the underlying mechanism. We argue the correct estimand for individual decisions is the probability of benefit where given the unit's history. We give four results. (i) A positive ATE is compatible with harm to a majority of units, illustrated with the 1930 Lanarkshire milk experiment and the RECOVERY dexamethasone trial. (ii) A hierarchical Bayesian model with a horseshoe prior on sparse effect heterogeneity, fit via Generative Bayesian Computation (GBC) after Neyman-orthogonal residualization, achieves the sparse minimax rate O(s log p/n) and resolves Ritov et al.'s (2014) CODA critique of high-dimensional Bayesian inference. (iii) A Bayesian difference-indifferences estimator with individual random effects on the treatment indicator delivers exactly; a panel simulation shows an 8.5-fold RMSE improvement over two-way fixed effects (TWFE), which has the wrong ATE sign in our example. (iv) The excess decision regret of double machine learning (DML) relative to the personalized Bayes rule decomposes into three non-negative terms: uncertainty, heterogeneity, and sparsity.

AI.tldr: 本文指出平均处理效应（ATE）是个会计恒等式，对个体决策而言，正确的估计量应是个体获益概率。论文通过四项结果论证：ATE为正时仍可能对多数个体有害；提出基于马刺先验的分层贝叶斯模型解决高维推断问题；构建贝叶斯双重差分估计器优于传统TWFE；并分解双机器学习相对于个性化贝叶斯规则的决策遗憾。
AI.research_question: 个体决策中，应使用什么估计量替代平均处理效应（ATE）？如何解决高维异质性处理效应估计问题？
AI.motivation: ATE作为群体平均值掩盖了个体层面的异质性，可能导致多数个体实际上受到伤害，需要更精准的个体化决策准则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯分层模型、马刺先验（horseshoe prior）、生成贝叶斯计算（GBC）、奈曼正交残差化、贝叶斯双重差分、双机器学习（DML）
AI.method: 四项理论结果+实证案例（1930年拉纳克郡牛奶实验、RECOVERY地塞米松试验、面板模拟）
AI.findings: (i) 正ATE可伴随多数个体受害；(ii) 所提贝叶斯模型达到稀疏极小化最优率O(s log p/n)；(iii) 贝叶斯双重差分的RMSE比TWFE提升8.5倍；(iv) DML的决策遗憾可分解为不确定性、异质性和稀疏性三项。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了ATE作为个体决策依据的局限性，提出了以个体获益概率为目标的估计框架，并在理论上证明了所提方法的最优性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为精准医疗、政策评估等需要个体化决策的场景提供了方法论指导，改进了高维异质性处理效应估计的实践工具。

title: Economic Foundation for Bitcoin - Bitcoin and Monetary Dilution: A U.S. M2 Pricing Framework
affiliations: and University of Cambridge

detail.title: Economic Foundation for Bitcoin - Bitcoin and Monetary Dilution: A U.S. M2 Pricing Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors own bitcoin in their ersonal portfolio.
declarations.funderStatement: Grant from Salomon Brothers.

detail.abstract: We present evidence that Bitcoin functions, at least in significant part, as a specialized store of value, and that its economic value is statistically related to monetary dilution. Data indicate that Bitcoin’s long-run price tracks the annual expansion of U.S. dollar money supply relative to Bitcoin’s implied market capitalization, a relationship reinforced by Bitcoin’s fixed-supply protocol design. The relationship is statistically significant across the sample tested, though the sample remains limited and the findings should be read as evidence supporting this thesis rather than as proof of it; further data and out-of-sample testing are needed. Backtested against annual year-end prices over the primary 2013–2024 sample, the model yields Pearson r = 0.896 and R² = 0.803 (log₁₀ basis), with all twelve primary-sample years within one order of magnitude of the model price. Directional accuracy is encouraging at 63.6% (7 of 11 transitions), below a simple always-positive benchmark. Beyond its statistical performance, the model has four important implications. First, Bitcoin possesses a quantitative, testable valuation framework: its price tracks the relationship between fiat monetary creation and the capacity of a fixed-supply asset to absorb reallocation demand. This supports the view that Bitcoin’s value is linked to a meaningful extent to monetary dilution. Second, as the empirical record deepens across additional monetary expansion and contraction regimes, confidence in the model’s predictive value should strengthen; each additional annual observation, and further out-of-sample testing, will add evidence one way or the other. Third, broad adoption of a shared pricing model may contribute to reducing Bitcoin’s price volatility over time, consistent with the pattern observed as other asset classes have matured around shared valuation conventions, though this market-structure effect remains a hypothesis rather than a demonstrated result. Finally, the analysis indicates that Bitcoin has shown a stronger relationship to U.S. M2 growth than gold under the methodology tested.

AI.tldr: 本文提出比特币在很大程度上是一种专业化的价值储存手段，其经济价值与货币稀释（美元M2扩张）存在统计显著的关系。基于2013-2024年年度数据的回测显示，模型Pearson r=0.896，R²=0.803，且比特币与M2增长的关系比黄金更强。
AI.research_question: 比特币的经济价值是否与法定货币的货币稀释（特别是美元M2供应量扩张）存在可量化的统计关系？
AI.motivation: 比特币自诞生以来缺乏公认的估值框架，价格波动剧烈。研究者希望检验比特币作为“数字黄金”的价值储存假说，并为其提供一个可量化的、可检验的估值模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价值储存理论、货币稀释理论、固定供给资产与法币扩张的关系、资产定价的供求再分配机制。
AI.method: 基于年度数据的统计回归模型，将比特币长期价格与美元M2货币供应量扩张相对于比特币隐含市值的关系进行建模。使用2013-2024年样本进行回测，计算Pearson相关系数、R²和方向准确率。
AI.findings: （1）模型Pearson r=0.896，R²=0.803（log₁₀基准）；（2）12个主要样本年份的价格均在模型价格的一个数量级以内；（3）方向准确率63.6%（7/11次转变）；（4）比特币与M2增长的关系比黄金更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 为比特币提供了一种定量的、可检验的估值框架，支持比特币价值与货币稀释存在有意义的关联这一观点；将比特币纳入资产定价的货币稀释理论范畴。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为投资者提供了评估比特币价格的量化工具；（2）提示广泛采用共享定价模型可能有助于降低比特币未来价格波动；（3）比特币的定价模型未来可在更多货币扩张和紧缩周期中得到检验和强化。

title: AI Risk Premium: Insights from the US Corporate Bond Market
affiliations: Dublin City University, , Dublin City University Business School and Dublin City University

detail.title: AI Risk Premium: Insights from the US Corporate Bond Market
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether sectoral AI intensity affects corporate bond pricing at issuance. Using U.S. corporate bonds issued between 2015 and 2025, we find that firms in more AI-intensive sectors face higher yield spreads. Among the four OECD AI dimensions, AI use is associated with the largest premium, while the AI human capital, AI innovation, and AI exposure show weaker effects. The premium is significant for medium- and long-term bonds but not for short-term bonds. The difference-in-differences analysis shows that the AI premium increases significantly following the launch of ChatGPT.

AI.tldr: 本文研究行业AI强度对企业债券发行定价的影响，发现AI密集型行业的企业面临更高的信用利差，且这一溢价在ChatGPT发布后显著增加。
AI.research_question: 行业AI强度如何影响企业债券的发行定价？
AI.motivation: AI技术快速发展，但其对金融市场（尤其是债券市场）的影响尚不明确，需要探究AI强度是否以及如何影响企业融资成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于OECD的四个AI维度（AI使用、AI人力资本、AI创新、AI曝光度），分析AI强度对债券定价的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用2015-2025年美国企业债券数据，采用面板回归和双重差分法（DID）进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）AI密集型行业的企业债券发行利差更高；（2）AI使用维度的溢价最大；（3）AI溢价仅对中长期债券显著；（4）ChatGPT发布后AI溢价显著增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将AI行业强度与公司债券定价联系起来，区分了OECD四个AI维度的异质性影响，并识别了ChatGPT这一外部冲击的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业融资决策提供参考：AI密集型行业的企业需预期更高的债券融资成本；为投资者提供定价依据；为政策制定者理解AI技术对金融市场的溢出效应提供实证证据。

title: CFA Franc Zone: The Impasse a Structural Non-Decision Approach

detail.title: CFA Franc Zone: The Impasse a Structural Non-Decision Approach

declarations.funderStatement: Independent research. No external funding.

detail.abstract: The CFA franc zone is one of the oldest monetary arrangements in the post-colonial world and a colonial-era legacy that has outlived independence, the 1994 devaluation, and successive waves of political contestation. Despite partial reforms-notably the 2019-2021 UEMOA reform, pressure from the Alliance of Sahel States (AES), and the adoption of the CEMAC Act by the US Congress-its core architecture has remained largely unchanged. This paper argues that the persistence of the CFA franc zone cannot be explained either by its technical performance alone or by a unilateral French determination to preserve it. It results instead from a non-concerted convergence of individual rationalities-French, African, institutional, and private-all of which have structural reasons not to bear, alone, the cost of a clarifying monetary decision. Drawing on recent institutional data (BCEAO, BEAC, the French Treasury, the African Development Bank, and the Policy Center for the New South), as well as on both critical and technocratic contributions, the paper distinguishes between technical constraints and political choices and shows how a historically imposed dependence has gradually evolved, at least in the UEMOA, into a partially chosen dependence. It frames the current stalemate as a form of structural nondecision: a second-best equilibrium in which maintaining the status quo is individually rational yet collectively sub-optimal. Any significant change-maintaining, transforming, or exiting the CFA franc zone-would require at least one actor to accept a differentiated burden of transition. Recent shifts in constraints have made this deferred decision more visible, but no easier to assume.

AI.tldr: 本文分析CFA法郎区这一后殖民时代货币安排的持续存在机制。研究发现，该制度之所以长期维持，并非由于技术绩效或法国的单方面意志，而是法国、非洲国家、制度主体和私人行为体在结构性理由下各自理性地避免独自承担货币改革成本的结果。当前僵局是一种"结构性非决策"——维持现状对个体理性但对集体次优。
AI.research_question: CFA法郎区这一殖民时期货币安排在经历独立、1994年贬值及多次政治挑战后，为何其核心架构仍基本保持不变？
AI.motivation: 现有解释要么强调技术绩效（经济功能），要么归因于法国单方面意志，但两者均不足以解释CFA法郎区的持久性。本文试图提供更完整的解释框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性非决策理论（structural nondecision）、个体理性与集体次优的博弈均衡、依赖演化理论（从被迫依赖到部分选择依赖）
AI.method: 基于多来源制度数据（西非央行BCEAO、中非央行BEAC、法国财政部、非洲开发银行、新南方政策中心）的定性分析，结合批判性与技术官僚文献的区分分析。
AI.findings: 1. CFA法郎区的持续是法国、非洲国家、制度主体和私人行为体四种理性非协调趋同的结果；2. 历史强加的依赖已演变为（至少在UEMOA）部分选择的依赖；3. 当前僵局是结构性非决策：个体理性维持现状但集体次优；4. 任何重大变化（维持、改革或退出）都需要至少一个行为体承担差异化的转型成本；5. 近期约束条件的变化使被推迟的决策更明显，但并未使其更容易承担。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"结构性非决策"概念解释制度僵化；将个体理性趋同与集体次优相结合的分析框架；区分技术约束与政治选择，揭示制度依赖的演化机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解后殖民货币安排的改革困境提供分析工具；对2019-2021年UEMOA改革、萨赫勒国家联盟施压、美国国会CEMAC法案等近期事件提供解释；为政策制定者识别改革突破口提供参考。

title: Estimates of the Illegal Vaping Market in Canada
affiliations: Concordia University Montreal

detail.title: Estimates of the Illegal Vaping Market in Canada

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Disclosure & c.o.i: Ian Irvine, professor of Economics at Concordia University, has worked for the federal government as a consultant in the fields of tobacco and alcohol policy as well as in the private sector. He has received grants from the Global Action Against Smoking foundation and has accepted conference expenses from the nicotine-producing sector of the economy. The views expressed and conclusions presented are solely those of the author. Artificial Intelligence: No use has been made of AI at any point in the paper Ethics: No ethics permission sought or required Data availability: All data are publicly available from the sources cited in the text
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not required. All data required are in the public domain.
declarations.funderStatement: Project is unfunded

detail.abstract: New data series from Statistics Canada on the sales of vaping products provide evidence on the extent of illegality in e-cigarette markets, both provincially and federally. This paper address two empirical questions: First, how much of the market is either grey (borderline illegal) or black (definitely illegal)? Second, how does illegality vary by province? We find that the outsourcing of purchases to adjoining provinces, the grey market, is particularly high for those provinces with the strictest product-use regulations-Nova Scotia, British Columbia, Quebec and Saskatchewan. Since product that is banned in those provinces is readily available elsewhere, restrictive measures in any given province benefit out-of-province vendors, some of which may be legal, and illegal vendors everywhere. In volume terms Quebec stands out. The size of the black market is estimated by merging consumption data with legal sales data. Simulations indicate that it too is large, perhaps accounting for 30% of the total market. We conclude by pointing to the need to address incentives for illegal activity at the tax and regulatory stage of legislation.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用加拿大统计局关于电子烟产品销售的新数据，考察了电子烟市场的非法性程度，发现灰色市场和黑色市场规模巨大，且因省份监管严格程度而异。严格的省级监管将消费推向外省（灰色市场）和非法渠道（黑市），魁北克省的黑市规模尤为突出，约占全国总量的30%。
AI.research_question: 电子烟市场中灰色市场（边界非法）和黑色市场（明确非法）的规模有多大？各省之间的非法性程度如何差异？
AI.motivation: 加拿大各省对电子烟产品实施了不同的监管政策，但缺乏系统的证据来评估这些监管对市场非法性的影响。了解非法市场的规模对于制定有效的税收和监管政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非法市场经济学、监管溢出效应、跨省购物替代行为
AI.method: 使用加拿大统计局关于电子烟产品销售的新数据序列，将消费数据与合法销售数据合并，通过模拟方法估算黑市规模。
