AI.findings: （1）在监管最严格的省份（新斯科舍省、不列颠哥伦比亚省、魁北克省和萨斯喀彻温省），跨省购买（灰色市场）尤为突出；（2）魁北克省的黑市规模最大，模拟显示黑市约占全国总市场的30%。
AI.theory_contributions: 为监管严格程度与非法市场活动之间的关系提供了实证证据，揭示了产品禁令可能产生跨省溢出效应，使外省合法供应商和各地非法供应商受益。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于电子烟市场监管的重要启示：需要在税收和监管立法阶段解决非法活动的激励问题，否则严格的省级监管可能适得其反，助长灰色和黑色市场。

title: Code at the Door: Authenticated Delivery and the Reasonable Modification Requirement Under ADA Title III

detail.title: Code at the Door: Authenticated Delivery and the Reasonable Modification Requirement Under ADA Title III
detail.abstract: A consumer with a disability orders goods online, pays in full, and then cannot receive them. For orders above a value threshold, the seller conditions delivery on an in person authentication: the customer must be physically present, answer the door to an unfamiliar person on the driver's schedule, and read a one time code aloud to the driver, with no remote, written, or accessible alternative accepted. This article argues that the authenticated delivery handoff is itself a place of public accommodation, a staffed physical commercial transaction at a fixed location that is covered under Title III even in the circuits that require a connection to a physical place, so the argument needs no reform of the nexus doctrine. It then argues that conditioning the completion of a paid sale on an authentication the customer's disability makes impossible, while refusing any accessible alternative, is a failure to make a reasonable modification under 42 U.S.C. §12182(b)(2)(A)(ii) and a denial of full and equal enjoyment of goods already purchased under §12182(a). It identifies two distinct classes for whom the requirement is a wall: those whose disability is centered on control of the in person encounter, for whom the requirement reconstructs the barrier the digital channel removed, and those, including deaf, blind, and speech disabled customers, for whom the oral, in person code exchange is itself an inaccessible method of communication. Finally, it anticipates the seller's fraud prevention defense and shows that secure and accessible alternatives exist, so that the refusal to offer any of them, not the existence of a security measure, is the violation.

AI.tldr: 本文论证，残疾人消费者在完成线上支付后，因卖家要求必须本人当面进行身份验证（对门、朗读验证码）才能收货，这构成对《美国残疾人法》第三编的违反。文章指出，这种当面验证交付本身就是公共 accommodation 场所，且卖家拒绝提供无障碍替代方案属于未进行合理修改，剥夺了残疾人已购商品的完全平等享受。文章还反驳了卖家的欺诈防范抗辩，指出存在安全且无障碍的替代方案。
AI.research_question: 线上购物中，卖家要求残疾人消费者必须亲自当面身份验证才能收货，这种做法是否违反了《美国残疾人法》（ADA）第三编？
AI.motivation: 残疾人消费者在线上完成全额支付后，因无法满足当面身份验证要求而无法收到已购商品，这一现实困境在法律上尚未得到充分论证。文章旨在填补这一法律空白，为残疾人消费者的权利提供法律理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 《美国残疾人法》第三编（Title III）关于公共 accommodation 场所的规定、合理修改原则（42 U.S.C. §12182(b)(2)(A)(ii)）、完全平等享受条款（§12182(a)），以及 nexus doctrine（要求与物理场所存在联系）的判例法。
AI.method: 法律文本分析与判例法解释，运用逻辑论证和分类分析方法。
AI.findings: 1）当面验证交付本身属于公共 accommodation 场所，受 ADA 第三编管辖；2）卖家拒绝提供无障碍替代方案构成未进行合理修改；3）这一要求对两类残疾人构成障碍：一是对当面接触缺乏控制能力的群体，二是聋哑、盲人等无法通过口头验证码交流的群体；4）存在安全且无障碍的替代方案，卖方的欺诈防范抗辩不成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 将公共 accommodation 的概念从传统的实体店铺扩展到线上购物的当面交付环节，在已有 nexus doctrine 框架内实现了对残疾人保护的新解释，无需改革现有法律原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为残疾人消费者在线上购物遭遇当面验证障碍时提供了明确的法律维权路径；为法院审理此类案件提供了分析框架；督促电商平台和物流企业提供无障碍的替代身份验证方案。

title: Ratification Buys Nothing: The Section 301 Forced Labor Determination and the Statutory Sequence the United States Skipped
affiliations: New York Law School

detail.title: Ratification Buys Nothing: The Section 301 Forced Labor Determination and the Statutory Sequence the United States Skipped
detail.abstract:
In June 2026 the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative proposed action against sixty economies under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974, finding that each had failed to enforce a prohibition on goods produced with forced labor. Six of those economies, Canada among them, already maintain such a prohibition. This paper examines the proposed action against the text of the statute that governs it and identifies defects that make the action vulnerable to legal challenge and unlikely to achieve its stated aim.

The central argument is statutory. Section 303(a)(2) commands that where a Section 301 investigation involves a trade agreement and consultations fail, the Trade Representative "shall promptly request" proceedings under that agreement's formal dispute settlement procedures. USTR requested consultations with Canada on March 12, 2026, under this authority. The deadline to request formal proceedings has since passed, and no such request has been made. Section 304 ties the determination itself to that same sequence. The proposed action moves toward a unilateral tariff without completing the step the statute requires first.

The paper develops five further defects: an internal contradiction in the determination's own findings, a tariff structure that prices a congressionally ratified obligation the same as a revocable executive commitment, a scope question left open after the June 2026 denial of certiorari in HMTX Industries, an enforcement standard that cannot be applied consistently, and a duty aimed at the wrong point in the supply chain. Canada's enactment of Bill C-35 during the proceeding illustrates what treaty-based engagement produces. The analysis proceeds from the text and architecture of United States trade law, and the recommendations serve the durability of the action rather than the interests of any single party.  

This paper was filed with the US Trade Representative as document USTR-2026-0265-00131068

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国贸易代表办公室依据《1974年贸易法》第301条对加拿大等经济体拟议的强迫劳动禁令执法行动，指出该行动在法律文本上存在多处缺陷，包括未遵循法定争端解决程序、内部逻辑矛盾、关税结构问题等，使其易受法律挑战且难以达成预期目标。
AI.research_question: 美国贸易代表办公室依据Section 301对加拿大等经济体提出的强迫劳动禁令执法行动在法律上存在哪些缺陷？
AI.motivation: 2026年6月，美国贸易代表办公室根据《1974年贸易法》第301条提议对60个经济体采取行动，认定其未能有效禁止强迫劳动产品。其中加拿大等六国已存在类似禁令。本文旨在从成文法文本与结构角度审视该行动的合法性漏洞。
AI.theoretical_framework: 美国贸易法律文本解释与结构分析，以Section 303(a)(2)和Section 304的法定程序要求为核心。
AI.method: 成文法解释（statutory analysis），结合贸易法体系结构与先例（如HMTX Industries案中certiorari denial的影响）进行法律文本分析。
AI.findings: 该行动存在六项主要法律缺陷：1）未在法定时限内请求正式争端解决程序，违反Section 303(a)(2)；2）Section 304的裁定与法定程序脱节；3）裁定结论内部矛盾；4）关税结构将国会批准的条约义务与可撤销的行政承诺等同定价；5）HMTX Industries案后的管辖范围问题悬而未决；6）执法标准无法一致适用；7）关税针对供应链错误环节。加拿大通过Bill C-35的立法行动展示了条约路径的实际成效。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了Sections 301、303、304之间程序性衔接的技术性法律漏洞，阐明了贸易法成文法解释中程序前置条款对后续单边行动的约束力。
AI.practical_contributions: 该论文已作为正式文件提交至美国贸易代表办公室（文档编号USTR-2026-0265-00131068），为利害关系方提供法律挑战依据，并为美国贸易执法行动的改进提出具体建议。

title: An Economic Evaluation of Dengue Vaccination with Qdenga in Thailand: Findings from a Dynamic Transmission Model
affiliations: , Imperial College London - MRC Centre for Global Infectious Disease Analysis, , Imperial College London - MRC Centre for Global Infectious Disease Analysis, University of Trento, Imperial College London, National Vaccine Institute, National Vaccine Institute, National University of Singapore (NUS) - Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health, Imperial College London - MRC Centre for Global Infectious Disease Analysis and Imperial College London - MRC Centre for Global Infectious Disease Analysis

detail.title: An Economic Evaluation of Dengue Vaccination with Qdenga in Thailand: Findings from a Dynamic Transmission Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no competing interests to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was supported by funding from Thailand’s National Vaccine Institute (NVI) (Grant ID: 2567.1/25) and the Program Management Unit for Frontier Brainpower and Future Industries (Grant ID: B41G680024). NMF, CM, AV, BCD, ID, and H.C.T. acknowledge funding from the MRC Centre for Global Infectious Disease Analysis (reference MR/X020258/1), funded by the UK Medical Research Council (MRC). This UK-funded award is carried out in the frame of the Global Health EDCTP3 Joint Undertaking.

detail.abstract:
Background: Dengue is highly endemic in many tropical and subtropical regions, including Thailand. As no specific treatment is available, vaccination is an important preventive strategy. The Qdenga (TAK-003) live-attenuated quadrivalent dengue vaccine is recommended by the World Health Organization for routine immunisation programmes in high-transmission settings with substantial disease burden. However, an independent country-specific economic evaluation is needed before inclusion in Thailand's National Immunization Program. This study evaluated the cost-effectiveness and budget impact of Qdenga vaccination strategies in Thailand.

Methods: Cost-utility and budget impact analyses were conducted using a previously developed dengue transmission model. Qdenga vaccination scenarios, varying by vaccination age, vaccine mode of action (protection against disease only or against both disease and infection), and duration of waning (5 or 10 years), were compared with a no vaccination comparator. Costs and health outcomes, measured in quality-adjusted life years (QALYs), were projected over a 30-year time horizon.

Findings: A national vaccination programme cumulatively targeting 15 million children aged 6 years could prevent 1·7 million symptomatic dengue cases and 382,000 hospitalisations. In the base-case analysis, routine vaccination targeting 6-year-olds would generate incremental costs of US$1,186 million and gain of 41,169 QALYs, resulting in an ICER of US$30,458/QALY. This exceeds Thailand's cost-effectiveness threshold (US$4,739/QALY) and yields an incremental net monetary benefit of –US$996 million. The annual government budget impact over the first five years was estimated to vary between US$66·4–70·9 million.

Interpretation: Qdenga vaccination could substantially reduce symptomatic dengue cases and hospitalisations in Thailand. However, at its current price, the programme is unlikely to be cost-effective and would have a considerable budget impact. Price negotiation is therefore recommended before inclusion in the national immunisation programme.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了Qdenga（TAK-003）登革热疫苗在泰国国家免疫计划中的成本效益和预算影响。研究发现，虽然该疫苗可大幅减少登革热病例和住院人数，但在当前价格下不具有成本效益，建议进行价格谈判。
AI.research_question: Qdenga登革热疫苗在泰国国家免疫计划中是否具有成本效益？其预算影响如何？
AI.motivation: 登革热在泰国高度流行，世界卫生组织推荐Qdenga疫苗用于常规免疫计划，但泰国在将其纳入国家免疫计划前需要独立的国别经济评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本效用分析（Cost-utility analysis）、预算影响分析（Budget impact analysis）、增量成本效果比（ICER）
AI.method: 使用先前开发的登革热传播模型进行成本效用和预算影响分析，比较不同接种年龄、疫苗作用机制和免疫持久性情景，以30年时间范围评估成本和健康结果（QALYs）。
AI.findings: 全国性接种计划可预防170万例症状性登革热病例和38.2万例住院；但ICER为30,458美元/QALY，远超泰国成本效益阈值（4,739美元/QALY），增量净货币收益为-9.96亿美元；前五年年度政府预算影响为6640-7090万美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 为登革热疫苗经济学评估提供了基于传播模型的分析框架，验证了成本效果临界值在疫苗定价决策中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为泰国及其他类似高流行国家的疫苗政策制定提供了经济证据，建议在当前价格下进行价格谈判后再纳入国家免疫计划。

title: Prioritising Colorectal Cancer Screening Strategies in Average-Risk Populations: A Global Systematic Review and Harmonised Synthesis of Economic Evaluations
affiliations: Capital Medical University, Peking University, Capital Medical University, Queensland University of Technology - Centre for Health Care Transformation, Capital Medical University, Capital Medical University, Capital Medical University and Capital Medical University - Department of Health Management and Policy

detail.title: Prioritising Colorectal Cancer Screening Strategies in Average-Risk Populations: A Global Systematic Review and Harmonised Synthesis of Economic Evaluations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (82204127).

detail.abstract:
Background: Comparative economic evidence for colorectal cancer (CRC) screening modality, interval, and age range remains fragmented. We synthesised global evidence using harmonised net-benefit metrics to identify robust and context-dependent strategy choices.

Methods: We searched English-language and Chinese-language databases for original economic evaluations published between Jan 1, 2004, and Feb 1, 2026. Eligible studies compared faecal immunochemical testing (FIT), colonoscopy (COL), flexible sigmoidoscopy (FS), or interval or age-range variants of these strategies in average-risk populations. Monetary values were harmonised to 2022 purchasing-power-parity US dollars. We calculated incremental net monetary benefit (INMB) using local average gross domestic product per capita (AGDP) as the willingness-to-pay threshold and expressed INMB/AGDP as an affordability-standardised measure. Primary pooled analyses excluded observations outside the predefined 3×interquartile range (IQR) fence, defined as values below Q1−3×IQR or above Q3+3×IQR within each comparison group; Wilcoxon signed-rank testing was used when n≥4.

Findings: We included 67 studies. FIT generated higher incremental net monetary benefit (INMB) than COL (median US$571; p=0·010) and FS (US$292; p=0·016), and COL exceeded FS (US$512; p=0·00057). Results supported FIT-led prioritisation. Annual FIT exceeded biennial FIT (US$812; p=0·013); broader age ranges were favourable, whereas shorter COL intervals were less stable.

Interpretation: FIT was the most consistent economic starting point. Intensification was best supported for increasing FIT frequency; COL-intensive and age-boundary decisions require local reassessment of capacity, burden, programme structure, and affordability.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过荟萃分析67篇经济学评价文献，发现粪便免疫化学检测（FIT）在结直肠癌筛查中比结肠镜（COL）和可弯曲乙状结肠镜（FS）具有更高的净货币效益，年度FIT优于两年一次FIT，而结肠镜强化策略和年龄边界决策需基于本地情况重新评估。
AI.research_question: 在结直肠癌筛查中，不同筛查方式（FIT、COL、FS）、筛查间隔和年龄范围的净货币效益如何比较？哪些策略是稳健的，哪些是情境依赖的？
AI.motivation: 关于结直肠癌筛查方式、间隔和年龄范围的经济学证据较为零散，缺乏全球统一的净效益比较框架，亟需通过标准化指标识别最优策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于增量净货币效益（INMB）和购买力平价调整的货币统一方法，以人均GDP作为支付意愿阈值，构建 affordability-standardised 可比指标。
AI.method: 系统检索2004年至2026年中英文数据库，纳入67项原始经济学评价研究。将货币值统一调整为2022年购买力平价美元，以当地人均GDP为支付意愿阈值计算INMB/AGDP，采用3倍IQR剔除极端值，Wilcoxon符号秩检验进行组间比较。
AI.findings: FIT的INMB显著高于COL（中位差571美元，p=0.010）和FS（292美元，p=0.016）；COL优于FS（512美元，p=0.00057）；年度FIT优于两年一次FIT（812美元，p=0.013）；更宽的年龄范围更有利；较短的COL间隔稳定性较差。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了全球统一的结直肠癌筛查经济学比较框架，提出了 affordability-standardised INMB/AGDP 指标，为跨国比较提供了方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国结直肠癌筛查策略选择提供了循证依据：FIT是经济上最一致的优先选择；若需强化，应优先提高FIT频率；结肠镜强化和年龄边界设定需结合本地能力、负担、项目结构和支付能力进行重新评估。

title: Discharge Renin–Angiotensin System Inhibitor Use and 3-Year Outcomes after Acute Myocardial Infarction with Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction Greater Than 40%: A Temporal Validation Study
affiliations: Korea University - Institute of Health Science, Korea University, Korea University - Cardiovascular Center and

detail.title: Discharge Renin–Angiotensin System Inhibitor Use and 3-Year Outcomes after Acute Myocardial Infarction with Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction Greater Than 40%: A Temporal Validation Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The protocol for the present retrospective secondary analysis was approved by the Institutional Review Board of Chonnam National University Hospital (CNUH-2024-065), which waived the requirement for additional written informed consent.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract:
Background: Renin–angiotensin system (RAS) inhibition improves outcomes after acute myocardial infarction complicated by heart failure or left ventricular systolic dysfunction, but its incremental value after successful revascularisation in patients without heart failure and with left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) greater than 40% is uncertain. We assessed the association between discharge RAS inhibitor use and 3-year outcomes and explored heterogeneity according to GRACE risk.

Methods: We did a retrospective secondary analysis of two prospective nationwide registries in the Republic of Korea. KAMIR-NIH (November, 2011, to December, 2015) was the derivation cohort and KAMIR-V (January, 2016, to June, 2020) the temporal validation cohort. Eligible patients survived discharge after successful percutaneous coronary intervention with drug-eluting stent implantation, had no documented heart failure, and had LVEF greater than 40%. The exposure was discharge prescription of an angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitor or angiotensin receptor blocker at discharge. The primary outcome was 3-year all-cause death. Missing covariates were handled with 20-fold multiple imputation. Stabilised inverse probability of treatment weights targeting the average treatment effect were estimated separately in each cohort, and weighted Cox models were pooled using Rubin’s rules.

Findings: Among 8770 eligible KAMIR-NIH patients, 7224 (82·4%) received a RAS inhibitor and 1546 (17·6%) did not. Among 11 372 eligible KAMIR-V patients, 8559 (75·3%) received a RAS inhibitor and 2813 (24·7%) did not. After weighting, RAS inhibitor use was not associated with 3-year all-cause death in KAMIR-NIH (4·9% vs 5·2%; hazard ratio [HR] 0·931, 95% CI 0·736–1·178; p=0·569) or KAMIR-V (3·1% vs 3·6%; HR 0·866, 0·692–1·083; p=0·217). The treatment by GRACE interaction was not significant (p=0·142).

Interpretation: Discharge RAS inhibitor use was not associated with lower 3-year mortality in either cohort. Importantly, our proactive exploration across the continuous risk spectrum confirmed that this lack of incremental benefit persisted even in high-risk patients, demonstrating that elevated prognostic risk does not equate to therapeutic efficacy. These findings do not alter established indications or establish the safety of withdrawal, but support prospective randomised evaluation of routine versus indication based prescribing.

AI.tldr: 在成功进行血运重建、无心力衰竭且左室射血分数>40%的急性心肌梗死患者中，出院时使用RAS抑制剂与3年全因死亡率降低无关，即使在高风险患者中也未观察到获益。
AI.research_question: 在成功血运重建、无心衰且LVEF>40%的急性心梗患者中，出院使用RAS抑制剂是否与更好的3年结局相关？这种关联是否因GRACE风险评分不同而存在异质性？
AI.motivation: RAS抑制剂在心衰或左室收缩功能障碍的急性心梗后患者中已证实获益，但在无心力衰竭且LVEF>40%的成功血运重建患者中的增量价值尚不确定，需要证据来指导临床实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: RAS抑制理论（通过ACEI/ARB阻断肾素-血管紧张素系统以改善心血管结局）；风险-疗效异质性理论（高预后风险不等于高治疗获益）。
AI.method: 基于韩国两个前瞻性全国注册研究的回顾性二次分析（KAMIR-NIH为推导队列，KAMIR-V为时间验证队列），使用稳定化逆概率治疗权重（IPTW）和加权Cox模型，20重多重插补处理缺失协变量。
AI.findings: 在两个队列中，RAS抑制剂使用与3年全因死亡率均无显著关联（KAMIR-NIH: HR 0.931, p=0.569; KAMIR-V: HR 0.866, p=0.217）；GRACE风险与治疗间的交互作用不显著（p=0.142），表明即使在连续风险谱的高风险端也未观察到增量获益。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证检验了"高预后风险等于高治疗获益"这一隐含假设，证明该假设在RAS抑制剂用于低危心梗患者中不成立，丰富了风险-疗效异质性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为低危（无心衰、LVEF>40%、成功血运重建）急性心梗患者的RAS抑制剂使用提供了循证依据，支持开展常规处方与基于适应症处方的前瞻性随机对照试验，有助于避免不必要的药物治疗和资源浪费。

title: Not All Lottery Stocks Are Equal: Payoff Asymmetry Refines the Lottery Anomaly Within Volatile Equities

detail.title: Not All Lottery Stocks Are Equal: Payoff Asymmetry Refines the Lottery Anomaly Within Volatile Equities
detail.abstract: The lottery anomaly-the tendency of lottery-like stocks to earn low subsequent returns-is conventionally captured by measures such as the maximum daily return (MAX) and idiosyncratic volatility (IVOL), which identify which stocks are lottery-like but treat them as a homogeneous group. We show that they are not homogeneous. Using a prospective, look-ahead-clean measure of payoff asymmetry (PA)-the ratio of mean conditional gains to mean conditional losses estimated from each stock's prior three years of daily returns-computed over 106,163 stock-month observations of 715 U.S. equities (2009-2025, monthly formation), we document that payoff asymmetry refines the lottery anomaly within the volatile population. Among the highest-volatility quintile of stocks, those with high payoff asymmetry (the "fragile" names that mostly bleed and rarely spike) underperform those with low payoff asymmetry by approximately 5% per month in median return, with a Newey-West t-statistic of 3.8; among low-volatility stocks the same sort produces no significant spread (t ≈ 1.0). This conditional effect is robust to a six-factor horserace (MAX, IVOL, beta, momentum, short-term reversal, skewness), survives autocorrelation-robust inference, and is largely uncorrelated with existing lottery proxies: rank correlations with MAX, IVOL, beta, and total volatility are all below 0.12; the correlation with skewness is 0.35, reflecting shared tail structure but well below any threshold for collinearity concern. We further establish three supporting results. First, the relationship is invisible to-indeed sign-flipped by-standard linear cross-sectional regressions, because under fat tails the conditional mean return is inflated at the high-asymmetry extreme by rare large moves while the median declines, so ordinary least squares and rank-based methods disagree on sign; this is a clean empirical demonstration of two consequences of fat-tailedness identified by Taleb (2025). Second, the infinite-variance tail class is economically bimodal: low-PA names are predominantly financials, energy, and utilities, while high-PA names are 42% healthcare and biotechnology, so the tail index alone is not a sufficient statistic for tail risk. Third, look-ahead bias does not merely overstate significance but inverts sign: estimating payoff asymmetry from a window that overlaps the outcome period compresses the bottom-decile win rate from 64% to 51% and lifts the top decile, attenuating and partially reversing the true relationship-a cautionary result for any rolling-window signal evaluated against forward returns of the same series.

AI.tldr: 本文发现彩票型股票并非同质群体，提出用收益不对称性（PA）指标来区分高波动股票中"脆弱型"（持续小亏、偶尔暴涨）和"非脆弱型"股票。在高波动股票中，高PA股票比低PA股票每月中位数收益低约5%（t=3.8），而低波动股票中无此效应。该发现对多种因子稳健，且与现有彩票代理指标相关性低。研究还发现标准线性回归会错误反转符号，尾部指数不能充分刻画尾部风险，前瞻性偏差会扭曲真实关系。
AI.research_question: 彩票型股票是否具有异质性？收益不对称性（payoff asymmetry）能否在波动率群体内部进一步区分彩票型股票的横截面收益差异？
AI.motivation: 现有彩票异常文献（如MAX、IVOL）将彩票型股票视为同质群体，但本文认为这些股票内部存在重要差异——有的持续小亏偶尔暴涨（脆弱型），有的则不然。作者旨在提出一个前瞻性、无前瞻偏差的收益不对称性指标，揭示这种异质性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 彩票异常理论（lottery anomaly）、收益不对称性（payoff asymmetry）、肥尾分布（fat-tailedness, Taleb 2025）、尾部风险（tail risk）
AI.method: 基于2009-2025年美国715只股票的106,163个股票-月观测值，采用前瞻性、无前瞻偏差的收益不对称性指标（PA，定义为条件收益均值与条件损失均值之比），按前三年日收益估计。使用分位数排序、中位数收益比较、Newey-West t统计量、六因子竞争回归（MAX、IVOL、beta、动量、短期反转、偏度），以及与现有彩票代理指标的秩相关分析。
AI.findings: (1) 在高波动股票中，高PA（脆弱型）股票比低PA股票每月中位数收益低约5%（t=3.8），低波动股票中无此效应；(2) 该效应对六因子模型稳健，与现有彩票指标相关性低（除偏度0.35外均<0.12）；(3) 标准线性回归因肥尾分布会符号反转；(4) 低PA股票多为金融、能源、公用事业，高PA股票42%为医疗和生物技术；(5) 前瞻偏差会压缩并部分反转真实关系。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 揭示彩票型股票群体内部异质性，提出PA作为精细化区分工具；(2) 实证展示肥尾分布下条件均值偏差（Taleb 2025）的两个后果；(3) 证明尾部指数不足以刻画尾部风险的经济学含义，需结合行业分布；(4) 警示前瞻偏差不仅夸大显著性，还会反转符号。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为投资者提供更精准的彩票异常识别工具——PA指标，帮助区分"真正脆弱"的股票；(2) 指出标准线性回归在肥尾数据中的缺陷，建议使用中位数或分位数方法；(3) 为资产定价和风险管理实践提供尾部风险分类的行业视角。

title: Ergodicity Deficit Across Tail Classes: When the Peters Formula Breaks Down

detail.title: Ergodicity Deficit Across Tail Classes: When the Peters Formula Breaks Down
detail.abstract: Peters (2019) establishes that under geometric Brownian motion (GBM), the ergodicity deficit-the gap between the ensemble-average growth rate and the time-average growth rate experienced by a single investor-equals 𝜎 2 /2. This formula has been treated as universal in the ergodicity economics literature. We show it is not. The formula assumes finite variance and is undefined for tail exponents 𝛼 ≤ 2, precisely the empirically observed regime for a non-trivial fraction of U.S. equities. For 𝛼 ∈ (2,4), it produces a systematic underestimate because sample variance overestimates true variance in finite samples under power-law dynamics (Taleb 2025), inflating the apparent deficit relative to its population value. Using a cross-section of 715 U.S. equities (2009-2025, 𝑁 = 106,163 stock-month observations) with Hill-estimated 𝛼 ̂ per ticker (median 𝛼 ̂= 2.69, FAT tail class), we derive a corrected ergodicity deficit formula as a function of 𝛼 for 𝛼 > 2 using the stable distribution moment structure, demonstrate empirically that the time-average to ensemble-average growth rate divergence increases as 𝛼 ̂ decreases, and quantify the correction factor at 𝛼 ̂= 2.69. For our SUPER_FAT tickers (𝛼 ̂≤ 2, 𝑛 = 78), the Peters formula is epistemically unavailable; we document empirically the mean-versus-median return divergence that constitutes the observable signature of the ergodicity deficit when variance is undefined. The paper bridges two literatures-Peters' ergodicity economics and Gabaix's empirical equity tail exponents-that have not previously been connected. No prior work has calibrated the ergodicity deficit to an empirically estimated 𝛼 ̂ crosssection.

AI.tldr: 本文修正了Peters (2019)提出的遍历性赤字公式σ²/2，证明该公式仅在尾部指数α>2时成立，且当α∈(2,4)时存在系统低估。作者利用715只美国股票的数据，推导出基于稳定分布矩结构的修正公式，并实证了尾部越厚、遍历性赤字越大的规律。
AI.research_question: Peters (2019)提出的遍历性赤字公式σ²/2在真实股票收益数据（具有厚尾特征）中是否仍然成立？若不成立，应如何修正？
AI.motivation: Peters (2019)的遍历性赤字公式被遍历性经济学文献视为普适公式，但该公式假设方差有限，而大量美国股票收益的尾部指数α≤2或α∈(2,4)，导致公式不适用或产生系统低估。此前未有研究将遍历性赤字与实证估计的尾部指数α̂进行校准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 遍历性经济学（Ergodicity Economics）、稳定分布矩结构、幂律尾部指数估计（Hill估计）、肥尾分布理论、Taleb (2025)的有限样本方差高估问题。
AI.method: 基于715只美国股票（2009-2025，106,163个股票-月度观测值），使用Hill估计法估算每只股票的尾部指数α̂，利用稳定分布矩结构推导修正的遍历性赤字公式，并进行实证比较均值-中位数回报差异。
AI.findings: 1) Peters公式在α≤2时不可用（方差未定义），在α∈(2,4)时系统低估遍历性赤字；2) 实证样本中α̂中位数为2.69（属于FAT tail类别）；3) 时间平均与总体平均增长率的分化随α̂减小而增大；4) 在α̂≤2的超肥尾股票中，均值-中位数回报差异是遍历性赤字的可观测信号。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次将Peters的遍历性经济学与Gabaix的实证股票尾部指数文献桥接起来；2) 纠正了遍历性赤字公式的普适性误用，提出了基于α的修正公式；3) 揭示了有限样本下方差高估导致Peters公式系统低估的内在机制（Taleb 2025）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和风险管理者在肥尾市场中的长期增长预期提供了更准确的遍历性赤字估计工具；提醒实践者注意Peters公式在厚尾资产中的误导性。

title:
Minimum Track Record Length Under Fat Tails 
How Long Must Performance History Be Before Skill Is Declared?

detail.title:
Minimum Track Record Length Under Fat Tails 
How Long Must Performance History Be Before Skill Is Declared?
detail.abstract: Bailey and López de Prado (2012) derived the Minimum Track Record Length (MinTRL)the number of return observations required to reject, at a specified confidence level, the hypothesis that a manager's Sharpe ratio is zero. Their derivation rests on the central limit theorem applied to the Sharpe ratio estimator, which in turn requires finite fourth moment (tail exponent 𝜅 > 4). Kao, Lee, and Lee (2025) proved that when the return distribution has tail index 𝜅 ∈ (2,4), the Sharpe ratio estimator converges at rate 𝑛 1-2/𝜅 rather than 𝑛 1/2 , toward a stable limit distribution with stability index 𝜅/2 rather than the Gaussian. This slower convergence invalidates the CLT foundation of the Bailey-López de Prado MinTRL in precisely the empirical regime most relevant to individual equities: our cross-section of 715 U.S. equities (2009-2025, 192 months) has median estimated tail exponent 𝛼 ̂= 2.69, which falls squarely in the fat-tail regime where Gaussian MinTRL is inapplicable. We derive the correct MinTRL under fat tails analytically as 𝑛 fat = (𝑧 𝑝 ⋅ 𝐶 𝜅 /𝑆 ̂)𝜅/(𝜅-2) , and construct the table that does not elsewhere exist: for each tail exponent 𝛼 ̂∈ {2.1,2.3,2.5,2.69,3.0,3.5,4.0} and confidence level 𝑝 ∈ {90%, 95%, 99%}, the minimum number of return observations required to declare skill at 𝑆 ̂= 0.5 annualized. The results are dramatic. At 𝛼 ̂= 3.5 and 95% confidence, MinTRL ≈ 24 years-achievable but demanding. At 𝛼 ̂= 3.0, MinTRL ≈ 124 years-beyond any individual manager's career. At 𝛼 ̂= 2.69 (the empirical median), MinTRL ≈ 1,100 years. At 𝛼 ̂≤ 2, the variance of returns is undefined and the Sharpe ratio denominator diverges; skill is formally undeclarable at any finite sample. The paper concludes that standard due-diligence track-record requirements of three to five years have effectively zero statistical power for instruments in the empirically prevalent fat-tail regime, and that any MinTRL computation must be preceded by tail-exponent estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，Bailey和López de Prado (2012)提出的最小跟踪记录长度（MinTRL）基于中心极限定理，要求收益分布的四阶矩有限（尾部指数κ>4）。但Kao等人(2025)证明，当尾部指数κ∈(2,4)时，夏普比率估计量的收敛速度更慢且不服从高斯分布。对美国715只股票的实际测算显示中位尾指数α̂=2.69，属于肥尾区间。作者推导了肥尾下的正确MinTRL公式，发现当α̂=2.69时MinTRL约需1100年，3-5年的常规尽职调查要求统计功效几乎为零。
AI.research_question: 在收益分布呈现肥尾（尾部指数κ∈(2,4)）的现实情境下，如何正确计算最小跟踪记录长度（MinTRL），以及传统基于正态假设的MinTRL在实证中的失效程度有多大？
AI.motivation: Bailey和López de Prado (2012)的MinTRL广泛应用于评估基金经理技能，但其推导依赖中心极限定理，要求尾部指数κ>4。而大量实证表明个股收益分布尾部更肥（κ常在2-4之间），这使得传统MinTRL在最重要的实证场景中无效，亟需修正。
AI.theoretical_framework: 极值理论（肥尾指数）、稳定分布理论、夏普比率估计量的收敛性质；中心极限定理在肥尾条件下的失效机制。
AI.method: 理论推导结合实证分析。首先从数学上推导肥尾条件下的MinTRL公式；然后对美国715只股票2009-2025年共192个月的数据进行实证，估计各股票的尾部指数，并计算不同尾部指数和置信水平下的MinTRL数值表。
AI.findings: (1) 715只美股的中位尾部指数α̂=2.69，处于肥尾区间；(2) 在α̂=3.5、95%置信水平下，MinTRL≈24年，尚可实现但要求极高；(3) 在α̂=3.0时，MinTRL≈124年，超过任何个人职业生涯；(4) 在α̂=2.69（实证中位数）时，MinTRL≈1100年；(5) 当α̂≤2时，方差发散去，技能在有限样本下无法被宣告；(6) 传统3-5年的跟踪记录在肥尾条件下统计功效几乎为零。
AI.theory_contributions: 将MinTRL从高斯假设推广到肥尾假设，推导了正确的肥尾MinTRL公式，揭示了传统MinTRL在实证常见条件下的根本性失效机制，为金融统计中肥尾现象的后果提供了量化框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了不同尾部指数和置信水平下的MinTRL数值表（目前公开文献中首个此类表格）；建议投资者和监管机构在进行任何MinTRL计算前必须先估计尾部指数；对基金经理评估、尽职调查标准设定具有直接指导意义。

title: Financial Equilibrium in Banking: The Architecture of a Modern Credit Systems

detail.title: Financial Equilibrium in Banking: The Architecture of a Modern Credit Systems
detail.abstract: Seventy-four million Americans live in communities the financial system has systematically decided not to serve-not because the residents are uncreditworthy, but because the ZIP code in which they live carries a history that no amount of individual qualification can overcome. Financial Equilibrium in Banking is the first comprehensive empirical treatise to measure this geography of exclusion with the precision it demands, model the mechanisms by which it perpetuates itself, and prescribe the interventions the evidence actually supports. Drawing on 547,000 census tract-years of HMDA panel data, 48 Sub-Saharan African banking systems, 68 sovereign credit markets, and an original computational pipeline built entirely in Python, the book introduces the Dynamic Hardship and Credit Inaccessibility Index (DHCI)-the first forward-looking instrument capable of detecting credit desert formation before conventional indicators register failure. It documents the racialized premium in municipal bond spreads (the Black Tax), models the three-wave ripple effect of bank failures on community credit markets, and advances a concrete policy architecture-costed, parameterized, and replicable-for eliminating credit deserts within a generation. " "Credit deserts are not natural formations. They are policy constructions-built by decisions that can be unmade, sustained by inertia that can be broken, and measurable by instruments that can hold institutions accountable." THE INSTRUMENT-DYNAMIC HARDSHIP & CREDIT INACCESSIBILITY INDEX (DHCI) The DHCI is constructed from five HMDA-derived components at the census tract level and validated against sixteen years of panel data: mortgage denial rate vs. regional baseline, Residential Vacancy Rate (RVR), Income-Expenditure-to-Origination Disparity (IEOD), branch closure rate, and AI intensity score. Two numbers define its significance: 0.166 AR(1) Persistence Coefficient-16.6% of last year's credit hardship remains embedded in this year's outcomes regardless of current conditions. Exclusion is self-propagating, not merely correlated over time. DHCI* = 0.8309 Structural Lending Cliff-the threshold beyond which credit desert formation accelerates by 34.6 percentage points as conventional lenders exit simultaneously. A phase transition, not a gradual decline. CORE EMPIRICAL FINDINGS +0.142 LENDER FRAGMENTATION EFFECT Each 0.10 increase in mortgage origination HHI raises credit distress by 0.142 standard deviations (p<0.001), amplified 62.7% in below-threshold tracts.-0.31pp CDFI DENSITY STABILIZER A one-standard-deviation increase in CDFI market share reduces the racial denial gap by 0.31 percentage points-an effect that doubles in distressed communities. +18.3pp AI UNDERWRITING GAP AI-intensive underwriting increases mortgage denial gaps by 18.3 percentage points in low-information tracts relative to high-information counterparts.-15.7% THREE-WAVE BANK FAILURE EFFECT Log loan volume falls 15.7 percent by year three following a bank failure, with all three-wave effects 2.0x larger in distressed communities.

title: Maximum Drawdown Under Power Laws: What the Gaussian Analytical Result Cannot Tell You

detail.title: Maximum Drawdown Under Power Laws: What the Gaussian Analytical Result Cannot Tell You
detail.abstract: The analytical result of Magdon-Ismail and Atiya (2004) provides a closed-form expression for expected maximum drawdown under Brownian motion, yielding the now-familiar scaling 𝐸[𝐷𝐷(𝑇)] ∼ 𝜎√𝑇 for zero-drift processes. This result is elegant and practically useful for Gaussian or near-Gaussian return environments. However, it rests on assumptions-continuous paths, finite variance, Gaussian increments-that are violated by empirically documented heavy-tailed equity returns. This paper extends the drawdown analysis to the class of 𝛼-stable distributions and derives how expected maximum drawdown scales with horizon 𝑇 under power-law return dynamics. For 𝛼 < 2, variance is infinite and the √𝑇 scaling is replaced by 𝑇 1/𝛼 , which is strictly faster, implying that risk models calibrated to Gaussian drawdown formulae will systematically understate longhorizon drawdown risk. We further introduce and develop the distinction between FAT_STRUCTURAL and FAT_BINARY tail sources-a taxonomy established in Paper 3 of this series-and show that these two mechanisms generate qualitatively different drawdown signatures despite potentially identical estimated tail indices. Empirically, using 715 U.S. equities over 2009-2025 (𝑁 = 106,163 stock-month observations), we document breach rates for 35% and 50% drawdown thresholds stratified by tail class. THIN-tailed stocks exhibit approximately Gaussian drawdown scaling (log-log slope ≈ 0.5), while SUPER_FAT stocks exhibit slopes exceeding 0.7, consistent with 𝛼 ≈ 1.4-1.6. We calibrate a correction factor Φ(𝛼, 𝑇) such that 𝐸[𝐷𝐷(𝑇, 𝛼)] = 𝐸[𝐷𝐷 Gaussian (𝑇)] × Φ(𝛼, 𝑇), finding empirical estimates of Φ ≈ 1.15-1.25 for moderate fat tails and Φ ≈ 1.4-1.6 for severe fat tails. These results have direct implications for drawdown-based risk budgeting, regulatory capital, and portfolio construction.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了最大回撤分析到α稳定分布（厚尾分布）情景，发现当α<2时，预期最大回撤的标度律从√T变为T^{1/α}，并基于715只美股实证验证了厚尾股票的回撤风险被高斯模型系统性低估，引入FAT_STRUCTURAL与FAT_BINARY两种尾部来源分类，提出校正因子Φ。
AI.research_question: 在厚尾（α稳定分布）收益环境下，预期最大回撤如何随投资期限T标度？不同尾部来源（结构性厚尾vs二元厚尾）是否产生不同的回撤特征？
AI.motivation: Magdon-Ismail和Atiya（2004）的高斯回撤公式被广泛使用，但实证发现股票收益具有厚尾特征，违背了连续路径、有限方差和高斯增量的假设，导致高斯模型系统性低估长期回撤风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: α稳定分布理论、最大回撤的标度律、FAT_STRUCTURAL与FAT_BINARY尾部分类框架。
AI.method: 理论推导α稳定分布下预期最大回撤的标度律；实证采用715只美股（2009-2025年，106,163个股票-月度观测），按尾部类别分层分析35%和50%回撤阈值的突破率，并校准校正因子Φ。
AI.findings: (1) α<2时，预期最大回撤标度律从√T变为T^{1/α}，标度速度更快；(2) 结构性厚尾和二元厚尾产生定性不同的回撤特征；(3) 薄尾股票回撤标度近似高斯（log-log斜率≈0.5），超级厚尾股票斜率>0.7（α≈1.4-1.6）；(4) 校正因子Φ：中度厚尾约1.15-1.25，严重厚尾约1.4-1.6。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将最大回撤分析从高斯过程扩展到α稳定分布（无限方差）情景；(2) 建立了FAT_STRUCTURAL与FAT_BINARY两种尾部来源的区分及其对回撤特征的异质性影响；(3) 提供了校正因子Φ的理论与实证框架。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 揭示基于高斯回撤公式的风险模型会系统性低估长期回撤风险；(2) 提供校正因子Φ帮助实务工作者调整回撤风险预算；(3) 对基于回撤的风险预算、监管资本和投资组合构建有直接指导意义。

title: Anticipatory Urbanism: How Intermediaries Shape Mobility and Displacement Across Ecological Gradients

detail.title: Anticipatory Urbanism: How Intermediaries Shape Mobility and Displacement Across Ecological Gradients
detail.abstract:
Ecological stress can reorganize household life around urban work, institutions, and time before anyone moves. I use anticipatory urbanism to describe this origin-side reorganization and to test how far an existing urban concept can travel before a new one is needed. It takes shape when destination-linked occupations, portable institutional claims, and non-agrarian schedules begin to influence livelihood decisions in places of departure. Intermediary configurations give this process practical form through the financial, social, institutional, and aspirational channels available to households.

The paper builds a bridge between climate mobility and urban theory by bringing an explicit intermediation lens to the threshold before movement becomes formally legible. It places Kalimpong, Purulia, and the Sundarbans in West Bengal, India, in analytic conversation through exploratory scoping conversations in Kalimpong, a structured literature synthesis in Purulia, and two interviews with one expert informant read alongside a structured literature synthesis in the Sundarbans. These materials do not form equivalent regional datasets, so the theory-building exercise proceeds at the level of the intermediary configurations documented within each evidence base. Their unevenness also reflects a process spread across ordinary institutions and recorded less clearly than movement itself.

Across the three regions, the analysis identifies different ways in which intermediary configurations organize mobility and staying. Women’s collectives in Kalimpong support both overseas migration and livelihood renewal in place. In Purulia, kin networks and commercial agents channel households into circular labor routes. In the Sundarbans, a wider but fragmented field of savings groups, NGOs, health workers, public programs, and recruiters produces diversified access to mobility and staying. Bringing migration infrastructure (Xiang & Lindquist, 2014) into dialogue with people as infrastructure (Simone, 2004) shows how leaving, returning, adaptive staying, and constrained immobility are organized before arrival, while household relations to work, institutions, and time are already becoming urban-facing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"预期城市化"概念，研究生态压力如何通过中介配置在人口实际迁移前就围绕城市工作、制度和时间重组农村家庭生活，基于印度西孟加拉邦三个地区的混合证据进行理论构建。
AI.research_question: 生态压力如何通过中介配置（intermediary configurations）在人口实际迁移之前，使迁出地的家庭生活围绕城市工作、制度安排和时间节奏进行重组？
AI.motivation: 现有气候迁移研究多关注迁移行为本身，忽视了迁移发生前迁出地家庭生活已经被城市逻辑重新组织的现象。本文旨在检验现有城市概念的适用边界，并探讨是否需要新的理论工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预期城市化（anticipatory urbanism）；迁移基础设施（migration infrastructure, Xiang & Lindquist, 2014）；人即基础设施（people as infrastructure, Simone, 2004）
AI.method: 混合方法：卡尔姆蓬（Kalimpong）的探索性范围访谈、普鲁利亚（Purulia）的结构化文献综合、孙德尔本斯（Sundarbans）的两轮专家访谈结合结构化文献综合。三种证据不对等，理论构建在中介配置层面进行。
AI.findings: 三个地区的中介配置以不同方式组织流动与留守：卡尔姆蓬的女性集体支持海外迁移与就地生计更新；普鲁利亚的亲缘网络和商业中介将家庭引入循环劳动路线；孙德尔本斯的储蓄小组、NGO、卫生工作者、公共项目和招聘人员形成广泛但碎片化的配置，产生多样化的流动与留守机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"预期城市化"概念，将迁移基础设施与人即基础设施两个理论对话，揭示迁移前迁出地家庭生活如何通过中介配置变得面向城市，扩展了气候迁移研究与城市理论的交叉地带。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解生态压力下的人口流动提供前置性分析框架，有助于政策制定者关注迁移发生前的中介配置干预节点，从而更有效地规划适应策略。

title: Irreversible Efficient Action and Endogenous Timing in the Minimum Effort Game: Effects on Coordination

detail.title: Irreversible Efficient Action and Endogenous Timing in the Minimum Effort Game: Effects on Coordination

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was approved by the Research Ethics Committee of the Graduate School of Economics, Osaka Metropolitan University (Approval No. 2024-3). Before participating in the experiment, all participants read an informed consent form describing the study, and only those who agreed to participate proceeded to the experiment.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by JSPS Grant-in-Aid for Scientific Research (B) Grant Number JP26K00342 and JST SPRING, Grant Number JPMJSP2139

detail.abstract: This study investigates the effects and characteristics of endogenous timing when efficient actions are irreversible in a minimum effort game through an online experiment. When efficient actions are irreversible, players may postpone their decisions to obtain information about the actions of others. We examine how such "wait-and-see" behavior affects the achievement of coordination. The experimental results show that endogenous timing with irreversible efficient actions promotes efficient coordination to some extent. However, its effect is limited, and it also tends to destabilize coordination itself.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过在线实验，探讨了在最小努力博弈中，当高效行动不可逆时，内生时机（即玩家可观察他人行动后再做决定）对协调效果的影响。实验发现，这种机制虽能在一定程度上促进高效协调，但效果有限，且会动摇协调的稳定性。
AI.research_question: 在最小努力博弈中，当高效行动具有不可逆性时，内生时机（等待-观察行为）如何影响协调的达成与效率？
AI.motivation: 现实中许多协调情境（如技术投资、市场进入）存在行动不可逆性，且决策者常有机会观察他人后再行动。现有文献对这类“等待-观察”行为在协调博弈中的效果认识不足，因此需要深入探究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最小努力博弈（Minimum Effort Game）、内生时机（Endogenous Timing）、行动不可逆性（Irreversible Actions）、协调博弈理论
AI.method: 在线实验（Online Experiment），设计最小努力博弈，引入高效行动不可逆条件，允许玩家自主选择决策时机，观察其等待-观察行为对协调结果的影响。
AI.findings: (1) 内生时机与不可逆高效行动在一定程度上促进了高效协调；(2) 但这种促进效果有限；(3) 同时，这一机制倾向于破坏协调本身的稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了协调博弈理论中对内生时机和行动不可逆性交互作用的理解，揭示了“等待-观察”行为在促进效率与破坏稳定之间的权衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计协调机制（如投资决策、项目管理中是否允许延迟决策）提供了实证依据，提醒管理者注意效率提升与稳定性之间的潜在冲突。

title: Ontological vs Epistemic Extremes: Why FAT_BINARY Events Are Neither Black Swans Nor Power Laws

detail.title: Ontological vs Epistemic Extremes: Why FAT_BINARY Events Are Neither Black Swans Nor Power Laws
detail.abstract: Contemporary frameworks for classifying extreme financial events draw on three traditions that rarely speak to each other: Knight's (1921) distinction between risk and unmeasurable uncertainty, Taleb's (2007) epistemic framework of Black Swans, and extreme value theory's (EVT) distributional taxonomy of tail behavior. This paper argues that a specific and empirically non-trivial class of extreme returns-those arising from discrete binary events with known structure and unknown directional resolution-occupies a genuine ontological category that none of these frameworks adequately captures. We formalize this category using the mixture process 𝑋 = (1-𝐵) ⋅ 𝑍 𝑆 + 𝐵 ⋅ 𝐽, where 𝐵 ∼ Bernoulli(𝑝) governs binary event occurrence, 𝑍 𝑆 is a structural power-law component, and 𝐽 is a discrete binary jump. We call events generated by the 𝐵 ⋅ 𝐽 mechanism knownstructure, unknown-direction extremes. These events: (1) are not Black Swans-their structure is fully within the model in advance; (2) do not arise from power-law generating mechanisms-their extreme returns stem from discrete resolution, not distributional tail accumulation; yet (3) produce estimated tail indices 𝛼 ̂≤ 2 under Hill estimation, indistinguishable from genuine power-law SUPER_FAT stocks. The Hill estimator, we show, is not a sufficient statistic for ontological type. Drawing on a dataset of 715 U.S. equities over 2009-2025 (𝑁 = 106,163 stock-month observations) and on the formal inconsistency result for FAT_BINARY stocks established in Paper 3 of this series, we argue that the standard EVT tail taxonomy requires a source-oftail pre-classification step before Hill estimation can be interpreted. The implications extend to Black Swan discourse-FAT_BINARY events are not epistemically opaque, they are directionally uncertain under fully transparent structure-and to risk management, where FAT_BINARY and FAT_STRUCTURAL stocks require categorically different treatment despite identical Hill estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一类被现有框架忽视的极端金融事件——"已知结构、未知方向极端事件"（FAT_BINARY），这类事件源于离散二元事件，其结构已知但方向不确定。作者通过混合过程模型形式化这一类别，并证明标准Hill估计量无法区分这类事件与真实幂律分布的超级肥尾股票，主张在极端值分析中需增加"尾部来源"预分类步骤。
AI.research_question: 现有极端金融事件分类框架（Knight的不确定性、Taleb的黑天鹅、极端值理论的尾部分类）是否遗漏了一类重要的、经验上不可忽视的极端事件？这类事件的本体论类别是什么，以及如何将其形式化？
AI.motivation: 现有三大传统（Knight风险/不可测不确定性、Taleb黑天鹅认识论框架、极端值理论尾部行为分类）之间缺乏对话，导致一类特殊的极端收益——源于离散二元事件、结构已知但方向不确定——未被任何框架充分捕捉。这一问题具有经验非平凡性，且对风险管理有重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: Knight (1921) 风险与不可测不确定性二分法；Taleb (2007) 黑天鹅认识论框架；极值理论（EVT）尾部行为分类；Hill估计量的统计性质；混合过程模型 𝑋 = (1-𝐵) ⋅ 𝑍_𝑆 + 𝐵 ⋅ 𝐽
AI.method: 理论形式化：提出混合过程模型定义FAT_BINARY事件类别；实证分析：基于2009-2025年间715只美国股票的106,163个股票-月观测值；统计推断：使用Hill估计量估计尾部指数，并展示FAT_BINARY与FAT_STRUCTURAL股票在Hill估计上不可区分。
AI.findings: ① FAT_BINARY事件不是黑天鹅——其结构完全事先内在于模型；② 不源于幂律生成机制——极端收益来自离散方向分辨率而非分布尾部累积；③ 但在Hill估计下产生的尾部指数估计值𝛼̂≤2，与真实幂律超级肥尾股票不可区分；④ Hill估计量不是本体论类型的充分统计量。
AI.theory_contributions: ① 识别并形式化了一个被现有三大框架遗漏的极端事件本体论类别；② 证明Hill估计量不能区分不同尾部来源，尾部指数大小不是本体类型的充分条件；③ 提出极端值分析需要进行"尾部来源预分类"步骤；④ 重新审视黑天鹅话语——FAT_BINARY事件不是认识论上的不透明，而是在完全透明结构下的方向不确定性。
AI.practical_contributions: ① 风险管理：FAT_BINARY与FAT_STRUCTURAL股票尽管Hill估计相同，但需要截然不同的处理方式；② 为金融从业者提供更精细的极端事件分类工具，避免将方向不确定性误判为认识论上的黑天鹅；③ 改进尾部风险模型设定和风险度量方法。

title: Against Optimization: Why Fat Tails Make the Optimal Portfolio Epistemically Unavailable

detail.title: Against Optimization: Why Fat Tails Make the Optimal Portfolio Epistemically Unavailable
detail.abstract: Portfolio optimization-find the portfolio that maximizes expected utility subject to distributional constraints-is the foundational technology of modern quantitative finance. This paper argues that optimization is not merely imprecise under fat-tailed return distributions; it is epistemically unavailable. The argument proceeds in four steps. First, under power-law tails with tail index α̂ ∈ (2, 3), moment estimators converge at rates dramatically slower than the classical √T, making input parameters unidentifiable at any conventional precision within realistic investment horizons. Second, the Michaud (1989) problem-that optimization amplifies estimation error-becomes catastrophically worse under fat tails; the required sample size to estimate a K-asset covariance matrix to within 10% relative error, at α̂ = 2.69, exceeds several centuries. Third, the distribution itself is non-stationary: fat-tail regimes shift across market epochs, so even infinite historical data cannot resolve the estimation problem. Fourth, these three failures converge on a common prescription: the Taleb barbell strategy is not a heuristic but the formally derivable rational response to estimation unavailability. The paper connects this conclusion to Peters' (2019) ergodicity argument and Taleb's (2014) Precautionary Principle, showing that independent lines of argument converge on structural robustness rather than optimization. The claim that optimization is epistemically unavailable-not merely difficult-is a precise, falsifiable statement about sample-size requirements and convergence rates, not a counsel of pessimism.

AI.tldr: 本文论证在肥尾分布下，投资组合优化不仅是"不精确"，而是根本上"认知不可及"——由于参数估计收敛极慢、协方差矩阵样本需求超数百年、分布非平稳，唯一理性策略是塔勒布杠铃策略，而非优化。
AI.research_question: 在肥尾收益分布条件下，投资组合优化是否在认知论层面上"不可及"（而非仅仅"困难"或"不精确"）？
AI.motivation: 传统投资组合优化是现代量化金融的基础，但该技术假设收益分布具有良好统计特性。现实金融市场呈现肥尾分布，这一基本假设不成立，亟需检验优化的可行性边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 幂律尾部（尾部指数α̂∈(2,3)）的估计收敛理论；Michaud（1989）优化放大估计误差问题；Peters（2019）遍历性论证；Taleb（2014）预防性原则。
AI.method: 理论推导与数值分析：通过收敛速度分析、样本量需求计算、非平稳性论证，四步递进证明优化不可及性。
AI.findings: ①尾部指数α̂∈(2,3)时，矩估计收敛速度远慢于经典√T；②协方差矩阵估计10%相对误差所需样本量在α̂=2.69时超过数百年；③肥尾状态跨市场时期漂移，无限历史数据也无法解决；④杠铃策略是优化不可及下的形式化理性应对。
AI.theory_contributions: 将投资组合优化问题从"计算困难"提升至"认知不可及"层面，给出了精确、可证伪的样本量需求与收敛速率论证，并连接遍历性论证与预防性原则建立结构性稳健性框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为量化金融实践提供根本性指导：放弃"优化—估计"范式，转向塔勒布杠铃策略等结构性稳健策略，对资产管理、风险控制具有颠覆性启示。

title: Cross-Cultural Patterns in Real-Time Retail-Investor LLM Conversations: A Behavioural-Finance Lens on Multilingual Algorithm Appreciation and Political-Economy Salience
affiliations: , Independent and University of Oxford - Said Business School

detail.title: Cross-Cultural Patterns in Real-Time Retail-Investor LLM Conversations: A Behavioural-Finance Lens on Multilingual Algorithm Appreciation and Political-Economy Salience

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests. The data-providing platform had no role in study design, analysis, interpretation, or the decision to publish.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study received ethics-review approval from Saïd Business School, University of Oxford. The conversational corpus was accessed under a non-disclosure data-use agreement with the data-providing platform; all data were anonymised prior to analysis.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: We document the structure of 2,347 multilingual real-time conversations between retail investors and a generative-AI assistant on an anonymised European retail-investor AI platform (March–October 2025), spanning 19 language communities. Three nested findings: (i) classical home bias (French & Poterba 1991) replicates strongly in conversational data - German-speaking users discuss German-headquartered companies at 2.6× the English-speaker rate (log-OR +1.09, χ² p < 10⁻¹⁵), with extension to a culturally-proximate foreign market (Denmark, log-OR +1.21, the "Novo Nordisk effect"); (ii) substantial cross-cultural behavioral asymmetries beyond home bias - defense-sector salience (DE 9.9 % vs EN 4.9 %, with March-2025 spike coinciding with Germany's Sondervermögen defense fund), risk-language asymmetry (EN 3.3× more leverage/options/shorts), and ticker-symbol financial-literacy associations; (iii) first real-world evidence for algorithm appreciation in retail-AI-investor interaction - only 0.6 % of multi-turn conversations contain disagreement language, only 1.8 % explicitly request AI's opinion, and longer AI responses reduce follow-up by 18 percentage points (an "AI verbosity paradox"). Findings have implications for cross-cultural retail-investor research, fintech-platform design, and the regulatory framing of AI-assisted retail finance.

AI.tldr: 基于欧洲零售投资者AI平台的多语言对话数据（2025年3-10月，19种语言，2,347条对话），本文发现：(i) 经典本土偏好显著存在于对话中；(ii) 除本土偏好外，存在显著的跨文化行为不对称（如国防主题、风险语言、金融素养差异）；(iii) 首次实证发现零售投资者对AI的"算法欣赏"现象，极少质疑AI建议，且AI回答越长投资者追问越少。
AI.research_question: 零售投资者在与生成式AI助手的多语言、多轮对话中，是否表现出本土偏好、跨文化行为不对称以及对AI的算法欣赏？
AI.motivation: 现有零售投资者行为研究多基于交易数据或问卷，缺乏对自然语言对话中投资者行为的系统分析；同时，生成式AI在金融咨询领域的快速普及需要实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本土偏好假说、跨文化行为金融学、算法欣赏理论
AI.method: 对2,347条多语言真实对话（19种语言）进行内容分析和统计检验，包括逻辑回归、卡方检验等。
AI.findings: (1) 德国语用户讨论德国公司频率是英语用户的2.6倍，且扩展到文化邻近的丹麦市场（"诺和诺德效应"）；(2) 德国用户国防话题比例（9.9%）远高于英语用户（4.9%），英语用户风险语言（杠杆/期权/做空）是德语用户的3.3倍，且ticker符号与金融素养存在关联；(3) 仅0.6%的对话包含质疑AI的语言，仅1.8%明确要求AI意见，AI回答长度增加1单位使追问概率下降18个百分点（"AI冗长悖论"）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经典本土偏好假说从交易数据扩展到对话数据；首次在零售-AI投资互动中实证验证算法欣赏理论；发现跨文化行为不对称的新维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融科技平台设计提供跨文化差异化策略依据；为监管机构在AI辅助零售金融的框架制定提供实证基础；揭示投资者过度依赖AI的风险。

title:
Digitalization, Sustainability, And Ecosystems 

An Application of Social Network Analysis to the Real Estate Sector

detail.title:
Digitalization, Sustainability, And Ecosystems 

An Application of Social Network Analysis to the Real Estate Sector
detail.abstract:
Societies today have increasing economic, social, and environmental needs for their built environments. The performance of the built environment depends largely on urban development, with the role of digital technologies therein being a long-standing research topic. The extant literature, however, has focused less on the organizational capabilities, such as absorptive capacity, that are needed for new technology adoption and organizational change. The capabilities of real estate owners, who are key decision makers throughout the built environment life cycle, have also, surprisingly, been neglected.
The purpose of this thesis is to increase the understanding of digitalization and sustainability in the built environment. To this end, this thesis presents the results of an empirical study of the capabilities of real estate owners, technology suppliers and industry associations in the context of a business ecosystem within the Swedish real estate sector. The findings show that real estate actors have developed new organizational capabilities related to digitalization and within collaborations inside the business ecosystem overall. For example, real estate owners have invested in R&D labs and business development functions that are atypical within the sector. These new capabilities may contribute to digitalization and sustainability within the built-environment sector more broadly. Nevertheless, many structural issues characteristic of a fragmented sector remain. 
Additionally, this thesis contributes to ecosystem theory and its methodology and to the built environment research methodology. The literature on the use of social network analysis methods in ecosystem and built environment research is reviewed, with the conclusion that social network analysis methods have great research potential despite being rarely used. Furthermore, formal concept analysis of ecosystem concepts is conducted, and a methodological framework for understanding ecosystems as multilevel structures that consist of flows between ecosystem actors and emergent system-level properties is presented. The introduction of new theories and methods in the built environment literature is important, as digitalization and sustainability transcend traditional organizational and technological boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文通过瑞典房地产行业的实证研究，探讨了房地产所有者、技术供应商和行业协会在数字化与可持续发展方面的组织能力，发现房地产所有者建立了研发实验室和业务开发职能等新能力，但碎片化行业的结构性问题依然存在。论文还对生态系统理论和建筑环境研究方法论做出了贡献。
AI.research_question: 房地产行业中的关键行为者（如房地产所有者）如何发展组织能力以推动数字化和可持续发展？
AI.motivation: 现有文献较少关注组织能力（如吸收能力）在新技术采用和组织变革中的作用，且房地产所有者作为建筑环境生命周期的关键决策者，其能力被忽视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 吸收能力理论、商业生态系统理论、社会网络分析方法、形式概念分析、多层次生态系统结构框架
AI.method: 对瑞典房地产行业商业生态系统中的房地产所有者、技术供应商和行业协会进行实证研究，采用社会网络分析方法和形式概念分析。
AI.findings: 房地产行为者发展出与数字化相关的新组织能力；房地产所有者投资了行业内非典型的研发实验室和业务开发职能；这些新能力有助于更广泛的建筑环境领域的数字化和可持续发展；但碎片化行业的许多结构性问题仍然存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 对生态系统理论及其方法论做出贡献；提出将生态系统理解为由行为者之间流动和涌现的系统层属性组成的多层次结构的分析框架；引入社会网络分析方法到生态系统和建筑环境研究中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为房地产所有者、技术供应商和行业参与者提供能力建设方向；指出尽管有新能力发展，碎片化问题仍需关注。

title: Early Detection of VaR Model Deterioration: A Cantelli-Bound Ratio Approach for Proactive Risk Management

detail.title: Early Detection of VaR Model Deterioration: A Cantelli-Bound Ratio Approach for Proactive Risk Management
detail.abstract: Financial institutions often face a critical challenge in the silent failure of Value-at-Risk (VaR) models, whose performance is typically assessed through ex-post backtesting such as unconditional coverage and independence tests-which tend to detect problems only after violations and losses have occurred. To address this gap, this paper introduces the VaR Efficiency Ratio (VER), defined as the ratio of model-based VaR to a Cantelli-implied VaR computed from the same conditional mean and variance. Using S&P 500 returns from 2000-2025 with rolling five-year estimation windows across multiple confidence levels and forecast horizons, empirical results indicate that lower VER values systematically precede VaR exceedances, providing early-warning signals for model recalibration before traditional backtests detect deterioration. VER declines sharply at deeper tail confidence levels, remains largely invariant across forecast horizons, and exhibits persistent behaviour during major market stress periods. VER is most informative in moment-stable environments and should be complemented by volatility-level diagnostics during abrupt jump driven crisis. VER is easy to implement and complements standard backtesting by tracking VaR conservatism in real time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VaR效率比（VER），即模型VaR与Cantelli隐含VaR之比，作为VaR模型的实时预警指标。实证发现VER下降能提前预示VaR违规，在传统回测发现问题前发出模型 recalibration 信号。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够在VaR模型失效（违规）发生之前就发出预警信号的实时监测指标？
AI.motivation: 传统VaR回测方法（如无条件覆盖检验、独立性检验）只能在违规和损失发生后才能检测到模型问题，缺乏前瞻性预警能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Cantelli不等式（切比雪夫不等式的单边版本）构建理论VaR基准，通过模型VaR与该基准的比值（VER）衡量VaR模型的保守程度。
AI.method: 定义VER = 模型VaR / Cantelli隐含VaR（基于条件均值和方差计算）。使用2000-2025年S&P 500日收益率数据，采用滚动五年估计窗口，测试多种置信水平和预测期限。
AI.findings: (1) VER下降系统性先于VaR违规发生，提供提前预警；(2) 尾部置信水平越深，VER下降越明显；(3) VER在不同预测期限下基本不变；(4) 市场压力期VER呈现持续性行为；(5) VER在矩稳定环境中信息量最大，在跳跃驱动的危机中需辅以波动率诊断。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出VER这一新的理论指标，将Cantelli不等式应用于VaR模型的实时监控，弥补了传统事后回测方法缺乏前瞻性的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: VER计算简便，可实时跟踪VaR模型的保守程度，在传统回测发现问题之前发出模型重新校准的早期预警信号，提升风险管理的前瞻性。

title: Institutional Failure and Regressive Redistribution: Wealth Inequality in Pakistan through the Lens of Taxation and Institutional Weakness

detail.title: Institutional Failure and Regressive Redistribution: Wealth Inequality in Pakistan through the Lens of Taxation and Institutional Weakness

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based exclusively on publicly available secondary data and published literature. It did not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental procedures; therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or financial support from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The research was independently conducted by the author.

detail.abstract: Wealth inequality in Pakistan constitutes one of the most consequential and structurally entrenched challenges confronting the country's long-term development trajectory. Despite sustained economic activity across successive governments, the top decile of Pakistan's population controls approximately 59 percent of total national wealth, while the bottom half of the population receives barely 13 percent of national income, figures that reflect a deeply bifurcated distributional outcome rather than a single measure (World Inequality Database, 2023). This paper investigates the mechanisms through which institutional weakness and a regressive taxation architecture jointly perpetuate and deepen wealth inequality in Pakistan. Drawing on a systematic qualitative analysis of secondary data sourced from the World Bank, the International Monetary Fund, the Federal Board of Revenue, the State Bank of Pakistan, the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, the World Inequality Database, and the United Nations Development Programme, the study constructs a causal analytical framework linking extractive institutional configurations to fiscal incapacity and elite capture, which in turn structurally undermine progressive redistribution. explain why repeated reform efforts fail. Policy implications centre on broadening the direct tax base, dismantling politically protected exemptions, strengthening the Federal Board of Revenue's institutional autonomy, and scaling targeted social transfers to mitigate the regressive incidence of existing indirect taxation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性定性分析，揭示制度弱点和累退性税收结构如何共同加剧巴基斯坦的财富不平等，并解释改革屡屡失败的原因。
AI.research_question: 制度弱点和累退性税收结构如何共同持续并加深巴基斯坦的财富不平等？为什么改革努力屡屡失败？
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦财富分配极度不均（顶层10%控制约59%财富，底层50%仅获得13%收入），这一问题长期阻碍国家发展，但既有研究对其深层机制缺乏系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 提取性制度配置→财政能力不足→精英俘获→阻碍再分配改革，形成因果分析框架。
AI.method: 系统性定性分析，数据来源包括世界银行、国际货币基金组织、巴基斯坦联邦税务局、巴基斯坦国家银行、巴基斯坦统计局、世界不平等数据库、联合国开发计划署等二手数据。
AI.findings: 提取性制度安排导致财政能力受限，精英俘获固化利益格局，累退性税收结构（间接税为主）进一步恶化分配，改革受到政治庇护网络的系统性阻挠。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了"制度-财政-俘获"因果分析框架，解释发展中经济体财富不平等持续和改革失败的内在机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出拓宽直接税基、废除政治保护性税收豁免、增强联邦税务局自主权、扩大定向社会转移支付等政策建议。

title: Threatening in the Shadow of Invalidity: Duress, Hold-Up, and Exploitation of Necessity

detail.title: Threatening in the Shadow of Invalidity: Duress, Hold-Up, and Exploitation of Necessity
detail.abstract: This article seeks to advance a unified theory of the legal treatment of promises obtained through pressure, with reference to the cases of duress, holdup , and the exploitation of a state of necessity. The problem is reconstructed by starting from the distinction between the voluntariness of the choice and the validity of the promise. A party may accept a contractual proposal in a knowing and rational manner while nonetheless finding itself in a condition of substantial need and with severely reduced reasonable alternatives. The question to be addressed concerns the validity of the contract so obtained.

AI.tldr: 本文旨在构建一个关于通过压力获得承诺的法律处理的统一理论，涵盖胁迫、劫持和利用紧急状态等情形，通过区分选择的自愿性与承诺的有效性来探讨合同效力问题。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的关于通过压力（胁迫、劫持、利用紧急状态）获得的承诺的法律处理理论？
AI.motivation: 现有法律对不同类型的压力下做出的承诺处理分散且不一致，需要建立一个统一的理论框架来系统解释和指导这些情形的法律判断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 选择的自愿性（voluntariness of choice）与承诺的有效性（validity of promise）的区分理论
AI.method: 理论分析/规范性法学研究
AI.findings: 一方可能在知情且理性的情况下接受合同提议，但同时处于实质性需求状态且合理替代选择严重减少，此时需要审视该合同的效力问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的理论框架来处理胁迫、劫持和利用紧急状态三种压力情形下的合同效力问题，将自愿性与有效性进行概念区分。
AI.practical_contributions: 为司法实践中判断在压力下签订的合同是否有效提供了统一的理论依据和思考路径。

title: The Sound of Coaching Source Language Interference and Regional Lexis as Forensic Markers of Rehearsed Testimony in Indian Health Insurance Fraud

detail.title: The Sound of Coaching Source Language Interference and Regional Lexis as Forensic Markers of Rehearsed Testimony in Indian Health Insurance Fraud

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or non-financial conflicts of interest in relation to this paper. The author has no commercial, financial, or other relationship with any insurer, third-party administrator, or other entity discussed in this paper and has not received compensation from any party with an interest in the subject matter. The field observation described in this paper arose from the author's independent professional activity in rural market research and advertising and is unconnected to any current or prospective commercial engagement.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper presents a theoretical and methodological framework and reports no claim-level empirical results. The qualitative field observation referenced in Section 3 and Appendix A was conducted prior to the author's academic affiliation with Deccan College and was not originally undertaken as formal research; it is reported here as contextual, motivating evidence and is not presented as a data-bearing empirical study. No human subjects data, personally identifiable information, or claimant records were collected, processed, or analysed for the purposes of this paper. Any future empirical study arising from the methodology proposed here, including the corpus collection and annotation protocol described in Section 5, will be submitted for institutional ethics review through Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute prior to data collection, consistent with the data governance and trauma-informed considerations set out in Section 5.4.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or funding from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was conducted as part of the author's independent post-dissertation research at the Department of Linguistics, Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute (Deemed University), Pune.

detail.abstract:
Health insurance fraud in India is increasingly organised, multilingual, and reliant on rehearsed testimony to evade verification by claims investigators. Existing fraud detection methods in this domain rely almost entirely on clinical and financial document analysis, leaving spoken testimony itself unexamined as a forensic resource. This paper proposes a methodological extension of the LIFS framework to the detection of coached testimony in Indian health insurance fraud investigations. LIFS (Linguistic Identification of Source Language Interference Feature Set) and RLI (Regional Lexis Index) are linguistic tools previously validated in the author’s master’s research and dissertation for detecting AI generated phishing text (LIFS) and regional dialect markers (RLI). 

We argue, on theoretical grounds supported by the cross-cultural deception literature and bilingual speech production research, that genuine first-language interference patterns are difficult to suppress under spontaneous speech conditions and that their absence in a speaker whose first language is not the language of the interview is itself a forensically meaningful signal. 

We further propose the RLI as a complementary measure of geographic authenticity in claimant testimony. The paper sets out four testable hypotheses, a proposed annotation and corpus design grounded in field observation of an organised fraud network operating across multiple Indian states, and a research agenda for empirical validation in partnership with an insurer or third-party administrator. If validated, this framework could enable insurers to flag coached testimony for human review, reducing fraud losses while protecting genuine claimants in India’s multilingual context. No claim-level empirical results are reported here; this is a framework and methodology paper intended to establish conceptual and methodological priority ahead of full empirical validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将LIFS和RLI语言学工具扩展到印度健康保险欺诈调查领域，用于检测被排练过的证词，目前仅为方法论框架，尚无比对实验数据。
AI.research_question: 如何利用语言学工具（LIFS和RLI）检测印度健康保险欺诈中被排练过的口头证词？
AI.motivation: 印度健康保险欺诈日益组织化、多语言化，且依赖排练证词规避调查，现有欺诈检测方法仅分析临床和财务文件，未将口头证词作为法医学资源加以利用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨文化欺骗文献、双语言语产出研究——母语干扰模式在自发言语条件下难以抑制，非母语受访者缺乏这种干扰模式本身即具有法医学意义。
AI.method: 方法论扩展论文，提出四项可检验假设，基于对跨州有组织欺诈网络的实地观察设计标注方案和语料库，计划与保险公司或第三方管理者合作进行实证验证。
AI.findings: 目前无实证结果，本文仅为框架与方法论论文，旨在在完整实证验证前确立概念与方法论的优先权。
AI.theory_contributions: 将LIFS（原用于检测AI生成钓鱼文本）和RLI（区域方言标记）扩展至保险欺诈证词检测领域，提出"母语干扰缺失本身即为法医学信号"的理论观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 若验证有效，可帮助保险公司标记排练证词进行人工审查，减少欺诈损失，同时保护印度多语言环境中的真实索赔人。

title: When States Break Promises: Informal Insurance Responses to Pension Reform
affiliations: Florida Institute of Technology

detail.title: When States Break Promises: Informal Insurance Responses to Pension Reform
detail.abstract: When governments expand pension systems, families reduce intergenerational transfers. This paper tests the reverse: do families substitute back toward informal insurance when governments renege on pension promises? I study Russia’s 2014 funded pension freeze, which eliminated future contributions for workers born after 1967, using RLMS panel data (2010–2023) and a cohort difference-in-differences design. Affected households increased financial transfers to adult children by 3.5 percentage points under a conservative age×year fixed effects specification and by 6.5 percentage points in the baseline—a 17–30 percent increase relative to pre-reform rates. To address the core identification challenge that treated households are mechanically younger, I exploit wage-based variation within the treated cohort: because the freeze diverted 6 percent of wages to frozen accounts, higher-wage workers lost more pension wealth and show monotonically larger transfer responses (4.1 percentage points per standard deviation, p = 0.013). A placebo test on control households—who were unaffected by the freeze and faced identical macroeconomic conditions—yields a precisely estimated zero wage dose-response (−1.0 percentage points, p = 0.50), ruling out general income effects as an alternative explanation. A falsification test reinforces this interpretation: transfers to children rise significantly (7.4 percentage points, p = 0.005) while transfers to parents do not (2.8 percentage points, p = 0.12). The response is entirely on the extensive margin—households initiate new transfer relationships rather than scaling up existing ones—and is concentrated among small households and rural areas. These patterns are consistent with parents investing in non-resident children as a source of old-age support. Collectively, the findings provide evidence that even in middle-income settings with well-established state pensions, families retain the capacity to rebuild informal insurance networks when formal systems fail.

AI.tldr: 本文研究俄罗斯2014年养老金冻结政策如何影响家庭代际转移。利用RLMS面板数据(2010-2023)和队列双重差分设计，发现受影响家庭增加了对成年子女的经济转移（幅度17-30%），且这一效应主要源于高工资工人（养老金损失更大者）的更强反应。安慰剂检验和证伪检验支持了养老金替代效应的解释，而非一般收入效应。结果表明，即便在拥有成熟国家养老金的中等收入国家，家庭仍有能力在正式制度失灵时重建非正式保险网络。
AI.research_question: 当政府缩减养老金承诺时，家庭是否会重新转向非正式保险（增加代际转移）以替代缺失的正式保障？
AI.motivation: 已有文献证实政府扩大养老金会减少家庭代际转移，但反向关系——政府削减养老金时家庭是否增加代际转移——尚缺乏因果证据。俄罗斯2014年养老金冻结政策提供了一个准自然实验情境，可以检验正式制度失灵时家庭非正式保险的替代能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际转移的替代理论（公共转移挤出私人转移）、家庭内部风险分担与互保理论、养老金财富效应理论。
AI.method: 队列双重差分设计（cohort difference-in-differences），利用RLMS面板数据（2010-2023年）；结合处理队列内部的工资变异进行剂量-反应分析；安慰剂检验（控制组队列）和证伪检验（区分对子女与对父母的转移）。
AI.findings: (1)受影响家庭对成年子女的经济转移增加了3.5-6.5个百分点（17-30%）；(2)高工资工人（养老金损失更大）的转移反应更大（每标准差4.1个百分点）；(3)控制组中工资剂量-反应效应为零，排除一般收入效应；(4)对子女转移增加（7.4个百分点）而对父母转移不显著（2.8个百分点），符合养老互保逻辑；(5)效应集中在广延边际（建立新转移关系），且集中于小家庭和农村地区。
AI.theory_contributions: 反向验证了公共养老金与私人代际转移之间的替代关系；揭示了家庭非正式保险网络的韧性——即便在正式制度长期存在后，家庭仍保留重建替代性保障机制的能力；为养老金制度改革的社会福利影响提供了微观机制证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为养老金政策改革提供了重要警示：削减养老金承诺可能导致家庭重新依赖代际转移，这会加剧不平等（高工资家庭反应更强）；提示政策制定者在改革正式保障体系时需考虑家庭层面的替代行为及其福利后果；对新兴市场经济体的养老金改革具有参考价值。

title: Structural Optionality and Productive Transformation: Evidence from a Six-Country Historical Panel
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Structural Optionality and Productive Transformation: Evidence from a Six-Country Historical Panel
detail.abstract: This paper proposes OPT_wtd, a measure of structural optionality that captures the complexity weighted upgrading potential encoded in a country’s export basket. Applied to a six-country panel (Japan, Italy, Germany, France, Belgium, Argentina, T0 = 1880, T1 = 1910), OPT_wtd ranks structural upgrading with Kendall τ = +0.966 (p = 0.007); OLS on n = 6 yields β̂ = +0.624 (SE = 0.188, R² = 0.735, p = 0.029). Within-country arc-level evidence for Japan confirms the adjacency mechanism (S = 0.857 of realised growth within the predicted reachable set, permutation benchmark 0.354). Two boundary conditions delimit the domain: Spain (OPT =  0.677, residual =− 0.326) establishes that optionality is not sufficient when institutional capacity is near zero; the United Kingdom establishes frontier saturation, where OPT_wtd collapses to zero and decline is measurable only as world-share erosion in high-complexity nodes (ρ(ΔOPT_fr_high, ΔCR) = +0.702, n = 11). A pre-registered second-episode test on Japan 1910–1939 (LTES P1™) yields ΔCR = +0.160 with all predicted arcs traversed, confirming portability of the arc-level mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OPT_wtd指标衡量一国出口篮子的结构性可选性，通过多国面板数据验证其预测产业升级的能力，并识别了制度能力和前沿饱和两个边界条件。
AI.research_question: 如何衡量一国出口结构中的升级潜力？OPT_wtd指标能否有效预测结构性升级？其适用边界条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有结构性升级指标未能充分捕捉出口篮子中编码的复杂性加权升级潜力，需要一种更精细的度量方法来预测产业升级路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性可选性（structural optionality）、经济复杂性、邻接机制（adjacency mechanism）、边界条件理论
AI.method: 构建OPT_wtd指标，采用六国面板（1880-1910）进行Kendall秩相关和OLS回归；日本国内弧级证据检验；西班牙和英国的边界条件案例分析；日本1910-1939年注册第二时期验证。
AI.findings: OPT_wtd与结构升级高度相关（Kendall τ=+0.966）；日本弧级证据确认邻接机制（S=0.857）；西班牙案例表明制度能力不足时可选性不充分；英国案例显示前沿饱和时OPT_wtd归零；日本第二时期验证了机制的可移植性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了OPT_wtd这一新的结构性可选性度量指标，识别了制度能力和前沿饱和两个边界条件，验证了邻接机制在不同时期和国家的可移植性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估产业升级潜力的新工具；揭示了制度能力对产业升级的必要性；指出了前沿经济体只能通过高复杂性节点的世界份额变化来衡量衰退的局限。

title: CRUACHAN: Stochastic, Tail-Aware Capital Allocation for Business Loan Origination: A two-stage stochastic programme with Conditional Value-at-Risk and chance constraints for SME loan-book construction under regulatory-capital, funding and concentration limits

detail.title: CRUACHAN: Stochastic, Tail-Aware Capital Allocation for Business Loan Origination: A two-stage stochastic programme with Conditional Value-at-Risk and chance constraints for SME loan-book construction under regulatory-capital, funding and concentration limits
detail.abstract: Business-loan origination is a constrained resource-allocation problem: a lender must select and size facilities from a pipeline of applicants so as to maximise risk-adjusted profit while respecting a binding regulatory-capital envelope, a funding budget, and single-name and sector concentration limits. The conventional toolkit — greedy margin ranking, RAROC ordering, and pro-rata participation — optimises a point estimate of return and is structurally blind to the joint tail of the loss distribution, where correlated defaults concentrate. We present CRUACHAN, a two-stage stochastic programme that places Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) at the centre of the origination decision. Losses are generated by a multi-factor Vasicek / Asymptotic Single Risk Factor model calibrated to Basel IRB inputs; the optimisation maximises expected profit net of a CVaR penalty subject to capital, funding, and concentration constraints, and supports a solvency chance constraint discharged through the Nemirovski–Shapiro CVaR safe approximation. Using the Rockafellar–Uryasev linearisation, the model reduces to a single linear programme solved by sample-average approximation. On a synthetic pipeline of 500 UK SME applicants, we show that, holding expected profit fixed at the greedy-margin level, CRUACHAN reduces the 97.5% portfolio-loss CVaR by roughly two thirds (16.18 to 5.46, in £m), and dominates pro-rata participation on both return and tail simultaneously. We document the out-of-sample optimism of sample-average approximation, validate that the chance-constraint approximation is reliably conservative, and trace an efficient frontier that subsumes the heuristics as exceptional cases. All code; synthetic data and figures are released for replication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRUACHAN模型，一种以CVaR为中心的两阶段随机规划方法，用于银行贷款发放决策。相比传统贪婪排序、RAROC等方法，该模型在保持预期利润不变的情况下，将97.5%的投资组合损失CVaR降低了约三分之二，显著优于传统启发式方法。
AI.research_question: 如何在受资本约束、资金预算和集中度限制的贷款发放问题中，优化风险调整后的利润，并系统性地考虑损失分布的尾部风险？
AI.motivation: 传统贷款发放工具（贪婪边际排序、RAROC排序、按比例参与）仅优化收益的点估计，结构性地忽视了损失分布的联合尾部（即相关违约集中发生的风险），导致对极端风险缺乏控制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 条件风险价值（CVaR）；多因子Vasicek/渐近单风险因子（ASRF）模型；Nemirovski–Shapiro CVaR安全近似；Rockafellar–Uryasev线性化；样本平均近似（SAA）。
AI.method: 两阶段随机规划，以CVaR为中心的目标函数（最大化预期利润减去CVaR罚项），约束条件包括资本、资金和集中度限制，并支持通过Nemirovski–Shapiro CVaR安全近似实现的偿付能力机会约束。利用Rockafellar–Uryasev线性化将模型简化为单个线性规划，通过样本平均近似求解。
AI.findings: 在500家英国中小企业申请人的合成管道上，保持预期利润与贪婪边际水平相同时，CRUACHAN将97.5%投资组合损失CVaR从16.18百万英镑降至5.46百万英镑（约降低三分之二），且在收益和尾部风险两方面均优于按比例参与。文档记录了样本平均近似的样本外乐观偏差，验证了机会约束近似的可靠保守性，并绘制了包络各启发式方法作为特例的有效前沿。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将CVaR置于贷款发放决策的核心，构建了一个结构性地处理损失分布联合尾部的优化框架，将传统启发式方法作为有效前沿上的特例纳入统一框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可直接用于实践的线性规划模型，显著降低极端损失风险（CVaR降低约三分之二），释放了代码、合成数据和图表供复现。

title: Index Funds, Active-Investor Selection, and the Re-Sorting of Factor Premia An Extension of Stambaugh [2014] *
affiliations: Innovation Strategy Consulting LLC

detail.title: Index Funds, Active-Investor Selection, and the Re-Sorting of Factor Premia An Extension of Stambaugh [2014] *

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is founder and principal of Innovation Strategy Consulting LLC, whose service lines include quantitative-finance advisory and regime-based portfolio allocation, and maintains a personal investment portfolio that may include the factor-tilt strategies analysed in this paper. All research and code were produced in a personal capacity; the views expressed are the author's own and do not constitute investment advice.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses only publicly available aggregate financial data (Kenneth French Data Library, ICI Fact Book, and exchange-traded-fund prices) and involves no human or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: A common critique of indexed investing holds that the displacement of active capital reduces price discovery and impairs market efficiency. Stambaugh [2014], in his AFA Presidential Address, argued the opposite: index funds primarily displace noise traders, which shrinks the mispricings active managers exploit and therefore reduces the equilibrium footprint of active management. This paper extends the Stambaugh mechanism to the cross-section of equity factors. We show theoretically that not all factor premia are affected symmetrically: characteristics identifiable from price-based information (the value factor HML) compress disproportionately as passive share grows, while characteristics requiring sustained fundamental analysis (the quality factor QMJ) compress at a fraction of the rate. The decomposition has a clean economic interpretation: HML historically compensated active capital for absorbing noise-trader overreactions; QMJ compensates investors for sustained information processing. As noise traders exit the market, the absorption premium shrinks substantially while the information premium shrinks only modestly. We support the prediction with a calibrated simulator of the 1963–2024 monthly factor panel and with a real-data replication using Ken French (1963–2025) factors and factor ETFs (IWD, IWF, VLUE, QUAL, EFV, EFG). The differential-compression direction is statistically confirmed in real data: bootstrap CI on βˆH − βˆQ excludes zero; the Russell 1000 IWD−IWF spread compressed at −8.4%/yr in 2020–2025, the steepest of any sub-period. The paper closes with implications for active manager mandate design, retail portfolio construction in a high-passive world, and the empirical interpretation of the so-called “death of value” literature.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了Stambaugh（2014）的机制至截面因子层面，理论证明被动投资增长对不同因子溢价影响不对称：基于价格信息的价值因子（HML）溢价压缩显著，而需要持续基本面分析的质量因子（QMJ）溢价压缩幅度较小。通过模拟和真实数据验证了这一差异压缩方向，并讨论了主动管理、零售投资组合构建及"价值投资消亡"文献的含义。
AI.research_question: 被动投资（指数化投资）的增长如何不对称地影响不同股票因子（如价值因子HML和质量因子QMJ）的溢价？
AI.motivation: 已有研究（Stambaugh, 2014）从理论上论证了指数基金主要替代噪声交易者而非主动资本，从而减少主动管理者的套利机会并降低主动管理的均衡规模。但该机制在截面因子层面的异质性影响尚不清楚，作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: Stambaugh（2014）机制——指数基金替代噪声交易者、减少错误定价、降低主动管理均衡规模的理论；因子溢价分解为"吸收溢价"（补偿主动资本吸收噪声交易者过度反应）与"信息溢价"（补偿持续信息处理）的双元框架。
AI.method: 理论建模；校准模拟器（1963–2024月度因子面板数据）；真实数据复制检验（Ken French 1963–2025因子数据及因子ETF数据：IWD、IWF、VLUE、QUAL、EFV、EFG）；Bootstrap置信区间统计检验。
AI.findings: (1) 不同因子溢价受被动投资增长的影响不对称：价值因子HML压缩幅度大，质量因子QMJ压缩幅度小；(2) 经济机制解释：HML补偿吸收噪声交易者过度反应（吸收溢价），QMJ补偿持续信息处理（信息溢价）；(3) 噪声交易者退场后，吸收溢价大幅萎缩，信息溢价仅小幅缩减；(4) 真实数据中差异压缩方向统计显著：βˆH − βˆQ的Bootstrap置信区间排除零；2020–2025年Russell 1000 IWD−IWF利差以年均-8.4%的速度压缩，为各子时期中最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Stambaugh（2014）的被动投资影响机制从市场整体层面扩展至截面因子层面，揭示了因子溢价受被动化影响的不对称性，提出了因子溢价的"吸收溢价"与"信息溢价"二元分解框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 对主动管理基金经理的授权设计、高被动化世界中的零售投资组合构建、以及"价值投资消亡"相关文献的实证解释提供了明确的理论指导和实践启示。

title: Exchangeability, Dependence, and Cause: de Finetti, Kolmogorov, and the Italian and Russian Schools at the Foundations of Causal Inference
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, George Mason University and

detail.title: Exchangeability, Dependence, and Cause: de Finetti, Kolmogorov, and the Italian and Russian Schools at the Foundations of Causal Inference
detail.abstract: Did Bruno de Finetti and the Italian school of probability work on causal inference? Taken literally, no: the average treatment effect, ignorability, and graphs were codified elsewhere and later. Yet this negative answer hides a positive one. The Italian school's operational, subjectivist program—above all de Finetti's theory of exchangeability—is the predictive foundation on which the applied estimation of average treatment effects now rests. We develop de Finetti's representation and partial-exchangeability theorems and show how they underwrite the Neyman–Rubin potential-outcome model, the average treatment effect as a functional of a completed data array, and the workhorse estimators of applied practice: outcome regression, inverse-probability weighting, and the doubly robust estimator, the last linked through orthogonality to modern machine-learning implementations. The propensity score appears as a de Finettian sufficiency reduction, and prediction-first methods as the operational realization of the program. A parallel foundation was laid by the Russian school of Kolmogorov and Markov, whose calculus of conditioning and conditional independence is the machinery on which the structural (graphical) program runs; between them the two great probability schools furnished the two halves of modern causal inference, neither having pursued causation. We set this against the long causal debate from Fisher and Neyman to Rubin and Pearl.

AI.tldr: 本文论证意大利概率学派（特别是de Finetti的可交换性理论）为现代因果推断中平均处理效应的预测基础提供了理论根基，同时俄国概率学派（Kolmogorov与Markov）的条件概率与条件独立性理论为结构因果模型提供了数学工具，两大概率学派分别奠定了现代因果推断的两个核心支柱。
AI.research_question: 意大利概率学派（de Finetti及其可交换性理论）是否以及如何为现代因果推断奠定基础？两大概率学派（意大利学派与俄国学派）对因果推断的理论贡献分别是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管de Finetti和意大利学派并未直接研究因果推断（如平均处理效应、可忽略性、因果图等概念是后来在其他地方被形式化的），但他们的预测主义框架（尤其是可交换性理论）实际上构成了现代因果推断中估计平均处理效应的操作性基础。文章试图揭示这一被忽视的理论联系。
